Preoperative imaging missed the torsion and was equivocal for the tumor. On exploration the left testis was ischemic from threefold rotation, while the right testis was largely replaced by necrotic lesions. Frozen section suggested malignancy, prompting high right orchiectomy. Histology showed a mixed germ cell tumor containing all subtypes. The authors state that no similar case has been reported.

pmid-10755608.summary_ja: 胎盤の絨毛血管腫23例を再検討し、15例(65%)で栄養膜細胞の増殖と核異型を認めた。これは妊娠性絨毛性疾患に類似する所見である。MIB-1増殖指数も高値であった(35.4%対15.7%)。持続性の妊娠性絨毛性疾患は認めず、臨床経過は良好であった。「栄養膜細胞増殖を伴う絨毛血管腫」への再分類を提案している。
pmid-10755608.summary_en: This study re-reviewed 23 placental chorangiomas and found trophoblastic proliferation with nuclear atypia, resembling trophoblastic neoplasia, in 15 cases (65%). The cytotrophoblast MIB-1 proliferation index was higher in these lesions than in classic chorangiomas (35.4% vs 15.7%). No persistent gestational trophoblastic disease was recorded, and the clinical course appeared benign. The authors propose reclassifying these lesions as chorangiomas with trophoblastic proliferation, noting they are more common than the rarity of reported cases suggests.

pmid-10757400.summary_ja: 精巣の性索間質性腫瘍10例に、胚細胞が取り込まれた所見を検討した。多くは精原細胞様の非腫瘍性細胞で、胚細胞腫瘍マーカーは陰性であった。1例はセミノーマ様細胞を含み、セルトリ細胞腫瘍との衝突腫瘍と判断された。このような取り込み例は、真の未分類型混合型腫瘍より一般的であると結論している。
pmid-10757400.summary_en: This study describes ten testicular sex cord-stromal tumors containing entrapped germ cells, which mimicked the unclassified type of mixed germ cell sex cord-stromal tumor. Patients were aged 3 to 48 years. The germ cells usually resembled spermatogonia and did not stain for neoplastic germ cell markers. In one case, seminoma-like germ cells stained positively, and the lesion was interpreted as a collision tumor with a Sertoli cell tumor. The authors conclude that such entrapped germ cells are more common than true unclassified mixed tumors.

pmid-10758320.summary_ja: 1930年から1998年に診断された生後28日以内の新生児腫瘍23例を後方視的に検討した。奇形腫/胚細胞腫瘍が8例(35%)で最多であった。悪性胚細胞腫瘍の1例は手術と化学療法後に死亡し、未熟奇形腫の生存例も報告されている。先天異常の合併が多く、新生児への放射線療法は晩期障害のリスクがあると結論している。
pmid-10758320.summary_en: This Duke University review identified 23 neonates with neoplasms diagnosed within 28 days of birth between 1930 and 1998. Teratoma or germ cell tumor was the most common histology, at 8 cases (35%), followed by neuroblastoma and retinoblastoma. Among the teratoma and germ cell tumor patients, one malignant germ cell tumor patient died despite surgery and chemotherapy, while two immature teratomas and several teratomas had long-term survivors. The authors note frequent associated congenital anomalies and that radiotherapy in neonates carries late effects.

pmid-10758807.summary_ja: 19週の超音波検査で出生前に診断された、極めて稀な口腔咽頭奇形腫（エピグナトス）の症例報告である。文献レビューを併記している。予後は発症時期、手術の難易度、合併奇形、構成組織によって決まるとされる。妊娠中期の超音波検査が出生前診断に有用であることを示している。
pmid-10758807.summary_en: This case report describes the prenatal diagnosis of epignathus, an extremely rare oropharyngeal teratoma, detected by ultrasonography at 19 weeks of gestation. The authors also review the relevant literature. Congenital oral cavity teratomas typically present as masses projecting from the mouth, and prognosis depends on age at presentation, surgical difficulty, associated anomalies, and tissue composition. The report highlights the value of second-trimester ultrasound for identifying such lesions before delivery.

pmid-10761461.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ64例でサイトケラチン(CK)発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。CKは約4割で陽性だったが、年齢・病期・腫瘍径・予後との関連はなかった。胎児性癌ではCKやCD30が高率に陽性で、小さな生検検体でセミノーマと胎児性癌を鑑別するのに有用と示された。
pmid-10761461.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined cytokeratin expression in 64 testicular seminomas and 17 embryonal carcinomas. CK7, CAM 5.2, AE1/AE3 and WSK were positive in roughly one-third to two-fifths of seminomas, but CK positivity did not correlate with age, stage, tumor size or outcome. Embryonal carcinomas showed much higher CK and CD30 positivity. In small needle biopsies, CK and CD30 staining may help distinguish seminoma from embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-10765098.summary_ja: 臨床病期IIA/Bの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍187例を対象に、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清＋化学療法2サイクル群と初回化学療法3～4サイクル群を比較した前向き多施設試験。再発率は両群とも低く、射精障害は郭清群で多く、急性毒性は化学療法群で高かった。著者らは初回郭清を推奨し、QOLに有意差はないと報告した。
pmid-10765098.summary_en: This prospective multicenter German-Austrian trial compared primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection plus two cycles of chemotherapy with three to four cycles of primary chemotherapy in 187 patients with clinical stage IIA/B nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. Relapse rates were low in both arms (7% and 11%). Surgical complications and loss of ejaculation were more frequent in the surgery-first arm, while chemotherapy caused more acute toxicity. The authors recommend primary RPLND, with quality of life comparable between groups.

pmid-10767385.summary_ja: 1982〜1998年の成熟卵巣奇形腫251例のうち、悪性成分を含む症例は5例(2.0%)であった。全例で腫瘍マーカーの上昇と画像診断から術前に悪性が疑われた。病期Iの扁平上皮癌2例と境界悪性1例は生存したが、進行例2例は8か月以内に死亡した。術前診断の有用性が示唆された。
pmid-10767385.summary_en: This study of 251 mature ovarian teratomas (1982 to 1998) identified five cases (2.0%) containing malignant elements. All five were suspected of malignancy before surgery, based on elevated serum tumor markers (CA19-9, CA125, SCC, CEA) together with imaging. Two early-stage squamous cell carcinomas and one borderline malignancy survived, while two advanced cases died within eight months. The findings suggest that tumor markers and imaging can support preoperative detection of malignant transformation in mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-10767517.summary_ja: 1976〜1992年に治療された卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍75例を後方視的に検討した。腫瘍と併存した妊娠は10例で、純粋ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）では予後と胎児転帰に悪影響はみられなかった。保存的手術後に妊娠を希望した22例のうち12例が妊娠し、多くは正常分娩であった。白金製剤による化学療法は妊孕性を損なわないと考えられた。
pmid-10767517.summary_en: This review of 75 ovarian malignant germ cell tumors treated from 1976 to 1992 examined pregnancy association and outcomes. Ten patients had a pregnancy concurrent with the tumor. Pure dysgerminoma did not appear to worsen prognosis or fetal outcome, whereas two non-dysgerminomatous tumors caused deaths during the second trimester. Among 22 women who wished to conceive after conservative surgery, 12 conceived, mostly with normal births. Platinum-based chemotherapy did not appear to impair fertility.

pmid-10767692.summary_ja: 43歳男性で、硬化性粘液水腫とセミノーマの再発を併発した症例である。硬化性粘液水腫は稀に悪性腫瘍と関連するが、セミノーマとの関連は報告がなかった。セミノーマに対する化学療法後、皮膚病変は完全に消退し、腫瘍随伴症候群の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10767692.summary_en: The authors report a 43-year-old man with scleromyxedema and relapsed seminoma. Although scleromyxedema has occasionally been associated with neoplasms, the literature had shown no link with seminoma. Notably, the skin lesions cleared completely once the seminoma was treated with chemotherapy, suggesting a possible paraneoplastic association that warrants consideration in patients with unexplained scleromyxedema.

pmid-10768863.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA2などを用いてBrachyuryの発現を検討した。レチノイン酸による神経系への分化誘導後もmRNAとタンパク質は持続し、中胚葉由来の分化は認められなかった。卵黄嚢癌および絨毛癌の細胞株でも発現がみられた。ヒト奇形癌におけるBrachyury発現は中胚葉分化の指標とは限らないと結論された。
pmid-10768863.summary_en: The authors examined Brachyury expression in human embryonal carcinoma (teratocarcinoma) cell lines, including NTERA2, along with yolk sac carcinoma and choriocarcinoma lines. Brachyury mRNA and protein persisted in NTERA2 during retinoic acid-induced neural differentiation, with no mesodermal derivatives formed. Expression was also detected in non-differentiating embryonal carcinoma lines and in the other germ cell-derived lines, indicating that Brachyury expression in human teratocarcinoma does not necessarily signal mesodermal commitment.

pmid-10769719.summary_ja: 血清AFPとhCGが高値の17歳男性で、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。シスプラチン併用化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは低下したが腫瘍は増大し、切除標本は未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の混在であった。術後6か月で神経芽腫様細胞の播種により死亡した。血清NSEは転移の検出に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-10769719.summary_en: A 17-year-old man with elevated AFP and hCG was diagnosed with a primary mediastinal germ cell tumor. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy lowered the tumor markers, but the mass continued to grow, and resection showed a mixture of immature and mature teratoma. Six months after surgery he died of disseminated neuroblastomatous cells resembling the immature neural component. The authors describe this as a rare complication and suggest that serum NSE may help detect such metastasis.

pmid-10769802.summary_ja: 肉眼的血尿を主訴とした68歳男性で、絨毛癌成分を伴う腎盂・膀胱の移行上皮癌と診断された。術後のβ-hCG上昇にMVC化学療法を行ったが肺転移が出現したため、PEBによる救援化学療法を施行した。β-hCGは正常化し転移は消失した。β-hCGのモニタリングが治療評価に有用であった。
pmid-10769802.summary_en: A 68-year-old man with gross hematuria was diagnosed with high-grade urothelial carcinoma of the renal pelvis and bladder containing a choriocarcinomatous component. Postoperative serum β-hCG rose, and MVC chemotherapy was given. After lung metastases appeared, salvage PEB chemotherapy normalized β-hCG and eliminated the metastases. The case shows that β-hCG can guide management of urothelial tumors with choriocarcinomatous differentiation.

pmid-10770066.summary_ja: 47歳男性の前縦隔の13 cm大の腫瘍で、AFPおよびβ-hCGの上昇と針生検から混合型の原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。BEP療法3コース後に外科的切除を行い、病理学的には成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。9か月間再発は認められていない。
pmid-10770066.summary_en: A 47-year-old man had a 13 cm anterior mediastinal mass with elevated AFP and β-hCG. Needle biopsy led to a diagnosis of primary mediastinal germ cell tumor with mixed seminomatous and non-seminomatous elements. After three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, surgical resection including left upper lobectomy and partial pericardiectomy was performed. Pathology of the resected mass revealed a mature cystic teratoma. No recurrence was observed during nine months of follow-up.

pmid-10773407.summary_ja: 本研究は、p53の状態が異なる2種のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株を用い、カフェインによる放射線増感効果を検討した。2 mMのカフェインは両株で放射線誘導性G2期停止を減少させた。変異型p53株では高線量域まで増感が認められ、p53非依存的経路によるアポトーシスが誘導された。
pmid-10773407.summary_en: This study examined whether caffeine radiosensitizes two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines differing in p53 status. Caffeine at 2 mM reduced radiation-induced G2 arrest in both lines. Survival reduction with the combination occurred at lower doses in the wild-type p53 line, while in the mutant-p53 line radiosensitization extended to higher doses. Irradiation combined with caffeine induced apoptosis in mutant-p53 cells through a p53-independent pathway, suggesting potential for radiotherapy enhancement regardless of p53 status.

pmid-10774080.summary_ja: ナイロビのケニヤッタ国立病院における1983～1997年の精巣がん患者を後方視的に検討した。セミノーマが最多で、奇形腫、胎児性癌が続いた。精巣摘除と放射線療法・化学療法が行われたが、シスプラチン系レジメンは使用されず、5年生存率は38.89%にとどまった。シスプラチン系化学療法の導入が推奨されている。
pmid-10774080.summary_en: This retrospective study of 39 histologically confirmed testicular cancer patients at Kenyatta National Hospital, Nairobi (1983-1997) assessed presentation, histology, treatment and outcome. Seminoma was most common, followed by teratoma and embryonal carcinoma. Many patients received orchidectomy combined with radiotherapy or chemotherapy, but no cisplatin-based regimen was used. Five-year survival was only 38.89%, and the authors recommend including cisplatin-based chemotherapy to improve outcomes.

pmid-10776985.summary_ja: 食道扁平上皮癌の53歳男性がシスプラチンと5-FUによる治療を受けたが、女性化乳房と全身状態の悪化が出現した。ホルモン産生性の絨毛癌が食道扁平上皮癌内に発生していたと診断された。救援化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは変化したが腫瘍は縮小しなかった。扁平上皮癌内発生例は化学療法抵抗性となり得ると結論づけている。
pmid-10776985.summary_en: A 53-year-old man with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma received cisplatin plus 5-fluorouracil, then developed gynecomastia and clinical deterioration. Diagnosis revealed a hormone-secreting choriocarcinoma arising within the esophageal squamous tumor, an extragonadal germ cell tumor. Salvage chemotherapy altered tumor markers but not the tumor itself. The authors conclude that extragonadal choriocarcinoma is chemosensitive, but when arising within esophageal squamous cell carcinoma it may be chemoresistant and fatal.

pmid-10779021.summary_ja: 凍結保存された小児卵黄嚢腫瘍16例（精巣10例、性腺外6例）を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した。20q、1q、11q、22の増加と6q、16q、1pの欠失が多くみられた。8q24の局所的増加とc-mycの増幅を2例で認めた。成人例と異なる遺伝学的特徴が示唆された。
pmid-10779021.summary_en: Sixteen frozen childhood endodermal sinus tumors (10 testicular, 6 extragonadal) were analyzed by comparative genomic hybridization to define genetic changes. Common alterations included gains of 20q, 1q, 11q and 22, and losses of 6q (common deleted region 6q24-qter), 16q and 1p. Localized gain at 8q24 with c-myc amplification was found in two tumors. A 12p gain, typical of adolescent germ cell tumors, appeared in one testicular tumor. The results distinguish childhood from adult tumors and highlight chromosome 6 loss for future study.

pmid-10782007.summary_ja: 胎児期に診断された仙尾部奇形腫が、高拍出性心不全・胎児水腫・直腸閉鎖・尿路閉塞を引き起こした症例を報告する。妊娠27週に子宮切開下で腫瘍を完全切除し、尿路変更と同時に引き抜き式肛門直腸形成術を施行した。出生後に心合併症で死亡したものの、同時施行を伴う胎児期完全切除の初例と結論づけている。
pmid-10782007.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratoma that caused high-output cardiac failure, hydrops, rectal atresia, and urinary obstruction. At 27 weeks' gestation, the tumor was completely resected in utero via hysterotomy, with bilateral ureterostomies for urinary diversion and concurrent pull-through anorectoplasty. The neonate died of a cardiac complication after delivery. The authors report this as the first complete prenatal resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma with simultaneous anorectoplasty.

pmid-10785479.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍(OGCT)の染色体ヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)を、精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と比較して解析した。32例の35検体について腫瘍と構成DNAの対を用い、62個のマイクロサテライトマーカーで8つの染色体領域を検討した。全組織型で3q27-q28、5q31、5q34-q35、9p22-p21、12q22に共通の欠失を認めた。両腫瘍に共通の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の存在が示唆された。
pmid-10785479.summary_en: This study examined loss of heterozygosity (LOH) in malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (OGCTs) and compared the findings with testicular germ cell tumors. Paired tumor and constitutional DNA from 35 specimens in 32 patients were microdissected and analyzed with 62 microsatellite markers across eight chromosomal regions. Common deletions were found at 3q27-q28, 5q31, 5q34-q35, 9p22-p21, and 12q22 in all histologic subtypes. These regions overlap those implicated in early testicular tumor development, suggesting shared tumor suppressor genes.

pmid-10786678.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ57例の後方視的研究で、体積加重平均核体積(MNV)の予後予測能を検討した。全例が精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた。MNVは病期II群で病期I群より大きく、多変量解析でリンパ節転移を予測する唯一の変数であった。病期I例ではMNVのみが無増悪生存期間と相関した。MNVは監視療法の対象から除外すべき患者の選別に有用と考えられる。
pmid-10786678.summary_en: This retrospective study of 57 patients with testicular seminoma evaluated whether volume-weighted mean nuclear volume (MNV) predicts prognosis. All patients underwent orchiectomy followed by radiation therapy. MNV was larger in stage 2 than stage 1 disease, and on multivariate analysis it was the only variable predicting lymph node metastasis. In stage 1 patients, MNV alone correlated with progression-free survival. The authors suggest MNV may help identify patients who can be excluded from surveillance protocols.

pmid-10789906.summary_ja: 4歳児の腸骨に偶発的に発見された大きな骨腫瘤を報告する。病理学的には良性の成熟奇形腫であった。骨内成熟奇形腫の報告はこれまでにないとされる。本児は出生前に発見された頸部未熟奇形腫を生後6日目に切除しており、同部位の再発を2度認め、再発のたびに成熟度が高まった。腸骨病変の発見時、頸部に残存病変はなかった。
pmid-10789906.summary_en: This report describes a 4-year-old child with an incidentally discovered iliac bone mass, pathologically a benign mature teratoma. The authors believe intraosseous mature teratoma has not been previously reported. The child had earlier been treated for an immature teratoma of the neck, detected prenatally and resected on day 6 of life. That neck tumor recurred twice, each time appearing more mature. No residual neck disease was present when the iliac lesion was found. Radiologic and pathologic features, differential diagnosis, and clinical course are discussed.

pmid-10790992.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の約半数を占める精巣セミノーマの治療と予後を概説した総説である。大半は早期病期で発見され、治癒する。病期Iでは精巣摘除術後に監視療法か後腹膜放射線療法を選択できる。病期IIAは後腹膜放射線療法が一般的で、カルボプラチンによる化学療法も代替となる。大きな後腹膜リンパ節腫大や遠隔転移（病期IIB、III）にはシスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法が標準とされる。
pmid-10790992.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes the treatment and prognosis of testicular seminoma, which accounts for about half of testicular germ cell tumors. Most patients present with early-stage disease and are cured. Stage I patients may choose surveillance or adjuvant retroperitoneal radiotherapy after orchiectomy. Stage IIA is usually treated with retroperitoneal radiation, with carboplatin as an alternative. Bulky nodal or distant disease (stage IIB, III) is treated with cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy, and about 85-90% of stage III patients are cured.

pmid-10790993.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)の治療選択肢を概説した総説である。日本では病期Iに対する監視療法が最も広く受け入れられている。ただし再発率は約30%と高く、リスクに応じた治療プロトコルの確立が必要とされる。病期II初期では、初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清と初回化学療法の治癒率は同等だが、射精障害や薬剤による不妊など毒性が異なる。予後良好例には、BEP療法3コースまたはエトポシド・シスプラチン併用療法4コースが標準とされる。
pmid-10790993.summary_en: This Japanese review covers treatment options for testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT). Surveillance is the most accepted option for stage I disease in Japan, but the relapse rate of about 30% supports risk-adapted protocols. For early stage II, primary RPLND and primary chemotherapy achieve equivalent cure rates but differ in toxicity, including ejaculatory disorders and drug-induced infertility. For good-prognosis disease, three cycles of BEP and four cycles of etoposide plus cisplatin are standard. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy, testicular cancer has become a model of curable cancer.

pmid-10790994.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療における過去20年間の主な進歩を概説した総説である。生存率は大きく改善し、多くの若年患者で妊孕性が温存されるようになった。また、本領域で未解決の主要な課題についても述べている。抄録は簡潔で、具体的なレジメンや予後データは示されていない。
pmid-10790994.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes major advances in therapy for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors over the past two decades. Survival has improved greatly, and reproductive potential is preserved in most young patients. The authors also outline major unresolved issues in the field. The abstract is brief, and specific regimens and outcome figures are not given in it.

pmid-10790995.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍は全胚細胞腫瘍の約3〜5%を占める。原発性か転移性かの診断は困難で、超音波検査が補助となる。治療は進行精巣腫瘍に準じ、シスプラチン併用化学療法と手術が中心で、セミノーマには放射線療法が有効である。IGCCCG分類による予後評価も有用とされる。
pmid-10790995.summary_en: This Japanese review addresses primary extratesticular germ cell tumors, which constitute about 3-5% of germ cell tumors. It discusses the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing primary from metastatic disease and the role of ultrasonography. Treatment generally follows approaches for advanced testicular tumors, usually cisplatin-based chemotherapy combined with surgery, while radiotherapy is effective for seminoma. The authors describe the IGCCCG prognostic classification, in which retroperitoneal primaries and poor markers define prognosis, and suggest that stem cell transplantation may improve outcomes in refractory disease.

pmid-10790996.summary_ja: 本総説は、初回治療に失敗した難治性精巣がんに対する救援治療を検討している。標準的な初回のBEP療法と救援手術により、転移性疾患の患者の約80%が完全寛解に至る。寛解に至らない、またはフォローアップ中に再発した患者が救援化学療法の対象となるが、VIPや大量化学療法と幹細胞移植の効果は限られる。日本ではイリノテカンが用いられ、米国と欧州ではパクリタキセルとゲムシタビンが検討されている。著者らは、より有効な新規レジメンの開発が必要と述べている。
pmid-10790996.summary_en: This review examines salvage treatment for refractory testicular cancer that fails initial therapy. Standard first-line BEP chemotherapy with salvage surgery achieves complete remission in about 80% of patients with metastatic disease. Those who do not reach remission or relapse during follow-up are candidates for salvage chemotherapy, including VIP or high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation, but benefit is limited. In Japan, irinotecan is used after these failures, while paclitaxel and gemcitabine are under investigation in the United States and Europe. The authors call for more effective novel regimens.

pmid-10792167.summary_ja: 552例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のうち11例(2%)が両側発生し、7例は異時性、4例は同時性であった。停留精巣や不妊などが関連しており、同時性例の多くは進行期で発見された。性機能は保たれ、中央値11.6年の追跡で全例が無病生存した。第2の胚細胞腫瘍が必ずしも予後不良を意味しないことが示された。
pmid-10792167.summary_en: This single-institution series of 552 testicular germ cell tumor patients identified 11 (2%) with bilateral disease. Seven developed metachronous tumors at a median of 87 months, and four had synchronous disease. Cryptorchidism, infertility or atrophic testis was associated with bilateral disease in most cases. Many synchronous tumors were advanced, while metachronous ones were early-stage. Platinum-based chemotherapy was used in five patients, sexual function was preserved, and no significant morbidity was noted. With a median follow-up of 11.6 years, all patients survived without evidence of cancer, suggesting that a second germ cell cancer does not necessarily imply poor prognosis.

pmid-10792792.summary_ja: 重度貧血で出生した新生児の満期胎盤から、羊膜面の2cm結節として胎盤内絨毛癌が見つかった症例報告である。免疫染色でhCGサブユニット、hPL、Ki-67が陽性であった。母児のCT・MRIで転移はなかった。胎盤に限局する絨毛癌はまれで見逃されやすいと指摘している。
pmid-10792792.summary_en: This case report describes intraplacental choriocarcinoma found in a term placenta from a newborn with severe anemia (Hb 3.0 g/dL). A 2 cm surface nodule resembled infarction. Immunohistochemistry was positive for alpha- and beta-hCG subunits, human placental lactogen and Ki-67, with necrosis and atypical trophoblastic proliferation destroying villi. CT and MRI of the mother and infant showed no metastases. The authors note that placenta-limited choriocarcinoma is very rare and often overlooked, and that it may arise in the placenta more often than in persistent trophoblast after pregnancy.

pmid-10795539.summary_ja: 無尿で受診した男性にみられた、まれな後腹膜原発セミノーマの症例報告である。超音波検査で大きな低エコー性腫瘤が描出され、CTでは正中部の均一で分葉状の腫瘤として確認された。精巣を原発としない後腹膜のセミノーマが存在することを示す症例である。画像所見の特徴を記した。
pmid-10795539.summary_en: This report describes a rare primary seminoma of the retroperitoneum in a man who presented with anuria. Ultrasonography revealed a large hypoechoic mass, and correlative computed tomography showed a midline, homogeneous, lobulated mass. The case highlights that seminoma can present as a primary retroperitoneal mass, so such lesions should be considered in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal tumors. The report illustrates the imaging features of this uncommon entity.

pmid-10796921.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の171例に行った235回の超音波検査を検討した研究である。28例に異常があり、腫瘤15例、不均一な変化11例、石灰化2例だった。精巣内腫瘤の67%、不均一な変化の27%でがんが確認された。精巣内腫瘤は常に懸念すべきで、全例で厳重なフォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-10796921.summary_en: This study categorizes ultrasonographic intratesticular abnormalities in 171 men after orchiectomy for testicular neoplasm, with 235 examinations. Abnormalities were found in 28 patients: masses in 15, heterogeneous changes in 11 and macrocalcification in 2. Cancer was present in 67% of patients with masses and 27% with heterogeneous changes. Patients without surgical correlation were disease-free on clinical follow-up. The authors conclude that intratesticular masses are always concerning and that rigorous follow-up is recommended in all patients to rule out malignancy.

pmid-10796922.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がん641例で、化学療法後の残存後腹膜腫瘤のCT計測と組織所見の関連を検討した。化学療法後の腫瘤径は残存腫瘍の有無と関連し、縮小率と臨床因子を加えるとモデルの精度が向上した(AUC 0.74から0.83)。切除の判断は腫瘤径だけでなく、複合的な所見に基づくべきである。
pmid-10796922.summary_en: In 641 men with nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent resection after chemotherapy with normal tumor markers, the authors assessed whether CT measurements predict the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses. Residual masses were benign in 302 patients and contained tumor (mature teratoma or cancer) in 339. Post-chemotherapy mass size predicted residual tumor, while pre-chemotherapy size did not. Adding the reduction in size and clinical characteristics improved the model, with the area under the ROC curve rising from 0.74 to 0.83. The authors conclude that resection decisions should rely on these combined characteristics rather than size alone.

pmid-10799168.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の292例を対象とした。精巣摘除術標本における胎児性癌の優位性と血管侵襲が、全身再発の予測因子であった。病理病期Iの患者の再発率は10.2%であった。病理病期IIでは、補助化学療法を受けた患者に再発はなく、受けなかった患者では22.6%に再発がみられた。
pmid-10799168.summary_en: This retrospective study of 292 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) found that embryonal carcinoma predominance and vascular invasion in the orchiectomy specimen predicted systemic relapse. Among pathological stage I patients, relapse occurred in 10.2 percent. Among pathological stage II patients, none given adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed, while 22.6 percent of untreated patients did.

pmid-10799182.summary_ja: 本報告は、高リスクの臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に対し、手術や経過観察ではなく、初期の化学療法2サイクルを行うことを提案するものである。リスク適応型補助化学療法を受けた59例のうち、20例はシスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンで、39例はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンで治療された。長期成績は良好で、罹病性は限定的であった。補助化学療法は、フォローアップが不十分な場合に特に有用である可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-10799182.summary_en: This report proposes that patients with high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors receive two initial cycles of chemotherapy instead of surgery or observation. In 59 patients treated with risk-adapted adjuvant chemotherapy, first with cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin in 20 patients, and later with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin in 39 patients, long-term outcomes were excellent with limited morbidity. Adjuvant chemotherapy may be especially valuable when follow-up is compromised.

pmid-10799183.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の根拠を、既存の代替治療と著者の経験から概説した総説である。郭清単独で病理学的病期IIの50〜75%が根治し、小腸閉塞のリスクは約1%とされる。術後再発もシスプラチン併用化学療法でほぼ治癒可能であり、標準治療として位置づけられている。
pmid-10799183.summary_en: This review examines the rationale for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) in clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer, combining published alternatives with the authors' experience. RPLND alone cures 50 to 75 percent of patients with pathological stage II disease, with about a 1 percent risk of small bowel obstruction. Relapses after RPLND are almost always curable with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors conclude RPLND remains standard therapy and retains both treatment and staging roles.

pmid-10799184.summary_ja: 本単施設報告は、1992年から1999年に臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんの73例に対し、修正片側テンプレート郭清を用いて腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った結果を示す。開腹移行率は2.7%、軽度合併症は6.8%で、全例で射精機能が温存された。後腹膜再発は偽陰性の組織所見に起因する1例のみで、3年以上のフォローアップで手術の失敗による再発はなかった。
pmid-10799184.summary_en: This single-center report describes 73 patients who underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with modified unilateral template dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular cancer between 1992 and 1999. The conversion rate was 2.7 percent, minor complications 6.8 percent, and ejaculation was preserved in all patients. Only one retroperitoneal relapse occurred, attributed to false-negative histology, and no surgical-failure recurrences were seen over more than 3 years of follow-up.

pmid-10810274.summary_ja: 副腎に発生した類皮嚢腫の初の単側性症例報告。胚発生と画像所見を検討している。類皮嚢腫は成熟囊胞性奇形腫であり、性腺外に生じた胚細胞腫瘍として本サイトの対象となる。抄録には治療や経過の詳細は乏しいが、稀な性腺外発生例として位置づけられる貴重な報告である。
pmid-10810274.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst arising in the adrenal gland, the first unilateral adrenal case reported. The authors discuss its embryonal development and imaging features. Dermoid cysts are mature cystic teratomas, which are germ cell tumors, and this is an extragonadal site. The abstract gives limited clinical detail on treatment or follow-up, but the case is directly relevant to germ cell tumor literature as an unusual extragonadal presentation.

pmid-10811491.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総説。成熟・未熟奇形腫は外科的切除が中心で、原発部位・未熟度・切除の完全性から再発リスクを推定できる。シスプラチン併用療法で約80%が長期寛解となり、原発腫瘍の完全切除が腫瘍マーカー値や原発部位より強力な予後因子とされる。
pmid-10811491.summary_en: This GPOH MAKEI and MAHO review summarizes management of childhood and adolescent germ cell tumors. Mature and immature teratomas are treated surgically, with recurrence risk depending on primary site, histological immaturity grade, and completeness of resection. Malignant GCTs make up 2.9% of pediatric malignancies, and over half arise at extragonadal sites. Cisplatin-based protocols achieve about 80% long-term remission. Complete primary resection is the strongest prognostic factor, outweighing tumor marker levels and primary site.

pmid-10811682.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍患者179例を対象にしたコホート研究で、シスプラチン併用化学療法中の重大な血栓塞栓症は8.4%に認められた。肝転移と制吐療法としての高用量デキサメタゾンが危険因子であり、予防的な配慮の必要性が示唆された。
pmid-10811682.summary_en: This cohort study of 179 male germ cell tumor patients, treated mostly with cisplatin-containing chemotherapy, found major thromboembolic complications in 8.4%, most of them venous, with one fatal event. Liver metastases and high-dose dexamethasone used as antiemetic therapy were independent risk factors. The authors also review the literature on thrombosis during chemotherapy for germ cell cancer. They conclude that patients with liver metastases or high steroid exposure are at considerable risk and may need preventive attention.

pmid-10812828.summary_ja: 56歳男性が急性腹症で受診し、当初は胃周囲膿瘍と診断された。開腹術で後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかり切除された。術後経過は順調で、2年後も残存病変は認められていない。後腹膜奇形腫は炎症性の急性腹症に類似しうるため、高齢者においても鑑別診断に含める必要があることを示す症例である。
pmid-10812828.summary_en: This case report describes a 56-year-old man who presented with acute abdomen and was initially diagnosed with a perigastric abscess. Exploratory surgery revealed a retroperitoneal cystic teratoma, which was resected. He recovered uneventfully after surgery and had no residual disease two years later. The report highlights that retroperitoneal teratomas can mimic inflammatory abdominal emergencies and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen, even in older adults.

pmid-10815803.summary_ja: 本研究は分泌型糖タンパク質CREGが、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2の分化に与える影響を検討したものである。CREGはNTERA-2では発現が低いが、分化の過程で誘導された。CREGを恒常的に発現させるとレチノイン酸による神経分化が促進され、CREG含有培地は誘導剤なしでも分化を促した。奇形癌などの多能性腫瘍細胞の分化に関わるシグナル伝達への関与が示唆された。
pmid-10815803.summary_en: This basic research study examines CREG, a secreted glycoprotein, in NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. CREG mRNA is largely absent in NTERA-2 cells but is induced during differentiation. Constitutive CREG expression enhances retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation, and CREG-enriched media promote differentiation even without an inducer. The authors suggest CREG participates in signaling that drives differentiation of pluripotent tumor cells such as those in teratocarcinomas.

pmid-10817054.summary_ja: 本稿は、嚢胞成分を有する卵巣腫瘍の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見をまとめたものである。充実成分や乳頭状結節がある場合、MRIで嚢胞内容物を推定し悪性の可能性を評価できる。脂肪抑制画像は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と他の病変の鑑別に有用である。造影後T1強調像は造影される充実部の同定に役立つ。
pmid-10817054.summary_en: This article describes MRI findings of ovarian tumors containing cystic components. MRI can predict cyst contents and assess malignant potential when solid or papillary nodules are present. Post-contrast T1-weighted imaging helps identify enhancing solid areas, while fat-suppression imaging is useful to differentiate mature cystic teratoma from other pathologies. Fat-suppressed post-contrast imaging may also reveal enhancement reflecting inflammatory or neoplastic pelvic processes, aiding diagnostic decision-making.

pmid-10820352.summary_ja: 本研究は、88例の卵巣腫瘍において経膣カラードプラ超音波検査(TV-CDU)が、扁平上皮癌(SCC)と良性嚢胞性奇形腫を鑑別できるかを検討した。低い抵抗・拍動指数（RI<0.4、PI<0.6）を示す腫瘍内血流は悪性病変を同定し、その診断精度は95.2%で、血清SCC抗原（76%）を上回った。著者らは、ドプラ血流評価は血清SCC測定よりも、卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化の検出に有用である可能性があると結論している。
pmid-10820352.summary_en: This study evaluated transvaginal color Doppler ultrasound in distinguishing malignant squamous cell carcinoma from benign cystic teratomas of the ovary in 88 patients. Intratumoral blood flow with low resistance and pulsatility indices (RI <0.4, PI <0.6) identified malignant lesions with 95.2% diagnostic accuracy, outperforming serum SCC antigen (76%). The authors conclude that Doppler flow assessment may be more useful than serum SCC measurement for detecting malignant transformation in ovarian cystic teratomas.

pmid-10820354.summary_ja: 父と息子の両者がセミノーマを発症した症例を報告し、発症年齢に27年の差があった。1972〜1999年の47組の文献レビューでは、息子の平均発症年齢は父親より約16年若く、43%で息子の病態がより重症であった。遺伝的アンティシペーションが精巣腫瘍の発症に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10820354.summary_en: This case report describes a father and son who both developed pure seminoma, with a 27-year difference in age of onset. A literature review of 47 father-son testicular tumor pairs (1972 to 1999) found that sons were diagnosed about 16 years earlier than fathers on average, and disease was more severe in sons in 43% of pairs. Pure seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors both showed earlier onset in sons, suggesting a possible inherited component in testicular carcinogenesis.

pmid-10829535.summary_ja: ナポリの単施設でセミノーマ12例を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍19例の治療経験を報告する。早期病期では手術と予防的放射線療法で予後が良好で、進行例では手術・放射線療法・化学療法の併用が有効であった。I・IIA期では精巣摘除術後の予防的放射線療法を推奨し、I・II期の5年生存率は約98%とされる。
pmid-10829535.summary_en: This report describes management experience with 12 seminoma cases among 19 patients with testicular germ cell tumours at a single Naples center. Early-stage patients treated with surgery and adjuvant prophylactic radiotherapy had better prognosis, while advanced-stage patients benefited from surgery combined with radiotherapy and chemotherapy. The authors favor total orchiectomy followed by prophylactic radiotherapy for stages I and IIA and do not routinely perform retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. They report five-year survival of about 98% for stages I and II.

pmid-10830185.summary_ja: 精巣外胚細胞腫瘍に対するエトポシド含有化学療法後に治療関連骨髄異形成症候群を発症した50歳男性の症例報告である。染色体検査でinv(11)(p15q22)が、RT-PCRでNUP98-DDX10融合転写産物が確認された。この融合遺伝子がトポイソメラーゼII阻害薬による二次性血液腫瘍の発症を促す可能性が考察されている。
pmid-10830185.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old man who developed therapy-related myelodysplastic syndrome after etoposide-containing chemotherapy for extratesticular germ cell tumor. Chromosomal analysis revealed an inv(11)(p15q22) translocation, and RT-PCR detected a NUP98-DDX10 fusion transcript. The authors propose that this fusion may promote secondary hematologic malignancy caused by topoisomerase II inhibitors through aberrant nucleocytoplasmic transport or altered ribosome assembly. The paper links germ cell tumor treatment to a secondary leukemogenic mechanism.

pmid-10830254.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法レジメンの忍容性を比較した総説である。シスプラチンとエトポシドを用いるEP・BEP療法が標準で、予後良好群では複数のレジメンが推奨され、予後不良群の治癒率は約50%にとどまる。長期的な性腺毒性や二次性悪性腫瘍は少ないとされる。
pmid-10830254.summary_en: This review compares the tolerability of chemotherapy regimens for germ cell cancer, focusing on EP and BEP regimens. It notes that over 80% of patients are cured, that serum tumour markers and visceral metastases guide advanced-stage treatment, and that randomized trials support EP four cycles, BEP four cycles with etoposide 350 mg/m2, or BEP three cycles with etoposide 500 mg/m2 for good-risk disease. Poor-risk cure rates are about 50%. The authors conclude that long-term gonadal toxicity and secondary malignancies appear negligible.

pmid-10831347.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎と妊娠性絨毛癌の組織を用い、EGFR関連癌遺伝子の発現を免疫組織化学とin situハイブリダイゼーションで比較した研究です。完全胞状奇胎では絨毛外栄養膜細胞のEGFRとc-erbB-3の強い染色が、持続性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生と相関していました。
pmid-10831347.summary_en: This immunohistochemical and in situ hybridization study compared EGFR, c-erbB-3, and c-erbB-4 expression across partial and complete hydatidiform moles, gestational choriocarcinoma, normal first-trimester placenta, and therapeutic abortion tissue. EGFR was strongly expressed in all choriocarcinomas and in complete mole trophoblasts, exceeding levels in normal placenta and partial mole. Strong EGFR and c-erbB-3 staining in extravillous trophoblasts of complete mole correlated with development of persistent postmolar gestational trophoblastic tumor, suggesting these oncogenes may contribute to pathogenesis and postmolar progression.

pmid-10831350.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に発生した扁平上皮癌を術前に鑑別するため、血清M-CSFとSCCの併用を検討した研究です。M-CSFとSCCのいずれかが陽性となる割合は悪性例で87.1%と高く、M-CSFは有用な腫瘍マーカーとされました。
pmid-10831350.summary_en: This study evaluated whether serum macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) combined with squamous cell carcinoma antigen (SCC) can preoperatively distinguish squamous cell carcinoma arising in ovarian mature cystic teratoma from benign mature cystic teratoma. Serum samples from 31 malignant and 133 benign cases were assayed. Elevated M-CSF was found in 71.0% of malignant cases versus 13.5% of benign cases, and SCC positivity in 41.9% versus 15.0%. Combined positivity for either marker reached 87.1%, and 83.3% in stage I tumors, supporting M-CSF as a useful marker.

pmid-10833370.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを用い、IL-6とIL-8の産生をin vitroで解析した研究です。炎症性サイトカインやTPAで産生が増加し、これらが絨毛癌の増殖や血管新生を調節するサイトカインネットワークの一部と考察されました。
pmid-10833370.summary_en: This study examined in vitro cytokine production by the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo to clarify biological features of choriocarcinoma. Basal IL-6 and IL-8 expression was low, but both were dose-dependently induced by IL-1beta, TNF-alpha, and TPA, while TGF-beta1 affected only IL-6. IL-6 secretion was inhibited by dexamethasone and by protein kinase C pathway inhibitors. The authors suggest these cytokines form a network modulating choriocarcinoma proliferation and angiogenesis, alongside steroid hormone production.

pmid-10833991.summary_ja: 腹腔洗浄細胞診で、炎症細胞に囲まれた扁平上皮細胞と毛髪が卵巣奇形腫の診断手がかりになることを示した研究です。これらの所見は、腫瘍破綻が臨床的・組織学的に確認できない場合でも見られました。
pmid-10833991.summary_en: This cytology study reviewed peritoneal washing specimens from 86 ovarian tumor cases, including 22 teratomas. Squamous cells and hair shafts surrounded by inflammatory cells were found in 5 of the 22 teratomas and in none of the other tumors or nonneoplastic conditions. Hair shafts measured 10 to 28.8 microns, much thinner than normal adult hair. The authors conclude that these findings are a diagnostic clue to ovarian teratoma, even when tumor rupture is not detected clinically or microscopically.

pmid-10833994.summary_ja: 甲状腺腫瘤と頸部リンパ節転移を有する32歳女性の悪性奇形腫の症例報告です。穿刺細胞診で神経上皮分化を伴う小円形細胞腫瘍がみられ、切除標本で扁平上皮や立方上皮の島を伴う悪性奇形腫と診断されました。
pmid-10833994.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with a thyroid mass and cervical lymph node metastasis. Fine needle aspiration showed a small round cell tumor with neuroepithelial differentiation, and thyroidectomy revealed predominantly neuroepithelial tissue with islands of squamous and cuboidal epithelium, leading to a diagnosis of malignant teratoma. Thyroid teratoma in adults is extremely rare and mostly malignant, and the authors emphasize that recognizing its cytologic features allows earlier, potentially more aggressive treatment.

pmid-10834329.summary_ja: 85歳の日本人女性の骨盤内腫瘤を報告する症例報告である。経膣超音波検査、MRI、血清腫瘍マーカーにより成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断され、術後の病理組織学的検査で確認された。高齢女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はまれだが良性のまま存在しうることを示し、世界で2番目に高齢の症例とされる。
pmid-10834329.summary_en: This case report describes an 85-year-old Japanese woman with a pelvic mass diagnosed as a benign mature cystic teratoma. Transvaginal ultrasonography, MRI, and serum tumor markers supported the diagnosis, which was confirmed histologically after surgery. The authors note that mature cystic teratoma in elderly women, though uncommon, can remain benign, and they report the case as the second oldest such case in the world.

pmid-10834390.summary_ja: 対側卵管の腺癌の手術を受けた患者の卵管と広間膜に、以前の妊娠が退縮しなかった残存物由来の胎盤部結節を認めた症例報告である。形態学的および免疫組織化学的に中間型栄養膜細胞の増殖と確認された。広間膜に認められた胎盤部結節として初の報告であり、異所性妊娠の残存物が胎盤部病変の形態を示しうることを示した。
pmid-10834390.summary_en: This report describes placental site nodules, benign proliferations of intermediate trophoblast from a failed prior gestation, found in the fallopian tube and broad ligament of a patient undergoing surgery for an unrelated adenocarcinoma of the opposite tube. Morphology and immunohistochemistry were consistent with intermediate trophoblast. The authors describe this as the first reported PSN in the broad ligament in direct contact with the fallopian tube, showing that ectopic gestation remnants can display placental-site features.

pmid-10834543.summary_ja: 23歳男性に生じた肺内奇形腫の症例報告である。気管支と交通する多房性の気管支拡張様病変で、区域切除により摘出された。三胚葉由来の成分を含み、15種類を超える胚細胞由来成分は報告例中最多である。既報65例の文献的検討も行い、年齢・性別分布や胚細胞成分について考察している。
pmid-10834543.summary_en: This case report describes an intrapulmonary teratoma in a 23-year-old man, a multiloculated, bronchiectatic benign cystic lesion communicating with a segmental bronchus and removed by segmental resection. The tumor contained derivatives of all three germ layers, including more than 15 germ-derived components, the largest number reported. Thymic tissue was present apart from the mediastinum, which the authors relate to pathogenesis. The authors review 65 previously reported cases and discuss age, sex distribution, and germ cell derivatives.

pmid-10835681.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の自家移植に際し、造血幹細胞・前駆細胞へヒトMDR1遺伝子を導入したパイロット臨床研究である。遺伝子導入は効率的で、有害事象なく速やかな造血回復が得られた。ベクターの発現は認められたが、異常スプライシングにより制限された可能性がある。遺伝子マーキングは1年以上持続した。
pmid-10835681.summary_en: This pilot clinical study transferred the human multidrug resistance 1 gene into hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells of patients with germ cell tumors undergoing autologous transplantation. Gene transfer was efficient, and the infusion caused no harmful effects and led to prompt hematopoietic recovery. In vivo vector expression occurred but was likely limited by aberrant splicing of the transgene. Gene marking persisted for more than one year at levels higher than previously reported in humans.

pmid-10836696.summary_ja: 46歳女性の大きな多嚢胞性骨盤内腫瘤と肝病変の症例報告である。骨盤内腫瘤の切除で濾胞型の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断され、肝生検で同様の組織像の転移性疾患が確認された。全甲状腺摘出後にI-131全身スキャンで複数の機能性肝転移への集積を認め、放射性ヨウ素治療の対象となった。
pmid-10836696.summary_en: A 46-year-old woman presented with a large multicystic pelvic mass and hepatic lesions on CT. Pelvic resection revealed malignant struma ovarii of the follicular type, and liver biopsy confirmed metastatic disease with similar histology. Thyroid laboratory values were normal, and total thyroidectomy showed only a follicular adenoma. I-131 whole-body scanning demonstrated uptake in multiple functioning liver metastases, which guided radioiodine ablation therapy. The case illustrates radioiodine-avid metastases from malignant struma ovarii.

pmid-10838729.summary_ja: 本報告は、後縦隔に発生した奇形腫の5歳男児例を報告するものである。後縦隔奇形腫は稀な部位の腫瘍である。著者らは文献上の既報18例をレビューし、小児における本疾患の臨床像を概観している。小児の胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告として、診断と臨床経過の理解に資する内容である。
pmid-10838729.summary_en: This report describes a five-year-old boy with a posterior mediastinal teratoma, a rare location for this tumor. The authors also reviewed eighteen previously published cases from the literature. The article provides a clinical overview of this uncommon presentation in a pediatric patient, placing the case in the context of prior reports. It is a case report with literature review, offering limited but useful information on diagnosis and presentation of mediastinal teratomas in children, which is relevant to the site's focus on pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-10840113.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者15例を対象に、BEP化学療法後の細胞性免疫を評価した研究である。治療後中央値61か月の時点でT細胞数や有糸分裂誘発反応は健常者と同等であった。一方、治療後約1年の群ではコンカナバリンAへの増殖反応が有意に一過性上昇した。BEP療法は細胞性免疫を損なわず、精巣がんの長期寛解の高さに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10840113.summary_en: This study assessed cellular immunity in 15 patients with testicular germ cell tumors who had received BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin), evaluated a median of 61 months after treatment. T-cell subsets and lymphoproliferative responses to mitogens were comparable to healthy controls. However, patients assessed about one year after chemotherapy showed a significant transient increase in response to concanavalin A. The authors conclude BEP does not impair cellular immunity and may contribute to the high rate of long-term remission in testicular cancer. The findings suggest a temporary enhancement of T-cell function after therapy.

pmid-10840119.summary_ja: 性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞がんの初診7年後に精巣セミノーマを発症した29歳男性の症例報告である。このような異時性の胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀で、本例は8例目とされる。既報の他7例の平均発症間隔は8年であった。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の既往を持つ患者では、精巣を含めた長期の経過観察が必要であることを強調している。
pmid-10840119.summary_en: This report describes a 29-year-old man who developed a primary testicular seminoma seven years after presenting with extragonadal non-seminomatous germ cell carcinoma. This metachronous occurrence is exceedingly rare. The authors add this eighth reported case to the literature and note that the other seven patients had extragonadal non-seminomatous tumors followed by testicular seminoma in six and non-seminomatous germ cell carcinoma in one, with a mean interval of eight years. The case emphasizes the need for long-term surveillance, including testicular evaluation, in patients with a history of extragonadal germ cell carcinoma.

pmid-10841951.summary_ja: シアトル地域の2施設における鼻咽頭奇形腫と類皮腫の後方視的検討と、1977年以降の文献レビューを組み合わせた症例集積である。多くは出生時に診断され、呼吸窮迫が主症状であった。奇形腫は類皮腫より再発が多く、先天異常や早産を伴う傾向があった。治療は完全切除が基本で、出生前診断が予後に与える影響は小さかった。
pmid-10841951.summary_en: This retrospective review examined nasopharyngeal true teratomas and dermoids from two Seattle-area centers, combined with a literature review of cases since 1977. Most lesions were diagnosed at birth, presenting mainly with respiratory distress. Teratomas were more often associated with maternal polyhydramnios, preterm birth, emergent airway management and congenital abnormalities, and had a higher recurrence rate. Complete surgical excision was the treatment of choice. Prenatal diagnosis had little impact on diagnosis or outcome. The authors note inconsistent classification has hindered distinguishing teratomas from dermoids.

pmid-10843453.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍患者54例(セミノーマ)と74例(非セミノーマ)で血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とβ-hCGを同時測定した。セミノーマの検出にはβ-hCGが優れ(陽性率83%)、再発の早期発見には両マーカーの測定が有用であった。hCGの偽陽性はテストステロン投与で鑑別できた。
pmid-10843453.summary_en: This study compared simultaneous serum hCG and hCG-beta measurements in 54 patients with testicular seminoma and 74 with non-seminomatous testicular tumors. hCG-beta detected seminoma more sensitively (83%) than hCG (50%), while hCG was more often positive in non-seminomatous tumors. Among 14 patients with recurrence, marker patterns varied, so both markers should be monitored. Testosterone administration was effective in identifying falsely elevated hCG.

pmid-10843474.summary_ja: 45歳の未経妊女性が、卵巣原発の絨毛癌により癌性腹膜炎で死亡した症例。減量手術後に化学療法抵抗性であった。DNA多型解析により妊娠に由来しない非妊娠性絨毛癌であることを証明した。臨床経過とDNA多型所見を報告する。
pmid-10843474.summary_en: A 45-year-old nulligravid woman died of carcinomatous peritonitis from a primary ovarian choriocarcinoma that was resistant to chemotherapy after debulking surgery. DNA polymorphism analysis showed that the tumor was non-gestational, meaning it did not originate from a pregnancy. The report details the clinical course and genetic findings, highlighting the value of DNA typing in determining the origin of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-10843487.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、流産、搔爬組織などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、PCNA、Ki-67、p53、β-hCG、HPLの免疫染色を比較した。PCNA指標のみが群間で有意差を示し、栄養膜疾患の有用なマーカーであり予後因子となりうると結論づけた。
pmid-10843487.summary_en: This study examined PCNA, Ki-67, p53, beta-hCG and HPL immunostaining in gestational trophoblastic disease, comparing 16 hydatidiform moles, 20 spontaneous abortions, and 20 curettage samples, plus two choriocarcinomas. The PCNA labeling index differed significantly among groups, while Ki-67, p53, hCG and HPL showed no significant differences. The authors conclude that PCNA is a useful marker for trophoblastic disease and may serve as a prognostic factor.

pmid-10845164.summary_ja: ダウン症候群を合併した40歳男性が無痛性の右陰嚢腫大で受診した症例。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右精巣腫瘍と腸骨窩の腫瘤を認め、右高位精巣摘除術と腫瘤摘出を施行した。病理はセミノーマで、腫瘤は外腸骨リンパ節転移であった。術後に放射線療法を実施した。
pmid-10845164.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with Down's syndrome presented with a painless swollen right scrotum. CT revealed a right testicular tumor and an iliac fossa mass. He underwent right high orchiectomy and mass extirpation. Histology showed seminoma in the testis, and the mass was an external iliac lymph node metastasis of seminoma. Radiation therapy followed surgery. The report highlights the association between Down's syndrome and testicular cancer.

pmid-10845165.summary_ja: ダウン症候群(21番染色体トリソミー)に精巣セミノーマを合併した症例を報告。国内でダウン症候群と精巣腫瘍の合併例は本例で19例目とされる。白血病リスクの上昇も知られており、精巣がんの合併に留意する必要性を示す。
pmid-10845165.summary_en: This report describes a man with Down's syndrome who was diagnosed with testicular seminoma. The authors note that coexistence of Down's syndrome with testicular tumors has been increasingly recognized, and that this case is the 19th reported in Japan. Down's syndrome, caused by trisomy 21, is also associated with an increased risk of leukemia. The case highlights the need to consider testicular cancer in these patients.

pmid-10849320.summary_ja: 46,XX核型で妊娠出産歴のある27歳女性に、片側卵巣の性腺芽腫と混合型胚細胞腫瘍を認めた極めて稀な症例。混合腫瘍は絨毛癌、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマから成る。手術と補助化学療法後10年以上無病経過。
pmid-10849320.summary_en: A 27-year-old woman with a 46,XX karyotype and two successful pregnancies had a unilateral ovarian gonadoblastoma with a mixed germ cell tumor. The mixed tumor comprised choriocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, immature teratoma and dysgerminoma. She was treated with surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy and remained disease-free for over 10 years. The case is extremely rare.

pmid-10850452.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍25例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析した。ディスジャーミノーマで変化が最も多く、12p・12qの獲得が目立った。卵黄嚢腫瘍も12p獲得を示し、未熟奇形腫は変化が少なく12p獲得がなかった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と同様の発生経路を持つのはディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍で、未熟奇形腫は異なる機序で発生すると結論づけた。
pmid-10850452.summary_en: Comparative genomic hybridization was used to analyze 25 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, including 12 dysgerminomas, four endodermal sinus tumors, and nine immature teratomas. Dysgerminomas showed the most alterations, with frequent gains on 12p and 12q. Endodermal sinus tumors shared 12p gains, while immature teratomas had fewer changes and lacked 12p gain. The authors conclude that dysgerminomas and endodermal sinus tumors follow pathways similar to testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-10851829.summary_ja: パキスタン・カラチの1施設で1991〜98年に診断された精巣腫瘍170例の形態学的研究。胚細胞腫瘍が悪性精巣腫瘍の83.5%を占め、セミノーマが最多であった。小児では卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、高齢者ではリンパ腫が主体であった。頻度は国際文献の報告と一致した。
pmid-10851829.summary_en: This morphological study reviewed 170 testicular tumors diagnosed over eight years at a tertiary hospital in Karachi, Pakistan. Germ cell tumors accounted for 83.5% of malignant testicular neoplasms. Seminoma was the most common subtype (36.5%), followed by mixed germ cell tumors (28.8%). Yolk sac tumor was the commonest testicular neoplasm in children, while lymphoma predominated in the elderly. Most patients presented in the third and fourth decades with a scrotal mass. The authors concluded that the relative frequency of testicular malignancy matched international reports.

pmid-10852465.summary_ja: 性腺異形成を伴う46,XY女性で卵黄嚢腫瘍を合併した症例報告。SRY遺伝子のHMGボックス内に新規のde novoミスセンス変異(Gly95Glu)が同定された。この変異は父親と男性兄弟には認められなかった。性分化疾患と胚細胞腫瘍の関連を示す症例であり、SRYのDNA結合活性の機能的重要性を支持する。
pmid-10852465.summary_en: This case report describes a 46,XY phenotypic female with pure gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhea and was found to have a yolk sac tumor. Sequencing of the SRY gene identified a novel de novo missense mutation (Gly95Glu) within the highly conserved HMG-box. The mutation was absent in her father and brothers. The authors note that this raises the number of reported SRY mutations to 36. They conclude that the findings support the functional importance of the putative DNA-binding activity of the HMG-box domain.

pmid-10853816.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍31例の初期病期分類におけるFDG-PETの後方視的検討。PETは転移10例を検出し、偽陽性はなく、陽性的中率は100%であった。陰性的中率は76〜91%であった。従来の画像診断で見逃される転移を検出できることが示唆された。役割の確立には大規模な前向き研究が必要とされた。
pmid-10853816.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated fluorodeoxyglucose PET (FDG-PET) for initial staging of 31 patients with testicular germ cell tumours (13 seminomas, 18 non-seminomatous tumours). FDG-PET detected metastatic disease in 10 patients, with no false positives and five false negatives. The positive predictive value was 100%, and the negative predictive value was 76% to 91%, depending on how six equivocal cases on CT were classified. The authors conclude that FDG-PET detects metastases missed by conventional imaging, and they recommend a larger prospective study to define its role in primary staging.

pmid-10856101.summary_ja: 再発精巣胚細胞腫瘍30例に対し、パクリタキセル併用のTIP療法を二次治療として評価した第II相試験。化学療法のみで77%が完全奏効し、中央値33か月の追跡で73%の奏効が持続した。主な毒性は骨髄抑制で、グレード3の神経毒性は2例であった。予後因子に基づく患者選択が重要とされた。
pmid-10856101.summary_en: This dose-escalation and phase II study tested paclitaxel added to ifosfamide and cisplatin (TIP) as second-line salvage therapy for 30 patients with relapsed testicular germ cell tumors, all with favorable prognostic features. Seventy-seven percent achieved complete response to chemotherapy alone, and 80% achieved a favorable response overall. Mature teratoma was found in one resected residual mass. Two patients relapsed, and 73% remained in durable response at a median follow-up of 33 months. Myelosuppression was the main toxicity, with two grade 3 neurotoxic events.

pmid-10857886.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍31例を後方視的に検討し、寛解後の生殖能力を評価しました。21例に妊孕性温存手術が行われ、術後にはほぼ全例で化学療法が実施されました。妊孕性を温存した20例のうち8例が計9人を出産し、多くは規則的な月経を維持していました。妊孕性温存を伴う管理は安全で、多くの患者が卵巣機能を保持できると結論されています。
pmid-10857886.summary_en: This retrospective review of 31 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors assessed reproductive outcomes after remission. Most patients were diagnosed in adolescence or early adulthood, and 21 underwent fertility-sparing surgery, with postoperative chemotherapy given to nearly all. Of the 31 patients, 4 died of disease. Among 20 fertility-preserved survivors, 8 delivered 9 healthy babies, and most others had regular menses. The authors concluded that fertility-sparing management is safe and most patients retain ovarian function.

pmid-10861442.summary_ja: 635例の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした多施設データベース研究で、二次悪性腫瘍のリスクを評価した。追跡期間中央値55か月で二次固形腫瘍は7例に発生し、治療関連白血病は認められなかった。全体のリスクは一般集団と比較して有意な増加は認められなかったが、化学療法後に皮膚がんが増加していた。著者らは、二次固形がんのリスクは精巣がんと同程度であり、原発性縦隔非セミノーマに関連する血液疾患の既知の関連を除けば、との結論を述べている。
pmid-10861442.summary_en: This multicenter database study of 635 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors assessed the risk of second malignancies. Over a median follow-up of 55 months, seven second solid tumors occurred, and no treatment-related leukemia was observed. The overall risk was not significantly increased compared with the general population, although skin cancers were elevated, particularly after chemotherapy. The authors concluded that second solid cancer risk is comparable to testicular cancer, except for the known hematologic association with primary mediastinal nonseminoma.

pmid-10861580.summary_ja: セミノーマと混合型非セミノーマの各発生段階を、マイクロダイセクションした試料で比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション解析した研究です。セミノーマは全段階で類似した染色体異常パターンを示しました。非セミノーマはより不均一で、一部の異常は初期病変のみに認められました。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初期発生と進展に特定の染色体変化が関与する可能性が示唆されますが、解析は2例のみです。
pmid-10861580.summary_en: This study applied comparative genomic hybridization to microdissected samples from a seminoma and a mixed non-seminoma, covering intratubular neoplasia through invasive stages. The seminoma showed a consistent pattern of chromosomal gains and losses at all developmental stages. The non-seminoma displayed a more heterogeneous profile, with some aberrations present only in the early neoplasia or shared with invasive components. The results suggest that specific chromosomal alterations contribute to early development and progression of testicular germ cell tumors, though only two cases were analyzed.

pmid-10862031.summary_ja: 染色体12q22の欠失領域に位置するAPAF1遺伝子が、男性胚細胞腫瘍の候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子かを検討した研究です。FISHでは欠失が認められましたが、コード配列の変化はありませんでした。欠失を持つ細胞株ではカスパーゼ-3活性化の障害が見られました。著者らはAPAF1が腫瘍抑制遺伝子として働くことは支持されないと結論づけています。
pmid-10862031.summary_en: This study investigated APAF1, a proapoptotic gene on chromosome 12q22, as a candidate tumor suppressor in male germ cell tumors, since this region is frequently deleted. APAF1 showed deletions by FISH in GCTs but no coding sequence changes. Expression was detectable in all examined cell lines, and some lines with deletions had defective caspase-3 activation that was restored by caspase-9 and APAF1 proteins. The authors concluded that APAF1 does not act as a tumor suppressor, though other apoptotic pathway defects linked to 12q22 loss remain possible.

pmid-10864077.summary_ja: 固形成分を持たない嚢胞性卵巣甲状腺腫の画像所見を報告した研究です。1例は薄壁の単房性腫瘤、2例は多房性嚢胞性腫瘤で、T2強調像で信号欠損がみられました。いずれも術前診断は困難でした。完全嚢胞性の卵巣腫瘤であっても、卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別に含めるべきだと述べられています。
pmid-10864077.summary_en: This imaging report describes three cases of cystic struma ovarii without any solid component, a specialized ovarian teratoma. One was a thin-walled unilocular mass, while two were multilocular cystic masses showing T2 signal void and intermediate T1 signal. Preoperative diagnosis was difficult in all cases. The authors conclude that struma ovarii should be included in differential diagnoses even when an ovarian mass is entirely cystic, given its imaging overlap with other cystic ovarian lesions.

pmid-10865402.summary_ja: 先天性上咽頭奇形腫（epignathus）の症例報告。羊水腔内の腫瘤として現れ、非対称性双胎との鑑別が問題となった。組織学的に三胚葉由来の高分化組織と骨性の中核を認めた。腫瘤は口蓋垂後方の領域に付着していた。胚細胞由来の奇形腫が性腺外に発生した例である。
pmid-10865402.summary_en: A case report describes a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma, also called epignathus, presenting as an intra-amniotic sac mass that initially resembled asymmetric twins. Histology showed highly differentiated tissues from all three germ layers, including partially developed infant organs with a bony core. The tumor was attached in the retro-uvular region of the nasopharynx. The report illustrates the diagnostic distinction from twin pregnancy and documents the tumor's anatomical origin. It is an extragonadal teratoma in a neonatal context.

pmid-10866307.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍119例の末梢血を用い、ネステッドRT-PCRでAFPおよびβ-hCGのmRNAを検出した。全体の陽性率は26.5%で、血清AFP値とは相関しなかった。β-hCG PCRは血清hCG高値例で陽性が多く、病期IIC/IIIでは病期Iの約2倍の陽性率であった。陽性は主に胎児性癌で認められた。
pmid-10866307.summary_en: This study used nested RT-PCR to detect AFP and beta-hCG mRNA in peripheral blood of 119 patients with germ cell tumors, with 336 samples collected before and during therapy. Overall positivity was 26.5%, independent of serum marker levels for AFP. Positive beta-hCG PCR occurred more often when serum hCG was elevated. In a pretreatment subgroup of 36 patients, stage IIC/III tumors showed nearly twice the positivity of stage I tumors. Positive results were mostly seen in embryonal carcinoma, suggesting circulating tumor cells may complement conventional tumor markers.

pmid-10870299.summary_ja: 1980〜1997年に妊娠中に付属器腫瘤の手術を受けた69例を後方視的に検討した。最多は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（33例）であった。早産は12%、周産期死亡は3例で、そのうち2例は重篤な先天異常によるものであった。典型的な良性嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波所見があれば、妊娠中の手術を回避できると結論づけた。
pmid-10870299.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 69 Japanese women who underwent surgery for adnexal masses during pregnancy between 1980 and 1997. The most common pathology was mature cystic teratoma (33 cases), followed by functional cysts and mucinous cystadenomas; two were malignant. Pregnancy outcomes showed preterm birth in 12% and perinatal deaths in 3, two from major anomalies. The authors suggest adnexal masses may be associated with adverse fetal outcomes, and that surgery can be avoided when ultrasound shows features typical of benign cystic teratoma.

pmid-10870321.summary_ja: 妊娠11週の25歳女性が急性の左下腹部痛で受診し、捻転を伴う左卵巣奇形腫と診断された。緊急腹腔鏡手術で卵管と卵巣の捻転を解除し、奇形腫の嚢腫摘出を行った。妊娠は継続し、正期産で合併症なく出産した。超音波検査と細胞診による正確な診断、および温生理食塩水による十分な洗浄が良好な転帰に寄与したと考察している。
pmid-10870321.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman at 11 weeks of gestation who presented with acute left lower abdominal pain and was diagnosed with a twisted left ovarian teratoma. Emergency laparoscopic detorsion and cystectomy were performed, preserving the pregnancy. She delivered a healthy full-term infant without complications. The authors credit accurate ultrasound and cytologic diagnosis and copious warm saline irrigation for the favorable outcome, suggesting laparoscopy can be safely used for adnexal torsion in the first trimester.

pmid-10870687.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者において、放射線照射またはカルボプラチンによる治療前後の体細胞染色体損傷を細胞遺伝学的検査で比較した。放射線治療では治療後6か月でも染色体異常率が高く残存したのに対し、化学療法では回復と損傷細胞の排除がより速やかであった。細胞遺伝学的な観点から、化学療法は患者にとってより侵襲性が低いと結論づけている。
pmid-10870687.summary_en: This study compared somatic chromosomal damage in seminoma patients before and after treatment with ionizing radiation or the cytostatic drug carboplatin. Cytogenetic assays measuring chromosomal aberrations, sister chromatid exchanges, and micronuclei were performed before treatment, immediately afterwards, and six months later. Irradiation strongly suppressed lymphocyte mitotic activity and left a high aberration rate at six months, while chemotherapy showed faster recovery and quicker elimination of damaged cells. The authors conclude chemotherapy was less cytogenetically aggressive to patients.

pmid-10870792.summary_ja: 正期産で生児を出産した後に絨毛癌を発症した、まれな症例報告である。腫瘍は子宮漿膜から発生する巨大な有茎性腫瘤として現れ、子宮内病変や遠隔転移は認めなかった。非典型的な提示様式のため診断が遅れやすいことを指摘している。予後不良とされる妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な臨床像を示す報告である。
pmid-10870792.summary_en: This case report describes a woman who developed choriocarcinoma after a live term pregnancy. The tumor presented as a large pedunculated growth arising from the uterine serosa, without intrauterine involvement or distant metastasis, which delayed diagnosis. The authors note that post-term choriocarcinoma carries a poor prognosis and that its atypical presentation is often not recognized. Because clinical data on this rare entity are limited, the report adds to knowledge of an unusual manifestation of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-10871025.summary_ja: 新生児に鼻咽頭奇形腫と鞍上部の異所性小脳が同時に認められた症例報告である。分化の良好な異所性小脳の腫瘤は、眼窩、脊椎、前頭部脳瘤では報告があるが、鞍上部での報告は知られていないと述べている。両病変の画像所見を記述し、その起源について考察している。鼻咽頭奇形腫は性腺外の胚細胞腫瘍に分類される。
pmid-10871025.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a nasopharyngeal teratoma found together with a heterotopic cerebellum in the suprasellar region. Well-differentiated heterotopic cerebellar masses have been reported in the orbit, spine, and frontal encephalocele, but not previously in the suprasellar region. The authors describe the imaging findings of both masses and discuss their possible embryologic origins. The nasopharyngeal teratoma is an extragonadal germ cell tumor, and the case is notable for its unusual combination of findings.

pmid-10872667.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ20例でトポイソメラーゼIとIIαの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。トポイソメラーゼIの上昇は30%に認められ、その群は増殖指数が高かった。CD30は60%で陽性、CD15とc-erbB-2は陰性であった。トポイソメラーゼを標的とする化学療法が精巣セミノーマに有用である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-10872667.summary_en: This study examined DNA topoisomerase I and topoisomerase II-alpha expression in 20 testicular seminomas. Elevated topoisomerase I was found in 30% of cases, and these tumors had a higher proliferative index measured by topoisomerase II-alpha staining. CD30 was focally expressed in 60% of cases, while CD15 and c-erbB-2 were negative. Because camptothecin-class drugs require elevated topoisomerase I and cell proliferation for killing, the authors suggest that topoisomerase-targeting chemotherapy may be useful against testicular seminomas.

pmid-10873407.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患において、CA-125が化学療法の必要性の予測や経過観察に有用かを検討した。CA-125は化学療法を要した群と要しなかった群で有意差がなく、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)とも相関しなかった。CA-125が陰性化してもヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が上昇したままの症例が多かった。管理指標としては信頼できないと結論づけている。
pmid-10873407.summary_en: This study assessed whether serum CA-125 could guide chemotherapy decisions and track disease in gestational trophoblastic disease. CA-125 was measured serially in patients with hydatidiform mole, nonmetastatic and metastatic disease, and a few cases of ovarian choriocarcinoma and placental site tumor. CA-125 did not differ significantly between patients who did and did not need chemotherapy and did not correlate with hCG. It often became negative while hCG remained elevated. The authors conclude that CA-125 does not provide reliable information for managing gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-10874672.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマと胎児性癌を主体とする混合型胚細胞腫瘍40例で、Ki-67、サイクリンA・Eの発現を比較しました。サイクリンEは胎児性癌で74%、セミノーマで20%に陽性で、陽性例では病期が進んでいました。肺転移はサイクリンE陽性例のみに認められ、遠隔転移の予測因子として有用と結論されています。
pmid-10874672.summary_en: This study compared cyclin expression in 20 pure seminomas and 20 mixed germ cell tumors predominantly composed of embryonal carcinoma. Ki-67 and cyclin A were broadly expressed and offered little prognostic information. Cyclin E was positive in 74% of embryonal carcinomas but only 20% of seminomas, and its positivity correlated with higher clinical stage. Pulmonary spread occurred only in cyclin E-positive tumors. The authors conclude that cyclin E immunoreactivity correlates with tumor type and is strongly predictive of distant spread in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-10883028.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍について、病期と組織型ごとの外科的治療をまとめた総説です。ディスジャーミノーマの病期IAでは片側卵巣摘出のみが選択され、非ディスジャーミノーマでは手術と化学療法を併用します。病期III・IVでは減量手術と化学療法が基本となります。一次・二次減量手術やリンパ節郭清の生存への寄与は議論が続いています。
pmid-10883028.summary_en: This review summarizes surgical management of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors by clinical stage and histologic type. For dysgerminoma, stage IA is treated with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy alone, while later stages receive chemotherapy with or without second-look surgery. Non-dysgerminomas are generally managed with surgery plus chemotherapy, with conservative procedures considered where appropriate. Advanced stages III and IV require cytoreductive surgery with chemotherapy. The authors note that the role of primary or secondary cytoreductive surgery and lymphadenectomy in improving survival remains controversial.

pmid-10884496.summary_ja: 1973年から1995年に診断された小児原発縦隔悪性腫瘍22例を、成人197例と比較した研究です。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は18%を占め、5年生存率は25%と、リンパ腫（74%）より低値でした。胚細胞腫瘍は主に思春期に発症し、手術療法が多く用いられていました。病期分類と生存率に成人との有意差は認められませんでした。
pmid-10884496.summary_en: This study analyzed 22 children with primary mediastinal malignancies diagnosed between 1973 and 1995 and compared them with 197 adults. Lymphoma accounted for 55%, neurogenic tumors 23%, and malignant germ cell tumors 18%. Five-year survival was 25% for germ cell tumors versus 74% for lymphoma. Germ cell tumors presented mainly in adolescents, and surgery was used more frequently for germ cell tumors than lymphoma. Children had more neurogenic tumors and fewer thymomas than adults, and staging and survival did not differ significantly.

pmid-10884752.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の断裂・破裂により、腹痛を主訴とした39歳女性の症例報告です。卵巣奇形腫による脂肪成分を含む横隔下膿瘍をCTで確認しました。術後合併症としての横隔下膿瘍は既知ですが、膿瘍内に奇形腫様の内容物を認めた例は稀とされています。
pmid-10884752.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman who presented with abdominal pain after tubal sterilization. CT revealed a subphrenic abscess containing fatty inclusions, attributed to laceration or rupture of a mature ovarian teratoma. The authors note that subphrenic abscess is a recognized postoperative complication and that ovarian teratomas are common. A teratomatous inclusion within a subphrenic abscess, however, is unusual. The report highlights the CT appearance of this rare complication of a ruptured ovarian teratoma.

pmid-10886088.summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I胚細胞腫瘍51例（セミノーマ28例、奇形腫23例）を対象に、血管新生マーカーを免疫組織化学で評価した。奇形腫はセミノーマや正常精巣より微小血管密度とVEGF発現が有意に高かったが、いずれも無再発生存とは相関せず予後因子にはならなかった。セミノーマの一部ではリンパ管新生因子が検出され、治療標的として今後の検討が必要とされる。
pmid-10886088.summary_en: This study examined whether angiogenesis could serve as an additional prognostic marker in 51 men with clinical stage 1 testicular germ cell tumours managed by orchidectomy and surveillance alone (28 seminomas, 23 teratomas). Immunohistochemistry assessed microvascular density and VEGF and thymidine phosphorylase expression, and VEGF-C and VEGFR-3 were evaluated in seminomas. Teratomas showed significantly higher microvascular density and VEGF expression than seminomas and normal testis. However, neither angiogenic marker correlated with relapse-free survival, so they were not prognostic here. Lymphangiogenic factors were detected in a subset of seminomas, suggesting possible therapeutic targets.

pmid-10886090.summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍417例を18年間追跡し、監視療法と補助化学療法の腹部再発率を比較した。1986年以前は監視療法のみで腹部再発は16%だったが、以後は高リスク例に化学療法を行い、再発率は8%へ有意に低下した。治療関連死亡は低く抑えられた。著者らは、本病期でのRPLNDの必要性は依然として疑わしいと結論づけている。
pmid-10886090.summary_en: This study assessed whether adjuvant chemotherapy reduced abdominal relapse in 417 men with clinical stage 1 nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours over 18 years. Up to 1986, 161 men were managed by surveillance alone, with abdominal relapse in 26 (16%). From 1986, men with adverse risk factors in the orchidectomy specimen were offered two cycles of chemotherapy; 60 accepted, with one abdominal relapse, while 196 under surveillance had 19 relapses. Abdominal relapse fell significantly from 16% to 8%. Treatment-related mortality remained low. The authors conclude that the need for RPLND in stage 1 NSGCT remains doubtful.

pmid-10886732.summary_ja: 妊娠28週の22歳女性が男性化徴候と血清テストステロン・αフェトプロテイン(AFP)高値で受診した。左卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍に、ライディッヒ細胞の集簇が混在していた。免疫染色でライディッヒ細胞はビメンチン、インヒビンα、カルレチニンが陽性で、テストステロンも細胞質に証明された。腫瘍切除後にテストステロンとAFPが並行して低下し、機能性間質として作用したライディッヒ細胞が男性化の原因と考えられた。
pmid-10886732.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman at 28 weeks of gestation presented with virilization and elevated serum testosterone and alpha-fetoprotein. Resection revealed a left ovarian yolk sac tumour with Leydig cell islands distributed throughout the tumour, mostly peripherally. Immunohistochemistry showed Leydig cells positive for vimentin, inhibin alpha-subunit and calretinin, and negative for cytokeratins, while the yolk sac components were the reverse. Testosterone was identified within the Leydig cells. After resection, testosterone and AFP levels fell in parallel, indicating that Leydig cells acting as functioning stroma caused the virilization. This combination is very rare.

pmid-10886737.summary_ja: 55歳の無症状女性で、多発子宮筋腫の検索中に子宮体部の偶発的な病変が見つかった。肉眼的にはコロイド状・出血性の結節で、組織学的・免疫組織化学的に甲状腺組織からなる小腫瘤と判明し、甲状腺分化を伴う子宮体部成熟奇形腫と診断された。性腺外に発生した成熟奇形腫の稀な例である。
pmid-10886737.summary_en: A 55-year-old asymptomatic woman with multiple uterine leiomyomas had an incidental colloid-hemorrhagic nodule within the uterine corpus. Histologic and immunohistochemical examination showed that this lesion was a small mass of thyroid tissue, establishing a diagnosis of mature teratoma of the uterine corpus with thyroid differentiation. The tumour was clinically silent and was discovered only incidentally during evaluation of leiomyomas. The report documents this rare extragonadal location of a mature teratoma with thyroid differentiation.

pmid-10890890.summary_ja: 129系マウスは雄の精巣胚細胞腫瘍になりやすく、p53欠損でさらに発生率が上がる。著者らはこの性質を利用して交雑・戻し交雑マウスを作製し、遺伝子マッピングを行った。その結果、第13染色体上のD13Mit188近傍に、雄性胚細胞腫瘍の表現型と連動する遺伝子座pgct1を同定した。ヒトの5q領域との対応が示唆される。
pmid-10890890.summary_en: Inbred 129 mice are predisposed to male testicular germ cell tumours, and loss of functional p53 increases tumour incidence in this strain. The authors used p53-deficient 129 males to generate intercross and backcross panels for genetic mapping. They identified a 129-derived locus, pgct1, on mouse chromosome 13 near marker D13Mit188 that co-segregates with the male GCT phenotype. The region may be syntenic with a segment of human chromosome 5q implicated in human male germ cell tumour susceptibility. The findings identify a candidate susceptibility locus for further study.

pmid-10892763.summary_ja: 部分胞状奇胎3000例中、遷延する妊娠性絨毛性疾患で化学療法を要した15例のうち3例が絨毛癌と診断された。中央病理診断、フローサイトメトリー、マイクロサテライト解析により、三倍体の奇胎から絨毛癌が生じたことが示された。部分胞状奇胎の疑いがある症例は中央診断を受け、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のフォローアップを行うべきと結論づけられた。
pmid-10892763.summary_en: This study examined whether partial hydatidiform moles can transform into choriocarcinoma. Among 3000 patients with partial mole, 15 needed chemotherapy for persisting gestational trophoblastic disease, and three of these had choriocarcinoma. Central histology review, flow cytometry, and microsatellite genotyping were used to confirm triploidy and clonal origin. In all three cases, the choriocarcinomas shared identical maternal and paternal alleles with their preceding partial moles, indicating transformation. The authors conclude that patients with suspected partial mole should undergo central review and hCG follow-up.

pmid-10893590.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが持続高値を示した男性30例の救済手術成績を検討した。57%が長期生存した。原病死例では胎児性癌が主な初発組織型で、内臓の残存病変が多く完全切除が難しかった。完全切除が良好な転帰を得る最重要因子であり、内臓転移例も手術の恩恵を受けた。特定のサブグループでは手術を省略すべきでないと結論している。
pmid-10893590.summary_en: This study reviewed 30 men with persistently elevated tumor markers at salvage surgery after chemotherapy for metastatic germ cell tumors. Seventeen patients (57%) were long-term survivors. Embryonal carcinoma was the predominant initial histology among those who died of disease, and their residual disease more often involved the viscera, making complete resection less likely. Complete resection was the most important factor for a favorable outcome, and patients with visceral metastasis also benefited. The authors conclude that surgery should not be omitted in certain subgroups.

pmid-10897052.summary_ja: オンタリオ州の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者502例と対照を用いた症例対照研究で、母体ホルモン曝露と周産期因子を組織型別に検討した。外因性ホルモン曝露はリスク上昇と強く関連した。若年母体の初産、早産、停留精巣の治療歴もリスクを高めた。母体の多量喫煙や切迫流産はリスク低下と関連した。危険因子はセミノーマと非セミノーマでほぼ同様で、母体エストロゲン曝露の関与が示唆された。
pmid-10897052.summary_en: This case-control study of 502 Ontario men with testicular germ-cell cancer examined maternal and perinatal exposures by histologic subtype. Exogenous maternal hormone exposure was associated with markedly elevated risk. First births among young mothers, preterm birth, and treatment for undescended testicle also increased risk. Heavy maternal smoking and bleeding or threatened miscarriage were associated with lower risk. Risk factors differed little between seminoma and non-seminoma groups, supporting a role for maternal estrogen exposure.

pmid-10899652.summary_ja: 化学療法後に腫瘍が増大し、切除標本で成熟奇形腫のみが認められる growing teratoma syndrome の33例を検討した。完全な外科的切除例では、再発GTSや後の悪性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の発生が部分切除例より明らかに少なかった。GTSは独自の合併症と自然経過を持つ。完全な外科的切除が治療の第一選択であると結論している。
pmid-10899652.summary_en: This study reviewed 33 patients with growing teratoma syndrome, defined as tumor enlargement during or after chemotherapy for germ cell tumour, with only mature teratoma on histology of the resected specimen. Recurrent GTS and later malignant NSGCT were far less frequent after complete surgical resection than after partial resection. GTS has distinct complications and natural history. The authors conclude that complete surgical resection is the treatment of choice.

pmid-10908150.summary_ja: 乳児期精巣の奇形腫2例と卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーションとin situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した。奇形腫では染色体異常はみられず、卵黄嚢腫瘍では異数性と特徴的な染色体の増減が一貫して認められた。MDM2は発現していたがp53は検出されず、乳児と成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は異なる発生機序を持つと結論している。
pmid-10908150.summary_en: Comparative genomic hybridization and in situ hybridization were used to analyze two teratomas and four yolk sac tumors of the infantile testis. The teratomas showed no chromosomal anomalies, whereas all yolk sac tumors were aneuploid with consistent gains and losses, including recurrent losses at 1p21-31 and 4q23-33. MDM2 was detected by immunohistochemistry without p53, and no p53 exon 5-8 mutations were found. The authors conclude that infantile and adult testicular germ cell tumors have distinct pathogenesis.

pmid-10914786.summary_ja: 36歳男性の低分化胃癌で、腺癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合成分を認めた症例報告。胃およびVirchow節の生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍成分がαフェトプロテイン(AFP)免疫組織化学染色に強陽性を示し、血清AFPは38,200 ng/mLであった。化学療法への反応は、原発性胚細胞腫瘍に比べて不良であった。胃原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めてまれである。
pmid-10914786.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with poorly differentiated gastric cancer showing mixed adenocarcinoma and yolk sac tumor components. Both gastric and Virchow node biopsies contained yolk sac areas strongly positive for alpha-fetoprotein by immunohistochemistry, with serum AFP of 38,200 ng/mL. The tumor metastasized to Virchow's node. The response to chemotherapy was less favorable than expected for pure primary germ cell tumors. The authors also review the rarity of gastric yolk sac tumors, which are mainly reported in elderly patients.

pmid-10917177.summary_ja: 129/SvJマウスに移植した実験的精巣奇形腫モデルで、エトポシドの効果を検討した研究。移植4週後の治療では腫瘍が有意に縮小したが、6週後では認めなかった。エトポシドにより未熟神経外胚葉成分が減少し、組織像は成熟奇形腫に近づいた。化学療法後の成熟奇形腫は化学療法に反応しにくく、ヒトの残存腫瘍には完全切除と慎重な経過観察が必要とされる。
pmid-10917177.summary_en: This experimental study examines etoposide in an implanted testicular teratoma model in 129/SvJ mice. Treatment given 4 or 6 weeks after implantation was assessed for tumor growth, differentiation, apoptosis, and mdr1 P-glycoprotein localization. Etoposide significantly reduced the size of 4-week teratomas but not 6-week ones. Apoptosis and mdr1-Pgp distribution were unchanged. Immature neuroectodermal components decreased in all treated tumors, shifting histology toward mature teratoma. The authors conclude that postchemotherapy mature teratomas may not respond to chemotherapy, and that residual human tumors need complete surgical excision and surveillance.

pmid-10917316.summary_ja: 生後10週の女児に生じた肝原発の乳児型絨毛癌の症例報告。β-hCGの著明な上昇を認めた。術前にエトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法を行い、肺転移を伴う腫瘍は縮小した。拡大右半肝切除により完全切除に至り、22か月間寛解を維持した。
pmid-10917316.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-week-old girl with infantile choriocarcinoma of the liver, presenting with ovarian cysts, cardiac insufficiency and hemolytic anemia. Serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated. Preoperative chemotherapy with etoposide and cisplatin, later intensified with ifosfamide, reduced the tumor and lung metastases. Complete resection by extended right hemihepatectomy followed, and the child remained in remission for 22 months, suggesting that preoperative chemotherapy is effective.

pmid-10918171.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍74例を対象とした後方視的研究で、子宮と対側卵巣を温存する保存手術を検討した。約75%が病期I、63.5%が補助化学療法を受けた。再発は9.5%、死亡は2例だった。化学療法後の多くの女性で月経が回復し、健常な生児14例が得られた。
pmid-10918171.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 74 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with conservative surgery that preserved the uterus and contralateral ovary. Most had early-stage disease, and 63.5% received adjuvant chemotherapy. Recurrence occurred in 9.5% and two patients died. Most women resumed normal menstrual function after chemotherapy, and 14 healthy live births were recorded, suggesting that fertility-sparing surgery with chemotherapy is a reasonable approach for young patients with disease confined to one ovary.

pmid-10925110.summary_ja: 病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の20歳男性で、化学療法後に再発性の腹部および横隔膜上の成熟奇形腫に対し複数回の切除を受けた。新たな心雑音から三尖弁奇形腫が判明し、弁の全切除と置換を行った。精巣癌からの三尖弁転移の初例を報告し、胚細胞腫瘍の心臓転移について文献をレビューした。
pmid-10925110.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who was treated with chemotherapy and multiple resections of recurrent abdominal and supradiaphragmatic mature teratomas. A new heart murmur revealed a tricuspid valve teratoma, which was excised and replaced. The authors present the first discrete tricuspid valve metastasis from testicular carcinoma and review the literature on cardiac metastases from germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-10931468.summary_ja: 水腫性変化の胎盤、完全胞状奇胎、部分胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるサイクリンEの発現を免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。サイクリンE発現は絨毛癌で最も高く、S期分画と相関した。過剰な蓄積が絨毛細胞の増殖亢進と悪性転化に寄与する可能性が示唆され、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の悪性度マーカー候補となりうると考えられる。
pmid-10931468.summary_en: This study examined cyclin E immunohistochemically in hydropic placentas, complete and partial hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. Cyclin E expression rose progressively from hydropic change to partial and complete moles, and was highest in choriocarcinomas. Expression correlated with S-phase fraction in gestational trophoblastic disease, and the authors propose that cyclin E overaccumulation contributes to uncontrolled trophoblast proliferation and neoplastic transformation. The work suggests cyclin E as a candidate marker of malignant potential in trophoblastic disease.

pmid-10942066.summary_ja: 心移植後に免疫抑制療法を受けていた37歳男性に、多発骨転移を伴う転移性セミノーマが発生した症例報告である。骨髄生検で胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ陽性の未分化細胞を認め、血清のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は90 IU/lと上昇していた。精巣および後腹膜に原発巣はなく、シスプラチン併用化学療法と免疫抑制の減量により寛解に至った。
pmid-10942066.summary_en: A 37-year-old man who had undergone cardiac transplantation for dilated cardiomyopathy presented with bone pain and multiple bone metastases. Bone marrow biopsy showed undifferentiated cells that were cytokeratin and placental alkaline phosphatase positive. Serum hCG was elevated at 90 IU/l, confirming metastatic seminoma without testicular or retroperitoneal primary disease. The authors attribute this extragonadal seminoma to immunosuppression with cyclosporin and prednisolone. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy with reduced immunosuppression achieved remission.

pmid-10945304.summary_ja: 2歳の雌ラブラドール・レトリバーの卵巣奇形腫と後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。開腹術で両腫瘤を摘出し、病理組織学的検査で気管支・腸嚢胞、毛包、皮脂腺などを含む奇形腫の特徴が確認された。犬における原発性後腹膜奇形腫の初報告とされる。
pmid-10945304.summary_en: A two-year-old female Labrador retriever presented with anorexia and abdominal distension and was found at laparotomy to have a 31-cm mass in the left ovary and an 11-cm mass in the left retroperitoneum. Both were surgically excised. Histopathology showed tissue elements characteristic of teratoma, including bronchial and intestinal cysts, hair follicles, sebaceous and apocrine glands, neural tissue, cartilage, bone, and fat.
