The authors report this as the first described case of primary retroperitoneal teratoma in a dog.

pmid-10945485.summary_ja: 1991〜1996年に当施設で治療された再発非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍41例の解析。腫瘍マーカー上昇例では、救援化学療法に続く手術の方が化学療法単独より成績が良く、導入療法後の残存病変が予後不良の最も強い因子であった。マーカー正常で再発した13例は全例生存し、再発NSGCTの治療成績は向上しつつあると結論している。
pmid-10945485.summary_en: This single-institution series from 1991 to 1996 analyzed 41 patients treated for relapsed non-seminomatous germ cell tumours. Among 28 patients with raised markers at relapse, those receiving salvage chemotherapy followed by surgery had better outcomes than chemotherapy alone, and residual disease after induction was the strongest predictor of poor survival. All 13 patients relapsing with normal markers survived after primary surgical management. The authors conclude that outcomes for relapsed NSGCT are improving.

pmid-10951360.summary_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫の成熟型と未熟型を対象に、フローサイトメトリーでDNA倍数性を、免疫組織化学でPCNAとKi-67を解析した研究。生後3か月以内に切除された腫瘍は全て二倍体で、未熟奇形腫2例はPCNAが強陽性であった。PCNAとKi-67は増殖活性を反映しうると結論づけている。
pmid-10951360.summary_en: This study measured DNA ploidy, DNA index, and proliferation markers (PCNA and Ki-67) in congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas, including mature and immature tumors. By flow cytometry, all tumors resected within three months of birth were diploid, and PCNA was strongly positive in both immature cases. Ki-67 showed weak to moderate positivity. The authors conclude that PCNA and Ki-67 may reflect proliferative activity and that the predictive value of flow cytometry needs further study.

pmid-10952776.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の87検体と40例由来の上皮内癌を微小切開した36検体で、ヘテロ接合性の消失を解析した。3q27-q28などで共通の欠失が見つかり、前駆細胞である上皮内癌でも同様の欠失が認められた。これらの領域の遺伝子不活化が初期事象であることを示唆する。セミノーマが上皮内癌から非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍へ進展する中間段階であるという直線的進展モデルを支持する結果である。
pmid-10952776.summary_en: This study analyzed loss of heterozygosity across 87 testicular germ cell tumor specimens and 36 microdissected carcinoma in situ samples from 40 patients. Common deletions were found at 3q27-q28, 5q31, 5q34-q35, 9p22-p21 and 12q22, and similar losses appeared in precursor CIS cells, supporting early inactivation of genes in these regions. All embryonal carcinoma samples showed 3q27-q28 loss. The results support a linear progression model in which seminoma is an intermediate stage between CIS and non-seminomatous germ cell tumor.

pmid-10955556.summary_ja: 小児の胃奇形腫10例を報告した。全体の1%未満とまれな腫瘍である。未熟grade III奇形腫が2例あり、1例は肝と結腸に浸潤し、1例は所属リンパ節と大網に転移していた。全例で完全切除が行われ、死亡例はなかった。平均4.2年の観察期間中に再発例はなかった。成熟型・未熟型ともに完全切除で予後は良好であり、浸潤例でも化学療法や放射線療法は不要な可能性があるとする。
pmid-10955556.summary_en: This report describes ten children with gastric teratoma, which accounts for less than 1% of pediatric teratomas. Two cases were immature grade III tumors, one infiltrating the liver and colon and one metastasizing to regional lymph nodes and omentum. All patients underwent complete excision without deaths. After a mean follow-up of 4.2 years, none had recurrence. The authors conclude that both mature and immature gastric teratomas have an excellent prognosis after complete excision, and chemo- or radiotherapy may be unnecessary even when infiltration is present.

pmid-10955557.summary_ja: 過去5年間に治療された頭頸部奇形腫の小児7例を後方視的に検討した。頸部、口腔、頭蓋骨の部位が含まれ、頭蓋骨奇形腫の1例を除く全例が切除術を受け、良好な転帰を得た。病理組織学的検査では三胚葉由来の成熟組織が確認された。最長4年の追跡で再発は認められず、頸部症例では甲状腺機能は正常化した。著者らは、これらの奇形腫は大部分が良性で切除により根治可能であり、頸部症例では気道管理を優先すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-10955557.summary_en: A retrospective review of seven children with head and neck teratomas treated over five years, representing 2% of all teratomas seen. Locations included cervical, oral and skull sites. All but one underwent excision with satisfactory outcome; the skull teratoma was not operated on. Histopathology showed mature tissue from all three germ layers. Follow-up up to four years showed no recurrence, and thyroid function normalized in cervical cases. The authors conclude these teratomas are mostly benign and curable by excision, with airway management prioritized in cervical cases.

pmid-10958315.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌が産生するhCGの過剰により甲状腺機能亢進症を来した男性例を報告した。全報告例をレビューし、広範な病変を有し甲状腺症状は少ないことを示した。化学療法によりhCGが低下すると甲状腺中毒症は改善し、抗甲状腺薬はまれにしか必要ないとする。患者のhCGは妊娠時より甲状腺刺激活性の高い酸性変異体が多く、予後は一般に不良である。
pmid-10958315.summary_en: The authors report a man with thyrotoxicosis caused by excess human chorionic gonadotropin from metastatic choriocarcinoma, a germ cell tumor. Thyroid function tests later changed due to nonthyroidal illness. They reviewed all reported cases of hCG-associated thyrotoxicosis in men. Such patients usually have widespread disease and few thyrotoxic symptoms. Thyrotoxicosis typically resolves as hCG falls after chemotherapy, and antithyroid drugs are rarely needed. The circulating hCG has more acidic variants with greater thyroid-stimulating activity than in pregnancy, and prognosis is generally poor.

pmid-10958596.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍13例に、ピラゾロアクリジン600 mg/m2を3週間ごとに静脈内投与する第II相試験を行った。白血球数の最低値中央値は2.5/mm3で血液毒性が認められた。評価可能な13例のいずれも主要奏効は得られなかった。ピラゾロアクリジンは、シスプラチン抵抗性胚細胞腫瘍に対して有効でないと結論づけられた。
pmid-10958596.summary_en: This phase II trial tested pyrazoloacridine, given intravenously at 600 mg/m2 every three weeks, in 13 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. Hematologic toxicity was observed, with a median nadir leukocyte count of 2.5 cells/mm3, hemoglobin of 10.8 g/dl and platelets of 126,000/mm3. None of the 13 evaluable patients achieved a major response. The authors conclude that pyrazoloacridine is not efficacious in cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors.

pmid-10962317.summary_ja: ナイメーヘンで1982～1998年に精巣がんと診断された488例を後方視的に解析し、精巣摘除術後の再発を検討した。再発は7.4%に認められ、対側精巣がんはセミノーマ成分と関連し、全身再発より著しく遅く出現した。非セミノーマでは原発巣の奇形腫および胎児性癌成分が全身再発の予測因子であった。対側がんや病期Iセミノーマの再発後の予後は良好であった。
pmid-10962317.summary_en: This retrospective analysis from Nijmegen reviewed 488 men treated for testicular cancer between 1982 and 1998. Recurrence occurred in 7.4 percent, including 12 contralateral and 24 systemic cases. Contralateral cancer was more common with seminoma components and appeared much later, at a median of 63.8 months, than systemic recurrence at 6.1 months. Teratoma and embryonal components predicted systemic recurrence in nonseminomas. Overall disease-related mortality was 3.9 percent, and prognosis was good after contralateral cancer or Stage I seminoma recurrence.

pmid-10962566.summary_ja: 精巣原発のセミノーマと非セミノーマについて、テロメア長とテロメラーゼ活性を比較した。セミノーマは大半が13kb未満と短く、非セミノーマは全例で23kb以上と精子に近い長さを示した。テロメラーゼ活性は多くの腫瘍で認められ、陰性だったのは成熟奇形腫のみの非セミノーマ1例であった。非セミノーマは生殖系列様のテロメア恒常性を保つと考えられる。
pmid-10962566.summary_en: This study compared telomere length and telomerase activity between seminomas and nonseminomas of the testis. Most seminomas had telomeres below 13 kb, whereas all nonseminomas had telomeres of at least 23 kb, similar to human sperm. Telomerase activity was present in most tumours of both types. The only telomerase-negative nonseminoma was a pure mature teratoma. The authors conclude that the telomere length difference is unrelated to telomerase activity and that nonseminomas retain germline-like telomere homeostasis.

pmid-10962575.summary_ja: CDK阻害因子p19INK4dのヒト精巣における発現を、正常発生と腫瘍化の各段階で検討した。p19INK4dは成人正常精巣の精母細胞に豊富に存在したが、上皮内癌を含む精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではほとんど検出されなかった。胎児胚細胞にも認められず、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の胎児起源説を支持する結果であった。
pmid-10962575.summary_en: This study examined p19INK4d, a cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, in the human testis. The protein was abundant in spermatocytes of normal adult testes but nearly undetectable in testicular germ cell tumours, including carcinoma in situ. It was also absent in fetal germ cells. These findings support a fetal origin for testicular germ cell tumours and highlight the role of the RB pathway in both spermatogenesis and tumorigenesis in the human testis.

pmid-10965301.summary_ja: pT3N2M1のセミノーマ患者31歳が、シスプラチン併用化学療法の2コース目中に脳底動脈血栓症を発症した。入院後14時間で死亡した。シスプラチン併用化学療法に伴う脳血管障害は稀だが致死的になりうるため、精巣がんの治療に当たる際には留意すべきと報告している。
pmid-10965301.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with pT3N2M1 seminoma who developed basilar artery thrombosis during the second course of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. He died 14 hours after hospital admission. The authors note that cerebrovascular events related to cisplatin-based chemotherapy are rare but potentially fatal. They advise clinicians treating testicular cancer to keep these complications in mind.

pmid-10965461.summary_ja: 37歳男性が右陰嚢腫脹と多発リンパ節腫大で受診した。右根治的精巣摘除術で精巣セミノーマと診断され、BEP療法を3コース施行した。後腹膜と左頸部の転移は縮小したが右頸部腫瘤は不変で、切除の結果、甲状腺乳頭癌の転移と判明した。精巣がんの転移が化学療法に反応しない場合は、別の原発巣を疑う手がかりになりうると述べている。
pmid-10965461.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with right scrotal swelling and multiple lymph node enlargement. Right radical orchiectomy revealed testicular seminoma. After staging, he received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy, which was effective for retroperitoneal and left cervical nodes but not for a right cervical mass. Retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, right cervical dissection, and hemithyroidectomy revealed papillary thyroid cancer with nodal metastasis, while the retroperitoneal nodes contained no viable germ cell tumor. The authors suggest that chemotherapy unresponsiveness of metastases from testicular cancer may signal a primary tumor of another origin.

pmid-10965623.summary_ja: 22歳男性の左肺門部の嚢胞性病変を報告する。術前は縦隔奇形腫が疑われたが、開胸で左上葉前区域の腫瘍が確認され、区域切除で肺内成熟奇形腫(4.0×3.5cm)と診断された。英文報告で27例目にあたる。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見も記載されている。
pmid-10965623.summary_en: The authors describe a 22-year-old man with a cystic lesion in the left lung hilum, initially suspected to be an anterior mediastinal teratoma. Thoracotomy revealed the tumor in the anterior segment of the left upper lobe, and segmentectomy confirmed an intrapulmonary mature teratoma measuring 4.0 x 3.5 cm. This was the 27th such case in the English literature. CT and MRI showed a heterogeneous cystic lesion, and the authors state this is the first intrapulmonary teratoma evaluated by MRI.

pmid-10965746.summary_ja: 慢性腎不全で血液透析中のステージIIIAセミノーマ患者で、シスプラチンとエトポシドの薬物動態を調べた。初回は骨髄抑制が強く、減量・透析日変更の治療に切り替えた。完全寛解が得られ、5年間再発はなかった。透析患者でも減量すれば副作用を抑えて投与できると結論している。
pmid-10965746.summary_en: The pharmacokinetics of cisplatin and etoposide were studied in a patient with stage IIIA seminoma who was receiving hemodialysis for chronic renal failure. Strong myelosuppression after the first regimen led to a reduced-dose schedule with hemodialysis on different days. Cisplatin AUC fell from 6.82 to 4.07 microg.hr/ml, and etoposide AUC was 241.9 and 216.9 microg.hr/ml. Complete remission was achieved, with no recurrence for five years. The authors conclude that these agents can be given to dialysis patients at reduced doses to limit toxicity.

pmid-10966195.summary_ja: 本研究は、4例の患者における卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉洞腫瘍）の放射線学的および病理学的特徴を報告している。CTとMRIでは、強く造影される充実性腫瘤として描出され、MRIでは顕著な信号欠損を伴っていた。顕微鏡検査で高血管性が確認され、出血は一般的な所見であった。著者らは、これらの画像所見が本腫瘍の診断に重要であると提案している。
pmid-10966195.summary_en: This study reports the radiologic and pathologic features of ovarian yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) in four patients. On CT and MRI, the tumors appeared as well-enhancing solid masses with prominent signal voids on MRI. Microscopy confirmed a hypervascular nature, and hemorrhage was a common finding. The authors propose that these imaging features are important for diagnosing this tumor.

pmid-10966994.summary_ja: 1960～1993年に精巣がんを発症したデンマーク人男性3530例を、記録照合で解析した。一般集団と比べて妊孕性が低下し、男児の割合も低かった。妊孕性の低下は非セミノーマで顕著であった。精巣がん、男性不妊、出生児性比の偏りは生物学的機序を共有すると結論している。
pmid-10966994.summary_en: This Danish record-linkage study included 3530 men who developed testicular cancer between 1960 and 1993. Compared with the general population, they showed reduced fertility (standardized rate ratio 0.93) and a lower proportion of male offspring (48.9% versus 51.3%). The fertility reduction was greater in non-seminoma patients, while the sex ratio shift was independent of histology. The authors suggest that testicular cancer, subfertility, and a female-biased sex ratio share biological mechanisms.

pmid-10967853.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)の2症例で、経腟超音波検査による術前評価の有用性を報告する。経腟超音波は両側卵巣の描出能を高め、正確な術前診断に役立つ。類皮嚢腫の典型的な超音波所見も示されている。
pmid-10967853.summary_en: The authors describe the value of transvaginal sonography for preoperative characterization of ovarian dermoid cysts in two patients. The report outlines the characteristic sonographic features of ovarian dermoid cysts. Transvaginal ultrasound improves visualization of both ovaries and supports accurate preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-10969472.summary_ja: 新生児の鼻前庭に発生した成熟奇形腫の初症例を報告する。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織を含む先天性の希少腫瘍で、頭頸部は全体の2～9%である。上気道奇形腫の診断と治療法を考察し、文献の簡単な概説も加えている。
pmid-10969472.summary_en: The authors report the first case of a teratoma arising in the nasal vestibule, in a newborn. Teratomas are rare congenital neoplasms derived from pluripotent cells, containing tissue from all three germ layers. Head and neck teratomas account for only 2 to 9 percent of cases. The article discusses diagnosis and treatment of upper airway teratomas and includes a brief literature review.

pmid-10969703.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマが上大静脈内へ直接浸潤し、右心房まで進展した稀な症例を報告する。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で上大静脈の欠損を確認し、急速な腫瘍縮小による破裂の危険性を考慮して治療計画を立てた。放射線療法と化学療法を組み合わせ、腫瘍侵入部の上大静脈欠損は徐々に治癒した。
pmid-10969703.summary_en: The authors present an unusual mediastinal seminoma that invaded the superior vena cava by direct intraluminal extension and reached the right atrium. MRI showed the SVC defect, which guided treatment because rapid tumor regression could risk SVC rupture. A tailored regimen of radiotherapy and chemotherapy led to gradual healing of the SVC defect at the tumor entry site.

pmid-10969740.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)で発現するHERV-Kの誘導因子を、胎児性癌細胞株NT2D1を用いて解析した。骨形成タンパク質(BMP)とレチノイン酸が早期に発現を誘導し、アクチビンやTGF-βでは誘導されなかった。誘導は一過性で、分化後には検出されなくなった。NT2D1細胞は分化時のHERV-K制御因子の研究に適した系であると述べている。
pmid-10969740.summary_en: HERV-K endogenous retrovirus expression is low in normal and tumor tissue but is detected in testicular germ cell tumors. NT2D1 embryonal carcinoma cells, which model TGCT stem cells, were used to show that HERV-K is induced early by bone morphogenetic proteins and retinoic acid, but not by activin or TGF-beta. Induction was rapid but transient, becoming undetectable upon differentiation. The authors propose NT2D1 cells as a system to study factors controlling HERV-K expression during differentiation.

pmid-10970686.summary_ja: 精巣がん治療後の患者55例(FDG-PET 70回)を後方視的に解析した本研究では、残存腫瘤例で陽性的中率96%、陰性的中率90%と、腫瘍マーカーより高い陰性的中率を示した。マーカーのみ上昇した例では陰性的中率が50%にとどまった。FDG-PETは再発部位の同定に有用で、57%の症例で治療方針が変更された。
pmid-10970686.summary_en: Retrospective study of 55 patients with testicular germ cell tumours who underwent 70 FDG-PET scans for residual masses or raised tumour markers with normal CT. In residual masses, FDG-PET showed a positive predictive value of 96% and a negative predictive value of 90%, with a higher negative predictive value than markers. In patients with raised markers alone, PPV was 92% but NPV only 50%. FDG-PET localised recurrence sites and changed management in 57% of cases, supporting its role in evaluating relapse.

pmid-10971168.summary_ja: 低リスク51例にはCEB(90)、高リスク9例にはVIPを用いたリスク適応型化学療法の単施設研究。CEB(90)では51例中45例が完全寛解に達し、3年生存率は全体で93%であった。高リスク例では9例中7例が完全寛解を得た。CEB(90)は外来で忍容性が高いが、シスプラチンに劣る可能性があり、臨床試験内での使用が推奨された。
pmid-10971168.summary_en: Single-centre study of 60 germ cell tumour patients treated with risk-adapted chemotherapy: 51 low-risk patients received carboplatin, etoposide and bleomycin (CEB90), and 9 high-risk patients received VIP. Among CEB90 patients, 45 of 51 achieved complete remission, with 3-year survival of 93% overall and 95% in the good-prognosis group. Seven of nine high-risk patients achieved CR. The authors conclude that CEB90 is a well-tolerated outpatient regimen, but recommend its use only within clinical trials given inferior results versus cisplatin.

pmid-10971278.summary_ja: 1983〜1998年に積極的監視を行った病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍185例を後方視的に解析した研究。26例(14%)が再発し、再発までの期間中央値は4か月であった。全例が化学療法などで救済された。精巣摘除術前の症状期間は再発の有無で差がなく、診断の遅れは再発確率に影響しなかった。
pmid-10971278.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 185 consecutive patients with low-risk or unknown-risk stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumour managed with active surveillance at Mount Vernon Hospital (1983-1998). Twenty-six patients (14%) relapsed, with a median time to relapse of four months. All were salvaged with chemotherapy, some with surgery. Duration of symptoms before orchidectomy did not differ significantly between relapsing and non-relapsing patients, indicating that diagnostic delay did not influence relapse probability.

pmid-10971742.summary_ja: ヒト精巣の上皮内セミノーマおよび浸潤性セミノーマに浸潤するリンパ球を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究。T細胞とB細胞が中心で、活性化マーカーやアポトーシスは低かった。上皮内病変と浸潤性病変の間に差はなく、腫瘍特異的リンパ球の欠如やFasL以外の免疫抑制機構の関与が示唆された。
pmid-10971742.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of lymphocytes infiltrating seminiferous tubules containing in situ seminoma and invasive seminomas in human testis. Lymphocytes were about 30% of cells, mainly CD4+ and CD8+ T cells and B cells, with few gamma/delta T and NK cells. Activation markers IL-2R, FasL and perforin were low, and apoptosis was limited. No differences were seen between in situ and invasive lesions. The authors suggest that specifically committed lymphocytes are absent, or that immune-suppressing mechanisms operate in addition to FasL.

pmid-10975558.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の疫学、遺伝学、診断、治療の最近の進歩をまとめた総説。部分胞状奇胎から絨毛癌までの疾患スペクトラムを扱う。超音波検査や高感度β-hCG検査により胞状奇胎の臨床像は変化したが、持続性GTDの発生率は低下していないと述べている。
pmid-10975558.summary_en: Review of gestational trophoblastic disease, a spectrum of rare, highly curable neoplasms ranging from partial hydatidiform mole, which rarely requires chemotherapy, to choriocarcinoma, treated with multi-agent chemotherapy. The review covers advances in epidemiology, genetics, diagnosis and treatment. Improved imaging such as ultrasonography and sensitive beta-hCG assays have changed the presentation of molar pregnancy, although the incidence of persistent disease has not declined.

pmid-10975942.summary_ja: 子宮頸部扁平上皮癌の再発に対し両側卵管卵巣摘出術を受けた43歳女性で、卵巣成熟奇形腫の主成分をなすグロムス腫瘍を偶発的に認めた症例報告。膣の再発癌と類似したため当初は転移と判断された。免疫組織化学と超微形態学的検索で診断され、類似の報告はないとしている。
pmid-10975942.summary_en: Case report of a glomus tumour forming the major component of a mature ovarian teratoma, found incidentally in a 43-year-old woman undergoing bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for recurrent cervical squamous carcinoma. Its superficial resemblance to the vaginal recurrence initially suggested metastasis. Immunohistochemistry and ultrastructural examination supported the glomus tumour diagnosis. The authors note that no similar tumour has previously been described in the ovary or in teratomas elsewhere.

pmid-10979266.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(純粋セミノーマ)から頭蓋内硬膜転移を生じた24歳男性の症例報告。放射線療法後のMRIで髄膜腫様の腫瘍が見つかり、部分摘出とカルボプラチン・エトポシドによる化学療法の2サイクルで残存腫瘍はほぼ消失した。寛解後も他部位の再発を含め、長期のフォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-10979266.summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old man with a mediastinal germ cell tumour infiltrating the superior vena cava, pericardium, aorta and lung, who later developed an intracranial dural metastasis mimicking a meningioma. Treatment comprised partial resection and radiotherapy, then partial tumour removal and two cycles of carboplatin and etoposide, which nearly eliminated the residual tumour. Both lesions were pure seminoma. The authors recommend long-term follow-up for patients in remission.

pmid-10984413.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株を用いて、子宮上皮細胞への接着と分化の関係を調べたin vitro研究。分化誘導剤はhCG分泌を増やす一方で接着を低下させた。分化と接着能は逆相関する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10984413.summary_en: This in vitro study examines how trophoblast-type choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, JAr, Jeg-3) adhere to uterine epithelial cells, a process relevant to embryo implantation. Cells were treated with retinoic acid, methotrexate, dibutyryl-cAMP, or PMA to induce differentiation. All agents increased hCG secretion but reduced adhesion to endometrial monolayers in all three cell lines. The findings suggest that differentiation and adhesive capacity are inversely linked, and that epithelial adhesion is regulated differently from the matrix invasion seen in later trophoblast invasion.

pmid-10984827.summary_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理に関する総説。現代の治療により治癒率は非常に高い。現在の焦点は、治療に伴う毒性による罹患率を減らすことにある。
pmid-10984827.summary_en: This review addresses the management of low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. It notes that testicular cancer has become one of the most curable solid neoplasms, with high cure rates from modern treatment regimens. The focus has shifted toward reducing the morbidity of potentially toxic treatment for low-stage disease. The abstract is brief and provides only a general overview of the clinical approach to balancing cure with treatment-related toxicity.

pmid-10985150.summary_ja: 小児の精巣奇形腫と類表皮嚢胞の診断と管理に関する総説。思春期前の患者では良性病変が強く疑われる。精巣温存手術の適応は凍結切片で確定する必要があり、精巣摘除術より温存手術が支持される。
pmid-10985150.summary_en: This review addresses the diagnosis and management of teratomas and epidermoid cysts in children. Preoperative sonographic, biochemical, and clinical evaluation can strongly suggest a benign lesion in prepubertal patients. Testis-sparing enucleation requires a definitive diagnosis by frozen section pathology. The authors argue that the high incidence of benign testicular lesions, the absence of carcinoma in situ in prepubertal germ cell tumors, and the benign behavior of these tumors support testis-sparing surgery over orchiectomy.

pmid-10985882.summary_ja: 英国の絨毛性疾患スクリーニング登録者を後方視的に解析し、再度の胞状奇胎の頻度と特徴を調べた。再発率は1%未満で、血液型Bで高かった。再発時の化学療法は6%にとどまり、再発だけでは化学療法の適応にならないと結論づけている。
pmid-10985882.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 5,030 registrants at a UK trophoblastic screening service examines women who develop a second molar pregnancy. The recurrence risk is less than 1%, highest in the second year after the first event. Women with blood group B and, possibly, Indian/Pakistani women showed increased risk. Only 6% required chemotherapy for the second mole, and partial moles tended to recur as partial moles. The authors conclude that a second molar pregnancy is not in itself an indication for chemotherapy.

pmid-10987254.summary_ja: AFPを産生し血清AFPが上昇した膵腫瘍5例を報告し、文献もレビューした。うち1例は縦隔奇形腫の膵成分から生じた。AFP産生は腺房細胞分化と関連し、膵芽腫と腺房細胞癌が多い。両者の鑑別は難しいとされる。
pmid-10987254.summary_en: This study presents five pancreatic tumors that produced alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) and showed elevated serum AFP, along with a review of documented cases. Four arose in the orthotopic pancreas, while one arose in the pancreatic component of a mediastinal teratoma. The patients were children or young adults. AFP production was closely linked to acinar differentiation, mostly in pancreatoblastoma or acinar cell carcinoma. The authors note these two tumors share many features and can be difficult to distinguish.

pmid-10998444.summary_ja: 末梢血中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)mRNAを半定量RT-PCRで測定し、胚細胞腫瘍患者7例の循環腫瘍量を健常対照者と比較した。治療前にAFP mRNAが大きく上昇した7例は全例、12か月以内に再発または転移を来した。治療前に播種した腫瘍細胞が再発の源となる可能性が示された。AFP mRNAの経時的測定は、転移リスクの高い患者の同定に有用と考えられる。
pmid-10998444.summary_en: This study quantified circulating tumour load in germ cell tumour patients by semiquantitative RT-PCR for alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) mRNA in peripheral blood. Samples from seven patients at diagnosis and during follow-up were compared with 47 healthy controls. All seven patients with markedly elevated AFP mRNA before treatment developed recurrence or metastasis within 12 months. The authors propose that AFP-expressing tumour cells disseminating before treatment may be the source of relapse. Sequential AFP mRNA monitoring may help identify patients at high risk of metastasis.

pmid-11000572.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する303例（セミノーマ120例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍183例）の監視療法の成績を報告している。中央値5.1年の追跡期間中の死亡は3例のみであった。再発はNSGCTの28%、セミノーマの15%に生じた。5年再発フリー生存率はセミノーマで82%、NSGCTで69%であった。再発の大半は予後良好または中間リスク群で発生し、5例が対側精巣腫瘍を発症した。著者らは、動機づけの高い施設では監視療法の死亡率は低く、過剰治療を回避できると結論づけている。
pmid-11000572.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of surveillance in 303 men with stage I testicular germ cell tumours: 120 with seminoma and 183 with non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT). Median follow-up was 5.1 years, with only three deaths. Relapse occurred in 28% of NSGCT and 15% of seminoma patients. Five-year relapse-free survival was 82% for seminoma and 69% for NSGCT. Most relapses occurred in good or intermediate prognosis groups, and five patients developed contralateral testicular tumours. The authors conclude surveillance has low mortality and avoids overtreatment in well-motivated centres.

pmid-11002361.summary_ja: 穿刺吸引細胞診で卵黄嚢腫瘍に特徴的なシラー・デュバル小体の細胞学的所見を検討した。29歳男性の後腹膜リンパ節転移例では、細胞ブロックに多数の小体が認められた。塗抹標本では腫瘍細胞に覆われた血管様構造が観察された。これらは穿刺生検での卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断の手がかりとなりうる。
pmid-11002361.summary_en: This cytology study identifies cytological features of Schiller-Duval bodies, a histologic hallmark of yolk sac tumour, in fine-needle aspiration. The case involved a retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis of yolk sac tumour associated with testicular complex mature teratoma in a 29-year-old man. Cell block sections showed numerous Schiller-Duval bodies. Smears displayed anastomosing, thin-walled vascular channels with marked diameter variation, folded balloon-like channels, and branched vascular fragments. These findings may serve as diagnostic clues for yolk sac tumour on aspiration biopsy.

pmid-11005356.summary_ja: 進行した絨毛癌（非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍）の52歳男性で、化学療法開始後48時間以内に腫瘍崩壊症候群を発症した症例報告である。人工呼吸管理と透析により腎機能は改善したが、その後の化学療法後に肺不全で死亡した。進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の全身化学療法後に腫瘍崩壊症候群を来した初めての報告とされる。
pmid-11005356.summary_en: A 52-year-old man with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell cancer (choriocarcinoma) with retroperitoneal, lung, and liver metastases developed acute tumor lysis syndrome within 48 hours of receiving etoposide, cisplatin, and bleomycin. He had hypotension, hypoxemia, and anuria, requiring mechanical ventilation and hemodialysis. Renal function improved, but after a shortened carboplatin and etoposide course he died of pulmonary insufficiency and cardiac arrest on day 48. The authors report this as the first case of tumor lysis syndrome after systemic chemotherapy for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell cancer.

pmid-11005453.summary_ja: 進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療方針を決めるための予後因子をレビューした。従来の因子には腫瘍量、肝・骨・脳転移、腫瘍マーカーの著明な上昇、縦隔原発が含まれる。β-hCGやMAGE発現などの生物学的因子は前向き試験での検証が必要とされる。また、専門施設での治療が予後に影響する点も強調されている。
pmid-11005453.summary_en: This review discusses prognostic factors guiding management of advanced testicular germ cell tumors. Traditional factors include large tumor volume, liver, bone or brain metastases, markedly elevated tumor markers, and extragonadal mediastinal primary sites. Novel factors include patient-related, socioeconomic, and tumor-biology markers such as beta-hCG and MAGE expression in seminoma and the proportion of embryonal carcinoma or vascular invasion. The authors emphasize that treatment in experienced centers influences outcomes and that biologic factors need prospective validation to tailor individualized treatment.

pmid-11005688.summary_ja: 経直腸超音波ガイド下生検で診断された、前立腺転移を有するセミノーマの症例である。化学療法10週後に直腸膀胱瘻を発症したが、腫瘍が画像上の完全奏効を示したことで瘻孔は治癒した。まれな転移部位と化学療法の稀な合併症を示す単一症例の報告であり、提示、診断法、臨床経過が記載されている。
pmid-11005688.summary_en: A man with metastatic seminoma to the prostate, diagnosed by transrectal ultrasound-guided biopsy, developed a rectovesical fistula after ten weeks of chemotherapy. The fistula healed after the tumor achieved a complete radiological response to treatment. The case highlights an unusual site of metastatic seminoma and a rare complication of systemic chemotherapy. It is a single case report describing the presentation, diagnostic approach, and clinical course.

pmid-11006028.summary_ja: 成人の精巣および卵巣胚細胞腫瘍104組の腫瘍と正常DNAを用いて、マイクロサテライト不安定性を解析した。精巣腫瘍では24例中7例で一箇所のみに認められ、卵巣腫瘍では悪性例の多くで広範な不安定性が認められた。精巣腫瘍における遺伝的不安定性の役割は卵巣腫瘍より小さいと結論されているが、病因的意義は不明のままである。
pmid-11006028.summary_en: This study examined microsatellite instability (replication error) in 104 paired tumor and constitutional DNA samples from adult testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, including carcinoma in situ. Replication error appeared at one locus in 7 of 24 testicular tumors, suggesting limited involvement. Ovarian germ cell tumors showed widespread instability at 38 of 64 loci, with 12 of 36 malignant tumors affected. The authors conclude that genetic instability plays a lesser role in testicular germ cell tumors than in ovarian germ cell tumors, though its pathogenic significance remains uncertain.

pmid-11006413.summary_ja: 研究者らは、半骨盤放射線療法を受けた3例のセミノーマ患者の精子について、治療前と、前減数分裂・減数分裂・減数分裂後の各段階で照射された細胞由来の精子とを比較し、微小衛星変異頻度を測定した。B6.7およびCEB1の座位で超高感度の単一分子解析法を用いたところ、放射線誘発変異の証拠は認められなかった。この結果は、放射線誘発性の生殖細胞系変異を示唆した過去の集団研究と比較して考察されている。本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する放射線療法後の遺伝的安全性を検討したものである。
pmid-11006413.summary_en: Researchers measured minisatellite mutation frequencies in sperm from three seminoma patients who received hemipelvic radiotherapy, comparing pre-treatment sperm with sperm derived from cells irradiated at pre-meiotic, meiotic, and post-meiotic stages. Using a highly sensitive single-molecule approach at the B6.7 and CEB1 loci, they detected no evidence of radiation-induced mutation. The findings are discussed against earlier population studies that suggested radiation-induced germline mutation. The study addresses germline genetic safety after radiotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-11012991.summary_ja: 本報告は、64歳男性の精巣に生じ、主に肝様細胞から構成される卵黄嚢腫瘍（内胚葉洞腫瘍）を記述している。左精巣の腫瘤は約4×3cmで、血清αフェトプロテインは5479 ng/mLと著明に上昇していた。組織学的には、好酸性または明るい細胞質を持つ肝細胞様細胞がシート状と索状に増殖していた。腫瘍細胞はAFPや複数の肝・上皮系マーカーに陽性であった。著者らは、この亜型を転移性肝細胞癌、胎児性癌、肝様癌と鑑別する必要性を強調している。
pmid-11012991.summary_en: This report describes a testicular yolk sac tumor (endodermal sinus tumor) composed predominantly of hepatoid cells in a 64-year-old man. The left testicular mass measured about 4 x 3 cm, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated at 5479 ng/mL. Histologically, eosinophilic or clear hepatocyte-like cells grew in sheets and trabeculae, and tumor cells were immunoreactive for AFP and several hepatic and epithelial markers. The authors emphasize the need to distinguish this variant from metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma, embryonal carcinoma and hepatoid carcinoma.

pmid-11013274.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で治療された再発精巣がん患者65例を対象に、初回救援療法としてのカルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法の成績を検討した。追跡期間中央値39ヶ月で57%が無病生存を持続し、さらに3例が手術後に無病となった。有意な有害事象が認められたが、治療関連死はなかった。許容しうる毒性で良好な長期生存が得られたと結論された。
pmid-11013274.summary_en: This study evaluated high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with stem-cell rescue as initial salvage chemotherapy in 65 patients with relapsed testicular cancer. With a median follow-up of 39 months, 57% remained continuously disease-free, and three more patients became disease-free after surgery. The treatment caused significant morbidity without treatment-related deaths. The authors conclude that it achieves impressive long-term survival with acceptable toxicity.

pmid-11014571.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍115例、副精巣腫瘍3例、男性ホルモン不応症候群6例を対象に、インヒビンα、CD99、HEA125、PLAP、クロモグラニンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。インヒビンαは主に性索間質性腫瘍で陽性であり、PLAPは多くの胚細胞腫瘍で陽性であった。インヒビンα、PLAP、CD99、HEA125は精巣腫瘍の鑑別診断に有用であるが、クロモグラニンの有用性は限られると結論された。
pmid-11014571.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined inhibin-alpha, CD99, HEA125, PLAP and chromogranin in 115 testicular tumors, 3 epididymal tumors and 6 cases of androgen insensitivity syndrome. Inhibin-alpha was largely restricted to sex cord-stromal tumors, while PLAP was present in most germ cell tumors. CD99 and HEA125 showed variable staining, and chromogranin was of limited value. The authors conclude that inhibin-alpha, PLAP, CD99 and HEA125 aid differential diagnosis of testicular neoplasms.

pmid-11014580.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍21例とその周囲の精細管を対象に、正常男性胚細胞のマーカーであるRBMタンパク質の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。正常な精子形成を示す精細管ではRBMが陽性であったが、全ての胚細胞腫瘍と精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)の領域では陰性であった。RBM染色の消失はIGCNの同定に有用であり、精巣の浸潤前悪性病変の診断ツールになりうると結論された。
pmid-11014580.summary_en: This study examined RBM protein, a marker of normal male germ cells, in 21 testicular germ cell tumors and the adjacent seminiferous tubules. RBM was expressed in normal spermatogenic tubules but was absent in all germ cell tumors and in defined areas of intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCN). Loss of RBM staining allowed identification of IGCN, suggesting that RBM immunostaining may be a useful diagnostic tool for detecting preinvasive malignancy of the testis.

pmid-11014955.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株4種(GCH-1、GCH-1m、NUC-1、SCH)において、肝細胞増殖因子(HGF)受容体c-METの発現を解析した。全ての細胞株でc-METのmRNAとタンパク質が発現し、構成的にチロシンリン酸化されていた。一方、HGFは発現していなかった。c-METが絨毛癌の増殖や性質に関与する可能性が示唆されたが、オートクリン機構は考えにくいとされた。
pmid-11014955.summary_en: This study assessed c-MET, the hepatocyte growth factor receptor, in four human choriocarcinoma cell lines. RT-PCR showed that none of the lines expressed HGF, although all expressed c-MET mRNA. Western blotting demonstrated constitutive tyrosine phosphorylation of c-MET in these cells. The findings suggest that c-MET may contribute to the growth and behavior of choriocarcinoma, although an autocrine HGF loop seems unlikely.

pmid-11016773.summary_ja: 盲腸に生じたきわめてまれな類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。超音波検査とCTによる画像所見を、病理所見と対比して記載し、鑑別診断を簡潔に検討している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫に相当する病変で、本例は性腺外発生の胚細胞腫瘍の範疇に入る。
pmid-11016773.summary_en: A case report describing ultrasonography and CT findings of a dermoid cyst arising in the cecum, a very rare location for this lesion. The paper correlates imaging with pathology and briefly discusses differential diagnosis. Dermoid cysts are mature teratoma-type lesions, so this extragonadal case falls within the germ cell tumor spectrum. The report is brief and focuses on imaging characteristics.

pmid-11021820.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍における限局性12p増幅とK-RAS変異を検討した研究である。一次腫瘍の約8%で増幅を認め、セミノーマでは発症年齢の若年化とアポトーシスの低下に関連した。しかし増幅やRAS変異は病期、治療反応、生存を予測しなかった。12p獲得は浸潤性増殖に関与すると考察している。
pmid-11021820.summary_en: This study examines restricted 12p amplification and K-RAS mutations in adult testicular germ cell tumors. The amplification occurred in about 8% of primary tumors and was associated with younger age at diagnosis in seminomas, along with reduced apoptosis. However, neither amplification nor RAS mutation predicted stage, treatment response, or survival. The authors propose that 12p gain supports invasive growth.

pmid-11022995.summary_ja: 子宮絨毛癌の23歳女性で、胸部X線が粟粒状陰影を呈した症例報告である。剖検では実質転移ではなく肺筋性動脈内の多数の腫瘍塞栓が確認された。絨毛癌の肺転移が粟粒結核様の像を示す原因は、大血管内の腫瘍塞栓である可能性を示唆している。
pmid-11022995.summary_en: A case report of a 23-year-old woman with uterine choriocarcinoma whose chest X-ray showed a miliary-like pattern. Autopsy revealed multiple macrovascular tumour emboli in pulmonary muscular arteries rather than parenchymal metastases. The authors suggest that the miliary appearance of choriocarcinoma lung metastases may result from large-vessel tumour embolism, which can mimic tuberculosis.

pmid-11024504.summary_ja: 原発巣が不明な若年男性で、精巣がんが脊髄圧迫として発症した2症例を報告している。両例とも下肢の急速な筋力低下があり、緊急手術と化学療法を受けた。神経機能は改善したものの、独立歩行はできなかった。著者らは、若年男性で原因不明の脊髄圧迫がある場合は、脊椎のMRIとCTによる病期分類を推奨している。
pmid-11024504.summary_en: Two case reports describing testicular cancer presenting as spinal cord compression in young men without known primary disease. Both patients had rapid lower-limb weakness, underwent emergency surgery, and received chemotherapy. Neurological function improved but independent ambulation was not regained. The authors recommend spinal MRI and CT staging in young men with unexplained cord compression.

pmid-11029621.summary_ja: 本研究はヒト胎児性癌細胞株NTERA-2を用い、レチノイン酸による神経分化過程の遺伝子発現を解析した。分化は3段階に分かれ、初期にはnestinの一過性上昇、次いで細胞周期離脱期にneuroD1とA2B5が発現し、後期にはsynaptophysinやneuron-specific enolaseが増加した。in vitroの経路は生体内の神経発生に類似していた。
pmid-11029621.summary_en: This study uses the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NTERA-2, a model of pluripotent germ-cell-tumour stem cells, to examine gene expression during retinoic acid-induced neuronal differentiation. Differentiation proceeded in three phases: transient hath1 and nestin expression early, neuroD1 and A2B5 expression as cells exited the cell cycle, and later increases in synaptophysin and neuron-specific enolase. The authors conclude that the in vitro pathway resembles neural precursor development seen in vivo.

pmid-11032177.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞に相当するヒト胎児性癌細胞NT2D1を、BMPまたはレチノイン酸で処理した。レチノイン酸は神経・内胚葉・上皮マーカーを誘導したのに対し、BMPは主に上皮表現型をもたらした。レチノイン酸の作用の一部はBMP-7の誘導を介する。BMPシグナルによる多能性幹細胞の分化制御を提案している。
pmid-11032177.summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells, which represent the stem cells of testicular germ cell tumours, were treated with bone morphogenetic proteins (BMPs) or retinoic acid. Retinoic acid induced neuronal, endodermal and epithelial markers, whereas BMPs drove a predominantly epithelial phenotype. Retinoic acid effects were partly mediated through induced BMP-7. The authors propose BMP signalling as a means to direct differentiation of multipotent stem cells, potentially reversing malignant features.

pmid-11032921.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞悪性腫瘍16例を、BEP療法群（6例）とBAP療法群（10例）に分けて比較した。BAP群では脱毛、貧血、好中球減少が有意に軽度だった。5年生存率はBAP群87.5%、BEP群83.3%で有意差はなかった。BAP療法は予後を損なわず有害反応を減らす点で有益と考えられた。
pmid-11032921.summary_en: Sixteen patients with ovarian germ cell malignancy were divided into a BEP group (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin; n=6) and a BAP group (bleomycin, actinomycin-D, cisplatin; n=10). BAP patients had significantly milder alopecia, anaemia and neutropenia. Five-year survival was 87.5% with BAP and 83.3% with BEP, a non-significant difference. The authors conclude BAP may be preferable because it reduces adverse reactions without compromising outcome.

pmid-11034516.summary_ja: 新生児に生じた先天性頸部奇形腫9例を2施設の症例で検討した。病変は組織学的には良性のことが多いが巨大で気道閉塞を起こしやすく、出生時や胎児超音波検査で診断されることが多い。術前に1例が死亡し、手術関連死が2例発生した。残る6例は完全切除により良好な経過をたどり、3〜14年の追跡でも明らかな後遺症はみられなかった。
pmid-11034516.summary_en: This two-institution series from 1984 to 1996 describes nine neonates with congenital cervical teratoma, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor. Lesions are usually histologically benign but large, often causing airway obstruction, and are often diagnosed at birth or prenatally by ultrasound. One infant died before surgery, one intraoperative and one postoperative death occurred, and the remaining six did well after complete surgical excision, with 3 to 14 years of follow-up. The authors also review malignant cervical teratomas with metastasis, which mostly occur in adults and carry a poor outcome.

pmid-11034964.summary_ja: カナダ3州のがん登録データ（1970〜1995年、7296例）を用い、精巣セミノーマと非セミノーマの発症率推移を別々に解析した。両者とも増加したが、非セミノーマは91%増で若年男性（15〜19歳）に多く、セミノーマは高齢者で多かった。年齢・時代・コホートモデルではいずれも出生コホートによる変化が示され、病因の異質性が示唆された。
pmid-11034964.summary_en: Using cancer registry data from Ontario, Saskatchewan and British Columbia (1970 to 1995, 7296 testicular cancers), this study analyzed incidence trends of seminomas and non-seminomas separately. Both rose substantially, with non-seminomas increasing 91% and fourfold among 15 to 19-year-olds, while seminomas predominated in older men. Age-period-cohort modelling showed birth-cohort patterns for both, but with distinct age patterns. The authors conclude that the two histological types have different etiologies and recommend that epidemiological studies analyze them separately.

pmid-11036466.summary_ja: 23歳女性の直腸原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる4コースの化学療法後に外科的切除を行い、残存腫瘍は認められなかった。3.5年後も無病経過である。女性の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の文献をレビューし、積極的な化学療法と手術により精巣がんに準じた治療が有効であると結論している。
pmid-11036466.summary_en: A 23-year-old woman with a yolk sac tumor arising in the rectum is described, a rare presentation since extragonadal germ cell tumors are seldom reported in women. She received four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin, followed by surgical resection with no residual tumor, and remained disease free 3.5 years later. The authors review the literature on extragonadal germ cell tumors in females, noting that prior reports focus on children and predate cisplatin. They conclude that such tumors can be treated successfully with aggressive chemotherapy and surgery, similar to testis cancer.

pmid-11036868.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織からなる卵巣奇形腫である卵巣甲状腺腫の症例で、甲状腺機能亢進症と血清IV型コラーゲン・ラミニンの著明な高値を呈した。免疫染色では両成分が腫瘍の濾胞壁に局在した。血清値は摘出前に高く、術後に速やかに低下したことから、腫瘍自体が産生していると考えられた。甲状腺ホルモン過剰が基底膜の代謝回転を促す可能性も示唆している。
pmid-11036868.summary_en: This case report describes struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed of thyroid tissue, presenting with hyperthyroidism and markedly elevated serum type IV collagen and laminin. Immunohistochemistry localized both basement membrane components to the follicular walls of the tumor. Serum levels were high before removal and fell rapidly after surgery, suggesting that the tumor itself produces these proteins. The authors also propose that excess thyroid hormone may increase basement membrane turnover in various tissues.

pmid-11036955.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性または大量化学療法後に再発した胚細胞腫瘍19例を対象とした第II相試験である。対象の多くは大量化学療法と自家幹細胞支持を受けており、前治療として白金製剤の中央値9サイクルを投与されていた。奏効は部分奏効1例（持続6週間）のみで、毒性は軽度であった。臨床的に意味のある活性は乏しいと結論している。
pmid-11036955.summary_en: This phase II trial tested bendamustine, a bifunctional alkylating agent with partial cross-resistance to ifosfamide and cyclophosphamide, in 19 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors or relapse after high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support. Patients had received a median of nine platinum-containing cycles before treatment. Only one partial response, lasting six weeks, was observed. Toxicity was low, with one grade 3 thrombocytopenia. The authors conclude that bendamustine has little or no clinically relevant activity in this setting.

pmid-11037853.summary_ja: 1975〜1997年に治療された小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍56例を単施設で検討した。最も多い組織型はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）であった。化学療法レジメンはVAC、PVB、BEPの順に変遷し、BEP療法群で全生存期間（全生存率）が最も良好（74.6%）であった。年齢と治療レジメンが予後因子で、進行例では治療強化や新たな治療法が必要と結論している。
pmid-11037853.summary_en: This single-institution review covers 56 children and adolescents with malignant ovarian tumors treated between 1975 and 1997, with dysgerminoma the most common type. Treatment evolved from VAC to PVB and then BEP chemotherapy, and the 22-year overall survival was 68%. Age and treatment protocol predicted survival, with BEP giving the best outcomes (74.6%). The authors conclude that intensified chemotherapy or new approaches are needed for advanced ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-11038476.summary_ja: 病期I精巣奇形腫で監視療法を受けた25例と、進行例で化学療法を受けた22例の心理状態を比較した。不安スコアが境界域以上の割合は監視療法群で48%、化学療法群で27%と高かった。インタビュー分析から、監視中の患者は安全を示す信号を探し続ける傾向があることが示唆された。監視療法中の心理社会的支援の必要性を示している。
pmid-11038476.summary_en: This mixed-methods study compares psychological morbidity in men with stage 1 testicular teratoma managed by surveillance (n=25) with men who received chemotherapy for more advanced disease (n=22). Anxiety screening was higher in the surveillance group (48% versus 27% in the borderline or clinical range), and anxiety decreased as time since diagnosis increased. Interviews analyzed with grounded theory suggested that surveillance patients are seekers of safety signals, which may explain their heightened anxiety. The findings highlight the need for psychosocial support during surveillance.

pmid-11039504.summary_ja: 原発巣に胎児性癌を有する胚細胞腫瘍患者5例で腹膜癌腫症が生じた。4例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けており、摘出標本から生存する悪性細胞が検出された。郭清後6〜14か月で再発し、3例では腹膜のみが再発部位であった。既報3例も合わせ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と腹膜癌腫症の発生に強い関連がある可能性を示唆している。
pmid-11039504.summary_en: This report describes five patients with germ cell tumors who developed peritoneal carcinomatosis, all with embryonal carcinoma in the primary tumor. Four had undergone retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and viable malignant cells were found in these specimens. Relapses occurred 6 to 14 months after dissection, with the peritoneum as the only site in three. Combined with three previously published cases, the authors suggest a striking association between retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and subsequent peritoneal carcinomatosis.

pmid-11040447.summary_ja: 本研究は、絨毛癌由来のBeWo、JAR、JEG-3細胞株がエンドセリン-1（ET-1）を分泌し、ET-A・ET-B両受容体を発現するかを検討した。3株すべてがET-1を分泌し、受容体量はET-1濃度や培養条件により上下に調節された。ET-1による自己制御型のオートクリン系が存在することを示し、絨毛癌における機能解明の基盤を提供した。
pmid-11040447.summary_en: This study examined whether BeWo, JAR, and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cell lines secrete endothelin-1 (ET-1) and express its receptors. All three cell lines secreted ET-1, at differing levels and with differing sensitivity to fetal calf serum. All expressed both ET-A and ET-B receptor subtypes. Receptor levels were up- or downregulated depending on ET-1 concentration, culture time, and serum presence. The authors conclude these cells possess an autocrine ET-1 system capable of autologous receptor regulation, a molecular basis for ET-1-induced functions whose specific roles remain unidentified.

pmid-11041114.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍58例の血清LDアイソザイムを検討した。LD-1およびLD-1/LD比は、疾患の有無を有意に識別した。LD-1値の上昇は生存期間の短縮と関連したが、LD-5は予後と関連しなかった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーとして、総LDよりLD-1が優れると結論づけている。
pmid-11041114.summary_en: This study evaluated serum lactate dehydrogenase (LD) isoenzymes in 58 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including 13 with seminoma and 45 with non-seminomatous tumors. LD-1 and the LD-1/LD fraction distinguished patients with evidence of disease from those without. Higher LD-1 levels and fractions were associated with poorer survival, while LD-5 showed no prognostic value. The authors conclude that LD-1 is preferable to total LD as a serum tumor marker for testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-11043711.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、甲状腺全摘後に甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した患者を記載したものである。頸部にはTc-99m過テクネチウム酸塩の集積がなく、仙腸関節付近の骨盤内集積が認められた。全身ヨウ素131シンチグラフィにより両側性の卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。両側性は卵巣甲状腺腫患者の5～10%に生じるとされる。
pmid-11043711.summary_en: This case report describes hyperthyroidism in a patient who had undergone total thyroidectomy. Technetium-99m pertechnetate scintigraphy showed no uptake in the neck, while a pelvic focus near the sacroiliac joint was seen. Whole-body iodine-131 scanning confirmed bilateral struma ovarii. The authors note that bilateral involvement occurs in 5% to 10% of patients with struma ovarii. The case illustrates how functioning ectopic thyroid tissue within an ovarian teratoma can cause persistent thyrotoxicosis after thyroidectomy.

pmid-11043829.summary_ja: 本研究は、予後不良または再発の胚細胞腫瘍患者25例に対し、VIP療法（エトポシド・イホスファミド・シスプラチン）の逐次的中等量大量化学療法の有効性と忍容性を検討した。奏効率は56%、1年生存率は58%、2年生存率は44%であった。重篤な非血液毒性は稀であった。本療法は予後不良例および再発例に対し有効かつ忍容性の高い治療法とされる。
pmid-11043829.summary_en: This study evaluated sequential intermediate high-dose VIP (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin) in 25 consecutive patients with germ cell tumors, nine untreated with poor-prognosis disease and 16 relapsed. Clinical response was 56%, with 58% surviving beyond one year and 44% beyond two years. Survival did not differ significantly between previously treated and untreated patients, or between dose intensities except for better one-year survival with the higher dose. Serious non-hematological toxicity was rare. The authors conclude the regimen is effective and tolerable for poor-risk and relapsed germ cell tumors.

pmid-11043830.summary_ja: 進行性転移性セミノーマの19例に対し、シクロホスファミドとカルボプラチンの併用による外来治療を行った。全例で奏効し、完全奏効は58%であった。中央値4.2年の観察で15%が再発し、2年無病生存率は72%、全生存期間は94%であった。毒性は軽度で、シスプラチン併用療法に代わる有効で忍容性の高いレジメンと考えられた。
pmid-11043830.summary_en: This outpatient study evaluated carboplatin plus cyclophosphamide in 19 consecutive patients with advanced metastatic seminoma, given six 21-day cycles. All patients responded: 58% achieved complete response and 42% partial response. At a median follow-up of 4.2 years, 3 patients (15%) relapsed, with 2-year disease-free survival of 72% and overall survival of 94%. Toxicity was mild, including one case of granulocytopenic fever and one grade 3 cystitis, suggesting an effective and tolerable alternative to cisplatin-based regimens.

pmid-11044349.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、一次プラチナ系化学療法後に血清学的完全奏効を得たが残存腫瘤があった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の76例を対象に、外科的切除群（48例）と観察群（28例）を比較した。中央値66か月の追跡で、全生存率は手術群90%、観察群80%であり、有意差はなかった。持続無病率は手術群70%、観察群80%であった。反応を示した2cm以下の非嚢胞性残存腫瘤を有する患者は、綿密なフォローアップを行えば安全に観察できると結論づけられている。
pmid-11044349.summary_en: This retrospective study of 76 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumour who reached a serological complete response after platinum-based chemotherapy compared surgical resection (48 patients) with observation (28 patients) of residual radiological masses. Median follow-up was 66 months. Overall survival was 90% in the surgery group and 80% in the observation group, a non-significant difference, and continuous disease-free rates were 70% and 80%. Patients with non-cystic residual masses of 2 cm or less that had responded could be safely observed with diligent follow-up.

pmid-11051157.summary_ja: 妊娠23週の水腫を伴う胎児の仙尾部奇形腫に対し、子宮内での切除に成功した症例を報告した。臍帯テープによる段階的な結紮、電気凝固、鋭的剥離を用いて腫瘍を切除した。輸血後に心停止を起こしたが蘇生に成功した。術後に残存腫瘍の増大は止まり水腫は改善した。生後3か月で退院し、3歳時点で健康であった。
pmid-11051157.summary_en: This report describes a successful in utero resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 23-week hydropic fetus. Using gradually tightened umbilical tapes, electrocautery and sharp dissection, the team removed the tumour. The fetus had a cardiac arrest after transfusion but was resuscitated. Afterwards the residual tumour stopped growing and the hydrops resolved. After delivery and resection of the residual tumour, the infant was discharged at 3 months and was healthy at age 3, showing long-term survival is possible.

pmid-11054031.summary_ja: 精巣がん32例(セミノーマ16例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍16例)の凍結切片を用いて、E-カドヘリンとカテニンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。E-カドヘリンは非セミノーマで62.5%、セミノーマで18.8%に発現し、非セミノーマで有意に高かった。αカテニンは非セミノーマの25%のみに認められた。これらの発現は分化の程度を反映する可能性がある。
pmid-11054031.summary_en: Fresh-frozen sections from 32 testis cancers (16 seminomas and 16 non-seminomatous germ cell tumours) were examined immunohistochemically for E-cadherin and catenins. E-cadherin was expressed in 62.5% of non-seminomas, mainly in the epithelial component of teratoma, versus 18.8% of seminomas, a significant difference. Alpha-catenin was seen in 25% of non-seminomas and none of the seminomas, while beta-catenin was common in both. Immunoblotting confirmed E-cadherin and beta-catenin in non-seminomas. The authors suggest these markers may reflect tumour differentiation.

pmid-11055190.summary_ja: 19歳男性に生じた原発性前縦隔胚細胞癌の症例報告である。症状は曖昧で、縦隔腫瘤の診断には難しい判断が必要だったことが示されている。適切な治療への反応も報告されている。考察では、胚細胞腫瘍の種類、縦隔腫瘤の鑑別診断、検査の流れ、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療と転帰を概説している。
pmid-11055190.summary_en: The authors report a 19-year-old man with primary embryonal cell carcinoma of the anterior mediastinum, who presented with subtle symptoms. The case highlights diagnostic challenges in evaluating an anterior mediastinal mass and the response to appropriate therapy. The discussion reviews the spectrum of germ cell tumors, the differential diagnosis of mediastinal masses, workup, and treatment outcomes of extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-11057756.summary_ja: メラトニンは生理的および薬理学的濃度で絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3の増殖を抑制した。その作用はMT2受容体の発現と関連し、受容体を欠く形質転換栄養膜細胞株では影響がなかった。ヌードマウスでは、JArおよびJEG-3異種移植腫瘍の増殖が抑えられ、絨毛癌を有する動物の生存期間が延長した。アポトーシスは増加せず、PCNAおよびサイクリンAの発現が低下した。in vivoでの効果は主に腫瘍細胞への直接作用であると結論づけられている。
pmid-11057756.summary_en: Melatonin suppressed thymidine incorporation into human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells at physiological and pharmacological concentrations. Its antiproliferative effect was linked to MT2 receptor expression, while a transformed trophoblast line lacking these receptors was unaffected. In nude mice, melatonin inhibited JAr and JEG-3 xenograft growth and prolonged survival of animals bearing choriocarcinoma, reducing PCNA and cyclin A expression without increasing apoptosis. The in vivo effect is largely attributed to direct action on tumor cells.

pmid-11057782.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍が腸管に転移し、腸重積の原因となった稀な症例の報告である。精巣腫瘍の転移が、精巣の症状ではなく急性の腸閉塞として発症しうることを示している。症例は短い報告にまとめられており、精巣腫瘍の転移における非典型的な発症様式が強調されている。
pmid-11057782.summary_en: The authors describe an unusual testicular tumour that caused intussusception through intestinal metastases. The report highlights that metastatic testicular neoplasm can present as acute bowel obstruction rather than with typical testicular symptoms. The brief case report emphasizes an uncommon presentation of metastatic testicular tumour.

pmid-11061604.summary_ja: IGCCCG予後不良群の転移性胚細胞腫瘍332例を後方視的に解析し、CART法で予後サブグループを同定した。縦隔原発で肺転移を有する群は2年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)が最も低く、性腺・後腹膜原発で内臓転移がない群は最も良好であった。予後の層別化や新たな治療の検討への応用が示唆される。
pmid-11061604.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 332 patients with IGCCCG poor-prognosis metastatic germ cell tumors used classification-and-regression-tree (CART) modeling to identify prognostic subgroups. Variables included primary tumor site, visceral and lung metastases, abdominal tumor, number of metastatic sites, and serum beta-hCG, AFP and LDH. Patients with a primary mediastinal tumor and lung metastases had the worst two-year PFS, while those with gonadal or retroperitoneal primaries without visceral metastases had the best outcomes. The authors suggest these subsets could refine prognosis and guide testing of new treatments.

pmid-11061887.summary_ja: 一施設の精巣がんデータベースから、臨床病期I純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の成人12例を抽出し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の経過を検討した。観察群での再発は1例のみで、郭清単独で治癒した例もあった。成人例は他の臨床病期I非セミノーマと同様の経過を示し、血行性転移を起こしやすい若年性卵黄嚢腫瘍とは異なると結論づけている。
pmid-11061887.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 12 adults with clinical stage I pure yolk sac tumor of the testis who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). Most patients had pathological stage I or II disease, and only one recurrence occurred among those managed by observation after RPLND. Two patients were cured by RPLND alone. The authors conclude that adult pure yolk sac tumor behaves similarly to other stage I nonseminomas, unlike juvenile yolk sac tumor, which tends toward hematogenous metastasis. Management can therefore follow established nonseminoma protocols.

pmid-11061944.summary_ja: ドイツ5地域で行った症例対照研究で、精巣・鼠径部外傷と胚細胞腫瘍のリスクを検討した。当初は精巣外傷でオッズ比3.49の関連がみられたが、医療機関の受診を要した外傷に限定すると関連は消失した(オッズ比0.70)。著者らは、外傷は重要なリスク因子とはいえず、想起バイアスに注意すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-11061944.summary_en: This German population-based case-control study of 269 men with histologically confirmed gonadal or extragonadal germ cell cancer and 797 controls examined whether testicular or groin trauma increases risk. Trauma was initially associated with elevated odds of testicular cancer (OR 2.5), and testis-specific trauma showed an OR of 3.49. However, when analysis was restricted to trauma that prompted medical attention, the association disappeared (OR 0.70). The authors conclude that testicular trauma is unlikely to be an important risk factor and that recall bias should be considered.

pmid-11065243.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から17年後に悪性腹膜中皮腫を発症した52歳男性の症例報告である。放射線照射が石綿曝露とともに発症要因となりうると考察している。既往照射野に生じた原因不明の腹水や胸水は、長期生存者では中皮腫を疑うべきとしている。また、診断の4年前に深部静脈血栓症を発症しており、潜在的な悪性腫瘍の徴候となりうると述べている。
pmid-11065243.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old man who developed malignant peritoneal mesothelioma 17 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. The authors suggest prior therapeutic radiation as a possible causal factor alongside asbestos exposure. They emphasize that unexplained ascites or pleural effusion in a previously irradiated field warrants consideration of mesothelioma in long-term cancer survivors. The patient also had deep vein thrombosis four years before diagnosis, which the authors note can be an early clue to occult malignancy.

pmid-11068319.summary_ja: 77歳女性が無痛性の肉眼的血尿で受診し、膀胱原発の純粋な絨毛癌と診断された。前骨盤内臓全摘術と回腸導管造設後、1年後にβ-hCGが934 mIU/mLまで上昇したが腫瘍進行は認められなかった。ビンクリスチン、アクチノマイシン、シクロホスファミドによる6コースの化学療法でβ-hCGは正常化した。報告された膀胱原発純粋絨毛癌では4例目で、生存期間33か月は最長である。
pmid-11068319.summary_en: A 77-year-old woman presented with massive painless hematuria and was diagnosed with pure primary choriocarcinoma of the urinary bladder. After anterior pelvic exenteration and ileal conduit, serum beta-hCG rose to 934 mIU/mL one year later without tumor progression. Six courses of chemotherapy with vincristine, actinomycin, and cyclophosphamide normalized beta-hCG levels. The authors report this as the fourth documented case of pure bladder choriocarcinoma and the longest survival so far, 33 months.

pmid-11068428.summary_ja: 38度の発熱で受診した31歳男性。腎腫瘍と縦隔・鎖骨下・後腹膜リンパ節腫大を認め、AFPとβ-hCGの上昇から、左腎細胞癌を合併した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。術前にBEP療法4コースを施行し、根治的腎摘除術とリンパ節郭清を行ったが切除は不完全で、術後にVIP療法を追加した。両疾患の併存は世界初の報告とされる。
pmid-11068428.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with fever and was found to have a left renal tumor plus mediastinal, infraclavicular, and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Elevated AFP and beta-hCG led to diagnosis of extragonadal germ cell tumor coexisting with left renal cell carcinoma, confirmed by lymph node and renal biopsy. Treatment included four BEP courses with preoperative interferon-alpha and cimetidine, followed by radical nephrectomy and lymph node dissection with incomplete resection, then postoperative VIP therapy. The authors describe it as the first reported case of this combination.

pmid-11068876.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株3種(JAR、JEG-3、BeWo)と非悪性の栄養膜細胞について、エンドセリン-1分泌とETA・ETB受容体mRNAを比較した基礎研究。ET-1分泌量はいずれも同程度で、絨毛癌細胞はETB受容体が大部分を占め、栄養膜細胞はETA受容体を約20%発現していた。受容体発現の刺激応答は悪性細胞と非悪性細胞で異なり、悪性転化により内分泌応答性が変化すると結論された。
pmid-11068876.summary_en: This study compared endothelin-1 secretion and endothelin receptor (ET-A and ET-B) mRNA expression in three choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR, JEG-3, BeWo) and in nonmalignant trophoblasts. All cells secreted similar ET-1 amounts, while choriocarcinoma cells expressed mainly ET-B receptors and trophoblasts expressed about 20% ET-A. Receptor mRNA responses to dexamethasone, glucose, and insulin differed between malignant and nonmalignant cells. The authors conclude that malignant transformation alters the responsiveness of the endothelin receptor system and that endothelin regulation differs between vascular and nonvascular tissues.

pmid-11069382.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍52例を対象に、シスプラチン併用化学療法の初回投与21日後のCT所見が手術の必要性を予測するかを検討した。1次元計測で腫瘍縮小率50%未満の32例中21例が手術を要し、50%以上縮小した20例は全例が手術不要であった。1次元計測から導いた三次元推定値は完全な三次元計算値と同等の精度を示した。
pmid-11069382.summary_en: This study assessed whether computed tomography 21 days after the first cisplatin-based chemotherapy course predicts the need for residual surgery in 52 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Patients with less than 50% shrinkage on the one-dimensional measurement at day 21 frequently required surgery (21 of 32), whereas none with more than 50% shrinkage did. Three-dimensional estimates derived from the one-dimensional measurement performed comparably to full 3D computed estimates, so the simple 1D method adequately identifies patients likely to need surgery.

pmid-11069419.summary_ja: セミノーマ組織の単細胞浮遊液でマウスを免疫し、107のハイブリドーマから胚細胞腫瘍に特異的に反応するモノクローナル抗体ATC2を得た。解析の結果、標的抗原は胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)と同定された。血清PLAPのモニタリングや、超音波検査で判定が難しい精巣がん患者の精液中の癌細胞検出に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-11069419.summary_en: The authors generated monoclonal antibodies against germ cell tumors by immunizing mice with a single-cell suspension from a seminoma. Of 107 hybridomas, the antibody ATC2 stained germ cell tumors specifically without staining normal tissues. Biochemical analyses identified placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as its target, although ATC2 recognizes a different epitope than the known antibody H17E2. The authors suggest ATC2 could help monitor serum PLAP in testis cancer and detect cancer cells in semen, particularly when ultrasonography findings are equivocal.

pmid-11073819.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと正常精巣組織の遺伝子発現を比較し、真核生物翻訳開始因子3 p110(EIF3S8)のmRNAがセミノーマ細胞で過剰発現していることを見出した。in situハイブリダイゼーションと定量RT-PCRで細胞型を特定している。翻訳の全般的な亢進により増殖を促進する可能性が示唆され、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生機序解明に向けた候補分子を提示する研究である。
pmid-11073819.summary_en: This study compares gene expression between testicular seminomas and normal testicular parenchyma using modified differential display, followed by in situ hybridization and quantitative RT-PCR. Eukaryotic initiation factor 3 p110 subunit (EIF3S8) mRNA was overexpressed in seminoma cells relative to normal germ cells of the seminiferous tubules. The authors propose that elF3-p110 may promote seminoma development by increasing general translation, thereby enhancing cell growth and division rates. The work offers a candidate molecular contributor to testicular germ cell tumor pathogenesis.

pmid-11074146.summary_ja: 30歳女性のダグラス窩に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。持続する骨盤内腫瘤に対して腹腔鏡下に切除された。文献検索の結果、ダグラス窩の奇形腫は本例が2例目であり、腹腔鏡で摘出された初の報告であることが示された。部位の稀少性と低侵襲手術の有用性に焦点を当てた短報である。
pmid-11074146.summary_en: This case report describes a benign cystic teratoma in a 30-year-old woman who presented with a persistent pelvic mass in the posterior cul-de-sac and underwent laparoscopic removal. A literature review found this to be only the second reported teratoma of the pouch of Douglas, and the first removed laparoscopically. The brief report focuses on the rarity of this site and the value of a minimally invasive surgical approach.

pmid-11074643.summary_ja: 1994～1998年に精巣病変17例に施行した超音波検査下FNABの診断経験を報告。細胞診でセミノーマ7例、胎児性癌3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例などを診断し、全例で術後診断と一致した。悪性の予測において感度・特異度が高く、穿刺に伴う局所再発や鼠径リンパ節転移はなく、TNM分類の修正も不要だった。精巣腫瘍の術前評価における有用性を示す。
pmid-11074643.summary_en: This series reports fine-needle aspiration biopsy (FNAB) of testicular lesions in 17 patients treated between 1994 and 1998. Cytology diagnosed seminoma in seven, sex cord-stromal tumors in three, embryonal carcinoma in three, yolk sac tumor in one, and inflammatory lesions in three, and all were confirmed after surgery. Ultrasound-guided FNAB showed high sensitivity and specificity for predicting malignancy. No local recurrence or inguinal lymph node metastasis was attributed to the procedure, so TNM staging was unchanged.

pmid-11075860.summary_ja: 17年前に胞状奇胎で化学療法なしに治療された66歳閉経後女性の子宮に生じた上皮様絨毛性腫瘍(ETT)の症例報告。子宮筋層内に限局する充実性・嚢胞性腫瘍で、上皮様細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞からなり、サイトケラチンとEGFRが陽性であった。Ki-67指数は68.6%と高値を示した。妊娠イベントから長期間を経ても閉経後女性に発生しうることを示した。
pmid-11075860.summary_en: This case report describes an epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), a recently defined type of gestational trophoblastic tumor, in the uterus of a 66-year-old postmenopausal woman who had been treated for a hydatidiform mole 17 years earlier without chemotherapy. The solid/cystic tumor was confined to the myometrium and composed of epithelioid and syncytiotrophoblastic cells, with strong cytokeratin and EGFR expression. Focal beta-hCG, human placental lactogen, and inhibin-alpha staining was seen, and the Ki-67 index was 68.6%. The authors conclude that ETT can arise in postmenopausal women years after a gestational event.

pmid-11075967.summary_ja: シリラート病院で1988〜1997年に治療された卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫608例の後方視的研究。平均年齢は33.7歳で、約3分の1は無症状だった。主な症状は腹痛と腹部腫瘤触知。合併症は11.8%にみられ、大半は捻転であった。手術は63.8%が保存的、36.2%が根治的だった。
pmid-11075967.summary_en: This retrospective study of 608 women with benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, treated at Siriraj Hospital from 1988 to 1997, found a mean age of 33.7 years. About one-third were asymptomatic; the most common symptoms were abdominal pain and palpable mass. Complications occurred in 11.8% of cases, mostly torsion. Twisted tumors occurred in younger patients and were usually of intermediate size. Surgery was conservative in 63.8% and radical in 36.2%.

pmid-11078494.summary_ja: 英国小児がん研究グループの第2回胚細胞腫瘍研究で、悪性頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍の小児184例に対しカルボプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン(JEB)を評価した。5年生存率は全体で93.2%、JEB治療例で90.9%であった。部位、病期I、AFP値が予後因子で、保存的手術とJEBにより高い治癒率が得られた。
pmid-11078494.summary_en: The UK Children's Cancer Study Group's second germ cell tumor study evaluated carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (JEB) in 184 children with malignant extracranial germ cell tumors treated from 1989 to 1997. Stage I patients were monitored with AFP after resection. Five-year survival was 93.2% overall and 90.9% among JEB-treated patients. Site, stage, and AFP level were prognostic factors. Toxicity was mostly hematologic, and conservative surgery with JEB produced high cure rates.

pmid-11079315.summary_ja: 15歳男性が左胸痛で受診し、前縦隔に13×8×12cmの巨大腫瘤を認めた。血清AFPは8,089 ng/mlと著明に上昇し、生検で非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた。化学療法3コースで腫瘤は縮小し、AFPは正常化した。完全切除後10か月まで再発はみられなかった。
pmid-11079315.summary_en: A 15-year-old boy presented with left chest pain and a huge anterior mediastinal mass measuring 13 x 8 x 12 cm. Serum AFP was markedly elevated at 8,089 ng/ml, and biopsy suggested a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Three courses of cisplatin, bleomycin, and etoposide reduced the mass and normalized AFP. The tumor was completely resected, and there was no recurrence at 10 months. The authors highlight AFP as a useful guide for timing surgery.

pmid-11090407.summary_ja: 4施設で陰嚢超音波検査を受けた4,819例の紹介患者集団において、精巣微小石灰化(超音波画像1枚あたり5個超)は0.68%に認められた。7例に精巣腫瘍が併存しており、微小石灰化のない患者と比較した相対リスクは21.6倍であった。腫瘍の多くはセミノーマと奇形腫で、精巣摘除術後の病理組織学的検査で確認された。著者らは、精巣微小石灰化の症例では、腫瘍の有無を超音波で経過観察することが必須であると結論づけている。
pmid-11090407.summary_en: In a referral population of 4,819 patients undergoing scrotal sonography at four centers, testicular microlithiasis (more than five microliths per sonogram) occurred in 0.68%. Seven patients had concurrent testicular tumor, giving a 21.6-fold relative risk compared with patients without microlithiasis. Most tumors were seminomas and teratomas, confirmed histologically after orchiectomy. The authors conclude that sonographic surveillance of patients with testicular microlithiasis for underlying tumor is mandatory.

pmid-11092533.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるNEP/CD10の発現と局在を検討した研究。絨毛癌細胞株では全例でNEPが発現し、胞状奇胎・侵入奇胎・絨毛癌・胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の組織で検出された。絨毛癌では浸潤する異型細胞性栄養膜細胞にも発現が認められた。NEPはトロホブラストの形質転換やヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分泌調節に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11092533.summary_en: This study examined neutral endopeptidase (NEP/CD10) expression across gestational trophoblastic diseases. NEP was expressed in all choriocarcinoma cell lines and in hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, and placental site trophoblastic tumor tissues. Immunohistochemistry showed syncytiotrophoblast localization in moles, while choriocarcinoma also showed expression in invasive anaplastic cytotrophoblasts. Placental site trophoblastic tumors showed expression in intermediate trophoblasts. The authors suggest NEP may regulate trophoblast transformation and hCG secretion.

pmid-11095552.summary_ja: 若年男性に多い胚細胞腫瘍の総説。国際分類で予後不良の患者の長期生存率は約50%である。標準治療はブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンの4コース併用療法であり、これを上回るレジメンは無作為化試験で示されていない。中間・予後不良群における大量化学療法と造血幹細胞移植、ゲムシタビンやパクリタキセルなどの新規薬剤、予後分類について概説している。
pmid-11095552.summary_en: This review covers male germ cell tumors, which are highly curable in young patients. Patients with poor-risk disease by international classification have roughly 50% long-term survival. Four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin remain the standard, as no trial proved a superior regimen. The authors discuss high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation in intermediate- and poor-risk disease, newer agents such as gemcitabine and paclitaxel, and prognostic systems.

pmid-11096252.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍（臨床病期I）に対し精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた患者の報告。早期再発を化学療法で治療したが、187か月後に右腸骨部の腫瘤が出現した。切除標本では分化した成熟奇形腫と診断された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍治療後に成熟奇形腫が発生するまでの期間としては、文献上最長である。
pmid-11096252.summary_en: A patient with clinical stage I testicular mixed germ cell tumor underwent orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, followed by early relapse with rising tumor markers treated with five cycles of chemotherapy. Fifteen years later, a symptomatic right iliac mass arose. Surgical excision showed differentiated mature teratoma. The authors note this is the longest reported interval between treatment of a testicular germ cell tumor and development of mature teratoma in the literature.

pmid-11098043.summary_ja: 21歳未満の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫患者52例を後方視的に解析した研究。14例が腹腔鏡下に手術され、開腹術より入院期間が短かった。術中腫瘍漏出は52%に認められたが化学性腹膜炎は生じなかった。フォローアップ可能であった34例中7例が妊娠し、嚢胞摘出術を受けた症例に再発はなかった。成人の管理に関する知見の多くが小児・青年にも当てはまると結論している。
pmid-11098043.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 52 patients under 21 years who underwent surgery for mature cystic teratoma, 14 of them laparoscopically. Laparoscopy shortened hospital stay. Intraoperative spillage occurred in 52% without chemical peritonitis. Among 34 patients with follow-up, seven later became pregnant, and none treated with cystectomy had recurrence. The authors conclude that several conclusions about adult MCT management apply to children and adolescents.

pmid-11098508.summary_ja: 精巣がんを含む胚細胞腫瘍における大量化学療法の役割を論じた総説。標準治療に抵抗性を示す患者は約30%とされる。治療抵抗性の症例や、初回サルベージ療法・初回治療としての大量化学療法について検討している。また、患者選択に用いるリスク評価基準についても解説している。
pmid-11098508.summary_en: This review addresses high-dose chemotherapy in testicular and other germ cell tumors. About 30% of patients are refractory to standard therapy and need additional treatment. The authors discuss high-dose chemotherapy in refractory disease and as first-salvage or first-line therapy for poor-risk tumors. Various risk assessment criteria are also reviewed to guide selection of patients for this intensive approach.

pmid-11104334.summary_ja: 上皮性卵巣癌以外の卵巣悪性腫瘍の治療を概説した総説である。胚細胞腫瘍などの稀な原発性卵巣腫瘍や他臓器からの卵巣転移が対象である。組織型・進展度・合併症に応じて、積極的手術、全身化学療法、緩和的治療が選択されるとしている。
pmid-11104334.summary_en: This review covers management of ovarian malignancies other than epithelial ovarian cancer. These include less common primary ovarian cancers, such as germ cell tumors, and cancers metastatic to the ovary from other sites. Depending on histology, site of origin, extent of spread, and comorbidities, patients may receive aggressive surgery, systemic chemotherapy, or treatment focused on symptom control and comfort.

pmid-11104556.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ130例を対象に、カルボプラチン単剤とEP療法を比較したMRC無作為化試験である。3年無増悪生存率は71%対81%で有意差はなかった。臨床的に重要な劣性を除外できず、シスプラチンを含む併用療法が依然として標準的な初回化学療法とされた。
pmid-11104556.summary_en: This MRC randomized trial compared single-agent carboplatin with etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) in 130 patients with advanced seminoma. Estimated 3-year progression-free survival was 71% with carboplatin and 81% with EP (hazard ratio 0.64, not significant). Three-year survival was 84% and 89%. The trial could not exclude a clinically important inferiority of carboplatin, so cisplatin-based combinations remain the standard initial chemotherapy.

pmid-11104628.summary_ja: 子宮内で絨毛癌と悪性混合中胚葉腫瘍(MMMT)が併存した1例の症例報告である。絨毛癌成分はhCG-β陽性で、肺・リンパ節・脳へ転移し、診断から7か月で死亡した。子宮MMMTと栄養膜分化の関連を報告した文献はなく、発症機序について考察している。
pmid-11104628.summary_en: This case report describes a uterine tumor containing both choriocarcinoma, with hCG-beta-positive syncytiotrophoblastic cells, and malignant mixed mesodermal tumor. The patient developed metastases to the lungs, lymph nodes, and brain, and died 7 months after diagnosis. A literature search found no prior reports linking trophoblastic differentiation with uterine MMMT. The authors discuss possible pathogenesis of this rare coexistence.

pmid-11104629.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた扁平上皮癌で、悪性腫瘍による高カルシウム血症を合併した症例報告である。血漿PTH-rPが高値で、腫瘍細胞は免疫染色でPTH-rP陽性であった。手術時の血清カルシウムは有意に上昇していなかった。終末期にPTH-rP産生が恒常性の範囲を超えて高カルシウム血症を来したと考察している。
pmid-11104629.summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, complicated by humoral hypercalcemia of malignancy. Plasma PTH-rP was high, and the tumor cells stained positively for PTH-rP. Serum calcium was not significantly elevated at surgery. The authors suggest that PTH-rP production in the primary tumor rose beyond homeostatic levels in the terminal stage, producing hypercalcemia.

pmid-11104630.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣甲状腺腫を伴うGraves病の症例報告です。腫瘍摘出後に甲状腺機能が速やかに改善し、サイログロブリン値も低下しました。このことから、卵巣の腫瘍が患者の甲状腺機能亢進症に大きく寄与していたと示唆されています。悪性卵巣甲状腺腫が甲状腺機能亢進症の主要な原因となりうることを示し、このような患者の管理では腫瘍の評価も重要だと結論づけています。
pmid-11104630.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with malignant struma ovarii, a struma ovarii with malignant change, who also had Graves' disease. Thyroid function tests were analyzed before and after surgical removal of the tumor. After resection, thyroid function improved rapidly and thyroglobulin levels fell, suggesting the ovarian tumor contributed substantially to the hyperthyroidism. The authors conclude that malignant struma ovarii may be a dominant or significant cause of hyperthyroidism, which should be considered when managing such patients.

pmid-11104633.summary_ja: 46,XX/46,XY型のモザイク核型を有する真性半陰陽の女性で、右卵巣に卵精巣を伴うディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)を認めた症例です。片側卵管卵巣摘出後に化学療法を2コース施行し、約9か月後に妊娠して健康な男児を出産しました。XY核型では妊娠が不可能とする通念に疑問を呈し、片側手術と化学療法による妊孕性温存の可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-11104633.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with a 46,XX/46,XY mosaic karyotype and a normal female phenotype who had a dysgerminoma with ovotestis in the right ovary. After unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and two courses of combination chemotherapy, she conceived about nine months later and delivered a healthy male infant. The authors challenge the belief that women with an XY karyotype cannot conceive and that bilateral oophorectomy is always required. They suggest that unilateral surgery followed by chemotherapy can preserve fertility in selected patients.

pmid-11109075.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療の最近の進歩をまとめた概説論文です。進行例を含め多くの症例で高い治癒率が得られるようになった現状が示されています。著者らは、理解の深化と治療成績の向上に向けた研究の継続の重要性を強調しています。泌尿器科医や腫瘍医を対象とした総説です。
pmid-11109075.summary_en: This overview summarizes recent advances in the management of testicular germ cell tumors. It notes that these cancers are now generally highly curable, even in patients with advanced disease. The authors emphasize that ongoing research continues to improve understanding and treatment outcomes. The article covers current management of testis cancer rather than presenting original data, making it a review for clinicians and researchers in urology and oncology.

pmid-11109172.summary_ja: 本報告は、BRCA1生殖細胞系列変異(3312insG)を有し、卵巣がんと乳がんの家系に属する16歳女性の原発性卵巣ディスジャーミノーマを報告するものである。家族性レジストリの卵巣がん症例を再検討する中で、この胚細胞腫瘍を同定した。変異解析により、複数の親族に同じ変異が確認された。ディスジャーミノーマがBRCA1変異によるものか、独立して生じたものかは判断できなかった。この問題の解決には、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍のより大規模な症例の解析が必要であると著者らは提案している。
pmid-11109172.summary_en: This report describes a 16-year-old woman with a primary ovarian dysgerminoma who carried a germline BRCA1 mutation (3312insG) and came from a family with ovarian and breast cancer. While reviewing ovarian cancers from a familial registry, the authors identified this germ cell tumor. Mutation analysis confirmed the same variant in several relatives. The authors could not determine whether the dysgerminoma was caused by the BRCA1 mutation or occurred independently. They suggest that a larger series of ovarian germ cell tumors is needed to resolve this question.

pmid-11109817.summary_ja: 1981～1999年に進行転移性セミノーマの16例を治療した後方視的検討。シスプラチン併用療法を基本とし、非腫瘤性の6例にはカルボプラチンとイホスファミドを試みた。化学療法単独で10例が完全奏効し、放射線療法追加で4例が奏効した。全例が無病生存で、低毒性の治療は外来実施可能と報告している。
pmid-11109817.summary_en: This retrospective study reports outcomes of chemotherapy for advanced metastatic seminoma in 16 patients treated between 1981 and 1999. Cisplatin-based regimens were used initially, followed by an experimental carboplatin and ifosfamide combination in six patients with non-bulky disease. Ten patients achieved complete response with chemotherapy alone, and four more achieved it after radiotherapy. All patients were alive and disease-free at follow-up. Carboplatin and ifosfamide caused only mild toxicity and could be given on an outpatient basis. The authors suggest that low-toxicity chemotherapy should be compared with radiotherapy for stage IIA disease.

pmid-11109818.summary_ja: 精巣摘除・生検標本200例を病理学的に検討し、精巣微小石灰化の頻度を調べた。全体では3.5%に認められ、胚細胞腫瘍患者では9.8%と不妊症患者（2.5%）より有意に高かった。精巣微小石灰化は稀ながら精巣悪性腫瘍を伴うことが多く、両者の関係のさらなる検討が必要としている。
pmid-11109818.summary_en: This Japanese clinicopathological study assessed 200 testicular specimens (56 orchiectomies and 144 biopsies) for testicular microlithiasis (TM). TM was found in 3.5% of cases. It occurred in 9.8% of patients with germ cell tumors, compared with 2.5% of infertile men, a significant difference. The authors conclude that TM, although rare, is often associated with testicular malignancy. They call for further study to clarify the relationship between TM and testicular cancer.

pmid-11109821.summary_ja: 難治性精巣がん（混合型胚細胞腫瘍）の31歳男性例。精巣摘除後に11コースの全身化学療法と超大量化学療法を含む自家末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた。25か月後に汎血球減少が出現し、骨髄検査で急性骨髄性白血病(M2)と診断された。超大量化学療法後の二次性白血病として、国内で初めての報告としている。
pmid-11109821.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with refractory testicular cancer (mixed germ cell histology) who developed secondary acute myeloid leukemia after ultra high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell autotransplantation. After orchiectomy, he received 11 cycles of systemic chemotherapy, and his initial LDH, AFP and beta-hCG levels were high. Pancytopenia appeared 25 months after orchiectomy, and bone marrow examination confirmed AML (FAB M2). The authors state this is the first reported case in Japan of secondary leukemia after this treatment for testicular tumor.

pmid-11110399.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫（8×7×11cm）の胸腔鏡下切除例を報告。肋骨を開くことなく4か所の小切開のみで摘出した。大型の縦隔奇形腫は開胸に移行されることが多いが、本症例は低侵襲アプローチが大型腫瘍でも可能であることを示したと述べている。著者らは、胸腔鏡下手術の適応拡大につながると考察している。
pmid-11110399.summary_en: This case report describes thoracoscopic removal of a large anterior mediastinal teratoma measuring 8 x 7 x 11 cm. The surgery used video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) with only four small intercostal incisions and no rib spreading. The authors note that large mediastinal teratomas are usually managed by conversion to thoracotomy. Their report suggests that a minimally invasive approach can be feasible even for large tumors. According to the authors, no prior report has documented successful VATS removal of a tumor of this size.

pmid-11111190.summary_ja: 精巣・後腹膜の進行胚細胞悪性腫瘍5例で上部消化管に病変を認めた後方視的検討。十二指腸4例、食道1例で、3例は重度貧血が初発症状だった。緊急手術を要した消化管出血があり、大動脈十二指腸瘻を合併した例もあった。若年男性の上部消化管悪性腫瘍では胚細胞悪性腫瘍を鑑別に挙げ、出血への注意と集学的治療が必要としている。
pmid-11111190.summary_en: This retrospective review describes five patients with advanced germ cell malignancy (two testicular and three retroperitoneal) who had upper gastrointestinal involvement. Four had duodenal disease and one had esophageal disease. Grade 3 or 4 anemia was the main initial symptom in three patients. Some required emergency surgery for gastrointestinal bleeding, and one developed an aortoduodenal fistula. The authors advise considering germ cell malignancy in young men with upper GI tumors. They emphasize the need for multimodality therapy and attention to hemorrhage risk.

pmid-11111191.summary_ja: 対側精巣に上皮内癌（CIS）を伴う病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性3例で、高度乏精子症にもかかわらず補助生殖医療により父親となった症例を報告。将来の父親を望む患者では、精巣摘除後の精子形成回復を最大化するため監視療法が最適と述べている。術後1年目は精液を複数回凍結保存すべきとしている。
pmid-11111191.summary_en: This short report describes paternity achieved through assisted fertilization in three highly oligospermic men. Each had stage I unilateral testicular germ cell tumor with carcinoma in situ in the contralateral testicle. The authors argue that for patients planning future fatherhood, surveillance is the optimal approach because it allows maximal recovery of spermatogenesis after orchiectomy. They recommend multiple semen cryopreservations during the first postoperative year.

pmid-11112871.summary_ja: 非典型的な経過をたどった精巣セミノーマの2例を報告。原発腫瘍の自然退縮（いわゆるshrinking seminoma）の可能性を示唆し、その病因を考察している。精巣の縮小は腫大と同様、悪性腫瘍の精査が必要な所見であると強調している。
pmid-11112871.summary_en: This report presents two cases of testicular seminoma with unusual presentations, which may represent spontaneous regression of a primary tumor, the so-called shrinking seminoma. The patients showed reduction in testicular size, a finding usually considered a sign requiring investigation for malignancy, similar to enlargement. The authors discuss possible etiologies of this phenomenon. They emphasize that a decrease in testicular size should prompt evaluation for malignancy. The paper focuses on clinical presentation rather than treatment outcomes.

pmid-11115525.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、右蝶形骨洞から発生した先天性成熟奇形腫の新生児例です。頭頸部の奇形腫は極めてまれです。早期に内視鏡下経鼻的切除による外科的切除が行われ、術後は良好な経過をたどりました。蝶形骨洞は脳実質外の部位であり、中枢神経原発の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍として位置づけられます。
pmid-11115525.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a mature congenital teratoma arising from the right sphenoidal sinus, a rare head and neck location. The tumor was treated early with endoscopic endonasal resection, and the child recovered well after surgery. Teratoma in the head and neck is very uncommon, so the report documents an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting in infancy and managed surgically. The sphenoidal sinus lies outside the brain parenchyma, so this is not a primary CNS germ cell tumor.

pmid-11115530.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に甲状腺腫瘍を発症した男性3例の後方視的検討です。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の2例は術後化学療法中に甲状腺乳頭癌を発症し、セミノーマ1例は放射線療法後に頸部再発と甲状腺結節を認めました。ブレオマイシン毒性による肺合併症で1例が死亡しました。遺伝的素因の関与が示唆されています。
pmid-11115530.summary_en: This retrospective review examines three male patients treated for a testicular germ cell tumor who later developed or had a thyroid cancer. Two patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor developed papillary thyroid carcinoma during postoperative chemotherapy, and one with stage I seminoma recurred in the neck with seminoma and a thyroid nodule after radiation therapy.
