Thyroid cancers were treated surgically, one with adjuvant radioactive iodine. Two patients are disease-free and one died of bleomycin-related pulmonary toxicity. The authors suggest genetic predisposition may contribute.

pmid-11119439.summary_ja: 本研究は、1981年から1994年に治療された臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者471例について、経過観察と補助的放射線療法の長期転帰と費用を比較したものである。5年生存率は97%、がん特異的生存率は99.8%であった。再発率は経過観察群(226例中37例)の方が放射線療法群(245例中14例)より高かったが、経過観察の方が費用は高額であった。両治療法とも良好な成績を示し、著者らはすべての患者に経過観察を選択肢として提供することを提案している。
pmid-11119439.summary_en: This study compares long-term outcomes and costs of surveillance versus adjuvant radiotherapy in 471 patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1981 and 1994. Five-year survival was 97% and cause-specific survival 99.8%. Relapse was more frequent with surveillance (37 of 226) than after radiotherapy (14 of 245), but surveillance was more costly. Both approaches gave excellent results, and the authors suggest offering surveillance to all patients as an option.

pmid-11120414.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫10例のMRI所見を後方視的に検討した。単側性で多小葉状の表面と肥厚した隔壁を有する複雑な腫瘤で、甲状腺濾胞と間質に対応していた。嚢胞成分の信号強度は多様で、4例では粘稠なゼラチン様内容物を認めた。充実成分は造影で良好に増強され、診断に有用な特徴的所見とされた。
pmid-11120414.summary_en: This retrospective study describes MR imaging features of struma ovarii in 10 patients. Lesions were unilateral, complex, multilobulated masses with thickened septa, corresponding pathologically to thyroid follicles and stroma. Cystic components showed variable signal intensity, with viscid gelatinous contents in four cases, and solid portions enhanced well after contrast. The authors propose these findings as characteristic features that aid diagnosis.

pmid-11125934.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫と水腎症を有する妊婦に対し、28週で膀胱羊水腔シャント術を施行し、腎機能の保護と下大静脈の前負荷指数の低下(0.75から0.41)を得た。30週で帝王切開により出生した女児は数時間後に死亡した。剖検で仙尾部未熟奇形腫、両側水腎症、尿道狭窄、肺低形成が確認された。
pmid-11125934.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman with a fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma and hydronephrosis underwent vesico-amniotic shunting at 28 weeks to protect renal function, after which the inferior vena cava preload index fell from 0.75 to 0.41. The infant was delivered by cesarean section at 30 weeks and died hours later. Autopsy confirmed a sacrococcygeal immature teratoma, bilateral hydronephrosis, urethral stenosis and pulmonary hypoplasia.

pmid-11127011.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫16例の術前の臨床・検査・超音波所見を、卵巣類皮嚢腫32例と後方視的に比較した。卵巣甲状腺腫では病変中心部から低抵抗の血流が認められたが、類皮嚢腫では中心部の血流は検出されなかった。Bモード所見では両者の区別が困難であり、ドプラ超音波検査は術前診断の補助になりうるとされた。
pmid-11127011.summary_en: This retrospective review compares preoperative clinical, laboratory and sonographic features of 16 struma ovarii cases with 32 ovarian dermoid cysts. Struma ovarii showed central blood flow with low resistance on Doppler, whereas dermoid cysts lacked central flow. Most struma patients were premenopausal with normal CA-125, though some had elevated tumour markers. The authors conclude that Doppler may aid preoperative diagnosis, although B-mode appearances overlap.

pmid-11127299.summary_ja: 8週齢と10週齢のSD IGSラットの精巣腫瘍2症例を報告した。いずれも片側性の奇形腫と胎児性癌の混在を示し、両側精巣萎縮を伴っていた。対側精巣にも精細管内の奇形腫および胎児性癌の病巣がみられた。胎児性癌が扁平上皮へ移行する像から、胚細胞腫瘍の初期に奇形腫への分化が起こることが示唆された。
pmid-11127299.summary_en: This report describes two cases of testicular tumours in 8- and 10-week-old Sprague-Dawley IGS rats. Each showed a unilateral teratoma containing embryonal carcinoma, with bilateral testicular atrophy. Intratubular teratoma and embryonal carcinoma foci were also found in the contralateral testis. Transition of embryonal carcinoma into squamous epithelium suggests differentiation toward teratoma at an early stage of germ cell tumour development.

pmid-11127816.summary_ja: セミノーマ4例と非セミノーマ7例の浸潤成分17か所を、CGHと二重FISHで解析した。12p過剰は17か所中16か所の浸潤成分で認められ、上皮内癌では認められなかった。12p過剰は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の早期事象ではなく、浸潤性増殖に関連することが示された。
pmid-11127816.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization and double FISH on microdissected tissue from four seminomas and seven nonseminomas to examine 12p overrepresentation. A gain of 12p was found in 16 of 17 invasive components but in none of the carcinoma in situ samples. The findings indicate that 12p overrepresentation is not an early event in testicular germ cell tumour development but is linked to invasive growth.

pmid-11128910.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）は生殖年齢女性に最も多い良性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。本総説は、妊孕性の温存、卵巣組織の保存、癒着の最小化を中心に外科的管理を論じ、腹腔鏡手術と開腹術の利害、術中破綻、再発、悪性転化についての術前説明の要点を示している。小児例でも同様の懸念があるとし、臨床医向けの術前カウンセリングの指針を提供することを目的とする。
pmid-11128910.summary_en: This review addresses the management of ovarian mature cystic teratomas, commonly called dermoid cysts, the most common benign ovarian germ cell tumors in women of reproductive age. It emphasizes preserving ovarian tissue and fertility, minimizing adhesion formation, and counseling patients about laparoscopy versus laparotomy, intraoperative spillage, recurrence, and malignant transformation. The authors note that parents of children with these tumors have similar concerns. The article aims to give physicians practical information for preoperative counseling.

pmid-11130576.summary_ja: 精巣がんの36歳男性が、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法の初回コース中に急性心筋梗塞を発症した症例報告である。冠動脈疾患の明らかな危険因子はなく、化学療法レジメンに起因した可能性が高いと考えられた。著者らは化学療法と心事故の関連について想定される病態生理学的機序を論じ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍治療における心血管毒性の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-11130576.summary_en: A 36-year-old man with testicular cancer developed an acute myocardial infarction during the first cycle of chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. He had no significant coronary risk factors, so the infarction was judged likely attributable to the chemotherapy regimen. The authors discuss the possible physiopathological mechanisms linking the chemotherapy to the cardiac event, highlighting cardiovascular toxicity as a complication of testicular germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-11130577.summary_ja: ダウン症候群と精巣胚細胞腫瘍を合併した2症例を報告し、英語文献を概説した。両疾患の合併は偶然から予想される頻度より多い可能性が指摘されている。この関連を検討した報告は少ないが、本報告は過剰リスクの可能性を示し、臨床現場での注意を喚起することを目的としている。
pmid-11130577.summary_en: This report describes two patients with both Down syndrome and testicular germ cell tumors and reviews the English-language literature. The authors note that the co-occurrence of these conditions may be more frequent than expected by chance. Few prior reports have examined this association. By presenting the cases and literature review, the authors aim to highlight a possible excess risk and to draw clinical attention to this relationship.

pmid-11131657.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌由来細胞株Tera-2を用いたin vitro研究で、FGF-10、FGF-16、FGF-17、FGF-18の4種のFGFの作用を検討した。1〜10 ng/mlでは4因子ともアポトーシスを抑制して細胞生存を高め、高濃度では細胞運動能に優先的な効果を示した。4種すべてのFGF受容体の発現も確認され、胎児性癌細胞の生存と遊走をFGFシグナルが制御する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11131657.summary_en: This in vitro study examined four fibroblast growth factors (FGF-10, FGF-16, FGF-17, FGF-18) in Tera-2, a human embryonal carcinoma-derived cell line. All four factors enhanced cell survival by counteracting apoptosis at 1-10 ng/ml, while higher concentrations preferentially promoted cell motility. The authors confirmed expression of all four FGF receptors, which likely mediate these effects. The findings suggest that FGF signaling regulates both survival and migration of embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-11137207.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG3に対するNK細胞の細胞傷害を検討した。自然細胞傷害受容体の刺激によりNK細胞傷害が誘導され、NKp44が中心的役割を果たし、NKp46が協調して寄与した。NKp30、2B4、NKG2Dは関与しなかった。栄養膜細胞がNK細胞傷害に抵抗するのは、活性化受容体と標的リガンドの相互作用が不十分であるためと結論されている。
pmid-11137207.summary_en: This study investigated how natural killer (NK) cells kill the choriocarcinoma cell lines JAR and JEG3. NK killing was triggered by engagement of natural cytotoxicity receptors, with NKp44 playing a central role and NKp46 contributing in cooperation. NKp30, 2B4, and NKG2D were not involved. The authors conclude that trophoblast resistance to NK cytotoxicity reflects insufficient activating interactions between NK receptors and their ligands, while inhibitory nonclassical HLA class I interactions play only a marginal role.

pmid-11144509.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の症例で、両側の精巣腫瘍を認め、両側精巣摘除術を施行した。切除された腫瘍はいずれも純粋セミノーマと診断された。アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子のエクソンEに点変異（CGA→CAA）を同定し、コドン752でアルギニンからグルタミンへの置換を生じていた。両側精巣腫瘍を伴うAISの報告は初めてとされる。
pmid-11144509.summary_en: A case of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (AIS) with bilateral testicular tumors is reported. Both resected gonadal tumors were diagnosed as pure seminoma. Sequencing of androgen receptor exons E through G identified a point mutation (CGA to CAA) in exon E, causing an arginine-to-glutamine substitution at codon 752. The authors state this is the first reported case of AIS with bilateral testicular tumors.

pmid-11144519.summary_ja: 1987年から1999年に当院で治療した縦隔および後腹膜の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍14例を検討した報告である。完全寛解は9例、部分寛解は1例で、奏効期間の中央値は19か月であった。PVBやBEPに近い改変化学療法は、毒性を抑えつつ同程度の成績を示した。統一された病期分類と標準化された治療プログラムの必要性が強調されている。
pmid-11144519.summary_en: This report describes 14 patients with primary mediastinal or retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with chemotherapy and radiotherapy at one center between 1987 and 1999. Nine patients achieved complete remission and one partial remission, with a median response duration of 19 months. A modified regimen approximating PVB or BEP gave similar results with less toxicity. The authors emphasize the need for a uniform staging system and standardized treatment programs.

pmid-11144880.summary_ja: 右下腹部痛と10年来の腫瘤を訴えた50歳のエチオピア人女性の症例報告である。甲状腺組織が優位に増殖した奇形腫である卵巣甲状腺腫と、病理学的検査により診断された。症状は非特異的であった。臨床病理学的所見を記載し、極めて稀な腫瘍について文献レビューを併記している。
pmid-11144880.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old Ethiopian woman with right lower quadrant pain and a long-standing mass who was diagnosed with struma ovarii, a rare teratoma in which thyroid tissue predominates. Nonspecific symptoms were present, and the diagnosis was established by pathologic examination. The report discusses the clinicopathologic features and reviews the literature on this exceedingly rare neoplasm.

pmid-11144894.summary_ja: 成人および思春期の胚細胞腫瘍の一般的な前駆病変である精巣の上皮内癌（CIS）について、病態生物学、遺伝学的特徴、疫学を総説している。胚細胞腫瘍の発生と浸潤進展に関する仮説を検討し、CISの診断と臨床管理のガイドラインを提示している。精母細胞性セミノーマは例外とされている。
pmid-11144894.summary_en: This review summarizes current knowledge of carcinoma in situ (CIS) of the testis, a common precursor of germ cell tumours in adults and adolescents, with the exception of spermatocytic seminoma. It covers pathobiology, genetic features, and epidemiology, and discusses hypotheses for pathogenesis and invasive progression of germ cell neoplasia. The article also provides guidelines for diagnosis and clinical management of CIS.

pmid-11149742.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の2例に、カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を2回連続で実施した。2回目の移植ではカルボプラチン投与の前後にアミホスチンを使用した。その結果、粘膜炎と腎毒性が軽減し、好中球減少と血小板減少の期間が短縮した。抗菌薬と血小板輸血の使用も減少し、大量化学療法の毒性軽減に有用な可能性が示唆された。
pmid-11149742.summary_en: This report describes two patients with germ cell tumours who underwent tandem autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide. During the second transplant, amifostine was given around each carboplatin dose. Both patients had less mucositis and, in one case, less nephrotoxicity, along with shorter neutropenia and thrombocytopenia. Reduced antibiotic and platelet transfusion needs suggest amifostine may lessen high-dose chemotherapy toxicity.

pmid-11150371.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍159例（管内胚細胞腫瘍87例を含む）を対象に、アンジオテンシンI変換酵素の体細胞型（sACE）の分布を免疫組織化学とin situ hybridizationで解析した。sACEと胎盤型アルカリフォスファターゼは全ての管内腫瘍で発現し、古典型セミノーマでも保たれていた。一方、精母細胞性セミノーマでは消失していた。非セミノーマ性腫瘍では発現パターンが分かれ、sACEはセミノーマ分化を示す腫瘍のマーカーとして提案されている。
pmid-11150371.summary_en: This study analysed the somatic isoform of angiotensin I-converting enzyme (sACE) in 159 testicular germ cell tumours, including 87 intratubular germ cell neoplasias, using immunohistochemistry and in situ hybridization. sACE and placental alkaline phosphatase were expressed in all intratubular neoplasias and were preserved in classic seminomas but absent in spermatocytic seminomas. Expression patterns diverged in nonseminomatous tumours. The authors propose sACE as a marker for seminomatous differentiated tumours.

pmid-11150681.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の診断において、脂肪抑制の有無によるT1強調グラディエントエコー（FLASH）磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）を、従来のスピンエコーT1強調画像と比較した。対象は手術を受けた18例19病変である。FLASH画像では19病変中17病変を正しく診断し、スピンエコー法と同等の成績であった。グラディエントエコー法は従来法の代替になりうると結論されている。
pmid-11150681.summary_en: This study evaluated fat-suppressed and non-suppressed gradient-echo T1-weighted MRI (FLASH) for diagnosing ovarian mature cystic teratomas in 18 patients with 19 lesions, comparing it with conventional spin-echo T1-weighted imaging. Seventeen of 19 lesions were correctly diagnosed using FLASH images with or without fat saturation, matching spin-echo performance. The authors conclude that gradient-echo MRI can replace conventional spin-echo T1-weighted imaging for diagnosing ovarian mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-11154723.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の総説。前縦隔に生じ、大きな圧迫性腫瘤として発見されることが多い。組織診断前にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と血清腫瘍マーカーで評価する。セミノーマは化学療法・放射線療法に感受性が高く非手術的に治療される。良性奇形腫は外科的切除で良好な成績が得られ、悪性の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は主に化学療法で治療し、残存腫瘤に対してのみ手術を行う。
pmid-11154723.summary_en: This review covers mediastinal germ cell tumors, which mainly arise in the anterior mediastinum and often present as large masses causing compression. Workup relies on chest CT and serum tumor markers before tissue diagnosis. Seminomas respond well to chemotherapy and radiation and are treated nonsurgically. Benign teratomas are treated by surgical resection with excellent outcomes. Malignant nonseminomatous tumors are mainly treated with chemotherapy, with surgery reserved for residual masses.

pmid-11156144.summary_ja: 若年男性が急性下肢虚血と肺・左心房の腫瘤で発症した症例。左心房に浸潤した転移性胚細胞腫瘍による反復性動脈塞栓が原因で、これが悪性腫瘍の初発症状であった。悪性腫瘍による動脈塞栓は極めて稀であり、適切な精査が以後の治療方針を決めるうえで重要であると強調している。
pmid-11156144.summary_en: A young adult man presented with acute lower limb ischemia, a right lung mass, and a left atrial mass. These findings were caused by recurrent arterial embolization from a metastatic germ cell tumor invading the left atrium, and they were his first sign of malignancy. The case highlights the rarity of arterial embolization in malignancy and the importance of thorough investigation for guiding subsequent treatment.

pmid-11156214.summary_ja: 進行性・再発性胚細胞腫瘍患者57例で、末梢血幹細胞採取物への腫瘍細胞混入を後方視的に検討。混入例(28%)は大量化学療法後の1年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)および無イベント生存率が有意に低く、無イベント生存の独立した予測因子であった。自家移植を要する患者での採取物の純度管理の重要性を示す。
pmid-11156214.summary_en: This study examined 57 patients with advanced or recurrent germ cell tumors to see whether tumor cells in peripheral blood progenitor cell harvests affected outcomes after high-dose chemotherapy and autologous reinfusion. Contamination, detected by cytokeratin staining and RT-PCR for germ-cell alkaline phosphatase mRNA, was present in 28% of patients and linked to markedly worse overall and event-free survival at one year. It was also an independent predictor of poor event-free survival.

pmid-11156305.summary_ja: 前大泉門上に急速に増大した類皮嚢腫の症例報告。出生時から増大過程までの画像を提示し、病変の性状と急速増大との関係について文献を考察している。類皮嚢腫は成熟奇形腫型の病変で、本例は頭蓋内ではなく頭皮に発生している。
pmid-11156305.summary_en: This case report describes a rapidly enlarging dermoid cyst over the anterior fontanel. The authors document its growth using imaging taken at birth and during subsequent enlargement, and review the literature on the nature of the lesion and its relationship to rapid growth. Dermoid cysts are mature teratoma-type lesions; this one arose extracranially on the scalp rather than intracranially.

pmid-11173663.summary_ja: 妊娠性トロホブラスト疾患の中で最も稀な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の2症例。いずれも手術前に診断された。上皮性腫瘍との鑑別が重要で、診断はhPLの強陽性所見と超微細構造に基づくべきとしている。判断に迷う症例ではhPL・hCG・MIB-1の免疫染色を勧め、血清hCGの経時的モニタリングで経過を追う。
pmid-11173663.summary_en: Two cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), the rarest gestational trophoblastic disease, are presented; both were recognized before surgery. Diagnosis should rest on intense hPL positivity and ultrastructural features, since the tumor cells can resemble epithelial tumors. In equivocal cases, hPL, hCG, and MIB-1 immunostaining are recommended, and serial serum hCG monitoring is advised to follow the disease course.

pmid-11173850.summary_ja: 本研究は、Y染色体上のゴナドブラストーマ責任領域(GBY)の候補遺伝子TSPYの発現を、ゴナドブラストーマ（3例4検体）と精巣セミノーマ2例で免疫組織化学的に検討したものである。TSPYは全ゴナドブラストーマの腫瘍胚細胞に優位に発現し、セミノーマでも全病期で豊富に発現していた。TSPYは両腫瘍の発生に関与するか、有用なマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。症例数が少なく、結果は予備的なものである。
pmid-11173850.summary_en: This study examined expression of TSPY, a candidate gene for the gonadoblastoma locus on the Y chromosome (GBY), in four gonadoblastoma specimens from three patients and in two testicular seminomas, using immunohistochemistry. TSPY was preferentially expressed in the tumor germ cells of all gonadoblastomas and was abundant across all stages of the seminomas. The authors suggest TSPY may contribute to oncogenesis or serve as a useful marker for both germ cell tumor types. The sample size is small, so these findings are preliminary.

pmid-11186178.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に、呼吸器組織とともに胸腺組織がみられた稀な症例を報告している。CD99、CD3、CD68およびサイトケラチンの免疫組織化学染色パターンは正常胸腺と同様であった。胸腺のT細胞は、腫瘍由来（単為生殖起源）の可能性と、宿主T細胞による二次的な定着の可能性が検討されている。奇形腫内成分の組織発生を考えるうえで示唆に富む1例である。
pmid-11186178.summary_en: The authors describe an unusual case of thymus tissue found within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma, together with respiratory tissues. Immunohistochemistry for CD99, CD3, CD68 and cytokeratins showed a pattern identical to normal thymus. The thymic T lymphocytes could have arisen from the tumor itself through parthenogenetic origin, or from secondary colonization of the teratoma by host T cells. The case provides a single example relevant to the histogenesis of teratoma components.

pmid-11186912.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対し左精巣摘除術を受けた34歳男性が、術後1か月で対麻痺を発症した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で胸椎第10椎体の硬膜外転移による圧迫性脊髄症が認められた。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法で病変は縮小し、神経症状も改善した。脳脊髄液中のβ-hCGが血漿より高値であり、硬膜内浸潤が疑われた。血漿と脳脊髄液のβ-hCG比は、中枢神経転移の検出に有用とされた。
pmid-11186912.summary_en: A 34-year-old man developed paraplegia one month after left orchiectomy for testicular seminoma. MRI revealed compressive myelopathy from a metastatic extradural lesion at thoracic vertebra 10. Combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin reduced the lesion and improved neurological symptoms. Intradural tumor invasion was suspected because CSF beta-hCG exceeded plasma levels. The authors suggest that the plasma-to-CSF beta-hCG ratio may help detect central nervous system metastases from hCG-producing tumors.

pmid-11191442.summary_ja: 1993年から1998年にカラチのAga Khan大学病院で診断された卵巣腫瘍855例を後方視的研究で検討した。良性が約59%、悪性が約41%であった。良性では嚢胞性奇形腫が最も多く、悪性では漿液性嚢胞腺癌が最も多かった。悪性の胚細胞腫瘍は、西欧のデータに比べ本地域で頻度が高かった。
pmid-11191442.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 855 ovarian tumors diagnosed at Aga Khan University Hospital in Karachi between 1993 and 1998. Of these, about 59% were benign and about 41% malignant, with surface epithelial-stromal tumors the largest group. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common benign tumor, while serous cystadenocarcinoma was the most common malignant one. Malignant mucinous and germ cell tumors were more frequent in this population than in Western series. The authors conclude that aside from these differences, the findings match published Western data.

pmid-11191950.summary_ja: 28歳女性が前胸壁に発生した稀な奇形腫として受診した。嚢胞性病変として認められ、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では腫瘤内に歯様の高吸収物が描出された。開胸を伴わず胸壁切開で完全切除された。病理学的に未熟な歯を含む良性奇形腫と診断された。性腺外に生じる奇形腫の1例として、画像所見の特徴が示された。
pmid-11191950.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman presented with a rare teratoma of the anterior chest wall, appearing as a cystic lesion. Computed tomography showed a hyperdense, tooth-like object within the mass. The lesion was totally excised through a chest-wall incision without thoracotomy. Pathology confirmed a benign teratoma containing an immature tooth. The case illustrates that extragonadal teratomas can occur in the chest wall and may be identified by imaging features suggesting a tooth. It is a single case report with a favorable outcome after complete resection.

pmid-11193306.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍でリンパ節、肺および肝転移を伴う2例に対し、動注化学療法を行った報告である。1例目は胎児性癌と絨毛癌の混在例で、全身化学療法と動注を併用して肝病変が縮小し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清では生存癌細胞は認められなかった。2例目はセミノーマで、肝動注シスプラチンとエトポシドにより肺転移と後腹膜病変の縮小が得られた。
pmid-11193306.summary_en: This report describes two men with testicular tumors and metastases to lymph nodes, lungs and liver who were treated with intra-arterial infusion chemotherapy. In the first case, an embryonal carcinoma with choriocarcinoma component responded after combined systemic and intra-arterial chemotherapy, followed by retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with no viable cancer found. In the second case, a seminoma with progressive liver metastases responded to intrahepatic arterial cisplatin and etoposide, with regression of lung and retroperitoneal disease. The authors reported successful outcomes with this approach.

pmid-11193307.summary_ja: 29歳男性が左精巣結節と後腹膜腫瘤で受診。精巣摘除術では生存腫瘍はなく、線維化と石灰化のみで焼失型精巣腫瘍と考えられた。化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化し、後腹膜腫瘤を摘出したところ胎児性癌、成熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められた。補助化学療法後、再発なく経過している。
pmid-11193307.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with a left testicular nodule and a large left retroperitoneal mass suspected to be metastatic testicular cancer. Orchiectomy revealed no viable tumor, only fibrosis and calcification, consistent with a burned-out testicular tumor. After three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin, tumor markers normalized, and the retroperitoneal mass was resected with the left kidney. Histology showed embryonal carcinoma, mature teratoma and yolk sac tumor. Adjuvant chemotherapy was given, and the patient has remained recurrence-free.

pmid-11194585.summary_ja: 生後5か月男児が腹部腫瘤、発熱、嘔吐で受診。超音波検査、CT、血清α-フェトプロテインから胃奇形腫と診断された。完全切除のみで化学療法は行わず、病理で未熟奇形腫と確認された。術後1年の時点で良好に経過している。小児奇形腫の1%未満という稀な部位の症例である。
pmid-11194585.summary_en: A 5-month-old boy presented with an abdominal mass, fever and vomiting. Ultrasonography, CT and elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein led to a diagnosis of gastric teratoma. Complete surgical excision was performed without chemotherapy, and histology confirmed an immature teratoma. The child remained well one year after surgery. Gastric teratoma is extremely rare, accounting for under 1% of pediatric teratomas, and complete resection alone sufficed in this case.

pmid-11195902.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を有する若年男性が不妊で受診した。両側精巣微石症と左精巣セミノーマが判明した。停留精巣の既往がある患者において、微石症とセミノーマの関連が考察されている。両リスク因子を持つ患者では慎重な経過観察が重要であり、本症例は注目に値する。
pmid-11195902.summary_en: A young man with a history of bilateral cryptorchidism presented with infertility. Investigation revealed bilateral testicular microlithiasis and a left testicular seminoma. The authors discuss the possible association between microlithiasis and seminoma in men with a cryptorchidism history, and the need for careful surveillance of such patients, given that both conditions are recognized risk factors for testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-11205451.summary_ja: 24歳男性が鼻腔腫瘍で受診し、精巣原発胎児性癌の転移と判明した。極めて稀な転移部位であり、ギリシャ語および海外文献を含めて考察している。鼻腔腫瘤の鑑別において、精巣腫瘍からの転移も念頭に置くべきことを示す症例である。胚細胞腫瘍の転移パターンを理解する上で参考になる。
pmid-11205451.summary_en: A 24-year-old man presented with a nasal cavity tumor that proved to be a metastasis of a testicular embryonal carcinoma. The authors describe this uncommon metastatic site and review Greek and international literature on testicular tumors metastatic to the nose. The report highlights that nasal involvement is a rare site for testicular germ cell tumor spread and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of nasal masses.

pmid-11206931.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株の培養上清がリンパ球の活性化を抑制することを、フローサイトメトリーにより検討した基礎研究である。活性化マーカーやCD95が有意に抑制され、活性化初期の細胞周期停止が関与すると考えられた。母体と胎児の免疫寛容への示唆も議論されている。
pmid-11206931.summary_en: This basic immunology study examines how culture supernatants from a human choriocarcinoma cell line affect lymphocyte activation. Phytohemagglutinin-stimulated lymphocytes were cultured with 50% supernatant and analyzed by flow cytometry at 12 and 60 hours. The supernatant significantly suppressed activation markers (CD25, CD69, CD71, CD134, CD3/HLA-DR) and the apoptosis marker CD95, apparently by blocking the cell cycle at early activation. The authors discuss implications for maternal-fetal immune tolerance.

pmid-11211804.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍44例の治療成績を後方視的に検討した研究である。5年生存率は全体で83.6%であった。転移例では、シスプラチンの用量強度が臨床効果と予後に相関した。奇形腫成分のない部分奏効例では、外科的切除に加え、経過観察も考慮されるとしている。
pmid-11211804.summary_en: This Japanese retrospective review analyzed 44 patients with germ cell tumors treated with induction chemotherapy. The 5-year survival was 83.6% overall, stratified by prognostic group. In 29 metastatic cases, cisplatin dose intensity correlated with clinical response and prognosis. Among partial responders without teratoma elements, management included salvage surgery, additional chemotherapy, or surveillance. The authors conclude that surgical resection is effective for residual masses, while observation may be considered in tumors without teratoma components.

pmid-11211806.summary_ja: 左後腹膜に発生した大型の成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。術前は副腎骨髄脂肪腫が疑われたが、腫瘍摘出により成熟奇形腫と診断された。脂肪成分が多い点が画像診断を誤らせた要因とされ、鑑別の難しさが示された。
pmid-11211806.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old man with a 7 to 9 cm left retroperitoneal solid tumor above the kidney, containing mostly fatty density and focal calcification. CT and MRI findings, together with angiography showing a hypovascular mass, led to a suspected adrenal myelolipoma. Tumorectomy revealed a mature teratoma. The authors note that this tumor contained more fat than typical retroperitoneal teratomas, which caused the misdiagnosis. The report highlights the imaging difficulty in distinguishing these entities.

pmid-11214621.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍16例の治療経過を検討した後方視的研究である。多くの症例がBEP化学療法を受け、平均30.5か月の追跡で大部分が無病生存した。高い化学感受性を背景に、卵巣と子宮の温存を目指すべきとされ、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割の再検討も提言されている。
pmid-11214621.summary_en: This retrospective Egyptian series reviewed 16 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1994 and 1999, including dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, and endodermal sinus tumor. Most patients received BEP chemotherapy, and many had incomplete initial surgical staging. With mean follow-up of 30.5 months, nearly all remained disease-free, and most preserved fertility. The authors conclude that ovary and uterus preservation is feasible in these highly chemosensitive tumors and suggest that the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy should be redefined.

pmid-11215209.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマのリンパ節転移の機序を、SCIDマウスの同所性モデルと臨床検体の免疫組織化学により検討した研究である。MMP-2の発現はリンパ節転移と有意に相関した。セミノーマ異種移植片はTCam-2細胞株より転移関連遺伝子の発現が高かった。
pmid-11215209.summary_en: This study investigated factors linked to lymph node metastasis in testicular germ cell tumors. The authors established a seminoma orthotopic model in SCID mice with renal hilar lymph node metastasis in 47% of animals. Expression of MMP-2, VEGF and other metastasis-related genes was higher in xenografts than in the TCam-2 seminoma cell line. Immunohistochemistry of 42 human tumors showed a significant correlation between MMP-2 expression and lymph node metastasis, suggesting MMP-2 as a potential marker of metastatic potential.

pmid-11218184.summary_ja: 本後方視的臨床研究は、1986年から1997年に治療された卵巣胚細胞がん31例(ディスジャーミノーマ10例、非未分化胚細胞性腫瘍21例)を検討したブラジルの報告である。両群の臨床病理学的特徴に差はみられなかった。5年生存率はディスジャーミノーマで100%、非未分化胚細胞性腫瘍で53%であり、多くの患者に白金製剤併用化学療法が用いられた。術中迅速凍結切片は永久標本による診断と高頻度で不一致を示し、16例中8例で誤りがみられた。
pmid-11218184.summary_en: This retrospective Brazilian clinical study reviewed 31 women with ovarian germ cell cancer treated between 1986 and 1997, including 10 dysgerminomas and 21 nondysgerminomatous tumors. Clinicopathologic features did not differ between groups. Five-year survival was 100% for dysgerminoma and 53% for nondysgerminomatous tumors, with platinum-based chemotherapy used in most patients. Intraoperative frozen section showed frequent discrepancies with final paraffin diagnoses, with an error rate of 8 of 16 cases.

pmid-11218685.summary_ja: 乳児に発生した心膜内奇形腫の2例を報告している。心嚢液貯留による心タンポナーデと、気管・気管支の圧迫がそれぞれの主症状であった。腫瘍は被膜に覆われ上行大動脈に付着しており、組織学的には三胚葉すべての成分を含んでいた。
pmid-11218685.summary_en: This pathology report describes two infants with rare intrapericardial teratomas. Presenting symptoms were pericardial effusion with cardiac tamponade in one case and compression of the tracheobronchial tree in the other. Both tumors were well encapsulated and attached to the ascending aorta. Histologically, each contained derivatives of all three germ cell layers, confirming the diagnosis of teratoma. The report documents this unusual extragonadal location in infants.

pmid-11221919.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ27例で、MAGE抗原の発現と炎症性T細胞浸潤、アポトーシス、壊死との関係を検討した。57B抗体による陽性例は70%だった。T細胞は多クローン性で、CD4/CD8比は症例により異なった。MAGE発現はアポトーシスや壊死と相関せず、リンパ球浸潤を主に駆動する抗原とは考えにくいと結論づけている。
pmid-11221919.summary_en: This study examined 27 classical seminomas for MAGE antigen expression, the cytotoxic T-cell and inflammatory infiltrate, clonality of T cells, apoptosis, and necrosis. MAGE-positive staining was seen in 70% of cases. Most infiltrating T cells were CD45R0-positive and polyclonal, and CD4/CD8 ratios varied. MAGE expression did not correlate with apoptotic index or necrosis, suggesting MAGE is not a dominant epitope driving the lymphocytic infiltrate.

pmid-11240646.summary_ja: 本報告は、1988年から1997年に手術後、2日間BEPレジメンによる補助化学療法を受けた悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍31例を記述したものである。組織型は奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む。追跡期間中央値5年で無病生存率は93.1%であり、growing teratoma syndromeが3例に認められたが、これによる死亡はなかった。著者らは本レジメンが有効であると示唆しているが、本研究はパイロット研究であり、ランダム化試験による検証が必要である。
pmid-11240646.summary_en: This report describes 31 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated with surgery followed by a two-day BEP regimen as adjuvant chemotherapy between 1988 and 1997. Histology included teratomas, dysgerminomas, and endodermal sinus tumors. Disease-free survival was 93.1% at median follow-up of 5 years, and three cases of growing teratoma syndrome occurred without mortality. The authors suggest the regimen is effective, but the study is a pilot needing randomized validation.

pmid-11240662.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患の転移と見誤られた無関係な病変を報告している。小脳血管腫、肺および縦隔奇形腫2例、肺肉芽腫の計4例が示される。臨床像と合わない転移所見では、腫瘍の広がりと断定する前に別の原因を探すべきだと警告している。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の評価における落とし穴を示す短報である。
pmid-11240662.summary_en: The authors describe apparent metastases from trophoblastic disease that proved to be unrelated lesions: a cerebellar hemangioma, two lung and mediastinal teratomas, and a pulmonary granuloma. The report emphasizes that when a presumed trophoblastic metastasis does not fit the clinical picture, clinicians should investigate an independent cause before assuming tumor spread. It is a short report on pitfalls in evaluating gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11240669.summary_ja: 31歳女性の化学療法抵抗性絨毛癌が脳と肺に転移した症例である。多剤化学療法で血清β-hCGが一度正常化したが、その後再上昇した。肺葉切除術と緊急の開頭術を経て、全脳照射により寛解に至った。局所切除が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の合併症の制御や、一部の症例での治癒に寄与しうると述べている。
pmid-11240669.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with chemo-resistant choriocarcinoma metastatic to brain and lung. Despite 61 months of multiagent chemotherapy, serum beta-hCG rose after normalization. Pulmonary lobectomy and emergency craniotomy for intracerebral hemorrhage revealed metastatic choriocarcinoma, and whole brain irradiation achieved complete remission. The authors argue local resection can help control complications of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and occasionally cure disease.

pmid-11261589.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や絨毛癌の患者と正常妊婦の末梢血単核細胞で、hCGのαおよびβサブユニットのmRNAをRT-PCRで検出した。胞状奇胎7例中3例、絨毛癌4例中1例で陽性だった。発現は血漿中の完全型hCG濃度と相関した。絨毛性疾患では栄養膜細胞様の細胞が末梢血中を循環していることを示す研究である。
pmid-11261589.summary_en: The authors used RT-PCR and Southern blot to detect hCG alpha and beta subunit mRNA in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from patients with hydatidiform mole or choriocarcinoma and from normal first-trimester pregnant women. Transcripts were found in 3 of 7 mole patients, 1 of 4 choriocarcinoma patients, and in normal pregnancies, but not in healthy controls. Expression correlated with plasma intact hCG levels, suggesting circulating trophoblast-like cells exist in trophoblastic disease.

pmid-11268445.summary_ja: 20歳男性の原発性縦隔未熟奇形腫の症例報告で、growing teratoma syndromeの特徴を示した。血清AFPは3600ng/mlと著明に上昇し、経皮的針生検では成熟奇形腫が疑われた。化学療法後にAFPは大きく低下したが、腫瘍は増大を続けた。切除標本では未熟奇形腫と診断されたが、組織の大部分は成熟成分であった。本症例は診断の難しさと完全切除の重要性を示している。
pmid-11268445.summary_en: A case report of a 20-year-old man with a primary mediastinal immature teratoma showing features of growing teratoma syndrome. Serum AFP was markedly elevated at 3600 ng/ml, and percutaneous needle biopsy suggested mature teratoma. After chemotherapy, AFP fell substantially, yet the tumor continued to enlarge. Resection showed immature teratoma, although most of the tissue was mature. The case highlights diagnostic difficulty and the importance of complete resection.

pmid-11268477.summary_ja: 22歳女性の右肺葉に生じた良性嚢胞性肺内奇形腫の症例報告である。区域気管支との連続性と他部位に胚細胞腫瘍がないことから、原発性の肺内病変と確定された。壁内に胸腺組織が認められ、第3咽頭嚢由来の可能性が示唆された。肉眼所見と組織学的所見が報告されている。
pmid-11268477.summary_en: A case report of a benign, cystic intrapulmonary teratoma in the right lobe of a 22-year-old woman. A connection to the segmental bronchus and the absence of germ cell neoplasms at other sites established a truly intrapulmonary origin. Thymic tissue within the tumor wall suggested derivation from the third pharyngeal pouch. The paper presents gross and microscopic findings, illustrating an unusual extragonadal location of teratoma.

pmid-11268495.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍56例の検体で、多剤耐性関連タンパク(MRP)の発現を免疫組織化学により検討した。組織型、転移の有無、臨床病期にかかわらず全例で陽性となり、細胞質と核の両方に染色が認められた。MRP発現は臨床病理学的因子と関連せず、化学療法感受性の高い本腫瘍では耐性の媒介としての役割は疑問視された。
pmid-11268495.summary_en: An immunohistochemical study of multidrug resistance-associated protein (MRP) in 56 testicular germ cell tumor specimens. MRP staining was positive in all tumors regardless of histology, metastatic status, or clinical stage, with signal in both cytoplasm and nuclei. MRP expression was not related to clinicopathological variables. The authors conclude that MRP is unlikely to mediate chemoresistance in these highly chemosensitive tumors, though a nucleocytoplasmic transport role is proposed.

pmid-11274886.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の腎転移に起因する腎内仮性動脈瘤の症例報告である。腫瘍による仮性動脈瘤は稀な合併症であり、本症例では腎転移が原因であった。コイル塞栓術により病変の治療に成功した。転移性病変に伴う血管合併症に対する低侵襲な治療法として有用であったと報告されている。
pmid-11274886.summary_en: A case report describing an intrarenal pseudoaneurysm caused by renal metastases from choriocarcinoma, a rare tumor-induced complication. Most intrarenal pseudoaneurysms arise from arterial laceration, but tumor-induced cases are very rare. The lesion was successfully treated with coil embolization. The report suggests that embolization is an effective minimally invasive option for vascular complications of metastatic germ cell tumor.

pmid-11314122.summary_ja: 口咽頭に原発し頭蓋内へ進展した先天性奇形腫の症例報告である。頭蓋外および頭蓋内の腫瘍成分に対し、段階的に遅延して切除する独自の方法が用いられた。患者は神経学的・機能的欠損なく長期生存した。従来の報告では死産や周産期死亡、切除後の重篤な障害が多いことが指摘されている。
pmid-11314122.summary_en: A case report of a congenital teratoma arising in the oropharyngeal cavity and extending into the intracranial cavity. The patient survived long-term without neurological or functional deficits after a unique delayed, staged resection of both the extracranial and intracranial components. The authors review the literature, noting that such lesions are often associated with stillbirth, perinatal death, or significant morbidity after attempted resection.

pmid-11326662.summary_ja: 精巣がん20例を対象に、腫瘍マーカーとしてのTu-M2-PKの有用性を前向きに検討した。精巣静脈と肘静脈の血中濃度に有意差はなく、転移の有無やセミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の間でも差は認められなかった。著者らは、精巣がんの診断においてTu-M2-PKを用いる利点はないと結論づけている。
pmid-11326662.summary_en: A prospective study of 20 patients with testicular cancer evaluating tumor M2-pyruvate kinase (Tu-M2-PK) as a marker. Levels were measured in blood drawn from the testicular vein and cubital vein before semicastration and afterward. Concentrations were similar between the two veins and did not differ between metastatic and non-metastatic disease or between seminoma and non-seminomatous tumors. The authors conclude that Tu-M2-PK offers no diagnostic benefit for testicular cancer.

pmid-11326684.summary_ja: 再発・進行性胚細胞腫瘍の24歳男性で、hCG高値に並行して甲状腺ホルモンが上昇した症例報告である。大量化学療法の経過中、甲状腺ホルモン値とhCG値は強く相関して低下した。チアマゾールによる治療は減量・中止された。hCGが甲状腺細胞を直接刺激した可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-11326684.summary_en: A case report of a 24-year-old man with relapsed germ cell tumor (stage IIIC) who developed hyperthyroidism with elevated free T3 and T4 alongside markedly raised hCG. Thyroid hormone levels correlated strongly with hCG reduction during high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue, and thiamazole was tapered and stopped. The authors propose that hCG may directly stimulate thyroid cells, although no clinical hyperthyroid symptoms were present.

pmid-11344613.summary_ja: 44歳女性の卵巣甲状腺腫様カルチノイドの症例報告である。奇形腫の一型である卵巣甲状腺腫の中に、甲状腺組織とカルチノイド腫瘍が併存していた。多くは良性であるが、本症例では対側卵巣、子宮筋層および肺に転移を認めた。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化は稀であると述べられている。
pmid-11344613.summary_en: A case report of a 44-year-old woman with ovarian strumal carcinoid, a rare variant of struma ovarii in which thyroid tissue coexists with carcinoid tumor within an ovarian teratoma. Such tumors are usually benign, but this patient developed metastases to the contralateral ovary, myometrium, and lungs. The authors note that malignant transformation of struma ovarii is uncommon and that most cases behave in a benign fashion.

pmid-11344617.summary_ja: 45歳男性の胃原発絨毛癌の症例報告。心窩部腫瘤と腹痛で受診し、生検では低分化癌とされた。亜全胃切除後の病理組織学的検査で絨毛癌と腺癌の混在を認め、術後血清β-hCGは著明に高値であった。両側精巣は正常で、原発性胃病変と考えられた。文献的考察を加えて報告する。
pmid-11344617.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the stomach, presenting with abdominal pain and an epigastric mass. Biopsy initially suggested poorly differentiated carcinoma, but gastrectomy revealed choriocarcinoma with syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic components alongside foci of adenocarcinoma. Postoperatively, serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated and immunohistochemistry confirmed positivity. Both testes were clinically and radiologically normal, supporting a primary gastric origin. The authors review the literature on this rare entity.

pmid-11376370.summary_ja: 生後2週の男児に発生した後腹膜の胎児内胎児の症例報告。腹部腫瘤として切除された病変内に、毛髪に覆われた球状組織、脳組織、四肢様構造、腸管を含む嚢胞腔、陰茎と精巣様組織が認められた。奇形腫の稀な一型と考えられ、新生児の腹部腫瘤の鑑別として重要である。
pmid-11376370.summary_en: This report describes a two-week-old boy with a retroperitoneal fetus in fetu, an extremely rare cause of abdominal mass in neonates. The excised mass contained a round structure covered by hair, with brain tissue, two legs and two arms, and a cystic cavity holding a segment of intestine. A small penis and testis were also present within the lesion. Fetus in fetu is considered a rare form of teratoma, and the case illustrates the importance of recognizing this entity in neonatal abdominal masses.

pmid-11392106.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫の1例をMR画像と病理所見で報告。多房性嚢胞性の付属器腫瘤で、T1・T2強調像で液体様の均一な信号を示し、隔壁に軽度の造影効果を認めた。良性多嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍と鑑別困難であり、術前診断の難しさを示す。
pmid-11392106.summary_en: A case of struma ovarii, a rare form of mature teratoma in which thyroid tissue predominates, is described with MR imaging and pathologic correlation. MRI showed a well-defined multiloculated cystic adnexal mass with septations. Fluid-like homogeneous signal intensity was seen on T1- and T2-weighted images, with subtle enhancement of internal septa. These features closely resembled benign multicystic ovarian tumors and differed from previously reported cases. The report highlights how struma ovarii may mimic benign ovarian cystic neoplasms on imaging.

pmid-11535985.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の外科的管理を、若年女性に多いことから妊孕性温存を中心にまとめた総説。大部分は良性の嚢胞性奇形腫で、卵巣残存部を温存する嚢腫摘出術が標準である。悪性例は多くが片側性で化学療法感受性が高く、進行例でも妊孕性を温存できる。減量手術は非ディスジャーミノーマ性腫瘍で有用である。
pmid-11535985.summary_en: This review discusses surgical management of ovarian germ cell tumours, with an emphasis on fertility preservation, since most affected patients are young women. Most ovarian germ cell tumours are benign, mainly mature cystic teratomas, which are best treated by cystectomy preserving the ovarian remnant. Malignant forms are usually unilateral and highly chemosensitive, allowing fertility-sparing surgery even in advanced disease. Cytoreductive surgery is useful for non-dysgerminomatous tumours but unnecessary for dysgerminoma. Second-look surgery is rarely needed with modern combination chemotherapy.

pmid-11752948.summary_ja: 縦隔前部に発生し悪性転化を伴った奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍は破裂を合併していた。CTで脂肪成分と壁石灰化を伴う分葉状の不均一な嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、外側壁の断裂と左上葉の浸潤影から破裂が示唆された。病理学的に腺癌と診断された。高齢者に典型的な長い経過をたどった。
pmid-11752948.summary_en: A case of teratoma with malignant transformation arising in the anterior mediastinum is reported, complicated by tumor rupture. The mass had a long history, consistent with the typical presentation in older patients. CT showed a lobulated, inhomogeneous cystic mass containing fat and wall calcifications, with a disrupted lateral wall and adjacent left upper lobe consolidation indicating rupture. A heterogeneously enhancing solid component obliterated the fat plane between the mass and great vessels. Pathology revealed adenocarcinoma.

pmid-11752961.summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児に発生した未熟型胃奇形腫の症例報告。CTと超音波検査で診断された。胃奇形腫は極めて稀で、ほぼ良性であり、男性に多く腹部腫瘤として触知される。韓国の文献では成人例が1例報告されているのみである。乳児の腹部腫瘤の診断において画像検査が重要である。
pmid-11752961.summary_en: This case report describes an immature gastric teratoma in a 3-month-old boy, identified on CT and ultrasonography. Gastric teratomas are extremely rare and almost always benign, occurring predominantly in males and typically presenting as a palpable abdominal mass. Only one adult case had previously been reported in the Korean literature. The authors highlight the importance of imaging in establishing the diagnosis in infants with abdominal masses.

pmid-11776123.summary_ja: 本研究では免疫組織化学によりp27Kip1の発現を検討した。悪性の絨毛性腫瘍では陽性率が21.4%と、正常絨毛（80%）や完全胞状奇胎（73.3%）より有意に低かった。妊娠週数に比して子宮が大きい完全胞状奇胎では陽性率がさらに低かった。p27Kip1は妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生に関与し、完全胞状奇胎の予後因子となりうると結論づけられている。
pmid-11776123.summary_en: This study examined p27Kip1 immunohistochemical expression in 10 normal first-trimester chorionic villi, 15 complete hydatidiform moles, 7 invasive moles, and 7 choriocarcinomas. p27 expression was significantly decreased in malignant trophoblastic neoplasms (21.4%) compared with normal villi (80%) and complete moles (73.3%). In complete moles with uteri large for gestational age, positivity was lower (42.9% vs 100%). The authors conclude that p27Kip1 may act as a negative cell-cycle regulator in gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and that its level in trophoblastic cells could serve as a prognostic factor for complete hydatidiform mole.

pmid-11876614.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫6例（うち2例はカルチノイドを合併）の組織学的多様性を報告した。全例で臨床的に甲状腺機能は正常で、最大径は10cmであった。甲状腺組織には橋本病様変化や甲状腺腫性変化がみられ、1例では微小濾胞を伴う腺腫性病巣を認めた。2例では杯細胞を有する粘液性腺管と索状カルチノイドが混在していた。病理医はこれらの多様な所見を理解し、誤診を避ける必要があると指摘している。
pmid-11876614.summary_en: This report describes six cases of struma ovarii, including two with associated carcinoid, in patients aged 22 to 50 years. All patients were clinically euthyroid and all tumors were unilateral, the largest measuring 10 cm. Microscopy showed non-neoplastic thyroid changes such as Hashimoto thyroiditis and goitrous change, and adenomatous foci with microfollicles in one case. Two tumors contained trabecular carcinoid admixed with goblet-cell mucinous glands, a rarely reported finding. The authors stress that pathologists should recognize these variable features to avoid misdiagnosis and search for thyroid follicles or dermoid components.

pmid-12899400.summary_ja: 1985年から1997年に子宮摘出術を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍68例を後方視的に解析した。絨毛癌38例と侵入奇胎30例が含まれる。挙児を希望しない高齢者（完全寛解95.6%）、化学療法抵抗性の子宮限局病変（71.1%）、穿孔や致死的出血に対する緊急手術（94.4%）に用いられた。子宮摘出術は選ばれた症例で有用な補助療法であると結論づけられている。
pmid-12899400.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 68 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated by hysterectomy at PUMC Hospital from 1985 to 1997 included 38 choriocarcinomas and 30 invasive moles. Hysterectomy was used for older patients who did not desire fertility after brief chemotherapy (complete remission 95.6%), for chemorefractory isolated uterine lesions as adjunct therapy (71.1%), and as emergency treatment for perforation or life-threatening hemorrhage (94.4%). The authors conclude that hysterectomy remains an important adjunct for selected patients, and extended hysterectomy is preferable to prevent recurrence.

pmid-18521299.summary_ja: 65歳男性の後腹膜腫瘍で、β-hCG高値から性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われた症例を報告した。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)下生検では診断に至らず、化学療法2コース後にβ-hCGは正常化した。開腹生検と免疫組織化学により多形性平滑筋肉腫と診断された。後腹膜腫瘍でβ-hCGが中等度に上昇する場合は鑑別が難しく、β-hCG産生平滑筋肉腫を鑑別診断に加えるべきだと指摘している。
pmid-18521299.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old man with a large retroperitoneal mass and elevated beta-hCG, initially suspected to be an extragonadal germ cell tumor. CT-guided biopsy was nondiagnostic, and beta-hCG normalized after two cycles of chemotherapy. Laparotomy with incisional biopsy and immunohistochemistry identified a pleomorphic leiomyosarcoma. The authors note that tumor markers play a limited role in soft tissue sarcomas, but a retroperitoneal tumor with moderately elevated beta-hCG can mislead clinicians, so a beta-hCG-producing leiomyosarcoma should be included in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-20563696.summary_ja: 1971年から1996年に治療された35歳未満の悪性卵巣腫瘍58例を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍では保存的手術群の全例が生存し、白金製剤による化学療法群は非白金製剤群より有意に良好な生存成績を示した。術後化学療法による排卵障害は一過性で、妊娠を希望した患者の多くが妊娠に至った。
pmid-20563696.summary_en: This study of 58 women under 35 with malignant ovarian tumors (20 germ cell tumors, 38 epithelial tumors) treated from 1971 to 1996 compared conservative with radical surgery. Patients with stage I disease were included, while stage II or higher were excluded. All germ cell tumor patients survived, and platinum-based chemotherapy was associated with significantly better survival than non-platinum regimens. Postoperative chemotherapy caused only transient ovulatory dysfunction, and most women who wished to conceive became pregnant.

pmid-23008631.summary_ja: サウジアラビアの一施設で1983年から1998年に診断された胞状奇胎90例を後方視的に検討した。発生頻度は分娩1000件あたり2.2例で、最も多い症状は膣出血であった。受診が遅れた症例で出血などの合併症が多く、フォローアップ中に侵入奇胎6例と絨毛癌3例が認められた。
pmid-23008631.summary_en: This retrospective study of 90 hydatidiform mole cases at King Fahd Hospital in Saudi Arabia (1983 to 1998) reported an incidence of 2.2 per 1000 deliveries. Vaginal bleeding was the most common presentation, and complications such as hemorrhage and sepsis were more frequent in patients who presented late. Six cases of invasive mole and three of choriocarcinoma developed during follow-up. The authors emphasize that earlier diagnosis and treatment may reduce complications.

pmid-25905224.summary_ja: 精巣がんの総説で、セミノーマと非セミノーマを含む胚細胞由来腫瘍が大部分を占めることを述べている。胚細胞上皮内腫瘍や精巣異形成症候群との関連、病因、診断を解説する。治療は外科的切除、放射線療法、化学療法を簡潔に扱い、内分泌系への影響、妊孕性、生活の質に重点を置く。
pmid-25905224.summary_en: This chapter reviews testicular cancer, where germ cell-derived tumors (seminoma and nonseminoma) make up most cases and arise from germ cell neoplasia in situ. It covers the link to testicular dysgenesis syndrome, pathogenesis, and diagnosis. Management is summarized briefly, including surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy. The authors emphasize endocrine consequences, fertility concerns, and quality of life for endocrinologists, including pediatric specialists.

pmid-10692182.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、72歳男性の左鼻腔に生じた奇形腫様特徴を持つ芽腫性腫瘍を記述しています。未熟神経上皮と角化嚢胞を含み、癌腫・肉腫成分がない場合は芽腫より未熟奇形腫の用語が適切と論じています。
pmid-10692182.summary_en: This case report describes a polypoid blastomatous tumor with teratoid features in the left nasal cavity of a 72-year-old man. Histology showed immature neuroepithelial cells, keratinizing cystic squamous nests, mucous glands, and complex glandular structures. The authors argue that the term immature teratoma is more appropriate than blastoma when no carcinomatous or sarcomatous component is present. The tumor is a sinonasal neoplasm, so its classification as a germ cell-related teratoma is uncertain.

pmid-10700888.summary_ja: 泌尿器癌の化学療法をEBMの観点から総説したもの。進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではシスプラチン併用療法がランダム化比較試験により確立されている。予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍では自家幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法が検討中である。膀胱癌、腎細胞癌、前立腺癌については根拠が不十分とされている。
pmid-10700888.summary_en: This Japanese review applies evidence-based medicine to chemotherapy for urological cancers, including urothelial carcinoma, renal cell carcinoma, prostate cancer, and testicular germ cell tumor. For advanced testicular germ cell tumor, cisplatin-based regimens are well established through randomized trials. High-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell support is under evaluation for poor-risk germ cell tumors. Evidence for the other urological cancers is limited.

pmid-10717236.summary_ja: GDNFとニューツリンは、精巣のSertoli細胞が産生し、Ret受容体を発現する精原細胞のDNA合成を刺激した。同じ受容体・リガンド系が胚細胞腫瘍にも発現しており、腫瘍内で活性化している可能性が示された。主題は精子形成における傍分泌作用であり、胚細胞腫瘍の解析は付随的な位置づけである。
pmid-10717236.summary_en: This study shows that Ret, GFRα-1, and GFRα-2 are expressed by testicular germ cells, while GDNF and neurturin are produced by Sertoli cells. Both factors stimulated DNA synthesis in spermatogonia, suggesting paracrine roles in spermatogenesis. The authors also found Ret, its ligands, and co-receptors expressed in germ cell tumors, suggesting this signaling circuit may be active in these tumors. Germ cell tumor analysis is a secondary part of a mainly physiological study.

pmid-10718371.summary_ja: 未分化のヒト胎児性癌細胞ではHSP90の発現が高く、レチノイン酸や熱ショックによる分化に伴って減少した。HSP90αまたはβの過剰発現は神経系への分化を阻害し、βは栄養外胚葉への分化も阻害した。HSP90の減少はヒトEC細胞の分化に重要であり、アイソフォームごとに系譜の選択に関わると結論づけている。臨床ではなく培養細胞の基礎研究である。
pmid-10718371.summary_en: This study shows that HSP90 is highly expressed in undifferentiated human embryonal carcinoma cells and falls during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Heat shock also lowered HSP90 and induced neural differentiation. Overexpressing HSP90α or β inhibited neural differentiation, while HSP90β alone impaired trophoectoderm differentiation. The authors conclude that HSP90 downregulation is critical for human EC cell differentiation and that specific isoforms direct lineage choice. The work is in vitro basic biology of EC cells.

pmid-10721807.summary_ja: 膵臓に生じる扁平上皮で裏打ちされた嚢胞性病変の3型を概説した。リンパ上皮性嚢胞は主に高齢男性に、副脾由来の類表皮嚢胞は膵尾部に生じる。真の類皮嚢腫は若年者に性差なく認められ、毛髪や皮脂腺を含むことがある。これらの良性病変は粘液性嚢胞性腫瘍などの他の嚢胞性腫瘍との鑑別が必要であると強調されている。
pmid-10721807.summary_en: This review describes three types of squamous-lined cysts of the pancreas: lymphoepithelial cysts, dermoid cysts (monodermal teratomas), and epidermoid cysts arising in intrapancreatic accessory spleen. Lymphoepithelial cysts are mainly found in older men, while accessory spleen epidermoid cysts occur in the pancreatic tail of middle-aged adults. True dermoid cysts occur in younger patients without gender predominance and may contain hair, sebaceous units, or respiratory mucosa. The authors stress that these benign lesions must be distinguished from other cystic neoplasms, particularly mucinous cystic tumors.

pmid-10726703.summary_ja: 仙尾部の脊柱外上衣腫の症例を提示し、既報例のメタアナリシスを行った。これらの腫瘍は仙尾部、卵巣、縦隔などの奇形腫の好発部位に生じる。尾骨を切除した場合の局所再発はゼロであったが、残した場合は71%であった。臨床像が仙尾部奇形腫に類似することから、単相性奇形腫である可能性が示唆され、尾骨切除の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-10726703.summary_en: This report presents a sacrococcygeal extraspinal ependymoma and a meta-analysis of published sacrococcygeal and all-site extraspinal ependymoma cases. These tumors cluster at teratoma sites such as the sacrococcygeal region, ovary, and mediastinum. Local recurrence was zero when the coccyx was excised but rose to 71% when it was left behind. Because the clinical features resemble sacrococcygeal teratomas, the authors propose that these ependymomas may be monophasic teratomas, and they recommend coccygectomy as an essential component of surgical treatment.

pmid-10731933.summary_ja: 25歳女性で、卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に併存して卵管原発癌が偶発的に発見された症例。卵管原発癌は女性生殖器のまれな悪性腫瘍で、診断時には進行していることが多い。文献の簡単な概説を含む。主題は卵管癌であり、卵巣奇形腫は併存病変として記載されている。
pmid-10731933.summary_en: The authors describe a 25-year-old woman in whom a primary carcinoma of the fallopian tube was incidentally found alongside a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary. Primary fallopian tube carcinoma is a rare female genital malignancy that is usually extensive when diagnosed. The report includes a brief literature review. The main focus is the tubal carcinoma, while the ovarian teratoma is a coexisting finding.

pmid-10739532.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞などを用い、ケラチノサイト増殖因子(KGF)とその受容体の発現、およびヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)産生への影響を検討した細胞実験。KGFは細胞増殖には影響しなかったが、BeWo細胞のhCG産生を有意に増加させた。分化誘導後にその作用は増強され、栄養膜細胞のhCG産生にKGFが関与する可能性が示された。臨床例ではない。
pmid-10739532.summary_en: This study examined keratinocyte growth factor (KGF) gene expression and its receptor in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells, PA-1 teratocarcinoma cells, and endometrial stromal cells. KGF did not affect proliferation of BeWo or PA-1 cells but significantly increased hCG production in BeWo cells, and this effect was enhanced after forskolin-induced differentiation. The authors conclude that KGF may promote hCG production in trophoblast cells. The work is a cell-based trophoblast biology study rather than a clinical study of germ cell or trophoblastic disease.

pmid-10751151.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19でTrkA受容体の活性化が細胞間接触と細胞の密集化を促すことを示した。TrkA活性化はP19とMDCK上皮細胞の両方でカテニンのチロシンリン酸化を誘導した。Src阻害剤PP2はカテニンのリン酸化を抑制しても細胞の密集化を妨げなかった。カテニンのリン酸化はカドヘリン結合に必須ではないと結論づけている。腫瘍の挙動よりも接着シグナルが主題である。
pmid-10751151.summary_en: This study shows that ectopic activation of the TrkA receptor tyrosine kinase in embryonal carcinoma P19 cells promotes extensive cell-cell contacts and compaction into closely packed clusters. TrkA activation induced tyrosine phosphorylation of p120ctn and beta-catenin in both P19 and epithelial MDCK cells, irrespective of cellular response. The Src inhibitor PP2 blocked catenin phosphorylation without affecting compaction, indicating catenin phosphorylation is dispensable for cadherin binding. The work focuses on adhesion signaling rather than tumor behavior.

pmid-10756337.summary_ja: 2家系3例の胚発生異常(主に正中線の奇形)を報告する。1例は仙尾部奇形腫を伴い、その分化した部分に原始卵胞を含む卵巣組織が認められた。遺伝カウンセリングの難しさを論じ、遺伝的原因を疑うとともに次回妊娠での超音波検査を勧めている。奇形腫は多数の所見の一つで、主題は遺伝とカウンセリングである。
pmid-10756337.summary_en: This report describes three patients with defects of blastogenesis, mainly midline anomalies, from two families. One patient had hydrocephalus, a small cerebellum, cleft lip and palate, and a large sacrococcygeal teratoma containing ovarian tissue with primordial follicles. The authors discuss the difficulty of genetic counseling, suspect a genetic cause in some cases, and recommend ultrasound examination in subsequent pregnancies. The teratoma is one feature within a broader focus on genetics and counseling.

pmid-10765902.summary_ja: 3年間に腹腔鏡手術を受けた小児の付属器疾患23例の検討。性腺異常7例では腹腔鏡下性腺摘出を行い、腹痛を呈した15例では付属器腫瘤が多かった。大きな奇形腫の1例のみ開腹移行し、全例合併症なく回復した。腹腔鏡は小児の診断と治療に安全かつ有効と結論づけられた。
pmid-10765902.summary_en: This report reviews 23 girls aged 3 months to 15 years who underwent laparoscopy for adnexal pathologies over three years. Seven had congenital gonadal disorders treated with gonadectomy, and 15 presented with abdominal pain, mostly due to adnexal masses. Laparoscopic excision succeeded in 10 of 11 masses, with conversion to open surgery in one patient with a large teratoma. All patients recovered without complications. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe and effective for diagnosis and treatment in children.

pmid-10766799.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来JEG-3細胞を用い、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のサブユニット会合にジスルフィド結合が必要かを検討した。DTTで小胞体を還元環境にしてもαβ二量体は形成され、hCGは結合が不要な構造を取りうると示された。腫瘍マーカーの蛋白質フォールディングを扱った研究である。
pmid-10766799.summary_en: Using JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, this study tested whether disulfide bond formation is needed for assembly of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) subunits. Dithiothreitol created a reducing environment in the endoplasmic reticulum, which blocked disulfide formation yet still allowed alpha-beta dimer formation. Beta-subunit precursors folded back upon reoxidation. The results indicate hCG subunits can reach association-competent conformations without disulfide bonds. The study addresses protein folding of a tumor marker rather than tumor biology.

pmid-10767360.summary_ja: レトロウイルス挿入により複数の異常形質を示す胎児性癌変異細胞株NR1-6を樹立した。CA反復多型と種間戻し交配パネルを用いて、原因遺伝子座をX染色体近位部のMGIオフセット1.5～4.5の間にマッピングし、DXUalb1と命名した。細胞株の遺伝学的解析であり、患者の腫瘍は対象外である。
pmid-10767360.summary_en: The authors established a mutant embryonal carcinoma cell line, NR1-6, carrying a retroviral insertion that caused several aberrant phenotypes. Using CA repeat polymorphisms and interspecific backcross panels, they mapped the causative locus to the proximal X chromosome between MGI offsets 1.5 and 4.5, designated DXUalb1. Candidate genes in this region may help explain the variant phenotypes. The study concerns genetic mapping of an embryonal carcinoma cell phenotype rather than patient tumors.

pmid-10774179.summary_ja: 本総説は、卵巣および付属器腫瘤のMR画像診断における落とし穴を論じたものである。卵巣は多様な組織型の腫瘍を生じ、非腫瘍性疾患や他の骨盤臓器由来の腫瘍が卵巣腫瘍と誤診されやすい。固形の付属器腫瘤は悪性とみなすという原則の例外として良性奇形腫が挙げられ、正しい画像診断の手がかりが解説されている。
pmid-10774179.summary_en: This review discusses MR imaging pitfalls in diagnosing ovarian and adnexal masses. Because the ovary contains surface epithelial, germ cell, sex-cord stromal and stromal components, diverse histologic tumors arise there, and non-neoplastic lesions and tumors from other pelvic organs can mimic them. The authors describe common-sense diagnostic rules and their exceptions, including benign teratomas as an exception to the rule that solid adnexal masses are malignant. MR characteristics and clues for correct diagnosis are reviewed.

pmid-10782416.summary_ja: 65歳女性の子宮頸部腺癌で、絨毛癌様および肝様分化を示した症例を報告する。腫瘍の主成分は典型的な絨毛癌で、肝様癌および頸管腺癌が混在していた。絨毛癌成分でヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、肝様成分でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が検出された。患者は術後4か月で肺転移により死亡した。両異所性成分は上皮細胞の異常分化に由来すると考察されている。
pmid-10782416.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with cervical adenocarcinoma showing choriocarcinomatous and hepatoid differentiation. The major tumor component was typical choriocarcinoma, admixed with hepatoid carcinoma and endocervical adenocarcinoma. Immunostaining detected hCG in choriocarcinomatous areas and AFP in hepatoid areas. The patient developed pulmonary metastases and died four months after surgery. The authors propose that both heterotopic components arose from aberrant differentiation of somatic epithelial cells.

pmid-10813334.summary_ja: 新生児が著明な腹部膨隆と呼吸窮迫で受診し、当初は胎便性偽嚢胞が疑われた。緊急開腹術で後腹膜に脊椎や四肢様構造を含む病変が見つかり、胎児内胎児と診断された。奇形腫は悪性化の可能性があるため両者の鑑別が重要であり、再発を防ぐため病変はすべて切除すべきと著者らは強調している。
pmid-10813334.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with massive abdominal distension and respiratory distress, initially suspected of having a meconium pseudocyst. Emergency laparotomy revealed a retroperitoneal fetiform mass containing a vertebral column and limb-like structures, consistent with fetus-in-fetu, a rare congenital anomaly. The authors stress that this entity must be differentiated from teratoma because of teratoma's malignant potential, and that complete removal of all mass components is needed to prevent malignant recurrence.

pmid-10826495.summary_ja: 本研究はF9胎児性癌細胞をレチノイン酸とPTHrPで内胚葉へ分化させた際のコネキシン43の発現、リン酸化、局在、ギャップ結合通信の変化を解析した。マウス胚の内胚葉とも比較し、分化にはギャップ結合通信が必須ではないと結論づける。腫瘍学ではなく発生モデルとしての利用である。
pmid-10826495.summary_en: This study examines how connexin43 expression, phosphorylation, localization, and gap junctional communication change during endoderm differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells induced by retinoic acid and PTHrP. The authors compare these changes with visceral and parietal endoderm from mouse embryos at day 8.5. They find that the regulation correlates with functional communication, but gap junctional communication is not required for differentiation. The work uses an embryonal carcinoma line as a developmental model rather than studying tumor biology.

pmid-10828712.summary_ja: 本研究は血清および腹水のLDH値が卵巣癌と良性卵巣腫瘍を鑑別できるかを前向きに検討した。血清LDHは癌患者で有意に高く、特異度が高いため腫瘍マーカーとしての可能性が示唆された。腹水LDHには差がなかった。組織型・病期による差もなく、胚細胞腫瘍を主題とした研究ではない。
pmid-10828712.summary_en: This prospective study evaluates whether serum and peritoneal fluid lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) levels can distinguish ovarian carcinoma from benign ovarian tumors. Among 50 patients, 20 had ovarian cancer and 30 had benign tumors. Peritoneal fluid LDH did not differ significantly between groups, while serum LDH was significantly higher in cancer patients. LDH levels did not differ by histological type or stage. The authors suggest serum LDH has high specificity and potential as a biochemical marker. The study concerns ovarian carcinoma generally, without a germ cell tumor focus.

pmid-10831124.summary_ja: ヒト胎盤と絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3におけるギャップ結合コネキシンの発現を解析した。Cx26の導入が増殖を抑え、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)β分泌を誘導した。ヌードマウスでは絨毛癌細胞が宿主血管に浸潤し内皮細胞を置換した。主題は胎盤発育だが、絨毛癌は一部で腫瘍モデルとして扱われている。
pmid-10831124.summary_en: This study examines gap junction connexin expression in human placentae and in Jeg-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Connexin40 is expressed in invasive extravillous trophoblast and endothelium. Transfecting Jeg-3 cells with Cx26, Cx40, or Cx43 showed Cx26 most strongly reduced proliferation and induced hCG-beta secretion. In nude mice, choriocarcinoma cells invaded host vessels and replaced endothelial cells, and tumour connexin expression changed. The work mainly concerns placental development, with choriocarcinoma serving partly as a tumour model.

pmid-10833149.summary_ja: 長期間存在した舌下類皮嚢腫が扁平上皮癌へ悪性転化した、初めての症例報告です。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化と類似する現象ですが、口腔内の嚢胞性病変である点で生殖細胞腫瘍とは性質が異なります。
pmid-10833149.summary_en: This case report describes the first documented malignant transformation of a long-standing sublingual dermoid cyst into squamous cell carcinoma. Sublingual dermoid cysts typically present as slow-growing masses causing tongue elevation, speech interference, or a double chin. The report is relevant to the broader phenomenon of malignant transformation in dermoid-type lesions, which is well described in ovarian mature cystic teratoma, although the oral location differs substantially from germ cell tumors.

pmid-10835078.summary_ja: 19か月の女児の石灰化を伴う腹部腫瘤の症例報告である。単純X線、超音波検査、CTでは奇形腫より胎児内胎児が示唆された。病理学的に画像で描出されなかった脊柱が確認され、画像上の脊柱の非描出では胎児内胎児を否定できないことが示された。文献的考察を含み、奇形腫との鑑別の難しさを強調している。
pmid-10835078.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-month-old girl with a calcified abdominal mass. Radiography, ultrasonography, and CT suggested fetus in fetu rather than teratoma. The pathologist identified a vertebral column that was not visible on imaging, showing that its absence on radiography or CT does not exclude fetus in fetu. The paper includes a literature review and highlights the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing fetus in fetu from teratoma in young children.

pmid-10837916.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌(EC)細胞株であるマウスP19細胞とヒトNT2/D1細胞を用い、神経分化における細胞周期抑制因子p27(kip1)の役割を検討した基礎研究である。全トランス型レチノイン酸処理によりp27が早期に誘導され、p27の発現阻害は神経分化を阻害した。臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍の診療に関する内容ではない。
pmid-10837916.summary_en: This basic research study examines the cell-cycle inhibitor p27(kip1) during neuronal differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, using mouse P19 and human NT2/D1 lines. Retinoic acid induced p27 expression early, before neurite formation, whereas p21 rose later. A mutant line that failed to express p27 also failed to differentiate, and 9-cis retinoic acid restored both. Okadaic acid suppressed p27 and blocked differentiation, while antisense p27 oligonucleotides prevented neuronal differentiation. The authors conclude that p27 is essential for neuronal differentiation of EC cells. The work concerns cell biology rather than clinical germ cell tumor management.

pmid-10855051.summary_ja: 8か月の女児で先天性動眼神経麻痺と診断されたが、5歳時の斜視手術で筋を包む線維性腫瘤が見つかった。生検で毛髪を含む線維組織が確認され、周産期に破裂した眼窩類皮嚢腫と診断された。CTの再評価で外側眼窩壁の拡大と切痕が認められた。類皮嚢腫が神経性の眼球運動障害を模倣しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-10855051.summary_en: This case report describes an eight-month-old girl with congenital exotropia, ptosis and restricted eye movements, initially diagnosed as congenital oculomotor palsy. Brain and orbital CT were normal at eight months. At age five, strabismus surgery revealed a fibrous mass surrounding the superior and lateral rectus muscles, and biopsy showed fibrous tissue containing hair. The authors diagnosed a perinatally ruptured orbital dermoid cyst, supported by reassessment of CT showing enlargement and a notch in the lateral orbital wall. The case shows that orbital dermoid cysts can mimic neurogenic ocular motor palsy.

pmid-10877332.summary_ja: 米国の症例対照研究で、良性卵巣腫瘍746例と対照404例を比較し、脂肪・栄養素摂取との関連を検討しました。総脂肪・多価不飽和脂肪・植物性脂肪の高摂取でリスク上昇が見られ、ビタミンAは漿液性腫瘍で低リスクでした。奇形腫は子宮内膜様腫瘍や漿液性腫瘍と並ぶ組織型の一つとして解析されていますが、主題は良性卵巣腫瘍全体です。
pmid-10877332.summary_en: This US case-control study examined whether dietary fat and micronutrients were associated with benign ovarian tumors in 746 cases and 404 community controls. Higher intakes of total, polyunsaturated and vegetable fat were linked to elevated risk, while vitamin A appeared protective against serous tumors. Histological analysis found elevated polyunsaturated fat associations with endometrioid, serous, and teratoma tumors. Teratoma is only one of several histologic subgroups among benign ovarian tumors. The authors recommend replication of these findings. Germ cell tumor is not the principal focus.

pmid-10908768.summary_ja: 1980～1998年に手術を受けた21歳未満の女児・若年女性140例を後方視的に検討した研究。最も多いのは卵巣嚢腫で、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を含む良性腫瘍は30%、悪性腫瘍は7.9%であった。卵巣捻転は17.8%に認められた。ホルモン活性を伴う複雑な卵巣腫瘤は悪性の可能性が高く、注意が必要とされる。
pmid-10908768.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed 140 girls and young women under 21 years old who underwent surgery for noninflammatory ovarian masses between 1980 and 1998. Ovarian cysts were the most common finding, while benign tumors, including mature cystic teratomas, accounted for 30% and malignancies for 7.9%. Ovarian torsion occurred in 17.8% of patients. Laparoscopic use increased over time, driven mainly by patient age. The authors conclude that complex masses with hormonal activity on ultrasound in older patients are usually malignant and warrant caution.

pmid-10928112.summary_ja: 電離放射線が白血球と可溶性免疫因子に与える影響を検討した研究。セミノーマ患者で局所放射線療法後のリンパ球サブセットをFACSで解析した。CD95、CD95-L、サイトカインをELISAで測定したところ、生体内でも試験管内でも放出の増加は確認されなかった。放射線によりリンパ球は全体的に持続的に減少し、マイトジェン誘導性のサイトカイン産生は試験管内で抑制された。
pmid-10928112.summary_en: This study examined how ionizing radiation affects human leukocytes and circulating immune mediators. In seminoma patients receiving local radiotherapy, lymphocyte subsets were measured by FACS analysis. Soluble CD95, CD95-L and cytokines were assayed by ELISA both in vivo and after in vitro irradiation of blood cells. Radiation caused a sustained systemic reduction of lymphocyte subsets, but no increase in cytokines or CD95 mediators was detected, and mitogen-induced cytokine production was inhibited in vitro.

pmid-10933271.summary_ja: ニューヨーク市での症例対照研究で、経口避妊薬の使用と病理学的に確認された良性卵巣腫瘍（漿液性腺腫、奇形腫、子宮内膜症性嚢胞、粘液性腺腫）との関連を検討した。経口避妊薬使用者ではリスクが低下し（補正OR 0.79）、子宮内膜症病変を持つ女性や長期使用者で低下が大きかった。奇形腫は4つの解析対象の一つである。
pmid-10933271.summary_en: This case-control study from New York City examined oral contraceptive use in relation to pathologically confirmed benign ovarian tumors, including serous adenomas, teratomas, endometriomas, and mucinous adenomas. Ever use of oral contraceptives was associated with reduced risk (adjusted OR 0.79), with greatest reduction in women with endometriotic lesions and longer duration of use. Teratomas are one of four analyzed subtypes, while the focus is benign ovarian tumors overall. The authors conclude that oral contraceptives may provide a noncontraceptive benefit.

pmid-10951579.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞はγ線照射後にG1/S期で停止しない。野生型p53は蓄積し、p21WAF1/CIP1のmRNAも増えるが、タンパク質はプロテアソームで分解されるためである。その結果、細胞はG2/M期で可逆的に遅延し、多くはアポトーシスに至る。胚細胞腫瘍モデル細胞における細胞周期チェックポイントの特性を明らかにした基礎研究である。
pmid-10951579.summary_en: This basic research study examines why F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a teratocarcinoma-derived line used as a germ cell tumor model, fail to arrest at the G1/S checkpoint after gamma-irradiation. Wild-type p53 accumulates and p21WAF1/CIP1 mRNA rises, yet the p21 protein is degraded by the proteasome, preventing G1 arrest. Cells instead undergo a reversible G2/M delay and largely undergo apoptosis. The findings clarify how defective checkpoint control in embryonal carcinoma cells may affect genome integrity after DNA damage.

pmid-10982303.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する切除後に、肺門部の顆粒細胞腫瘍が見つかった35歳男性の症例報告。良性の顆粒細胞腫瘍と転移性胚細胞腫瘍の両方が確認された。鑑別診断と精巣がんとの関連を論じ、文献をレビューしている。
pmid-10982303.summary_en: This case report describes a pulmonary granular cell tumor found in a 35-year-old man who had undergone pulmonary resection for metastatic testicular mixed germ cell tumor. Frozen section and histology showed a benign, predominantly hilar granular cell tumor along with metastatic germ cell tumor. The unusual location, lack of an endobronchial component, and extension into hilar lymph nodes are highlighted. The authors discuss the differential diagnosis and the association with metastatic testicular cancer, and review the literature on pulmonary granular cell tumors.

pmid-10987258.summary_ja: 肺癌90例で栄養膜ホルモンの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。遊離hCGαが23%で検出され、主に神経内分泌腫瘍で高分化型ほど陽性率が高かった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍との比較を行い、hCGαが肺腫瘍の神経内分泌分化の指標として有用であると結論づけた。
pmid-10987258.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined trophoblastic and other hormones in 90 primary lung carcinomas. Free hCG-alpha was found in 23% of tumors, mostly neuroendocrine tumors, and its expression increased with more differentiated tumor grade. Intact hCG heterodimer was not detected. The authors contrast this with trophoblastic malignancies and testicular germ cell tumors, and conclude that free hCG-alpha is a useful marker of neuroendocrine differentiation in lung tumors, not hCG-beta. Germ cell tumors serve only as comparators.

pmid-10999709.summary_ja: 胎児手術で仙尾部奇形腫を切除し輸血を行った23週の胎児が徐脈となった症例報告である。胸骨圧迫と薬剤投与を3回行った後、心機能が回復した。著者らはこの経験をもとに胎児手術時の蘇生プロトコルを作成した。奇形腫は症例の背景であり、主題は腫瘍学ではなく蘇生法である。
pmid-10999709.summary_en: This case report describes successful resuscitation of a 23-week fetus during in utero surgery. The fetus underwent resection of a sacrococcygeal teratoma and packed red cell transfusion, then developed bradycardia. Chest compressions, epinephrine, atropine, and sodium bicarbonate were given while the fetus was kept in warm saline. After three rounds of medication, cardiac function returned to normal. The authors used this experience to develop a fetal surgery resuscitation protocol. The teratoma provides clinical context, while the focus is resuscitation.

pmid-11010814.summary_ja: 本研究では、マウス胎児性癌細胞F9のレチノイン酸による分化過程で、5種類の14-3-3タンパク質アイソフォームの発現が誘導されることを示した。これらはRaf-1との相互作用を介してMAPKシグナルを増強する。ドミナントネガティブMEK1によりMAPK活性を抑制すると、サイトケラチンEndoAおよびEndoCの誘導が消失した。14-3-3は分化過程においてMAPK経路を介しサイトケラチン誘導を促すと示唆された。
pmid-11010814.summary_en: This study shows that five 14-3-3 protein isoforms are induced during retinoic acid-driven differentiation of mouse embryonal carcinoma F9 cells. In yeast, these isoforms enhanced MAPK signaling mainly through interaction with Raf-1. Blocking MAPK activity with dominant-negative MEK1 abolished retinoic acid-induced expression of the cytokeratins EndoA and EndoC in F9 cells, indicating that 14-3-3 proteins promote cytokeratin induction through MAPK signaling during differentiation.

pmid-11030333.summary_ja: 胎児性癌（EC）細胞に特異的に存在する安定なTBP-TFIIA複合体TACを報告した。TACは未処理のTFIIAαβ前駆体とTFIIAγを含み、古典的TAFを欠くがRNAポリメラーゼIIによる転写を活性化する。EC細胞ではTFIIAと結合したTBPのクロマチン結合が増強される。臨床的腫瘍研究ではなく基礎転写生物学が主題である。
pmid-11030333.summary_en: This paper characterizes TAC, a stable TBP-TFIIA complex found in embryonal carcinoma cells but not in differentiated cells. TAC contains the unprocessed TFIIAαβ precursor and TFIIAγ, lacks classical TAFs, yet activates RNA polymerase II transcription in vivo. In EC cells, TBP association with chromatin is enhanced when complexed with TFIIA, and the precursor preferentially binds chromatin. The work concerns basic transcription biology, with EC cells as the model rather than a clinical tumour focus.

pmid-11061023.summary_ja: 心疾患のある57歳女性が、下痢と起座呼吸から右心不全に至った。尿中5-HIAAの上昇とオクトレオチドスキャンの異常集積から、カルチノイド症候群が疑われた。開腹手術で左卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫と右卵巣カルチノイドが見つかった。卵巣摘出後、症状は2週間以内に消失し、手術による根治が示された。
pmid-11061023.summary_en: A 57-year-old woman with cardiac disease presented with diarrhea and orthopnea leading to right heart failure. Workup showed elevated urinary 5-HIAA and an abnormal octreotide scan. Laparotomy revealed a benign left cystic teratoma and a right ovarian carcinoid. Oophorectomy resolved the symptoms, showing that surgery cured the carcinoid syndrome without metastases.

pmid-11063125.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1を用いて、レチノイン酸による神経分化誘導の機序を検討した基礎研究である。レチノイン酸はp27のタンパク質分解を抑制して発現を高め、cyclin E/CDK2活性を抑制した。p27を抑制した細胞では神経突起形成などの分化が障害され、p27が増殖停止と神経分化に必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-11063125.summary_en: This laboratory study used the embryonal carcinoma cell line NT2/D1 to examine how retinoic acid induces neuronal differentiation. Retinoic acid increased p27 expression by reducing its proteasome-dependent degradation, which suppressed cyclin E/CDK2 activity. Antisense clones with reduced p27 induction continued to synthesize DNA and failed to differentiate properly, including lacking neurite outgrowth and surface antigen changes. The authors conclude that p27 is required for growth arrest and neuronal differentiation in embryonal carcinoma cells. The study is mechanistic cell biology rather than clinical tumor management.

pmid-11064936.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JARを用いて、抗腫瘍活性を持つトリコサンチン(TCS)の作用機序を検討したin vitro研究である。TCSは細胞内カルシウム依存的に活性酸素種(ROS)を急速に産生し、ROSがアポトーシスに関与していた。抗酸化剤α-トコフェロールで細胞死が抑制された。臨床データは含まれず、抗腫瘍・抗HIV作用の機序理解への示唆にとどまる。
pmid-11064936.summary_en: This in vitro study examined how the ribosome-inactivating protein trichosanthin (TCS) affects human choriocarcinoma JAR cells. TCS rapidly induced reactive oxygen species generation in a calcium-dependent manner, reduced by extracellular calcium removal and BAPTA-AM. ROS production paralleled increased intracellular calcium and was linked to nuclear changes and apoptosis. The antioxidant alpha-tocopherol prevented ROS formation and cell death, supporting a role for ROS in TCS-induced apoptosis. The findings offer insight into TCS's antitumor and anti-HIV mechanisms, though no clinical data are presented.

pmid-11067815.summary_ja: 尿中hCGβコア断片(hCGbetacf)の糖鎖型を、MALDI-TOF質量分析で解析した生化学研究。妊娠尿由来の試料で従来より広い糖鎖型のセットが確認され、高分子量の過剰糖鎖化型も認められた。過剰糖鎖化は絨毛癌やダウン症候群の指標となりうるが、本研究は主に分析手法と糖鎖構造に関するものである。
pmid-11067815.summary_en: This study characterized glycoforms of the urinary human chorionic gonadotropin beta-core fragment (hCGbetacf) using MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry. Purified from pregnancy urine, hCGbetacf showed a broader set of glycoforms than previously reported, including hyperglycosylated forms with higher mass. The authors note that hyperglycosylated hCGbetacf may indicate choriocarcinoma or Down syndrome, providing biochemical background for hCG-based markers. The work is primarily analytical, and choriocarcinoma is mentioned as motivation rather than studied directly.

pmid-11085543.summary_ja: 野生型p53を持つヒトTera-2細胞とマウスF9細胞（奇形癌細胞株）を用い、UVとγ線でアポトーシスが異なる機序を検討した研究。UVはMDM2の転写を特異的に抑制し、p53の蓄積と細胞死を引き起こした。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍を扱う研究ではなく、細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-11085543.summary_en: This study examined why UV but not gamma irradiation triggers apoptosis in teratocarcinoma cells with wild-type p53, including human Tera-2 and murine F9 lines. UV caused rapid cell death and sustained p53 accumulation. This resulted from UV-specific repression of MDM2 transcription, independent of p53, while p21 and other genes were unaffected. A region of the MDM2 promoter outside the p53 binding site mediated the repression. The paper focuses on p53-MDM2 signaling rather than clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-11105700.summary_ja: 脂肪成分を含む胃腫瘍のCT画像所見を総説的にまとめた論文です。脂肪腫、血管脂肪腫、脂肪肉腫、奇形腫が取り上げられ、鑑別診断も議論されています。胃原発の奇形腫は対象の一つですが、主題は胃の脂肪性腫瘍全般であり、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の包括的な議論ではありません。
pmid-11105700.summary_en: This review describes CT imaging features of fat-containing gastric tumors, including lipoma, angiolipoma, liposarcoma, and teratoma. It also discusses differential diagnoses such as primary and reactive lipomatosis, carcinoma engulfing perivisceral fat, and other mesenchymal and peritoneal neoplasms. Gastric teratoma is one of four described entities, so the paper touches on a teratoma arising outside the gonads. The main focus, however, is gastric lipomatous lesions in general rather than germ cell tumors.

pmid-11113929.summary_ja: 本研究は、抗PLAP抗体による免疫ビーズ分離とHPLCを組み合わせ、混合タンパク質から個別のタンパク質を単離する手法を検討したものです。精製PLAPは酵素活性を保持し、解離試薬ではジエチルアミンが最適でした。精巣悪性腫瘍が疑われ超音波検査所見が不明瞭な症例での腫瘍マーカー応用が提案されていますが、臨床的検証は示されていません。
pmid-11113929.summary_en: This methodological study combines HPLC with immuno-bead separation using an anti-PLAP monoclonal antibody to isolate individual proteins from complex mixtures. HPLC-purified PLAP retained phosphatase activity, and diethylamine was the most effective dissociation reagent. Alkaline phosphatase profiles differed between testis and kidney tissue fragments. The authors propose the approach for identifying PLAP as a tumor marker in patients with suspected testicular malignancy and equivocal ultrasound findings. Clinical validation is not presented.

pmid-11144795.summary_ja: ファントムを用いてヘリカルCTによる体積計測の精度を検証し、一次元、二次元、三次元の腫瘍径計測による治療反応判定を比較した。胚細胞腫瘍またはリンパ腫で化学療法を受けた16例の20個のリンパ節腫瘤を、WHO基準とRECIST基準で評価した。体積計測は大きな構造物で正確かつ再現性が高く、計測法による判定の差は小さかった。ただし臨床判断や予後への影響は未解明である。
pmid-11144795.summary_en: This study validated helical CT volumetry using phantoms and compared treatment response classification based on one-dimensional, two-dimensional, and three-dimensional tumour measurements. Twenty lymph node masses in 16 patients treated with chemotherapy for germ cell cancer or lymphoma were assessed using WHO and RECIST criteria. CT volume measurements were accurate and reproducible for larger structures. Response classification was largely unchanged across measurement methods, although its effect on clinical decisions and outcome remains unclear.

pmid-11191646.summary_ja: 奇形癌由来のマウス胎児性癌細胞株PCC-3を、IGF-I発現モデルとして遺伝子治療の検討に用いた基礎研究である。IGF-I産生を抑制する三重らせん形成オリゴリボヌクレオチドを導入すると、表現型が変化し、MHC-IおよびB7の発現増加とアポトーシス（60〜70%）が生じた。これらの細胞は同系マウスでの腫瘍形成能を失った。
pmid-11191646.summary_en: This basic study used PCC-3 murine embryonal carcinoma cells, derived from teratocarcinoma and expressing IGF-I, as a model for gene therapy. Cells transfected with a triple-helix oligoribonucleotide that suppresses IGF-I production showed an altered phenotype, increased MHC-I and B7 expression, and 60-70% apoptosis. These cells lost tumorigenicity in syngeneic mice. Co-transfection with antisense MHC-I and B7 restored tumor induction, indicating the mechanism depends on these immune molecules. The authors suggest triple-helix technology may offer a new approach to treating IGF-I-expressing tumors.

pmid-11195005.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍などの患者で末梢血幹細胞動員に失敗した場合、二次的な骨髄採取を行い大量化学療法を可能にできるかを検討した。好中球の回復は対照と同等だったが、血小板の回復は有意に遅かった。支持療法の必要性は両群で差がなかった。胚細胞腫瘍は複数疾患の一つとして扱われている。
pmid-11195005.summary_en: Patients with germ cell tumor, lymphoma, sarcoma or medulloblastoma who failed peripheral blood stem cell mobilization underwent second-line bone marrow harvest before high-dose chemotherapy. Among 13 poor mobilizers, marrow harvest yielded autografts, and neutrophil recovery matched historical controls, though platelet recovery was significantly slower. Supportive care needs were similar. The authors conclude that second-line bone marrow harvest can preserve the option of high-dose chemotherapy for these patients.

pmid-11210826.summary_ja: マウス未分化胎児性癌細胞株を用い、カフェインがX線とUV照射後のp53依存的な放射線応答を修飾することを示した基礎研究である。作用はX線とUVで逆方向であった。臨床の胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした研究ではない。
pmid-11210826.summary_en: This radiobiology study uses undifferentiated mouse embryonal carcinoma (EC) cell lines, with and without functional p53, to examine how caffeine modifies responses to X-rays and UV light. Caffeine suppressed X-ray-induced p53 activation and G2/M arrest but enhanced UV-induced p53 activation and DNA fragmentation. Radioresponses of undifferentiated EC cells differed from those of somatic cells. The work is a basic mechanistic study with mouse cell lines rather than clinical germ cell tumor patients.

pmid-10022451.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト精巣の各年齢層と、上皮内癌(CIS)、胚細胞腫瘍、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍、停留精巣などの精巣疾患について、オンコスタチンM(OSM)の免疫組織化学染色を検討したものです。OSMはセルトリ細胞では胎児期のみ陽性で、ライディッヒ細胞では多くの年齢で強く染色されました。精巣腫瘍では、ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍やCISなどで陽性を示す一方、管内セミノーマでは陰性でした。
pmid-10022451.summary_en: This study immunohistochemically examined oncostatin M (OSM) expression in normal human testes across ages and in testicular disorders including carcinoma-in-situ, germ cell tumors, Leydig cell tumors, and cryptorchidism. OSM was seen in Sertoli cells only in fetuses, while Leydig cell staining was intense in fetal, newborn, and adult testes. Leydig cell staining persisted in Leydig cell tumors, cryptorchidism, and CIS but was absent in Klinefelter syndrome and intratubular seminoma. Findings suggest OSM in Leydig cells marks functionally active, differentiated cells.
