pmid-10029457.summary_ja: 手術で腫瘍を摘出後に重度の便秘が改善した、原発性卵巣strumal carcinoid(甲状腺組織を含む卵巣腫瘍)の症例報告です。腫瘍細胞の多くがペプチドYY(PYY)に強陽性を示し、完全長PYY mRNAが正常大腸粘膜と同様に発現していました。卵巣腫瘍によるPYY産生が便秘の原因と考えられています。卵巣奇形腫に関連する腫瘍であり、胚細胞腫瘍のスペクトラムに含まれます。
pmid-10029457.summary_en: This case report describes a primary ovarian strumal carcinoid in a patient whose severe constipation resolved after surgical removal of the tumor. Immunohistochemistry showed strong peptide YY (PYY) expression in many tumor cells, and Northern blot and RT-PCR confirmed complete PYY mRNA comparable to normal colon. The authors propose that PYY production by the ovarian tumor causes the constipation. Strumal carcinoid is a struma ovarii-type tumor related to ovarian teratoma, linking this report to the germ cell tumor spectrum.

pmid-10037435.summary_ja: SCIDマウスの皮下異種移植片を精巣内へ移植し、セミノーマのオルソトピック異種移植モデルを作成した研究です。マウスの47%で腎門部リンパ節への転移が生じ、血液・肺・肝での腫瘍細胞散布もPCRで検出されました。精巣内移植片では皮下移植片に比べてMMP-2、MT3-MMP、VEGFが増加し、PAI-2が低下していました。このモデルはセミノーマのリンパ行性転移の機序解明に役立つと考えられます。
pmid-10037435.summary_en: The authors developed an orthotopic human seminoma xenograft model in SCID mice by implanting fragments of a subcutaneous xenograft into the testis. Regional renal hilar lymph node metastasis occurred in 47% of mice, and tumor cells were detected by PCR in blood, lung, and liver. Testicular xenografts showed increased MMP-2, MT3-MMP, and VEGF and decreased PAI-2 expression compared with subcutaneous xenografts. The model recapitulates seminoma's lymphophilic behavior and may help elucidate mechanisms of lymphatic tumor spread.

pmid-10037628.summary_ja: デンマークの集団ベース症例対照研究で、精巣がん患者514人と対照720人を比較し、男性の不妊と精巣がんリスクの関連を調べました。父親であることはリスク低下(相対危険度0.63)と関連し、年齢に比べて子どもが少ない男性ではリスクが上昇(1.98)しました。セミノーマと非セミノーマで関連は類似し、交絡因子の調整後も変わりませんでした。著者らは、男性不妊と精巣がんが病因を共有する可能性を結論づけています。
pmid-10037628.summary_en: This Danish population-based case-control study of 514 testicular cancer cases and 720 controls examined whether male subfertility relates to testicular cancer risk. Fatherhood was associated with reduced risk (RR 0.63), while men with fewer children than expected for their age had elevated risk (RR 1.98). Associations were similar for seminoma and non-seminoma and unaffected by confounder adjustment. The authors conclude that male subfertility and testicular cancer likely share important etiologic factors.

pmid-10050882.summary_ja: 通常はBcl-2をほとんど発現しない精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株833Kに、Bcl-2を異所性に発現させた研究です。意外にも、Bcl-2過剰発現細胞は化学療法によるアポトーシスに対して感受性が高まり、Bcl-X(L)が相反的に減少していました。Bcl-X(L)をアンチセンスで抑制するとエトポシドによるアポトーシスが2倍に増強されました。Bcl-2とBcl-X(L)は化学療法に対する防御能が異なると結論づけられました。
pmid-10050882.summary_en: Bcl-2 was ectopically expressed in the 833K testicular germ cell tumour cell line, which normally has low Bcl-2. Surprisingly, Bcl-2 overexpression sensitized cells to chemotherapy-induced apoptosis, accompanied by reciprocal downregulation of Bcl-X(L). Antisense knockdown of Bcl-X(L) doubled etoposide-induced apoptosis. Bcl-2 and Bcl-X(L) therefore differ in protecting testicular germ cell tumour cells from chemotherapy, and Bcl-2 did not prevent p53 nuclear entry.

pmid-10053117.summary_ja: 著者らは、病期Iaの卵巣類内膜様卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告する。当初は悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と誤診され、手術のみで治療された。12年後、対側の類皮嚢腫を切除した際に、腫瘍の小さな大網結節が見つかった。血清AFPは正常を保ち、第2次手術後にBEP化学療法3コースが行われた。一部の類内膜様卵黄嚢腫瘍は緩徐に進行しうることが示唆され、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍では慎重な外科的病期分類と長期フォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-10053117.summary_en: The authors describe a stage Ia endometrioid-like yolk sac tumor of the ovary that was initially misdiagnosed as malignant struma ovarii and treated with surgery alone. Twelve years later, after a contralateral dermoid cyst was excised, a small omental nodule of the tumor was found. Serum AFP remained normal, and the patient received three cycles of BEP chemotherapy after second-look surgery. The case suggests that some endometrioid-like yolk sac tumors may behave indolently, and it emphasizes careful surgical staging and long-term follow-up for ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-10063719.summary_ja: 1981年から1996年に治療された小児精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍15例の後方視的検討です。全例で根治的鼠径精巣摘除術が行われ、病期Iの多くは術後にAFPが正常化すれば追加治療が不要でした。再発した2例はシスプラチン併用化学療法で治癒しています。無病生存は93.3%でした。
pmid-10063719.summary_en: This retrospective review describes 15 children with testicular yolk sac tumor treated between 1981 and 1996. All underwent radical inguinal orchiectomy, and most patients with stage I disease needed no further treatment once serum AFP normalized. Two patients who relapsed, identified by rising AFP, responded to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Overall, 93.3% remained disease-free, and one stage III patient died. The authors conclude that pediatric testicular yolk sac tumors have a favorable prognosis and that AFP is valuable for monitoring treatment response.

pmid-10063723.summary_ja: 腹部停留精巣に発生した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例です。32歳男性で、呼吸困難と大きな腹部腫瘤を認め、AFPとβ-hCGが上昇していました。シスプラチン併用化学療法3コース後に腫瘍を切除し、組織学的に生存腫瘍は認められませんでした。術後7か月間無病で経過しています。
pmid-10063723.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with abdominal cryptorchidism presented with dyspnea, weight loss, and a large abdominal mass with massive left pleural effusion. Imaging showed an 18 cm heterogeneous tumor and an enlarged retroperitoneal lymph node. Elevated AFP and beta-hCG supported a diagnosis of metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. After three cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy and surgical resection, histology showed extensive necrosis without viable cancer. The patient remained disease-free for seven months after surgery.

pmid-10063793.summary_ja: 1973年から1996年に治療された停留精巣の胚細胞腫瘍11例を後方視的に検討したものです。鼠径部の3例と腹部の8例中6例はセミノーマでした。放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法、手術を組み合わせて治療され、全生存期間(全生存率)は81.8%でした。集学的治療により効果的に管理できることを示唆しています。
pmid-10063793.summary_en: This retrospective review of 11 patients with germ cell tumors arising in cryptorchid testes, treated between 1973 and 1996, found that all three inguinal tumors and six of eight abdominal tumors were seminomas. The remaining two abdominal tumors were nonseminomatous. Treatment combined radiotherapy, cisplatin-based chemotherapy, and surgery. The overall survival rate was 81.8%, and two patients with stage III disease died during treatment. The findings suggest that cryptorchid germ cell tumors can be managed effectively with a multidisciplinary approach.

pmid-10068202.summary_ja: 正常胎盤と胞状奇胎などの妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるP2Y6受容体mRNAの発現を、ノーザンブロットとin situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した。発現は細胞性栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞に強く、胞状奇胎の絨毛栄養膜にも認められた。絨毛癌と絨毛癌細胞株では発現が見られず、栄養膜の分化や腫瘍化への関与が示唆された。
pmid-10068202.summary_en: This study examined P2Y6 nucleotide receptor expression in first-trimester and term placentas and in gestational trophoblastic disease using Northern blot and in situ hybridization. P2Y6 mRNA was highest in cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast and absent from intermediate trophoblast. Molar villous trophoblast expressed P2Y6, but the proliferative intermediate trophoblast did not. Choriocarcinoma and the cell lines JEG-3 and JAr did not express P2Y6. The authors suggest P2Y6 may contribute to trophoblastic development, differentiation, and neoplasia.

pmid-10071229.summary_ja: 本研究では、腫瘍性胚細胞を含むセルトリ細胞結節を有する精巣病変に加え、新生児女児2例を含む性腺芽細胞腫8例におけるHERV-K gagの発現を検討した。性腺芽細胞腫のすべての生殖細胞と、セルトリ細胞結節の腫瘍性胚細胞にHERV-K転写産物が認められた。奇形腫を除くすべての浸潤性GCTもHERV-Kを発現していた。胎児期のHERV-K誘導は浸潤性GCT形成に先行し、GCTの発生に関与している可能性があり、精巣の上皮内癌に類似した前駆病変から浸潤性腫瘍への関係を支持する。
pmid-10071229.summary_en: This study examined human endogenous retrovirus K (HERV-K) gag expression in eight gonadoblastomas, including two from newborn girls, and in testicular immature Sertoli cell nodules containing neoplastic germ cells. HERV-K transcripts were present in gonocytes of all gonadoblastomas and in neoplastic germ cells of the Sertoli cell nodules. All invasive GCTs except teratomas also expressed HERV-K. The findings suggest HERV-K induction during fetal development precedes invasive GCT formation and may contribute to GCT pathogenesis, supporting a precursor-invasive relationship analogous to testicular carcinoma in situ.

pmid-10073567.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する自家幹細胞支援付き大量化学療法を、再発の回数に応じた救援療法と初回療法に分類して批判的に検討した。早期施行の方が長期寛解率が高く、性腺外GCTでは効果が乏しい一方、シスプラチン抵抗性が絶対的でない精巣GCTには有用な可能性がある。唯一の第III相試験では生存上の利益は示されず、進行中の2試験の結果が待たれる。
pmid-10073567.summary_en: This critical review categorizes high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell support (HDC/ASCS) trials in germ cell tumors into salvage therapy for second or greater relapse, salvage therapy for first relapse, and first-line therapy. Earlier use achieved durable remission in about 50% of patients versus about 15% with later salvage. HDC/ASCS was not beneficial for relapsed or cisplatin-resistant primary extragonadal GCT but may help testicular GCT that is not absolutely cisplatin-resistant. The only phase III trial showed no survival advantage, though it had methodological problems. Two ongoing phase III trials will clarify its role.

pmid-10074455.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株がシスプラチンに高感受性を示す理由を検討した研究である。833KおよびGCT27細胞株では、ヌクレオチド除去修復能が低下しており、XPAとERCC1-XPFの発現が低かった。XPAを添加すると修復能が完全に回復し、シスプラチン付加体の除去能低下の主因がXPA不足であることが示された。
pmid-10074455.summary_en: This study investigated why testicular germ cell tumour cell lines are highly sensitive to cisplatin. Nucleotide excision repair capacity was reduced in extracts from the 833K and GCT27 cell lines. Immunoblotting showed low levels of XPA and the ERCC1-XPF complex, while most other repair proteins were normal. Adding XPA restored full repair activity, indicating that low XPA levels explain the poor removal of cisplatin adducts. The authors suggest that targeted XPA inhibition might sensitise other tumours to cisplatin.

pmid-10078744.summary_ja: 精巣がんに伴う傍腫瘍性脳幹脳炎により、核上性注視障害を呈した2例を報告している。1例では辺縁系脳炎と視床下部の造影病変を認めた。両例とも、精巣がんに関連する既報の抗体が検出された。神経眼科症状が潜在性精巣腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示している。
pmid-10078744.summary_en: The authors describe two men with testicular cancer who developed supranuclear gaze disorders due to a paraneoplastic brainstem encephalomyelitis. One patient also had prominent limbic encephalitis and an enhancing hypothalamic mass on imaging. The other had an unusual mixed pendular and jerk nystagmus with negative imaging. Both patients had an antibody previously reported in limbic encephalitis associated with testicular cancer. The report highlights that neuro-ophthalmic signs may be the first manifestation of an occult testicular tumour.

pmid-10079257.summary_ja: 本研究では、胚細胞核抗原を認識するモノクローナル抗体Ki-A10を、173例の胚細胞腫瘍と18例の性索間質性腫瘍で検討した。古典的セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマ、精母細胞性セミノーマ、性索腫瘍の胚細胞成分で強陽性を示した。卵黄嚢腫瘍は不均一な反応を示し、絨毛癌8例中3例では細胞栄養芽細胞の集団が標識された。Ki-A10は精母細胞性セミノーマを一貫して標識し、その胚細胞由来を支持した。著者らは本抗体が診断に有用である可能性を提案している。
pmid-10079257.summary_en: The study examined the monoclonal antibody Ki-A10, which recognises a germ cell nuclear antigen, in 173 germ cell tumours and 18 sex cord stromal tumours. Strong staining occurred in classic seminomas, dysgerminomas, spermatocytic seminomas and the germ cell component of gonadoblastomas. Yolk sac tumours showed heterogeneous reactivity, and three of eight choriocarcinomas had labelled cytotrophoblast clusters. Ki-A10 consistently labelled spermatocytic seminoma, supporting its germ cell origin. The authors propose the antibody as a diagnostic tool.

pmid-10080078.summary_ja: 過去20年間における妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断、管理、予後の進歩をまとめた総説である。低リスク例にはメトトレキサートとフォリン酸、高リスク例にはEMACO療法を用いる。再発例や難治例には外科的切除やシスプラチンを含むEP/EMA療法が用いられる。
pmid-10080078.summary_en: This review summarises advances in gestational trophoblastic disease over the past two decades. It covers improvements in diagnosis, management and prognosis. Patients should be registered at a trophoblastic disease centre for follow-up. Persistent low-risk disease is treated with methotrexate and folinic acid, while high-risk disease receives EMACO chemotherapy, preserving fertility. Relapsing or resistant disease may respond to surgery or to cisplatin-containing EP/EMA regimens.

pmid-10080592.summary_ja: 多剤前治療を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、ゲムシタビン単剤の第II相試験を実施した。20例中3例（15%）で奏効を認め、うち1例は完全寛解であった。非血液毒性は軽度であった。前治療の多い集団に対して一定の活性が認められた。
pmid-10080592.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated single-agent gemcitabine in heavily pretreated patients with germ cell tumours. Twenty evaluable patients received 1,200 mg/m2 on days 1, 8 and 15 every four weeks. Thirteen were platinum refractory, and five had extragonadal primaries. Three patients (15%) achieved an objective response, including one complete remission. Toxicity was mild, with only one grade 3 or 4 nonhematologic event. The authors conclude that gemcitabine has definite activity in this heavily pretreated population.

pmid-10080593.summary_ja: 本第II相試験は、再発またはシスプラチン抵抗性の転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者31例を対象にゲムシタビンを評価した。6例(19%)が奏効し、14例(45%)が病勢進行した。治療不成功までの期間の中央値は4か月、生存期間の中央値は6か月であった。グレード3/4の血液毒性が多くみられ、32%の患者で減量が必要であった。縦隔腫瘍を有する4例中1例を含め、約20%の患者で奏効が認められた。著者らは、ゲムシタビンが緩和的な選択肢となりうると示唆している。
pmid-10080593.summary_en: This phase II study assessed gemcitabine in 31 assessable patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours that were relapsed or cisplatin refractory. Six patients (19%) responded, and 14 (45%) progressed. The median time to treatment failure was four months and median survival was six months. Grade 3 or 4 haematologic toxicity was common, and 32% required dose reductions. Responses occurred in about 20% of patients, including one of four with mediastinal tumours. The authors suggest gemcitabine may be a palliative option.

pmid-10081858.summary_ja: 高リスク臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍60例に対し、精巣摘除術後に補助化学療法を2サイクル実施した前向き研究である。中央値93か月の追跡で、再発は2例のみであった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替として補助化学療法を推奨している。
pmid-10081858.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy after orchiectomy in 60 patients with high-risk clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours. Median follow-up was 93 months. Grade 4 toxicity occurred in nine of 116 cycles, without significant long-term sequelae. One patient relapsed with an adult teratoma near the iliac vessels, and another developed a contralateral seminoma. The remaining 56 patients were relapse-free. The authors recommend adjuvant chemotherapy as an alternative to retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy.

pmid-10084651.summary_ja: 25年間の原発性縦隔腫瘍124例を後方視的に検討し、集学的治療の役割を評価した研究。胸腺腫が最多で、次いで胚細胞腫瘍(23%)が多かった。診断時に遠隔転移を有する例は11%であった。初回に完全切除または奏効が得られた例の52%で再発がみられ、診断時の転移と再発が独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-10084651.summary_en: This retrospective review of 124 patients with primary mediastinal tumors over 25 years assessed multidisciplinary management. Thymoma was most common (31%), followed by germ cell tumors (23%), lymphoma, and neurogenic tumors. Most tumors were malignant, and 11% had distant metastases at diagnosis. Treatment included resection, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy, with recurrence in 52% of patients who initially responded. Metastatic disease at presentation and recurrence were independent predictors of poorer survival.

pmid-10086264.summary_ja: 61歳女性の右腎上極近傍に生じた後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告。副腎腫瘍に類似した画像所見を呈した。CTでは石灰化を伴う境界明瞭な脂肪濃度腫瘤、MRIでは高信号が認められた。針生検では組織が得られず、術前診断は後腹膜奇形腫または副腎骨髄脂肪腫であった。切除により良性の後腹膜嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-10086264.summary_en: This case report describes a 61-year-old woman with a retroperitoneal teratoma arising near the upper pole of the right kidney that mimicked an adrenal tumor. CT showed a well-marginated fat-density mass with calcification, and MRI showed high signal above the kidney. Needle biopsy failed to obtain tissue, so the preoperative diagnosis was retroperitoneal teratoma or adrenal myelolipoma. Surgical resection confirmed a benign retroperitoneal cystic teratoma. The case highlights diagnostic difficulty on imaging.

pmid-10086513.summary_ja: 3歳女児の心膜内に生じた潜在性の卵黄嚢腫瘍の剖検例。心基部を取り囲む5.5cmの腫瘤が左心房を圧迫していた。組織学的には純粋な卵黄嚢腫瘍であり、死後血中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は7000μg/Lを超えた。両心室の急性心筋炎も併存していた。
pmid-10086513.summary_en: This report describes an occult intrapericardial yolk sac tumor in a 3-year-old girl who died. At autopsy, a 5.5 cm mass surrounded the heart base and compressed the left atrium. Histology showed a pure yolk sac tumor, and postmortem blood alpha-fetoprotein exceeded 7000 µg/L. Acute myocarditis of both ventricles was also found. The case illustrates an extragonadal germ cell tumor presenting in the pericardial space with cardiac involvement.

pmid-10087421.summary_ja: 数種類の化学療法に抵抗性の転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)を有する36歳女性の症例報告。カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を施行した。効果は一時的にとどまり、原病により死亡した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の稀な型で予後不良であり、本治療の限界を示す。
pmid-10087421.summary_en: This report describes a 36-year-old woman with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor refractory to several chemotherapy regimens. She received high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. The response was only temporary, and she died of disease. The authors describe the failure of this approach in refractory metastatic PSTT, a rare form of gestational trophoblastic disease with a poor prognosis. It is a single-case report.

pmid-10091770.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍333例を後方視的に検討し、下大静脈閉塞は31例（9.3%）に認められた。下肢腫脹や腹壁静脈拡張が主症状で、約29%に血栓塞栓症が生じ、1例は致死的肺塞栓症であった。右側精巣原発と5cm超の腹部腫瘤が関連因子で、IVCOを認めた場合は予防的抗凝固療法が推奨される。
pmid-10091770.summary_en: This retrospective review of 333 men with metastatic germ cell tumor identified 31 patients (9.3%) with inferior vena cava obstruction. Leg swelling and dilated abdominal wall veins were common presenting features, and about 29% had thromboembolic complications, including one fatal pulmonary embolism. Right-sided testicular primaries and abdominal masses over 5 cm were associated with IVCO. The authors recommend careful radiologic evaluation in bulky disease and prophylactic anticoagulation when IVCO is identified.

pmid-10091779.summary_ja: 多施設後方視的研究で、悪性胚細胞腫瘍の脳転移139例を検討した。診断時に脳転移があった群の5年疾患特異的生存率は45%、化学療法後に出現した群では12%であり、孤立性脳再発では39%に上昇した。化学療法後の群では放射線療法が良好な予後因子であった。
pmid-10091779.summary_en: This multi-institutional retrospective study evaluated patients with brain metastases from malignant germ cell tumors, divided by whether metastases were present at diagnosis (56 patients) or appeared after cisplatin-based chemotherapy (83 patients). Five-year cause-specific survival was 45% in the first group and 12% in the second, rising to 39% with isolated brain recurrence. Neurosurgery and absence of extracerebral disease predicted better outcome, and radiotherapy was a key factor after chemotherapy.

pmid-10097554.summary_ja: 13歳女児が突然の胸部圧迫感を訴えて入院した。胸部X線とCTで縦隔奇形腫が疑われ、心臓カテーテル検査で軽度の肺動脈狭窄が認められた。腫瘍切除後に収縮期雑音は消失し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。縦隔成熟奇形腫による肺動脈狭窄のまれな症例報告である。
pmid-10097554.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with sudden chest tightness due to acquired pulmonary stenosis caused by a mediastinal mature teratoma. Imaging suggested a mediastinal teratoma, and catheterization confirmed mild pulmonary stenosis. After complete tumor resection, the systolic murmur disappeared, and histology showed a mature teratoma. The authors highlight this as a rare cardiac complication of mediastinal mature teratoma.

pmid-10097788.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3の培養上清が、リンパ球の免疫機能を抑制する機序を検討した。上清はIL-2産生、IL-2受容体α鎖、およびJak/Statシグナル分子の発現を抑制した。絨毛癌の増殖や胎児同種移植片の生存に関わる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10097788.summary_en: This study examines how supernatants from Jeg-3 human choriocarcinoma cells suppress immune function. Choriocarcinoma supernatant at 50% reduced IL-2 production and IL-2 receptor alpha-chain expression in peripheral blood lymphocytes and suppressed Jak1, Jak3, and Stat1/3/5 signaling. IFN-gamma production was variably affected. The authors suggest these effects may support choriocarcinoma growth and fetal allograft survival, linking tumor-secreted factors to immune evasion.

pmid-10188856.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍35例の解析で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍18例のうち14例が複数の悪性成分を含んでいた。2例の悪性奇形腫には、肉腫様および神経内分泌成分などの非胚細胞性の悪性成分が認められた。悪性例の多くは5年以内に死亡した。初回化学療法後の外科的切除が推奨される。
pmid-10188856.summary_en: This review of 35 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumours treated by primary thoracotomy over 30 years found that 14 of 18 non-seminomatous tumours contained more than one malignant component. Two malignant teratomas harboured additional non-germ cell malignancies, including sarcomatous and neuroendocrine components. Most patients with malignant tumours died within five years, while nearly all patients with seminoma survived. Surgical resection after initial chemotherapy is recommended.

pmid-10188902.summary_ja: 非胞状奇胎の正期産後に発症した絨毛癌の連続9例を報告する。全例が分娩後の持続性出血で受診し、メトトレキサート、ダクチノマイシン、エトポシドによる多剤併用化学療法で全例に奏効した。本疾患は適切な化学療法で治癒可能であるため、早期診断が重要である。
pmid-10188902.summary_en: This report describes nine consecutive patients with choriocarcinoma arising after a full-term non-molar pregnancy, all managed at a UK trophoblastic disease centre between 1987 and 1996. All presented with persistent primary or secondary postpartum haemorrhage. Multiagent chemotherapy with methotrexate, dactinomycin and etoposide was successful in every case. The authors emphasise that early diagnosis is important because this rare condition is potentially curable.

pmid-10189138.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍80例(セミノーマ33例、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍47例)を免疫組織化学染色で解析し、VEGF発現が正常精巣より高く、微小血管密度と相関することを示した。VEGF発現はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で転移と独立して関連しており、血管新生が転移進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10189138.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 80 testicular germ cell tumors (33 seminomas and 47 nonseminomatous tumors) examined VEGF, thymidine phosphorylase, and microvessel density. VEGF expression correlated with microvessel count and was higher in tumors than in normal testis. In both seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors, VEGF expression was independently associated with metastasis, suggesting that VEGF-driven angiogenesis contributes to tumor development and metastatic spread.

pmid-10189139.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に残存した20mm以下の後腹膜腫瘤について、切除と経過観察の生存を意思決定分析モデルで比較した。切除により余命は1〜2年以上延長すると推定され、5年生存率の改善は2.7〜4.3%とされた。利益は残存組織型の確率や手術合併症に左右されるため、個別の判断が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-10189139.summary_en: This decision analysis modeled survival with resection versus observation for small residual retroperitoneal masses (0-20 mm) after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer. Using an international cohort of 362 patients and expert estimates, resection was projected to extend life expectancy by more than one to two years, with 5-year survival gains of 2.7% to 4.3%. The benefit depends on residual histology probabilities and surgical morbidity, so individualized decision-making is advised.

pmid-10189147.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍11例(卵巣5例、精巣2例、性腺外4例)について、H19とIGF2のインプリンティング消失を解析した。精巣腫瘍2例はいずれも両遺伝子で消失を示し、卵巣と性腺外の腫瘍では消失パターンがさまざまであった。部位によって発がんの時期が異なる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10189147.summary_en: This study examined loss of imprinting at H19 and IGF2 in 11 fully informative pediatric germ cell tumors, including ovarian, testicular, and extragonadal tumors. Both testicular tumors showed loss of imprinting at both genes, while ovarian and extragonadal tumors showed variable patterns. The findings suggest that imprinting alterations may be common in pediatric testicular GCTs and that the timing of carcinogenesis may differ by primary site.

pmid-10189480.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者21例のFDG PETを解析し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤の鑑別と治療評価の有用性を検討した。活性腫瘍は強い集積を示し、成熟奇形腫や壊死・瘢痕と視覚的に区別できた。成熟奇形腫と壊死・瘢痕はSUVでは区別できなかったが、動態解析の定数K1とKで有意差があり、治療後管理への応用が期待される。
pmid-10189480.summary_en: This study evaluated FDG PET with kinetic modeling in 21 patients with germ cell tumor to monitor treatment and distinguish residual masses after chemotherapy. Viable tumors showed intense uptake and were visually distinguishable from mature teratoma and necrosis or scar. Mature teratoma and necrosis could not be separated by standardized uptake value alone, but kinetic constants K1 and K differed significantly. The authors conclude that PET with kinetic analysis is promising for post-treatment disease management.

pmid-10191775.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍142例を検討し、23例に精巣外進展を認めた。そのうち21例は精巣門部で生じていた。肉眼所見で指摘できたのは44%のみであり、肉眼では気づかれないことが多い。すべての症例で精巣門部の組織学的検索を行うべきと提言している。
pmid-10191775.summary_en: This pathology review of 142 primary testicular germ cell tumors found extratesticular extension in 23 cases, and 21 of these occurred at the hilum. Gross examination identified extension in only 44% of the cases where it was present, indicating that it is often grossly inapparent. The authors recommend histologic examination of the hilum in all testicular germ cell tumor cases.

pmid-10194591.summary_ja: 毛細血管拡張性運動失調症(AT)を合併した27歳男性に精巣セミノーマが発症した症例報告。ATで悪性腫瘍が報告された初の記載である。AT自体で血清AFPが上昇しうるため、AFPは本症例では腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性が限られると指摘されている。
pmid-10194591.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with ataxia-telangiectasia (AT), a syndrome associated with a markedly increased risk of malignancy, who developed a testicular seminoma. The authors note this is the first documented description of such a tumor in AT. They also highlight that alpha-fetoprotein, normally a useful tumor marker, has limited value in this setting because AT itself can raise serum levels, which complicates monitoring.

pmid-10194641.summary_ja: 3歳のウサギの両側精巣に、間質細胞腫瘍とセミノーマ様の胚細胞腫瘍が同時に認められた症例報告。セミノーマ様腫瘍に先行する上皮内癌の所見はウサギで初めて報告された。著者らは、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の研究に有用な動物モデルになりうると述べている。
pmid-10194641.summary_en: This report describes an interstitial cell tumour and a seminoma-like germ cell tumour with carcinoma in situ in the testes of a 3-year-old Dutch-Belted rabbit. The carcinoma in situ preceded the seminoma-like tumour, a feature not previously reported in rabbits. The authors suggest that the rabbit may serve as a practically useful animal model for studying testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-10195743.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NCR-G3を用い、M-CSFとその受容体fmsが栄養外胚葉分化およびhCG産生に果たす役割を検討した研究。レチノイン酸処理後、hCG産生に先立ちM-CSFの発現が増加した。中和抗体はhCG産生を強く抑制し、fmsの過剰発現は産生を増加させた。
pmid-10195743.summary_en: Using the human embryonal carcinoma cell line NCR-G3, this study examines how macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) and its receptor fms contribute to differentiation into trophoectoderm, which produces hCG. M-CSF expression rises before hCG production after retinoic acid treatment. Neutralizing antibodies strongly suppressed hCG output, while fms over-expression increased it. The authors conclude these molecules are functionally important in differentiation and propose the line as a model of early embryogenesis and placental differentiation.

pmid-10197862.summary_ja: 本研究では、病期I・IIの精巣胚細胞腫瘍37例（非セミノーマ24例、セミノーマ13例）の初回病期分類について、フルオロデオキシグルコースPETとCTを比較した。PETは34例を正しく病期分類し、CTの29例を上回った。PETは転移病変をより多く検出（10か所中7か所、CTは4か所）し、偽陽性はなかった。一方、0.5 cm未満の生存腫瘍や奇形腫は検出できなかった。著者らは、臨床病期Iの病期分類はPETによって改善されなかったと結論づけている。
pmid-10197862.summary_en: This study compared fluorodeoxyglucose PET with CT for initial staging in 37 patients with clinical Stage I or II testicular germ cell tumors, including 24 nonseminomas and 13 seminomas. PET correctly staged 34 patients versus 29 with CT and detected more metastatic lesions (7 versus 4 of 10) without false positives. However, PET could not detect viable tumor under 0.5 cm or mature teratoma. PET did not improve staging for clinical Stage I disease.

pmid-10197872.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍32例を対象に、MAGE-1～4遺伝子のmRNA発現をRT-PCRで解析した研究。セミノーマ成分を含む腫瘍では68～82%に発現したが、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では20～50%にとどまった。発現は病勢進行と相関せず、セミノーマは正常精巣に近い性質をもつと考察されている。
pmid-10197872.summary_en: This study measured mRNA expression of MAGE-1, -2, -3 and -4 genes by RT-PCR in 32 testicular germ cell tumor specimens. MAGE genes were detected in 68 to 82 percent of seminoma or mixed tumors with seminomatous elements, but in only 20 to 50 percent of nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Expression of MAGE-1, -3 and -4 was significantly higher in seminomatous tumors. MAGE expression did not correlate with disease progression, suggesting that seminoma is more similar to normal testis.

pmid-10202672.summary_ja: 正常胎盤および妊娠性絨毛性疾患病変でインヒビンαの免疫染色を行った研究である。胞状奇胎、胎盤部結節、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌などで陽性となり、細胞性栄養膜細胞は陰性であった。扁平上皮癌や子宮内膜癌などは陰性で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患病変の鑑別診断に有用であると結論づけられている。
pmid-10202672.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined inhibin-alpha expression in normal placentas and gestational trophoblastic lesions. Inhibin-alpha was detected in the syncytiotrophoblast of normal placenta and in all hydatidiform moles, placental site nodules, placental site trophoblastic tumors, epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, and choriocarcinomas. Cytotrophoblast remained negative throughout. Non-trophoblastic tumors, including squamous cell carcinoma of the cervix and endometrial carcinoma, were negative. Inhibin-alpha therefore appears useful for the differential diagnosis of gestational trophoblastic lesions.

pmid-10202677.summary_ja: 62歳女性に生じた男性化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。卵巣摘出後にテストステロン値は正常化した。嚢腫壁には不連続なステロイド細胞の帯があり、部分的に平滑筋細胞を伴っていた。免疫染色で、これらの細胞は酵素活性を示し卵胞内莢膜細胞に類似していた。卵巣間質の平滑筋化生に伴う修飾された間質細胞と考えられた。
pmid-10202677.summary_en: This case report describes a 62-year-old woman with virilization caused by a virilizing ovarian dermoid cyst. Testosterone levels normalized after oophorectomy. A discontinuous band of steroid cells lined the cyst wall, focally accompanied by smooth muscle cells. Immunohistochemistry showed that these steroid cells were enzymatically active and resembled the internal theca cells of ovarian follicles. The authors propose they are modified stromal cells associated with smooth muscle metaplasia of the ovarian stroma. The report highlights a rare cause of hyperandrogenism linked to dermoid cysts.

pmid-10202679.summary_ja: 卵管に原発した混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。腫瘍は未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分からなっていた。卵管の未熟奇形腫は英文文献で3例しか報告がなく極めて稀である。このまれな部位に生じた胚細胞腫瘍の知見を追加する報告である。抄録には治療および臨床経過の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-10202679.summary_en: This case report describes a primary mixed malignant germ cell tumor of the fallopian tube, composed of immature teratoma and yolk sac tumor components. Immature teratomas of the fallopian tube are exceedingly rare, with only three previously reported cases in the English literature. The report therefore adds to the limited literature on germ cell tumors arising at this unusual site. Details of treatment and clinical outcome are not provided in the abstract.

pmid-10203284.summary_ja: 経口避妊薬の使用が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のリスクを高めるかを検討した多施設症例対照研究である。症例235例（うち妊娠性絨毛癌50例）と対照413例を比較した。妊娠前の長期使用でリスクが上昇し、受精周期に服用していた女性で最も高かった。絶対的なリスクは非常に低いため、使用の変更は推奨されないとしている。
pmid-10203284.summary_en: This multicenter case-control study tested whether oral contraceptive use before conception raises the risk of gestational trophoblastic tumors. It included 235 case patients, 50 with gestational choriocarcinoma, and 413 matched controls. Long-term use before pregnancy was associated with higher risk, with the highest estimate among women who took contraceptives during the conception cycle. Results were similar for choriocarcinoma and persistent mole. The authors concluded that long duration of use increases risk, but because the attributable incidence is very low, no change in use is warranted.

pmid-10204106.summary_ja: 多房性胸腺嚢胞を伴い嚢胞変化が目立つ縦隔セミノーマの穿刺吸引細胞診である。大型で核小体の目立つ悪性細胞の集塊とリンパ球浸潤を認め、PLAPが陽性で細胞角化蛋白は陰性であった。胸腺嚢胞を伴う悪性腫瘍の鑑別診断を併せて考察している。多房性嚢胞を伴う縦隔セミノーマの穿刺吸引細胞診報告は初めてとされる。
pmid-10204106.summary_en: This report describes fine-needle aspiration cytology of a mediastinal seminoma with prominent cystic change, associated with a multilocular thymic cyst. Aspirates showed clusters of large malignant cells with prominent nucleoli, surrounded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate and noncaseating granulomas. Tumor cells were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and negative for cytokeratins, findings confirmed by surgical pathology. The authors review the differential diagnosis of malignancies associated with thymic cysts. To their knowledge, this is the first aspiration cytology report of a mediastinal seminoma associated with a multilocular cyst.

pmid-10204108.summary_ja: 52歳男性の左精巣に生じた精母細胞性セミノーマの穿刺吸引細胞診症例である。中型細胞が優位で、古典型セミノーマにみられるtigroid（まだら状）背景を欠き、背景は清明であった。有糸分裂像は少なく、リンパ球は認めなかった。術前に細胞診で診断でき、病理組織学的にも確認された。文献レビューを併せて報告している。
pmid-10204108.summary_en: This case report describes fine-needle aspiration cytology of a spermatocytic seminoma in a 52-year-old man involving the left testis. Smears showed three cell populations, predominantly medium-sized cells with visible nucleoli, against a clean background, unlike the tigroid background of classical seminoma. A low mitotic rate and absence of lymphocytes further aided diagnosis. A preoperative cytologic diagnosis was made and subsequently confirmed by histopathology. The case is reported because of the rarity of the tumor and the few previously published FNA diagnoses. A literature review accompanies the case.

pmid-10206399.summary_ja: 正期産の新生児が、生後すぐに中咽頭の有茎性腫瘤による急性の上気道閉塞を呈した症例報告。気道確保後に腫瘤を切除したところ、先天性の稀な胚細胞腫瘍である鼻咽頭奇形腫と診断された。出生前診断が可能な場合があり、診断不明時には挿管または気管切開による緊急の気道確保が不可欠であることを、治療選択肢の文献的考察とともに示している。
pmid-10206399.summary_en: A full-term neonate presented with acute upper airway obstruction from a polypoidal oropharyngeal mass, which was excised after securing the airway. Pathology identified a nasopharyngeal teratoma, a rare congenital germ cell tumour often accompanied by other malformations. The authors review management options, emphasizing that such tumours may be diagnosed prenatally, allowing planned delivery, and that urgent airway securing by intubation or tracheostomy is essential when the diagnosis is unknown.

pmid-10206457.summary_ja: St. Jude研究では、1962年から1988年に治療された小児期・思春期の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者73例の晩期合併症を検討した。2/3以上が少なくとも1つの合併症を有し、筋骨格系、内分泌系、消化器系の障害が多かった。放射線療法を受けた患者で異常が最も多くみられた。シスプラチン投与を受けた患者の半数以上で高音域の難聴が生じた。著者らは、晩期影響は治療強度に応じて生じると結論し、生活の質を改善するため治療に基づいたスクリーニングを推奨している。
pmid-10206457.summary_en: This St. Jude study reviewed late complications in 73 long-term survivors of childhood and adolescent malignant germ cell tumors treated between 1962 and 1988. More than two-thirds had at least one complication, most often musculoskeletal, endocrine, and gastrointestinal, and abnormalities were most frequent in patients receiving radiation therapy. High-frequency hearing loss occurred in more than half of those given cisplatin. The authors conclude that late effects follow treatment intensity and advocate treatment-directed screening to improve quality of life in survivors.

pmid-10206807.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫202例の超音波像を後方視的に検討し、充実性に見える病変の特徴を解析した研究。76例（37.6%）が非典型的な充実性像を示し、そのうち75%で辺縁低エコーが認められた。これは腫瘍内の液体成分を反映すると考えられ、後方音響陰影は23.7%でみられた。辺縁低エコーは充実性卵巣奇形腫を超音波検査で同定するための特徴的所見となりうる。
pmid-10206807.summary_en: The authors retrospectively reviewed ultrasonograms of 202 ovarian teratomas to characterize those appearing as solid masses. Of these, 76 (37.6%) were atypical solid-appearing lesions. Most (75%) showed peripheral hypoechogenicity, which likely reflects the fluid component of the tumor, while posterior sonic attenuation was seen in 23.7%. The authors suggest peripheral hypoechogenicity is a characteristic feature that can help recognize solid-appearing ovarian teratomas on ultrasonography.

pmid-10207631.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者とHIV感染の有無による対照群で、HERV-K10抗体の血清陽性率を比較した研究。診断時付近の患者の63%で抗体が検出され、対照群の5%を大きく上回った。セミノーマ、奇形癌、胎児性癌で陽性率に差はなく、セミノーマ診断の6か月以上前にも抗体がみられた。効果的な治療後に抗体は速やかに消失し、HIVは抗体陽性率に影響しなかった。
pmid-10207631.summary_en: Serum antibodies to HERV-K10 Env and Gag were compared between testicular cancer patients and controls, including those with HIV. Antibodies were detected in 63% of patients near diagnosis versus 5% of controls, with similar rates across seminoma, teratocarcinoma, and embryonal carcinoma. Antibodies appeared more than six months before seminoma diagnosis and seemed to disappear after effective therapy. HIV infection did not affect seroprevalence, leaving the higher testicular cancer risk in AIDS unexplained.

pmid-10210337.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の207例を対象に、胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と胸部X線写真の病期分類および再評価における有用性を比較した研究。胸腔内転移は、セミノーマで1%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で20%に認められた。CTの正確度は0.97、X線写真は0.91と、CTが優れていた。非セミノーマ患者では定期的な胸部X線写真は省略可能で、低リスクの純粋セミノーマでは再評価のCTを省略できると結論づけている。
pmid-10210337.summary_en: This study evaluated chest CT and chest radiography for staging and re-assessment of 207 patients with testicular germ cell tumours, comparing findings against a consensus standard of reference. Intrathoracic metastases occurred in 1% of seminoma and 20% of non-seminoma patients. CT was more accurate than radiography (0.97 vs 0.91), and radiography never detected unknown metastatic disease at re-assessment. The authors conclude routine interval radiographs can be omitted in non-seminoma patients undergoing CT, and CT can be avoided in low-risk pure seminoma.

pmid-10210571.summary_ja: 1990～1996年に転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍167例を治療した施設での後方視的検討です。脳転移は11例（約7%）に認められ、胸部に巨大病変を有する患者では32%に臨床的な脳転移が見られました。単発脳転移の予後は比較的良好でしたが、多発例や進行例では初回の外科的切除による利益は認められないようでした。定期的な頭部画像検査が推奨されています。
pmid-10210571.summary_en: This 1999 BJU International study reviewed 11 of 167 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours who developed brain metastases between 1990 and 1996. Patients with bulky thoracic disease had a 32% incidence of clinical brain metastases. Single brain metastases carried a better prognosis than previously reported, while patients with progressive or multiple lesions did not appear to benefit from initial surgical resection. The authors recommend routine cranial imaging for patients with bulky thoracic disease.

pmid-10210572.summary_ja: 1961～1995年に早期精巣セミノーマで精巣摘除術と放射線療法を受けた患者を対象に、性生活への影響を質問票で評価した研究です。回答98例の多くは性交渉を維持していましたが、性欲低下や勃起困難などを訴える例もありました。治療後の性的後遺症に関する説明は不十分と感じられており、年齢のみが性生活への適応を予測する因子でした。
pmid-10210572.summary_en: This BJU International study surveyed 98 evaluable patients treated for early-stage testicular seminoma with orchidectomy and radiotherapy between 1961 and 1995 to assess sexual function. Most patients remained sexually active, although 25% reported low libido and 14% poor sexual capacity. Some reported difficulty with erection, reduced orgasm, low semen volume, or premature ejaculation. Patients felt counselling about sexual sequelae was insufficient. Age was the only significant predictor of sexual adjustment, and the authors suggest better information tools.

pmid-10210573.summary_ja: 新たに樹立された精巣セミノーマ細胞株JKT-1と、マウスへの移植を経て得られた高転移性株JKT-HMの生物学的特性を検討した研究です。両株は形態や増殖能が類似していました。JKT-HMはマウスで肺やリンパ節に転移し、比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で18p欠失やXq増加など、転移に関連しうる染色体異常が検出されました。
pmid-10210573.summary_en: This 1999 BJU International study characterized a new human testicular seminoma cell line, JKT-1, and its highly metastatic derivative, JKT-HM, which was established by transplanting JKT-1 cells into nude mice. Both lines showed similar morphology, proliferation and DNA index. JKT-HM metastasized to lung and lymph nodes in all five mice within 50 days and showed greater in vitro invasion. Comparative genomic hybridization revealed aberrations such as loss of 18p and Yq and gain of Xq, suggesting candidate regions linked to metastasis.

pmid-10212781.summary_ja: 1986～1997年に名古屋大学で、進行した精巣・後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍15例に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った後方視的検討です。術中合併症は約3割にみられ、主に血管損傷でした。完全切除で壊死・線維化や奇形腫が確認された例の多くは無病生存しました。生存腫瘍細胞が残存していた3例はいずれも死亡しました。
pmid-10212781.summary_en: This Hinyokika Kiyo study from Nagoya University reviewed 15 patients with advanced testicular or retroperitoneal germ cell tumours who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1986 and 1997. Intraoperative complications occurred in one third of patients, mainly vascular injuries. Among patients with completely resected necrosis, fibrosis or teratoma, most remained disease-free. All three patients with residual viable cancer died. Relapses were usually preceded by rising tumour markers, and the authors conclude RPLND is useful for pathological assessment and prognosis.

pmid-10213045.summary_ja: 近縁の3人の女性が卵巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した家族を報告し、ウィスコンシン大学で治療を受けた8例の家族歴を調べた研究です。そのうち1例では、精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した叔父がいました。文献レビューでは、複数の親族が罹患した家族が他に6家系見つかりました。一部の家族には、卵巣および精巣の胚細胞腫瘍に関わる感受性遺伝子が存在する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-10213045.summary_en: This American Journal of Medical Genetics report describes a family in which three closely related women developed ovarian germ cell malignancies. Family histories of eight women treated for ovarian germ cell tumours at the University of Wisconsin were reviewed, and one had an uncle with testicular germ cell cancer. A literature review identified six other families with multiple affected relatives. The authors propose that a susceptibility gene for ovarian and possibly testicular germ cell tumours may be present in some families.

pmid-10216498.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ30例に根治的精巣摘除術後の腸骨・傍大動脈領域への放射線療法を行った後方視的研究です。1986年以降、総線量は40Gyから32Gyに変更されました。追跡期間中央値8.6年で、病期IおよびIIの5年無病生存率は100%でした。急性有害事象の多くは回復し、重篤な晩期合併症はほとんどありませんでした。
pmid-10216498.summary_en: This Anticancer Research study reviewed 30 patients with testicular seminoma, mostly stage I, treated with orchiectomy followed by iliac and para-aortic irradiation. The median total prescribed dose was reduced from 40 Gy to 32 Gy after 1986. With a median follow-up of 8.6 years, the 5-year disease-free survival was 100% for stage I and II patients. Most patients had acute side effects that resolved, and severe late complications were rare. The authors conclude that radical orchiectomy followed by postoperative irradiation gives good results.

pmid-10217181.summary_ja: 大量化学療法が予定された、前治療歴の多い進行胚細胞腫瘍34例で末梢血前駆細胞の動員を後方視的に検討した研究です。25例で採取に成功しました。VeIP療法では8例で目標量のCD34陽性細胞を動員できず、VIP療法の方が良好と考察されています。救援化学療法に抵抗性の患者には大量シクロホスファミド療法が代替になりうるとされています。
pmid-10217181.summary_en: This Bone Marrow Transplantation study retrospectively evaluated peripheral blood progenitor cell mobilization in 34 heavily pretreated patients with germ cell tumours scheduled for high-dose chemotherapy. Mobilization regimens included VeIP, VIP, or high-dose cyclophosphamide. Successful collection was achieved in 25 patients. VeIP failed to mobilize target CD34+ cells in eight patients, and VIP appeared more satisfactory. High-dose cyclophosphamide remained an alternative for patients refractory to salvage chemotherapy.

pmid-10220801.summary_ja: 2歳半の女児に発生した、心室中隔原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。収縮期雑音で受診し、心エコー検査で左室腔の半分以上を占める腫瘍が確認されました。AFPが著明に上昇し、凍結切片生検と切除標本で確定診断されています。心外病変は認められず、心臓内原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の既報は見当たらないとされています。
pmid-10220801.summary_en: This Pathology Research and Practice case report describes a 2.5-year-old girl with a primary yolk sac tumour arising in the interventricular septum of the heart. She presented with a systolic murmur, and echocardiography showed a mass filling more than half of the left ventricular cavity. Diagnosis was made on frozen-section biopsy and confirmed on resection, supported by markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein. CT of the head, thorax and abdomen showed no extracardiac disease. The authors found no prior reports of a primary intracardiac yolk sac tumour.

pmid-10221338.summary_ja: 性腺芽細胞腫3例と、性腺芽細胞腫を合併した混合型胚細胞腫瘍1例のY染色体遺伝子型を35のマーカーで解析した研究である。4例はいずれも共通の領域を共有していた。混合型胚細胞腫瘍ではY染色体の一部が失われており、増殖の速いがん細胞でのY染色体欠失が示唆された。GBY遺伝子座はおよそ5Mbの領域に絞り込まれた。
pmid-10221338.summary_en: This molecular study analysed Y chromosomal genotypes in four patients: three with gonadoblastoma and one with gonadoblastoma coexisting with a mixed germ cell tumour. Using 35 Y chromosomal markers, the authors found that all four shared a common region on the Y chromosome. In the mixed tumour, Y chromosomal material was lost, whereas it was retained in the gonadoblastoma. The results narrow the candidate gonadoblastoma locus GBY to a roughly 5-Mb pericentromeric region and suggest Y chromosome loss in rapidly proliferating cancer cells.

pmid-10221692.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症を示す46,XY女性2例が、腹腔内の精巣からディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を発症した。AR遺伝子に変異を認め、31歳例はホルモン結合領域（コドン681）、17歳例はDNA結合領域（コドン607）に変異があった。17歳例では性腺芽細胞腫も合併していた。ARの定期的な遺伝子解析が推奨されている。
pmid-10221692.summary_en: Two patients with a 46,XY female phenotype, complete androgen insensitivity and gonadal dysgenesis developed dysgerminoma in abdominal testes. Sequencing revealed AR gene mutations: one in the hormone-binding domain (codon 681) in a 31-year-old with dysgerminoma, and one in the DNA-binding domain (codon 607) in a 17-year-old who also had gonadoblastoma. The codon 607 mutation has been linked to male breast cancer in partial androgen insensitivity. The authors recommend regular AR gene analysis in such patients to detect early oncogenic change.

pmid-10221734.summary_ja: マウスの精巣に胎児の生殖腺原基を移植して実験的精巣奇形腫を作製し、2〜8週間の免疫組織化学で宿主精巣と腫瘍の免疫関連分子を解析した。腫瘍の周囲で傷害された精細管ではIL-6とIL-10の発現が増加していた。腫瘍を含む精巣のサイトカイン環境が液性免疫応答の活性化を促すと考えられた。
pmid-10221734.summary_en: In a mouse model, testicular teratomas were induced by grafting fetal male gonadal ridges into adult testes of the same strain. Immunohistochemistry at 2 to 8 weeks examined adhesion molecules, cytokines, T-cell costimulators and CD1d in both the host testis and the tumour. The cytokines IL-6 and IL-10 were increased in damaged seminiferous tubules around the growing tumour. The authors suggest the cytokine microenvironment of a testis containing neoplastic tissue favours activation of humoral immune responses.

pmid-10221868.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌で後腹膜腫瘤と肺転移を有する38歳男性が、標準化学療法4コース後に大量化学療法（ICE）を受けた。その後、重症横紋筋融解症と腎機能障害を発症し、透析や末梢血幹細胞移植を行ったが、第18病日に呼吸不全で死亡した。
pmid-10221868.summary_en: A 38-year-old man with advanced testicular choriocarcinoma, including a 9 cm retroperitoneal mass and lung metastases, received high-dose ICE chemotherapy (ifosfamide, carboplatin, etoposide) after four courses of standard chemotherapy. He developed confusion and hallucinations, then severe rhabdomyolysis with myoglobinuria and renal dysfunction. Despite haemodialysis and peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, he died of respiratory failure on day 18. The authors discuss pretreatment renal dysfunction, chemotherapy-related renal damage and sedatives as causes.

pmid-10223100.summary_ja: 精巣がんと診断された患者への説明と治療選択を解説した総説である。精巣腫瘍の種類、患者評価、病期分類、リスク分類、治療選択が取り上げられている。精巣摘除術、神経温存リンパ節郭清、化学療法の進歩により、治癒可能性の高いがんとなったと述べている。
pmid-10223100.summary_en: This review from Postgraduate Medicine, written by two oncologists, describes how to counsel patients after a diagnosis of testicular cancer. It covers types of testicular tumour, patient evaluation, disease staging, risk categorisation and treatment selection. The authors note the importance of orchiectomy, the nerve-sparing lymph node dissection and modern chemotherapy, which have made testicular cancer one of the most curable neoplasms. A patient handout on self-examination is included.

pmid-10223229.summary_ja: 良性十二指腸潰瘍に対するビルロートII法胃切除後43年目に、胃断端で卵黄嚢腫瘍と腺癌が合併した61歳男性の症例である。両成分でp53変異のパターンが一致し、同一クローンに由来すると考えられた。消化管に生じる性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍は極めて稀である。
pmid-10223229.summary_en: A 61-year-old man developed a combined extragonadal yolk sac tumour and adenocarcinoma in a gastric stump 43 years after a Billroth II gastrectomy for a benign duodenal ulcer. Immunohistochemistry and molecular analysis showed the same p53 mutation pattern in both components. This suggests a common clonal origin from a mucosal epithelial cell, with the two histological patterns representing heterogeneous differentiation of the same tumour. Extragonadal yolk sac tumours of the gastrointestinal tract are extremely rare.

pmid-10223302.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマ17例と古典型セミノーマ22例を、免疫組織化学とDNA倍数性解析で比較した。PLAPは古典型のみ陽性であった。c-kitは精母細胞性の約40%で陽性であった。両者は発癌経路が異なると考えられた。
pmid-10223302.summary_en: This study compared 17 spermatocytic seminomas with 22 classical seminomas using immunohistochemistry for PLAP, c-kit, cytokeratin and adhesion molecules, and DNA ploidy analysis. All classical seminomas were PLAP-positive, whereas no spermatocytic seminomas were. C-kit was positive in about 40 percent of spermatocytic seminomas and in all classical seminomas. Most spermatocytic seminomas were diploid or polyploid, while all classical seminomas were aneuploid. The authors suggest the two entities follow different carcinogenic pathways.

pmid-10225454.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の6種の細胞株を用い、p53の状態とアポトーシス誘導の関係を検討した。シスプラチンやドキソルビシンへの感受性はp53機能と関連せず、p53非依存性の複数のアポトーシス経路が示唆された。放射線療法と化学療法では誘導経路が異なることも示された。
pmid-10225454.summary_en: This study examined apoptosis induction in six testicular germ cell tumour cell lines with varying p53 status. Sensitivity to cisplatin and doxorubicin did not correlate with p53 function, as p53-inactivated NT2 sublines remained hypersensitive. S2 cells were resistant to radiation-induced apoptosis, indicating distinct pathways for chemotherapy and irradiation. Fas ligation induced apoptosis across several lines, including drug- and radiation-resistant 2102 EP cells. The authors conclude that distinct p53-independent apoptotic pathways operate in testicular germ cell tumour cells.

pmid-10226820.summary_ja: 38か月の男児の再発卵黄嚢腫瘍に対し、シスプラチン併用化学療法を施行した。後腹膜リンパ節転移は7×6cmから2×2cmに縮小し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化した。残存腫瘤の切除標本は完全壊死で、術後36か月間無病生存が得られた。
pmid-10226820.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-month-old boy with recurrent yolk sac tumour and a large retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Treatment with cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy reduced the mass from 7 x 6 cm to 2 x 2 cm and normalised serum AFP. Histology of the resected residual retroperitoneal mass showed complete necrosis without viable cancer cells. The patient remained disease-free for 36 months after surgery. The case shows that persistent post-chemotherapy residual masses in infantile yolk sac tumour may still be resected to confirm response.

pmid-10226829.summary_ja: クラインフェルター症候群を伴う33歳男性の前立腺腫瘍が、経直腸生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫の混合型と示唆された。他部位に腫瘍はなく、前立腺原発の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と判断された。シスプラチン、ビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシンによる全身化学療法と放射線療法で、上昇していた乳酸脱水素酵素(LDH)とαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は正常化した。
pmid-10226829.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with Klinefelter syndrome presented with a prostatic tumour, and transrectal biopsy suggested combined yolk sac tumour and teratoma. With no tumour elsewhere, the case was classified as primary extragonadal germ cell tumour of the prostate. Systemic cisplatin, vinblastine and bleomycin chemotherapy, together with radiation therapy, normalised elevated LDH and AFP. The patient has survived about four years since diagnosis, illustrating a curable outcome in this rare setting.

pmid-10226831.summary_ja: 9歳男児が左陰嚢内容の増大を主訴に受診し、超音波検査で左精巣の中心部に高エコー像を認めた。精巣生検で精細管内の悪性胚細胞を認め、精巣摘除術後に性腺芽細胞腫と診断された。性腺芽細胞腫は通常、性腺異形成を伴う表現型女性に生じ、本例は稀な男性例である。
pmid-10226831.summary_en: A 9-year-old boy with enlargement of the left scrotal contents had physically normal, descended testes. Scrotal ultrasound showed a hyperechoic lesion in the central left testis. Testicular biopsy revealed intratubular malignant germ cells, and left orchiectomy showed gonadoblastoma. Gonadoblastoma usually occurs in phenotypically female patients with gonadal dysgenesis. The authors report a rare case in a physically normal male without accompanying germ cell tumour, noting only three similar prior male cases.

pmid-10228505.summary_ja: シスプラチンとイホスファミドによる化学療法後に再発した転移性胚細胞腫瘍の1例に、アクチノマイシンDを基盤とするレジメンで救援療法を行い成功した。アクチノマイシンDは精巣がんに有効であり、白金製剤抵抗性例で考慮しうると結論された。
pmid-10228505.summary_en: This case report describes one patient with metastatic germ cell tumour who relapsed after cisplatin and ifosfamide chemotherapy. The patient was treated successfully with an actinomycin D-based regimen, an agent used widely in the 1960s. The authors note that actinomycin D is active in testicular cancer and may be considered in patients refractory to platinum. No prior data exist on actinomycin D as salvage therapy in cisplatin-refractory disease.

pmid-10230699.summary_ja: セミノーマ16例について、凍結切片を用いた免疫組織化学でFasとFasリガンド（FasL）の発現を解析した。腫瘍浸潤リンパ球にはFas陽性細胞が一定割合存在したが、FasL陽性リンパ球は少なかった。正常精細管ではFasLが発現し、前がん性の精細管では不連続になっていた。浸潤性腫瘍細胞は両分子とも発現しなかった。
pmid-10230699.summary_en: This study examined Fas and Fas ligand (FasL) expression in 16 seminomas and surrounding seminiferous tubules using immunohistochemistry on frozen sections. Fas-positive lymphocytes were present among tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, but FasL-positive lymphocytes were scarce. FasL was expressed in normal seminiferous tubules and discontinuously in precancerous tubules, while invasive tumor cells expressed neither molecule. Findings are discussed regarding immune responses to seminoma and the immunologically privileged status of the testis.

pmid-10233456.summary_ja: ニュージーランドの全国前向き研究で、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍248例を精巣摘除術単独とサーベイランスで管理した。70例（28%）が再発し、再発の危険因子は血管・リンパ管侵襲のみであった。17年後の疾患特異的生存率は98%だった。サーベイランスは後腹膜リンパ節郭清や予防的化学療法の有害事象を回避できると結論された。
pmid-10233456.summary_en: This 17-year New Zealand national study followed 248 men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumours managed by orchidectomy alone with surveillance, treating relapses with combination chemotherapy. Seventy patients (28%) relapsed, and vascular and/or lymphatic invasion was the only identified risk factor. Only one relapse occurred beyond 28 months. Disease-specific survival was 98%. The authors conclude that surveillance avoids the morbidity of retroperitoneal node dissection or elective chemotherapy.

pmid-10233573.summary_ja: 1978年から1996年に初回化学療法を受けた転移性セミノーマの患者107例を後方視的に検討し、CTで検出された残存腫瘤の管理を評価した。43例に残存腫瘤があり、19例が手術、24例が経過観察を受けた。生存腫瘍は、境界明瞭で3cm以上の残存腫瘤を有する患者で認められ、3cm未満の腫瘤では認められなかった。著者らは、小さい腫瘤や境界不明瞭な腫瘤は経過観察とし、3cm以上の境界明瞭な腫瘤は切除することを推奨している。
pmid-10233573.summary_en: This retrospective review of 107 patients with metastatic seminoma treated with initial chemotherapy between 1978 and 1996 evaluated management of residual masses detected by computed tomography. Forty-three patients had residual masses; 19 underwent surgery and 24 were observed. Viable cancer was found in patients with well-defined residual masses of at least 3 cm, but not in those with masses under 3 cm. The authors recommend observing small or poorly defined masses and resecting well-defined masses of 3 cm or more.

pmid-10233836.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫7例を組織マイクロダイセクションと複数の遺伝子マーカーで解析し、胚細胞起源をめぐる論争の解明を試みた。奇形腫成分の異所性組織はほぼ一貫してホモ接合型を示し、減数分裂I期を経た胚細胞由来を支持した。2例では減数分裂組換えによるヘテロ接合性が認められた。リンパ組織は宿主由来、高分化胸腺組織はホモ接合型で、リンパ系分化能を示した。
pmid-10233836.summary_en: This study used tissue microdissection with a panel of genetic markers to genotype mature ovarian teratomas, aiming to resolve controversy over their germ cell origin. Seven cases were analyzed. Teratomatous heterotopic tissues were consistently homozygous, supporting origin from germ cells that had passed through meiosis I, while two cases showed heterozygosity from meiotic recombination. Lymphoid aggregates were heterozygous and host-derived, whereas well-differentiated thymic tissue was homozygous, indicating lymphoid differentiation capacity.

pmid-10326591.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、播種性精巣非セミノーマの1例について、原発腫瘍、化学療法後の残存成熟奇形腫、9年後の晩期再発病変の細胞遺伝学的解析を行った。晩期再発病変には成熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の両成分が含まれていた。原発腫瘍から残存奇形腫、さらに晩期再発病変へと進行する過程で染色体の正味の減少が認められた。著者らは、晩期再発において生存腫瘍への転化にはさらなる染色体欠失が伴う可能性を示唆している。
pmid-10326591.summary_en: This case report analyzes the cytogenetics of a single patient with disseminated testicular nonseminoma, comparing the primary tumor, a residual mature teratoma after chemotherapy, and a late relapse 9 years later that contained both mature teratoma and yolk sac tumor components. The authors found net chromosomal loss during progression from primary tumor to residual teratoma and to the late-relapse lesion. They suggest further chromosomal losses may accompany transformation to viable cancer in late relapse.

pmid-10326623.summary_ja: 本研究は絨毛癌、侵入奇胎、胞状奇胎を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍患者の血清216検体について、ロゼット阻害試験で早期妊娠因子(EPF)様活性を検討した。EPF様活性による悪性絨毛性腫瘍の診断精度は91.3%であり、治療後には有意に低下した。EPF様活性は良性と悪性の絨毛性腫瘍を鑑別する指標になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-10326623.summary_en: This study tested serum early pregnancy factor (EPF)-like activity by rosette inhibition assay in 216 sera from patients with gestational trophoblastic tumor, including choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, and vesicular mole. EPF-like activity diagnosed malignant trophoblastic tumor with 91.3% accuracy, and titers fell significantly after treatment. The authors propose that EPF-like activity can distinguish benign from malignant trophoblastic tumor and could serve as a diagnostic indicator.

pmid-10326703.summary_ja: ロンドンの施設で治療された非ディスジャーミノーマ性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性69例を後方視的に解析し、治療成績と再発の危険因子を検討した。プラチナ系化学療法により無再発生存率は約87%、全生存率は約84%であった。再発はAFPが1000 kU/Lを超える症例や卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型で多くみられた。非プラチナ系レジメンやAFP値は、リスク層別化の指標となる。未熟奇形腫の一部の患者には、より軽度の管理が適している可能性がある。
pmid-10326703.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 69 women with nondysgerminomatous ovarian germ cell tumors (NDOGCT) from London centers examines treatment outcomes and risk factors for relapse. Platinum-based chemotherapy achieved relapse-free and overall survival of about 87% and 84%. Relapse was associated with AFP above 1000 kU/L and endodermal sinus tumor histology, while immature teratoma patients did not relapse. Non-platinum regimens and AFP levels guide risk stratification, and less intensive management may suit some immature teratoma patients.

pmid-10328086.summary_ja: 本報告は、微小嚢胞パターンを示し卵黄嚢腫瘍を模倣した精巣のライディッヒ細胞腫瘍4例を記述している。全例がαフェトプロテインと胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼに陰性で、ビメンチンとインヒビンの染色はライディッヒ細胞由来を支持した。ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍は経過観察のみで足りるが、卵黄嚢腫瘍は化学療法を要することが多いため、両者の鑑別は臨床的に重要である。経過観察期間2か月から2年の間に、再発や転移は認められなかった。
pmid-10328086.summary_en: This report describes four testicular Leydig cell tumors with microcystic patterns that mimicked yolk sac tumor, a germ cell tumor. All were negative for alpha-fetoprotein and placentalike alkaline phosphatase, with vimentin and inhibin staining supporting a Leydig origin. Recognizing this mimicry matters clinically because Leydig tumors need only follow-up, while yolk sac tumors often require chemotherapy. Patients had no recurrence or metastasis during 2 months to 2 years of follow-up.

pmid-10328600.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関わる出生前のエストロゲン作用や思春期後の分子事象、胎児性癌の新規マーカー(FGF4、CD30、OCT-4)を概説した総説。不要な化学療法を減らすため病理学的定義の改善が必要と述べ、SWOGの試験ではVIP療法がBEPに優る結果は得られなかったことから、予後不良例の治療再検討を今後の課題として挙げている。
pmid-10328600.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in understanding germ cell cancer, including prenatal estrogen-mediated priming, postpubertal molecular events, and new markers such as FGF4, CD30, and OCT-4 for embryonal carcinoma. It emphasizes improved pathologic definition to limit unnecessary chemotherapy, noting that chemotherapy outperforms radiation even in seminoma and that seminoma is more chemosensitive than nonseminoma. The authors report that the Southwest Oncology Group trial showed no benefit of vinblastine, ifosfamide, and cisplatin over BEP, and they call for re-examining treatment of poor-risk disease in future trials.

pmid-10329037.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の3例と、文献から集積した88例を解析した報告。FIGO病期が最も重要な予後因子で、病期I-IIは子宮摘出後に良好な経過をたどり、病期III-IVの生存率は約30%だった。病変の完全切除は良好な予後と関連し、切除不能例では多剤併用化学療法で高い奏効率が得られたものの、完全寛解は少数にとどまった。
pmid-10329037.summary_en: This report describes three placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) cases and a pooled analysis of 88 published cases from MEDLINE. Disease extent outside the uterus at presentation was associated with a longer latency after the antecedent pregnancy and older age. FIGO stage was the strongest prognostic factor: stage I-II patients after hysterectomy had excellent outcomes, whereas stage III-IV patients had about 30% survival. Complete removal of all lesions provided good outcomes, and combination chemotherapy achieved high response rates in unresectable disease, though few reached complete response.

pmid-10329054.summary_ja: 良性卵巣奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が発生した稀な悪性転化の症例。腸管と腹膜に浸潤し、骨盤内および腹膜に転移があった。根治的手術に続き骨盤部放射線療法と化学療法を施行し、子宮頸癌に準じた治療で19か月の無病生存が得られた。進行例に対する集学的治療の有用性を示唆する。
pmid-10329054.summary_en: This report describes a patient with squamous cell carcinoma arising from a benign mature ovarian teratoma, a rare malignant transformation. The tumor had invaded bowel and peritoneum, with pelvic and peritoneal metastases. Treatment consisted of radical surgery followed by whole pelvic radiation and chemotherapy, a regimen usually used for cervical squamous cell cancer. The patient remained disease-free for 19 months, suggesting that this multimodal approach may be beneficial in selected cases of advanced malignant transformation.

pmid-10329055.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、妊娠30週で内出血を呈した異所性妊娠の女性における原発性卵管胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)を記述している。妊娠30週で緊急開腹および右部分卵管切除術を施行し、妊娠34週の帝王切開後に子宮全摘、両側卵管卵巣摘出、大網切除を行った。術後の補助療法は行われず、12か月の追跡期間中に再発や転移は認められなかった。著者らは、英語文献においてこの症例が初めての報告であると述べている。
pmid-10329055.summary_en: This case report describes primary tubal placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) in a woman with a heterotopic pregnancy, presenting with internal bleeding at 30 weeks' gestation. Emergency laparotomy with right partial salpingectomy was performed, followed by total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and omentectomy after cesarean section at 34 weeks. No adjuvant therapy was given, and no recurrence or metastasis was observed during 12 months of follow-up. The authors note this is the first such case reported in the English literature.

pmid-10331173.summary_ja: 精索へ広範に進展した巨大精巣腫瘍の2例。停留精巣のセミノーマ(520g)と非セミノーマ(7,000g)で、いずれも初回VIP化学療法の後に高位精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、切除標本は壊死と線維化のみだった。13か月と15か月の再発なし経過を報告し、日本の文献42例もまとめて、初回化学療法後の外科的切除が有用と結論づけている。
pmid-10331173.summary_en: This report describes two patients with giant testicular tumors extending into the spermatic cord: a 55-year-old with seminoma in an undescended testis (520 g) and a 38-year-old with nonseminoma (7,000 g). Both received initial VIP chemotherapy followed by high orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and histology showed only necrosis and fibrosis. Both remained recurrence-free for 13 to 15 months. The authors reviewed 42 Japanese cases of giant testicular tumors and conclude that upfront chemotherapy followed by surgical resection is a better management strategy for extensive spermatic cord invasion.

pmid-10333717.summary_ja: 1978-1997年にMDアンダーソンで治療された胚細胞腫瘍2,107例のうち、両側精巣腫瘍は21例だった。ほとんどは異時性の発生で、初発と第二腫瘍の組織学的一致率は35%。化学療法後は対側にセミノーマが多く発生する傾向があった。超音波検査は対側腫瘍の28.6%を身体診察や腫瘍マーカー上昇より前に発見しており、対側精巣の綿密なフォローアップが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-10333717.summary_en: This retrospective study of 2,107 germ cell cancer patients treated at MD Anderson between 1978 and 1997 identified 21 with bilateral testicular tumors. Most second tumors developed metachronously, and seminomas predominated. Histologic concordance between first and second tumors was 35%. Chemotherapy for the first tumor was associated with a shift toward metachronous seminomas in the contralateral testis. Ultrasonography detected 28.6% of contralateral tumors before physical examination or tumor marker elevation, supporting close ultrasound follow-up of the contralateral testis.

pmid-10337997.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍81例の染色体異常を、性別、年齢、部位、組織型ごとに解析した研究である。良性の乳幼児奇形腫は大半が正常核型であった。悪性腫瘍では卵黄嚢腫瘍が多く、1p欠失/1q増加や3番染色体増加が共通してみられた。思春期の精巣腫瘍は成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に似ており、12p等染色体は思春期男児で頻出した。
pmid-10337997.summary_en: This Children's Cancer Group study analyzed chromosome abnormalities in 81 pediatric germ cell tumors from the INT-0097 and INT-0098 trials. Patterns differed by sex, age, tumor site, and histology. Benign infant teratomas were mostly chromosomally normal, while malignant tumors, mainly endodermal sinus tumors, commonly showed 1p loss with 1q gain and gain of chromosome 3. Adolescent testicular tumors resembled adult testicular GCTs, including isochromosome 12p, which was frequent in adolescent boys.

pmid-10340903.summary_ja: EORTC/MRC無作為化試験に登録された380例を対象に、予後不良の転移性非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍において、施設の登録症例数が生存に影響するかを検討した。登録数5例未満の施設では全生存期間が有意に不良であった(ハザード比1.85)。プロトコール遵守、残存腫瘤の手術、投与量強度の差が影響した可能性がある。
pmid-10340903.summary_en: This analysis of 380 patients from a randomized EORTC/MRC trial examined whether the number of patients an institution enrolled affected outcomes in poor-prognosis metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell cancer. Patients treated at institutions enrolling fewer than five patients had significantly worse overall survival (hazard ratio 1.85). Survival was similar at institutions enrolling five or more. Differences in protocol adherence, surgery for residual masses, and dose intensity may explain the effect.

pmid-10341408.summary_ja: 妊娠15週で超音波検査により発見された、口蓋から生じる稀な先天性奇形腫(両方向性エピグナサス)の症例報告である。両方向性の腫瘍は脳組織に進展し予後不良となる。出生前超音波検査が病変の検出と進展範囲の評価に有用であることを示した。出生後の管理方針を決める上でも重要である。
pmid-10341408.summary_en: This case report describes antenatal ultrasound detection of a bidirectional epignathus, a rare congenital teratoma arising from the hard palate, at 15 weeks of gestation. Unlike unidirectional epignathi that protrude through the mouth, bidirectional tumors extend into the brain and carry a poorer prognosis. The report highlights the prenatal diagnostic value of ultrasound for identifying this lesion and its extent, which also guides postnatal management.

pmid-10344305.summary_ja: 小児の縦隔に生じる胚細胞腫瘍、間葉系腫瘍、胸腺腫瘍について概説した総説である。これらは小児縦隔腫瘍の25%未満を占める。多くは前縦隔と上縦隔に生じるが、胚細胞腫瘍と間葉系腫瘍はすべての区画に発生しうる。組織学的亜型が多様で腫瘍は大きくなりやすく、治療の成功には完全切除が不可欠である。
pmid-10344305.summary_en: This review describes germ cell, mesenchymal, and thymic tumors of the mediastinum in children. These heterogeneous neoplasms account for under 25% of childhood mediastinal tumors. Most arise in the anterior and superior mediastinum, though germ cell and mesenchymal tumors can occur in any compartment. They share diverse histologic subtypes and often large size, and require complete surgical excision for successful therapy.

pmid-10348299.summary_ja: 2系統のラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株は放射線感受性が異なり、耐性株NMT-1Rではp53のエクソン7に変異が認められた。10Gy照射後、感受性株NMT-1ではp53、p21、baxの発現が上昇したが、NMT-1Rでは変化がなかった。放射線により誘発されたp53機能喪失が放射線感受性を低下させると結論づけている。
pmid-10348299.summary_en: Two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines differ in radiosensitivity. The radioresistant NMT-1R line carries a three-base substitution in p53 exon 7 at codons 267 to 268, while the radiosensitive NMT-1 line does not. After 10 Gy irradiation, p53, p21, and bax expression increased in NMT-1 cells but not in NMT-1R cells. The authors conclude that radiation-induced loss of p53 function decreases radiosensitivity in these cell lines.

pmid-10352915.summary_ja: 耳下腺の類皮嚢腫2例について、穿刺吸引細胞診(FNA)の所見を報告した論文である。無痛性で可動性のある耳下腺腫瘤を呈し、CTでは嚢胞性病変として描出された。細胞診では無核および有核の扁平上皮と角化物質が確認され、病理組織学的にも類皮嚢腫と診断された。FNAは術前診断に有用で、術式の選択に役立つと結論づけている。
pmid-10352915.summary_en: This report describes fine-needle aspiration cytology of two parotid dermoid cysts, both presenting as painless, mobile parotid masses that appeared cystic on CT. Cytology showed anucleated and nucleated squamous epithelium and keratin debris. Histology confirmed dermoid cysts in both cases. The authors conclude that FNA is a reliable preoperative diagnostic method that helps select an appropriate surgical procedure for parotid dermoid cysts.

pmid-10355200.summary_ja: 上顎洞原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍を発症した4歳男児の症例報告である。卵黄嚢腫瘍は性腺および性腺外に生じる稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍で、中枢神経系を除く頭頸部発生例はまれである。放射線療法と化学療法の併用により腫瘍は完全に消退した。小児の頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍に対する集学的治療の有用性が示された。
pmid-10355200.summary_en: This case report describes a four-year-old boy with an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor arising from the maxillary sinus. Endodermal sinus tumors are uncommon malignant germ cell tumors occurring in gonadal and extragonadal tissues, and head and neck cases outside the central nervous system are rare. Combined radiation therapy and chemotherapy produced complete tumor regression. The authors highlight the value of multimodal treatment for pediatric head and neck germ cell tumors.

pmid-10355255.summary_ja: 進行性の後腹膜胚細胞腫瘍と左鎖骨上窩リンパ節転移を有する29歳男性の症例報告である。BEP療法3コース後も後腹膜腫瘤が残存したため、エトポシドを用いた骨髄抑制化学療法で採取した末梢血幹細胞を用いて大量化学療法と自家移植を施行した。残存腫瘤の切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清では壊死のみで生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、9か月間無再発で経過している。
pmid-10355255.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with advanced retroperitoneal germ cell tumor and left supraclavicular lymph node metastases, who achieved complete remission after combined treatment. Initial AFP, hCG, and beta-hCG levels were markedly elevated. After three BEP cycles, a retroperitoneal mass persisted, so the patient received high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Resection and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed necrosis without viable tumor cells. The patient remained disease-free for nine months.

pmid-10355256.summary_ja: 左精巣腫瘍に対し根治的精巣摘除術を受けた22歳男性が、両肺に腫瘍を生じた症例報告である。経気管支生検で胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、血清のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGが上昇していた。陰嚢超音波検査で右精巣に小さな高エコー病変が見つかり、切除標本からburned-out型の精巣腫瘍と判明した。異時性両側精巣腫瘍の1例である。
pmid-10355256.summary_en: A 22-year-old man who had undergone left radical orchiectomy for a testicular tumor developed bilateral pulmonary tumors, which transbronchial biopsy identified as germ cell tumors. Serum AFP and beta-hCG were elevated. Scrotal ultrasonography revealed a small hyperechoic lesion in the right testis without a palpable mass. Excision showed a whitish nodule beneath the tunica albuginea, which was pathologically diagnosed as a burned-out testicular tumor, representing metachronous bilateral testicular tumors.

pmid-10355572.summary_ja: スペインの13施設における38例のIGCCC予後不良胚細胞腫瘍患者に対し、BOMP/EPI交互化学療法の有効性と毒性を評価した研究である。全体の60%で良好な奏効が得られ、2年全生存期間(全生存率)は64%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は58%であった。グレード4の顆粒球減少が70%にみられた。著者らは、BOMP/EPIが有効で、従来の化学療法より良好な結果が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-10355572.summary_en: This multicenter study from 13 Spanish centers evaluated the alternating BOMP/EPI chemotherapy regimen in 38 patients with IGCCC poor-prognosis germ-cell tumors. The median number of cycles was 7, and 60% of patients achieved a favorable response, including 18 complete responses with chemotherapy alone. Grade 4 granulocytopenia occurred in 70%. At a median follow-up of 41 months, two-year overall survival was 64% and progression-free survival was 58%. The authors conclude that BOMP/EPI is active and compares favorably with conventional chemotherapy.

pmid-10355653.summary_ja: 前縦隔に好発する縦隔胚細胞腫瘍について、組織型ごとの発生頻度と予後をまとめた総説である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫とセミノーマは予後が非常に良好である。一方、非セミノーマ性腫瘍は進行例で発見されることが多く、化学療法への反応が劣る。予後不良な胸腺癌との鑑別の重要性も強調されている。
pmid-10355653.summary_en: This review covers mediastinal germ-cell tumors, which arise mainly in the anterior mediastinum and are thought to derive from extragonadal germ cells or thymic cells with germ-cell potential. It outlines the histologic types and their demographics. Mature cystic teratoma and seminoma have an excellent prognosis, while nonseminomatous tumors often present at an advanced stage and respond less well to chemotherapy than their gonadal counterparts. The authors stress distinguishing these tumors from thymic carcinoma, which has a poor prognosis. Many patients respond very well to modern therapy.

pmid-10355916.summary_ja: 7年間に単施設で出生前診断された胎児仙尾部奇形腫9例を後方視的に検討した研究である。新生児期を生存したのは6例で、妊娠20週以降に診断された例は全て生存した。胎児水腫を生じた3例は全て死亡した。妊娠早期の診断、胎児水腫、早産は予後不良因子であった。可能な限り分娩を遅らせ、腫瘍切除前に新生児を安定化させることが推奨されている。
pmid-10355916.summary_en: This retrospective review of nine fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed antenatally at a single center over seven years examined perinatal and surgical management. Six infants survived the neonatal period, and all fetuses diagnosed after 20 weeks survived. Fetal hydrops developed in three fetuses, all of whom died, with inadequate ventilation from prematurity contributing. Early gestational diagnosis, fetal hydrops, and premature delivery predicted a poor outcome. The authors recommend delaying delivery when possible and stabilizing the infant before tumor resection.

pmid-10355967.summary_ja: 未熟奇形腫8例と成熟奇形腫2例を用い、13種の細胞同定マーカーで免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。組織の成熟度によらず抗原の共発現や越境性発現がみられ、他の腫瘍のパターンと類似していた。奇形腫内の癌腫成分は異常な発現を示さなかった。著者らは、腫瘍における抗原発現の異常は悪性転化よりも分化・成熟の過程と関連すると結論づけている。
pmid-10355967.summary_en: This study uses teratomas (eight immature, two mature) as a model to examine why tumors aberrantly express intermediate filaments and other cell identity markers. Immunohistochemistry with a panel of 13 markers showed antigenic coexpression and transbarrier expression in tissues of varying maturity, resembling patterns seen in other tumors. Carcinomatous elements within teratomas were nonreactive rather than aberrant. The authors conclude that antigenic subversion in neoplasia relates to maturation and differentiation rather than malignant transformation.

pmid-10357096.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の3病型（乳児奇形腫・卵黄嚢腫瘍、成人のセミノーマと非セミノーマ、精母細胞性セミノーマ）の発症機序を染色体異常の観点から概説した総説である。成人型では等染色体i(12p)が最も一貫した異常である。乳児奇形腫と精母細胞性セミノーマは良性で、セミノーマと非セミノーマは治癒率が90%を超えるとされる。
pmid-10357096.summary_en: This review examines the pathogenesis of testicular germ cell tumors, distinguishing infantile teratomas and yolk sac tumors, adult seminomas and nonseminomas, and spermatocytic seminomas. Chromosomal analyses reveal distinct patterns, with isochromosome 12p the most consistent abnormality in adult types, while infantile teratomas often lack aberrations. Infantile teratomas and spermatocytic seminomas are considered benign, whereas seminomas and nonseminomas are malignant, with cure rates above 90%. The paper also discusses the relationship between seminomas and nonseminomas and available animal models.

pmid-10359533.summary_ja: 本研究では、37個のマーカーを用いて精巣胚細胞がん標本の染色体5の高解像度LOH解析を行った。48検体中42%で対立遺伝子の消失が認められ、5q14、5q21、5q34-qterに共通の欠失部位が3つ見つかった。著者らは、推定上の腫瘍抑制遺伝子の単離に役立てるため、YACクローンと放射線ハイブリッドマッピングを用いて5q14欠失の物理地図を作成した。この結果は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍抑制遺伝子の供給源として5qを支持するものである。
pmid-10359533.summary_en: This study performed high-resolution loss of heterozygosity analysis of chromosome 5 in testicular germ cell cancer specimens using 37 markers. Allelic losses were found in 42% of the 48 specimens, with three common deletion sites on 5q14, 5q21, and 5q34-qter. The authors built a physical map of the 5q14 deletion using YAC clones and radiation hybrid mapping, to aid isolation of a putative novel tumor suppressor gene. The findings support 5q as a source of tumor suppressor genes in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-10359854.summary_ja: 70歳女性における卵巣甲状腺腫と卵巣悪性リンパ腫の同時発生例の報告である。病変は、チェルノブイリ原子力事故による電離放射線被曝の10年後に検出された。両成分の鑑別における免疫組織化学染色の有用性が強調されている。卵巣甲状腺腫は単一組織型からなる特殊な奇形腫である。
pmid-10359854.summary_en: This case report describes a 70-year-old woman with coexisting strumal ovarii (struma ovarii) and ovarian involvement by malignant lymphoma. The lesions were detected ten years after exposure to ionizing radiation during the Chernobyl nuclear accident. The report emphasizes the diagnostic value of immunohistochemical stains in distinguishing these components. Struma ovarii, a specialized monodermal teratoma, has previously been reported alongside carcinoid tumor, carcinoma, and primary ovarian lymphoma.

pmid-10360811.summary_ja: 前向きに収集された血清コホート内で、CMVおよびEBVの抗体反応と精巣がんリスクを症例対照研究により検討した。CMV陽性はセミノーマのリスク上昇、非セミノーマのリスク低下と関連した。EBVのVCA陽性者ではリスク上昇が見られたが、信頼区間は広かった。感染時期を考慮することが今後の課題とされた。
pmid-10360811.summary_en: This nested case-control study within a prospectively collected serum cohort of 293,692 individuals examined cytomegalovirus and Epstein-Barr virus seroreactivity in relation to testicular cancer risk. Eighty-one cases were matched with three controls each. CMV seropositivity was not associated with overall testicular cancer risk, but showed higher odds for seminoma and lower odds for non-seminoma. EBV viral capsid antigen seropositivity was associated with increased risk, although confidence intervals were wide. The authors suggest that age at infection should be considered in future studies.

pmid-10362082.summary_ja: 7年間に単施設で出生前診断された胎児仙尾部奇形腫9例の後方視的検討である。新生児期の生存は6例で、妊娠20週以降に診断された例は全例生存した。胎児水腫を生じた3例は全例死亡し、未熟性による換気不全が関与した。早期診断、水腫、早産は予後不良因子であり、可能なら分娩を遅らせ、切除前に児を安定させることが推奨されている。
pmid-10362082.summary_en: This retrospective review of nine fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed antenatally over seven years at a single center assessed perinatal and surgical outcomes. Six infants survived the neonatal period, and all fetuses diagnosed after 20 weeks survived. Fetal hydrops developed in three fetuses, all of whom died, with inadequate ventilation due to prematurity contributing to each lethal case. Early gestational diagnosis, hydrops, and premature delivery predicted poor prognosis. The authors recommend delaying delivery when possible and stabilizing the infant before tumor resection.

pmid-10362788.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍33検体でc-kit遺伝子を解析し、セミノーマ/ディスジャーミノーマ分化を示す腫瘍に新規変異D816Hを見いだした。この変異は非腫瘍組織にはなく、悪性転化の過程で獲得されたと考えられる。変異KITタンパクは恒常的に活性化していた。胚細胞腫瘍における活性化c-kit変異の初の報告である。
pmid-10362788.summary_en: This study screened the c-kit gene in 33 primary testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors by PCR and DNA sequencing. A novel missense mutation, D816H, in the phosphotransferase domain was found in tumors with seminoma or dysgerminoma differentiation, and was absent from nonneoplastic tissue, suggesting acquisition during malignant transformation. Transfection experiments showed that the mutant KIT protein was constitutively active and tyrosine phosphorylated. This is the first report of an activating c-kit mutation in germ cell tumors, supporting a role for KIT signaling in seminoma-type neoplasia.

pmid-10365682.summary_ja: 大きな卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に存在した甲状腺組織により甲状腺機能亢進症を生じた症例を報告し、術前後の内分泌学的、画像的、病理学的データを示している。卵巣甲状腺腫に分泌性下垂体腫瘍が合併した初めての症例でもある。さらに2施設で切除された卵巣腫瘍1390例の後方視的病理解析も含む。
pmid-10365682.summary_en: This report describes a patient with hyperthyroidism caused by thyroid tissue within a large ovarian cystic teratoma, with detailed endocrinological, radiological, and pathological data before and after surgery. It is also the first documented case of struma ovarii associated with a secreting pituitary tumor. The authors additionally present a retrospective pathological analysis of 1390 surgically removed ovarian tumors from two academic centers. The paper thus combines a rare clinical case with a larger institutional review.

pmid-10366215.summary_ja: 成人男性に生じた仙骨前奇形腫の症例報告。反復性に感染する毛巣嚢胞として受診し、生検で良性の成熟奇形腫と判明した。後方アプローチで左半側仙骨切除術と一次閉鎖を行い、術後再発は認めていない。小児診断が多い本疾患の成人例は極めて稀であり、文献レビューを併載している。
pmid-10366215.summary_en: This case report describes an adult man with recurrent infected pilonidal cysts whose biopsy revealed a benign mature presacral teratoma. Presacral teratomas are rare and usually diagnosed in infancy, and adult cases are exceptional, with about 85 reported cases in the literature. He underwent left hemisacrectomy with primary closure via a posterior approach and has had no recurrence. The report combines the clinical course with a review of the relevant literature.

pmid-10366419.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍細胞株において、新規のヒトLIF転写産物hLIF-MとhLIF-Tを同定した。胎児性癌細胞株では一貫して発現が高く、hLIF-Mが主要な転写産物であった。これらは異なるタンパク質を翻訳し、分泌型と細胞内型のLIFを生じることが示された。胚細胞腫瘍の発生における自己分泌性および細胞自律的なLIFシグナルの関与が示唆される。
pmid-10366419.summary_en: This study identifies two novel human LIF transcripts, hLIF-M and hLIF-T, in germ cell tumor cell lines, containing noncoding alternate first exons conserved across LIF genes. Embryonal carcinoma lines expressed these transcripts consistently, with hLIF-M predominant. Overexpression experiments showed that the transcripts encode distinct protein sets, including secreted LIF and intracellular proteins, which generate different levels of extracellular LIF activity. The authors propose that autocrine and cell-autonomous LIF signaling contributes to germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-10366457.summary_ja: hCGフォローアップ完了前に妊娠した絨毛性腫瘍患者43例の後方視的検討。継続した29例のうち22例が正期産で出産した。1例は肺病変を伴う絨毛癌を発症したが、胎盤に腫瘍は認めなかった。密な監視下での妊娠継続は許容されるが、再発の診断遅延リスクに留意すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-10366457.summary_en: This retrospective review of 43 women treated for gestational trophoblastic tumor who conceived before completing standard hCG follow-up. Most antecedent pregnancies were complete moles, and most tumors were stage I. Of 29 continuing pregnancies, 22 ended in term live births, with a few preterm deliveries, abortions, and one repeat mole. One patient developed choriocarcinoma with lung involvement but delivered a normal fetus with no placental tumor. The authors conclude these pregnancies may continue under close surveillance, while cautioning about delayed relapse diagnosis.

pmid-10366474.summary_ja: 40歳以上の女性3例に発生した悪性生殖管未熟奇形腫の報告。原発は卵管、卵巣、両側卵巣皮質と様々であった。全例が病期III。2例は1年以内に死亡した。化学療法後に増大した1例では、切除組織が成熟組織のみからなっていた。閉経周辺期および閉経後女性にも悪性胚細胞腫瘍が生じうると結論づけている。
pmid-10366474.summary_en: Three women aged 40 or older with malignant genital tract immature teratomas are described, arising from the fallopian tube, the ovary, and the surfaces of both ovaries. All had FIGO stage III tumors with grade II or III histology. Two women died within a year. In the third patient, interval growth after chemotherapy was reexplored, and the excised tumor consisted entirely of mature tissue. The authors conclude that malignant germ cell tumors, though rare, can occur in peri- and postmenopausal women.

pmid-10366477.summary_ja: 転移を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の2症例。いずれも手術と放射線療法の併用で治療された。本疾患は稀で、臨床的に明らかな転移例は約20例しか報告されていない。甲状腺腫瘍と同様の挙動を示すとされ、減量手術後の放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが提唱されている。症例数が少ないため治療の評価は困難である。
pmid-10366477.summary_en: Two patients with metastatic malignant struma ovarii are reported, each treated with a combination of surgery and radiation therapy. The authors note that this condition is rare, with about 20 previously reported clinically evident metastatic cases, and that these tumors behave like their thyroid counterparts. Cytoreductive surgery followed by radioactive iodine ablation has been advocated, although treatment evaluation is difficult given the small number of cases.
