pmid-10367237.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清などの後腹膜手術後に生じた逆行性射精11例に、イミプラミンを投与した非対照試験。全例で順行性射精が回復し、2例が自然妊娠した。副作用は軽微であった。一時的な内服は、後腹膜手術後の妊孕性の回復に有効で安全な治療と結論づけている。
pmid-10367237.summary_en: Imipramine was tested in an open, uncontrolled study of 11 men with retrograde ejaculation after retroperitoneal surgery, ten of whom had retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer. Using a cycle-timed dose of 25 to 50 mg daily, antegrade ejaculation was restored in all patients. Two achieved spontaneous pregnancy, and two ICSI cycles achieved fertilization without pregnancy. Side effects were minor. The authors conclude that temporary imipramine is an effective and safe option for restoring paternity possibilities after retroperitoneal surgery.

pmid-10368043.summary_ja: 本研究では、病期I～IIの精巣セミノーマ患者131例における第二の非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍の発生を測定した。累積発生率は10.7%、標準化発生比は2.81であった。横隔膜下および横隔膜上への放射線療法後にリスクが上昇したが、横隔膜下のみの放射線療法後には上昇しなかった。化学療法を受けた患者はリスクが著しく高く、特に血液悪性腫瘍で顕著であった。著者らは、放射線療法と化学療法の併用が二次がんのリスクを高めると結論づけている。
pmid-10368043.summary_en: This study measured second non-germ cell malignancies in 131 patients treated for stage I to II testicular seminoma. The cumulative incidence was 10.7%, with a standardized incidence ratio of 2.81. Risk was elevated after combined infra- and supradiaphragmatic radiotherapy but not after infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy alone. Patients receiving chemotherapy had markedly higher risk, especially for hematologic malignancy. The authors conclude that combining radiotherapy with chemotherapy increases second cancer risk.

pmid-10370047.summary_ja: 妊娠32週に双胎の一児の前縦隔腫瘍が出生前診断された症例。34週で出生後、生後48時間で正中胸骨切開術により完全切除された。病理学的には成熟奇形腫であった。1歳時点で双生児はともに良好な状態である。出生前診断と出生直後の外科的計画の有用性を示している。
pmid-10370047.summary_en: An anteromediastinal tumor in one twin fetus was diagnosed prenatally at 32 weeks of gestation, allowing planned neonatal management after delivery at 34 weeks. At 48 hours of age, median sternotomy achieved complete resection. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma. At one year, both twins were well. The case illustrates the value of prenatal diagnosis and immediate postnatal surgical planning for intrapericardial teratoma.

pmid-10370714.summary_ja: 小児・思春期女性の卵巣腫瘤についての総説。若年者では機能性嚢胞が多く、腫瘍は上皮性より胚細胞性が多い。悪性は約10%にとどまる。診断では詳細な病歴と身体診察が重要で、将来の妊孕性を温存する配慮が求められると述べている。卵巣腫瘤の評価と若年者の妊孕性温存の要点を概説した論文である。
pmid-10370714.summary_en: This review describes ovarian masses in children and adolescents. Ovarian tumors in these age groups resemble adult types, but their relative frequencies differ; functional cysts are common in adolescents, and neoplasms are more often germ cell than epithelial in origin. Only about 10% are malignant. The authors emphasize a complete history and physical examination during evaluation and stress preserving reproductive function in young patients to protect future fertility.

pmid-10374685.summary_ja: 80歳の女性で、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した骨肉腫の症例を報告する。著者らは、奇形腫内に発生した骨肉腫の報告としてはこれが4例目にすぎないと述べている。本短報では、年齢と診断以外の臨床詳細は限られている。
pmid-10374685.summary_en: A report of an 80-year-old woman with osteosarcoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors describe this as only the fourth reported case of osteosarcoma arising within a teratoma. The short report documents the rare malignant transformation of a benign ovarian germ cell tumor into a sarcoma in an elderly patient. Clinical details beyond age and diagnosis are limited in the abstract.

pmid-10374778.summary_ja: 胎盤部結節（PSN）の中間トロホブラストを、過剰な胎盤部や正常胎盤のものと比較した研究である。PSNの細胞は絨毛型に類似し、Ki-67標識率3～10%の軽度の増殖を示した。42例中4例は5mmを超え類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍への移行像を示したが、大きさにかかわらず再発例はなかった。
pmid-10374778.summary_en: This study compares trophoblastic cells in placental site nodules (PSN) with those in exaggerated placental sites and normal placentas. The PSN cells resemble chorionic villi, showing mild proliferation (Ki-67 3-10%), while implantation-site cells show none. Four of 42 nodules, larger than 5 mm, showed features transitional to epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. No PSN recurred regardless of size. PSN cells express inhibin-alpha and cytokeratin 18, distinguishing them from cervical squamous cell carcinoma.

pmid-10376186.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の心臓転移により失神を呈した症例の報告です。下大静脈内進展を伴う心臓転移の既報8例を文献的にレビューしています。診断には経食道心エコー検査が有用で、白金系化学療法と残存病変の外科的切除が主な治療とされています。
pmid-10376186.summary_en: This report describes a patient with a metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor to the heart presenting with syncope, the first such case with this presentation. The authors review eight previously reported cases of NSGCT with intracaval extension to the heart. Transesophageal echocardiography was the diagnostic test of choice, and treatment consisted mainly of platinum-based chemotherapy followed by surgical resection of residual deposits. Cardiac metastasis is rare but should be considered in germ cell tumor patients with cardiac symptoms.

pmid-10376427.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎後にhCG値が上昇した48歳女性の症例報告です。非転移性絨毛性疾患と臨床診断されて子宮摘出術が行われましたが、病理組織学的検査で非腫瘍性の過大胎盤部と判明しました。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍との鑑別が重要であり、手術的子宮鏡検査の有用性が示唆されています。
pmid-10376427.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with rising hCG after a molar pregnancy who underwent hysterectomy under a presumed diagnosis of non-metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease. Final histopathology revealed an exaggerated placental site, a non-neoplastic trophoblastic lesion that can be mistaken for placental site trophoblastic tumor. The authors emphasize that clinicians should recognize this lesion and suggest that operative hysteroscopy may aid its diagnosis and management.

pmid-10376430.summary_ja: 1993〜1997年にアテネ大学の2施設で診療された小児・思春期の卵巣腫瘍57例の臨床病理学的検討です。胚細胞腫瘍が49.1%と最も多く、悪性腫瘍の44.5%を胚細胞癌が占めました。小児・思春期の卵巣腫瘍では胚細胞腫瘍が優位であることが示されています。
pmid-10376430.summary_en: A clinicopathological review of 57 ovarian tumors in children and adolescents treated at two Athens university gynecology departments between 1993 and 1997. Germ cell tumors were the most common histologic type (49.1%), and germ cell carcinomas accounted for 44.5% of malignancies. Overall, 77.2% of tumors were benign, 15.8% malignant and 7% borderline. The findings highlight the predominance of germ cell neoplasms among pediatric and adolescent ovarian tumors and their clinical distinctness from adult cases.

pmid-10378640.summary_ja: 制吐薬としてデキサメタゾンを用いたBEP化学療法を受けた若年男性の精巣腫瘍5例で、無腐性壊死(AVN)が生じました。血液腫瘍以外の固形腫瘍ではまれな合併症です。デキサメタゾンがAVNの一因となりうることが示唆され、頻度を評価する前向き研究の必要性が述べられています。
pmid-10378640.summary_en: This report describes five young men with testicular tumours who developed avascular necrosis after BEP chemotherapy with dexamethasone as an antiemetic. Three of the five had good-prognosis disease. Avascular necrosis is well recognised after corticosteroid-containing regimens for haematological malignancies but is rarely reported in solid tumours. The authors suggest dexamethasone may contribute to AVN in solid tumour chemotherapy and call for a prospective study to quantify its frequency.

pmid-10379129.summary_ja: 心膜液貯留を伴う水腫胎児で、心膜内奇形腫を出生前に診断した症例報告です。胎内で心膜穿刺を行い、診断と水腫の治療を兼ねました。心タンポナーデを伴う場合は心膜穿刺により胎児死亡や早産を防げる可能性があります。
pmid-10379129.summary_en: A hydropic fetus with an intrapericardial teratoma and marked pericardial effusion was diagnosed prenatally. Intrauterine pericardiocentesis was performed both to diagnose the cause and to treat the hydrops. The authors propose that draining the effusion in fetal intrapericardial teratoma with tamponade may prevent fetal death and premature delivery. The case shows that extragonadal teratomas can present in utero and that prenatal intervention may be feasible.

pmid-10379339.summary_ja: 腹痛と腰痛を訴えた28歳男性で、精巣に異常はないものの後腹膜腫瘍と αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇を認めました。外科的切除で混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、PVeBV化学療法3コースで肺および鎖骨上リンパ節の転移は消失しました。術後26か月以上再発なく生存しています。
pmid-10379339.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with abdominal pain and lumbago and had a retroperitoneal mass with elevated AFP and LDH despite normal testes. Surgical resection revealed a mixed germ cell tumor. After three courses of PVeBV chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin, vinblastine), pulmonary and supraclavicular nodal metastases disappeared completely. The patient remained alive and recurrence-free more than 26 months after surgery, suggesting the regimen's efficacy in advanced extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-10381572.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞の表現型維持におけるカドヘリン介在性細胞間接着の役割を検討した基礎研究です。NTERA2細胞株では接着を阻害しても分化は起こらず、接着は表現型維持に必須ではないと結論されました。一方、カドヘリン発現は細胞密度に応じて変化し、リチウムによる分化誘導はWntシグナルを介する可能性が示されました。
pmid-10381572.summary_en: This study examines whether cadherin-mediated cell adhesion maintains the embryonal carcinoma phenotype in human EC cells. EC cells express E- and P-cadherin and aggregate in a calcium-dependent manner, but disrupting adhesion in the NTERA2 line did not induce the typical differentiation seen at low density. The authors conclude that cadherin-mediated adhesion is not required to maintain the EC phenotype, while cadherin expression responds to cell density. Lithium-induced differentiation appears to act through Wnt pathway activation rather than adhesion.

pmid-10383695.summary_ja: 本研究は、古典型精巣セミノーマ8例における宿主の慢性炎症反応を免疫組織化学的に解析したものである。浸潤細胞の多くはT細胞で、腫瘍破壊部に集積していた。CD68、MAC387、HLAクラスII陽性の付随細胞が腫瘍胞巣を取り囲んでおり、腫瘍動態に影響する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10383695.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study characterized the inflammatory response in eight classical testicular seminomas. Most infiltrating cells were T lymphocytes, concentrated where tumor destruction occurred. A distinct population of CD68-, MAC387- and HLA class II-positive accessory cells, likely macrophages or dendritic cells, rimmed tumor islands. The authors suggest these cells respond directly to the tumor and may influence tumor dynamics.

pmid-10386059.summary_ja: 64歳女性が顕微鏡的血尿と骨盤内嚢胞性腫瘤で受診した。手術で左卵巣の類皮嚢腫に甲状腺濾胞を含む卵巣甲状腺腫が確認され、膀胱および回腸への瘻孔形成を認めた。部分膀胱切除術と子宮全摘術、回腸と膀胱の一部切除を施行した。卵巣奇形腫が隣接管腔臓器に瘻孔を形成する稀な合併症を示す症例報告である。
pmid-10386059.summary_en: A 64-year-old woman presented with microscopic hematuria and a pelvic cystic mass. Surgery revealed a left ovarian dermoid cyst containing thyroid follicles, i.e., struma ovarii, with fistulous connections to the bladder and ileum. Partial cystectomy, total hysterectomy and resection of part of the ileum and bladder were performed. The case illustrates a rare complication of ovarian teratoma in which fistulization to adjacent hollow organs occurs.

pmid-10386812.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学とnested RT-PCRを用い、セミノーマ10例、胎児性癌3例、未熟奇形腫1例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)発現を検討した。セミノーマでは蛋白は陰性だったが、10例中6例でAFP mRNAが検出された。古典型セミノーマ中の微小な非セミノーマ成分の検出に有用で、セミノーマ細胞が非セミノーマ性胚細胞へ分化する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10386812.summary_en: Using immunohistochemistry and nested RT-PCR, the authors examined AFP expression in 10 seminomas, 3 embryonal carcinomas and 1 immature teratoma. AFP protein was absent from seminomas, while AFP mRNA was detected in 6 of 10 seminomas, all embryonal carcinomas and the teratoma. PCR sequences matched the AFP gene. The authors conclude that nested RT-PCR can detect minute nonseminomatous elements within classic seminoma, and that seminoma cells may differentiate into nonseminomatous germ cells.

pmid-10389293.summary_ja: 精巣の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍13例を後方視的に検討した。大半は卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。13例中3例が精巣摘除術後約3か月で再発したが、いずれもシスプラチン併用化学療法に反応した。中央値42か月のフォローアップで全例が生存し無病である。精巣摘除術後の観察は妥当な選択肢と結論された。
pmid-10389293.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 13 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis, mostly yolk sac tumors, managed by orchiectomy and observation. Three of 13 relapsed about three months after orchiectomy, and all responded to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. At a median follow-up of 42 months, all patients were alive and disease free. The authors conclude that observation after orchiectomy is a reasonable approach for clinical stage I disease.

pmid-10389991.summary_ja: 成体マウス精巣に胎生期の生殖隆起を移植し、精巣奇形腫モデルを作製した。移植片の29%で奇形腫が発生し、宿主精巣に浸潤した。移植後6～8週で増殖が止まり、未熟成分にアポトーシスが認められた。11～12週では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に類似した組織像を示した。転移能は極めて低く、宿主精巣との相互作用を研究するのに適したモデルである。
pmid-10389991.summary_en: The authors established an experimental model of testicular teratoma by grafting fetal gonadal ridges from 129/SvJ mice into adult testes. Teratomas developed in 29% of grafts, invaded the host testis, and stopped growing 6 to 8 weeks after implantation, with apoptosis of immature components. By 11 to 12 weeks, histology resembled a mature cystic teratoma. Metastatic capacity was very low, making the model useful for studying teratoma and host testis interactions.

pmid-10391531.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫内に発生した、横紋筋肉腫成分を伴う低分化型悪性混合性中胚葉腫瘍の症例を報告した。被膜浸潤のためFIGO病期ICと判定された。シスプラチン、イホスファミド、メスナによる併用化学療法を行ったが急速に進行し、肩甲骨へ転移した。術後4か月で患者は死亡した。
pmid-10391531.summary_en: The authors describe a poorly differentiated malignant mixed mesodermal tumor with a rhabdomyosarcomatous component arising within a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary, a very rare event. The tumor was staged FIGO IC due to capsule invasion. Despite combination chemotherapy with cisplatin, ifosfamide and mesna, the disease progressed rapidly and metastasized to the scapula. The patient died in the fourth postoperative month.

pmid-10391536.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者12例について、精巣摘除術と同側の傍大動脈・骨盤リンパ節への術後補助放射線療法の前に精液を評価し、妊孕性のある男性60例と比較した。セミノーマは精子形成に悪影響を及ぼし、精液の主要な3項目すべてに影響することが示された。その機序は不明のままである。
pmid-10391536.summary_en: This study assessed semen quality in 12 men with testicular seminoma, sampled before orchiectomy and adjuvant radiotherapy to the ipsilateral para-aortic and pelvic nodes, and compared them with 60 fertile men. Seminoma appeared to impair spermatogenesis, affecting all three main semen parameters. The mechanism of this deleterious effect remains unclear, but the findings highlight fertility concerns for young men with this tumor.

pmid-10392822.summary_ja: 病期I・IIAのセミノーマ29例を対象に、術後放射線療法時の残存精巣の散乱線量を測定しました。傍大動脈のみ、または傍大動脈と同側腸骨への照射のいずれでも、性腺遮蔽により精巣線量は有意に低下しました。遮蔽に加えた追加ブロックの効果は有意ではありませんでした。傍大動脈領域に限定した照射でも性腺遮蔽には利益があると結論づけています。
pmid-10392822.summary_en: This radiotherapy study measured testicular scatter doses in 29 patients with stage I and IIA seminoma receiving postoperative radiotherapy to para-aortic or para-aortic plus iliac nodes. Scrotal shielding and an additional inferior field-edge block were compared across shielding conditions. Gonadal shielding substantially reduced testicular doses in both field types, reaching statistical significance for PAI fields. Extra external blocks did not significantly reduce dose beyond gonadal shielding. The authors conclude that gonadal shielding benefits seminoma patients even when radiotherapy is limited to the para-aortic region.

pmid-10394118.summary_ja: 後方視的解析で、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍38例に白金製剤を用いた化学療法±手術を実施しました。完全奏効率は縦隔で約67%、後腹膜で約88%でした。性腺外セミノーマは全例が無病生存しました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍でも多くが長期寛解を得ました。精巣の疑わしい超音波所見の6例では、精巣腫瘍は認められませんでした。
pmid-10394118.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 38 patients with primary extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin- or carboplatin-based chemotherapy, with or without surgery, at the Hellenic Cooperative Oncology Group. Complete response rates were about 67 percent in the mediastinum and 88 percent in the retroperitoneum. All extragonadal seminoma patients remained disease-free, and most patients with nonseminomatous tumors achieved long-term remission. Testicular biopsy or orchiectomy was not needed in six patients with suspicious ultrasound findings because no testicular tumor was found.

pmid-10397266.summary_ja: 精巣に特異的に発現するヒト新規セリンプロテアーゼであるテスティシンを解析しました。正常精巣の減数分裂前の胚細胞に発現し、胚細胞由来の精巣腫瘍8例ではいずれも発現が消失していました。遺伝子座16p13.3は精巣腫瘍でヘテロ接合性の消失が報告される領域です。腫瘍進展への関与が示唆されます。
pmid-10397266.summary_en: This cancer research paper reports the cloning and characterization of testisin, a new human serine proteinase expressed only in the testis by premeiotic germ cells. Immunostaining showed testisin in normal testis but none in eight germ cell-derived testicular tumors. The gene maps to 16p13.3, a region linked to loss of heterozygosity in testicular tumors. The findings suggest that loss of this proteinase may contribute to the progression of germ cell-derived testicular tumors.

pmid-10398124.summary_ja: 成人精巣と精巣腫瘍32例におけるD型サイクリン(D1〜D3)の発現を免疫組織化学で解析した。上皮内癌ではD2の獲得が多く、奇形腫ではD3の発現が増殖より分化と相関した。D2は精巣腫瘍の発生初期に関与する可能性が示唆された。増殖とは独立したD型サイクリンの多様な役割も示唆された。
pmid-10398124.summary_en: This study examined cyclin D1, D2, and D3 expression in normal adult testis and 32 testicular tumors. Normal germ cells lacked D-type cyclins, while Leydig cells expressed cyclin D3. Carcinoma in situ frequently gained cyclin D2 but rarely D1. Cyclin D3 expression correlated with differentiation in teratomas, supported by induction in NTera2/D1 cells. The findings suggest cyclin D2 may contribute to early testicular oncogenesis and that D-type cyclins have proliferation-independent roles.

pmid-10399808.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の治療から9年後に肺転移性絨毛癌を発症した38歳女性の症例報告である。その間に正常な妊娠・出産を経ていた。肺葉切除により転移巣を切除し、術後5年間転移は認められなかった。妊娠性栄養膜疾患の晩期再発を示す稀な経過である。
pmid-10399808.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman developed metastatic choriocarcinoma of the lung nine years after treatment for a hydatidiform mole. In the interval she had conceived and given birth to a child. The pulmonary metastasis was resected by lobectomy, and she remained free of metastasis for five years afterward. The case illustrates late recurrence of gestational trophoblastic disease, even after an intervening normal pregnancy.

pmid-10402179.summary_ja: 肺内および胃に生じたきわめて稀な奇形腫2例を報告する。肺内奇形腫は気管支内腫瘍として発育し、胃奇形腫は27歳男性に発生した。組織所見は卵巣や精巣の奇形腫と同様であったが、術前診断は困難であった。韓国での報告は、肺内例が8例目、胃例が初例である。
pmid-10402179.summary_en: This report describes two rare cases of teratoma at unusual sites: an intrapulmonary teratoma presenting as an endobronchial tumor, and a gastric teratoma in a 27-year-old man. Histology resembled that of ovarian or testicular teratomas, although preoperative diagnosis was difficult. The intrapulmonary case is the eighth reported in Korea and the gastric case the first.

pmid-10402724.summary_ja: 純粋XY型性腺形成不全症(Swyer症候群)の患者20例で両側性腺摘出を行い、索状性腺を病理学的に検討した。55%で性腺腫瘍が認められ、性腺芽腫からディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）への移行が示唆された。索状性腺の95%で卵巣様間質がみられ、腫瘍リスクの高さが示された。
pmid-10402724.summary_en: Twenty patients with Swyer syndrome (pure XY gonadal dysgenesis) underwent bilateral gonadectomy, and their streak gonads were examined histologically. Gonadal tumors were found in 55% of patients, including gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, with a possible progression from gonadoblastoma to dysgerminoma. Ovary-like stroma was present in 95% of streak gonads. These findings highlight the high tumor risk in these gonads and support gonadectomy in affected patients.

pmid-10404307.summary_ja: 進行期精巣腫瘍で化学療法後に残存腫瘤切除を受けた38例を解析した。残存腫瘤は壊死/線維化、成熟奇形腫、癌に分類された。残存癌では切除後の再発率が62.5%と高く、生存率も不良であった。切除は組織確認と転移部位の制御に有用であった。
pmid-10404307.summary_en: This study analyzed 38 patients with advanced testicular tumors who underwent resection of residual masses after chemotherapy. Residual masses were necrosis/fibrosis (19), mature teratoma (11), or cancer (8). Recurrence after resection was markedly higher in patients with residual cancer (62.5%) and stage III disease than in those with necrosis or mature teratoma. Despite adjuvant chemotherapy, patients with residual cancer had poor survival, underscoring the need for more effective therapy.

pmid-10405065.summary_ja: 妊娠26週で発見された胎児仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。超高速T2強調磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により、体動によるアーチファクトなく胎児の形態を描出した。帝王切開直後に完全切除され、1歳時点で再発は認められなかった。出生前MRIの有用性を示す症例である。
pmid-10405065.summary_en: A fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma was detected at 26 weeks of gestation. Ultrafast T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging provided clear visualization of fetal morphology without motion artifacts. The tumor was completely resected immediately after cesarean delivery, and no recurrence was seen at one year of age. The case demonstrates the utility of prenatal MRI for evaluating sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-10408400.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株と初発腫瘍を対象に、アポトーシスに関与するBcl10遺伝子のエクソン2・3について変異の有無を検索した研究である。一本鎖高次構造多型解析と制限酵素断片解析を用いて大規模な検体を調べたが、変異は1例も検出されなかった。著者らは、変異によるBcl10の不活化は、従来考えられていたほど精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症に重要ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-10408400.summary_en: This study screened exons 2 and 3 of the Bcl10 gene, which is involved in apoptosis, for mutations in testicular germ cell tumour cell lines and primary tumours. Using single-strand conformation polymorphism and endonuclease restriction analysis across a larger series, no aberrations were detected. The authors conclude that inactivation of Bcl10 by mutation plays a far less important role in testicular germ cell tumour development than previously proposed.

pmid-10408402.summary_ja: 化学療法中にhCGが上昇している胚細胞腫瘍患者27例を対象に、125I標識hCGを用いてhCGの血中消失を調べた研究である。消失曲線は二相性を示し、長期寛解に至った症例では半減期が3日を超えることがあった。緩徐なhCG低下は腫瘍からの産生ではなく血中からの消失が遅いことによると考察され、固定された半減期による判断は不適切であると結論づけられた。
pmid-10408402.summary_en: The authors used 125I-labelled hCG as an elimination marker in 27 patients with germ cell tumours and elevated hCG during chemotherapy. hCG clearance was biphasic, and some patients who achieved long-term remission had half-lives longer than 3 days, so the commonly used fixed 3-day cutoff is too simple. The slow hCG decline reflected slow plasma clearance rather than continued production by viable tumour cells. The authors conclude that this decline should not guide decisions about additional or intensified chemotherapy, and that total hCG should be compared with labelled hCG disappearance.

pmid-10408868.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に関連するオンコフェタル抗原M2Aの性状と分布を調べた研究である。M2A抗原は分子量約4万の単量体シアロ糖タンパク質で、N型糖鎖を欠きO型糖鎖を豊富に持つことが示された。精巣胚細胞腫瘍69例の免疫染色では、セミノーマで一様な膜染色、胎児性癌、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍で部分的な染色が認められた。保存組織でも反応する抗体は、胚細胞腫瘍の発生と進展の研究に有用とされる。
pmid-10408868.summary_en: The authors characterised the oncofetal M2A antigen, associated with germ cell neoplasia, and developed monoclonal antibodies against it. The antigen was identified as a monomeric 40 kDa sialoglycoprotein with O-linked glycans and no N-linked sugars. Immunohistochemistry of 69 formalin-fixed testicular germ cell tumours showed uniform membrane staining in seminomas and focal staining in embryonal carcinomas, teratomas and yolk sac tumours. Carcinoma in situ also stained. The antibodies work in archival tissue, aiding study of the origin and progression of germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-10410156.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の精巣がん2例に経口全トランス型レチノイン酸(ATRA)を投与した経過を報告している。1例目は悪性奇形腫に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を3レジメン受けた後に肺転移をきたした21歳男性、2例目は奇形癌で精巣摘除術後に肺転移をきたした45歳男性である。両例ともATRA投与中に腫瘍は増大し、腫瘍マーカーは上昇した。本投与量のATRAは抗腫瘍効果を示さないと結論づけられた。
pmid-10410156.summary_en: The authors report two patients with chemotherapy-refractory testicular cancer treated with oral all-trans-retinoic acid (ATRA). Case 1 was a 21-year-old man with lung metastases after three cisplatin-based regimens for malignant teratoma. Case 2 was a 45-year-old man with lung metastases after orchiectomy for teratocarcinoma, who had also received high-dose chemotherapy with bone marrow rescue. Both had disease progression with tumour growth and rising tumour markers during ATRA. Side effects were tolerable apart from headache requiring dose reduction. The authors conclude that this oral ATRA dose lacks clinical antitumour activity in refractory testicular cancer.

pmid-10410881.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)が膠芽腫へ悪性転換した41歳女性の症例報告である。腫瘍は卵巣に限局し、卵管卵巣摘出術で完全に切除された。術後3年半の時点で再発なく生存している。文献上、ⅠA期では術後に補助化学療法を行わず経過観察とする方針が支持されると考察されている。
pmid-10410881.summary_en: The authors describe a 41-year-old woman with a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the ovary that had undergone malignant transformation to glioblastoma multiforme. The tumour was confined to the ovary and was completely removed by salpingo-oophorectomy. At 3.5 years after surgery the patient remained alive without recurrence. Reviewing the literature, the authors found support for expectant management without adjuvant chemotherapy after surgery for limited-stage Ia tumours. The report includes a brief literature review and a comment on treatment.

pmid-10410892.summary_ja: 印環細胞を伴う小葉癌成分を有する原発性乳癌が、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に転移した症例である。乳癌からの卵巣転移は既知であるが、卵巣原発腫瘍への転移はまれである。他の原発性卵巣腫瘍や転移(性)腫瘍との鑑別診断、および転移性小葉癌成分の特異な振る舞いについて考察されている。
pmid-10410892.summary_en: The authors present a case of primary breast carcinoma with a lobular component, showing signet ring cells, that metastasised into a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Breast carcinoma metastases to ovaries are well recognised, but involvement of a primary ovarian tumour is much less common. The report discusses the differential diagnosis from other primary ovarian tumours and from metastatic tumours. It also considers the particular behaviour of metastatic lobular components.

pmid-10411040.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者1,954例で、対側精巣生検による精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)の偽陰性率を検討した研究である。生検陰性の1,859例を中央値6年追跡した結果、5例に第二の精巣腫瘍が生じた。再検で2例にTINが検出され、残りは検体損傷や染色の技術的問題によるものであった。偽陰性率は0.3%と低く、外科的生検が依然として診断の標準とされている。
pmid-10411040.summary_en: The authors assessed how often contralateral testicular biopsies falsely failed to detect testicular intraepithelial neoplasia in 1,954 patients with testicular germ cell tumour. Of 1,859 patients with negative biopsies followed for a median of six years, five developed a second testicular tumour. Reexamination detected intraepithelial neoplasia in two specimens, and technical problems accounted for the remaining failures. The false-negative proportion was 0.3%, with biopsy sensitivity of 0.95 and accuracy of 0.997. The authors conclude that surgical biopsy remains the gold standard for diagnosis.

pmid-10413405.summary_ja: 本研究は、男性胚細胞腫瘍で繰り返し欠失する染色体12q22領域の3Mb高解像度物理地図を作成した。コスミド52、PAC 49、BAC 168を用い、99個のマーカーを順序どおりに配置した。108組の腫瘍-正常DNA対のLOH解析により、最小欠失領域は約830kbに絞り込まれた。これらの資源は、候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子の同定、配列決定、遺伝子地図の作成に有用と考えられる。
pmid-10413405.summary_en: This study constructs a high-resolution 3-Mb physical contig of chromosome 12q22, a region recurrently deleted in male germ cell tumors and suspected to harbor a tumor suppressor gene. The map includes 52 cosmids, 49 PACs and 168 BACs, with 99 markers placed in order. Loss-of-heterozygosity analysis of 108 tumor-normal pairs narrowed the consensus minimal deletion to approximately 830 kb between D12S1716 and P382A8-AG. These resources should facilitate identification of the candidate gene, sequence completion and generation of a gene map for this chromosomal segment.

pmid-10415302.summary_ja: 不完全型Currarino三徴症と直腸狭窄を有する乳児で、後方矢状切開直腸形成術中に仙骨前奇形腫が見つかり切除された。腫瘍は3回再発し、初回は化学療法に反応したが、患者は4歳で死亡した。直腸狭窄では仙骨前部の腫瘤を疑うこと、PSARPが奇形と腫瘍切除の両方に最適であること、再発に備えて仙骨前領域の綿密なフォローアップが必要であることが強調されている。
pmid-10415302.summary_en: An infant with an incomplete Currarino triad and severe rectal stenosis was found to have a presacral teratoma during posterosagittal anorectoplasty, and the tumor was resected. The tumor recurred three times and responded initially to chemotherapy, but the patient died at age 4. The authors emphasize that a presacral mass should be suspected in anorectal stenosis, that PSARP is the preferred approach for both the anomaly and tumor excision, and that the presacral region needs close follow-up for recurrence.

pmid-10415313.summary_ja: 13歳半の女児が両側性良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫で腹部腫瘤を呈し、腹部X線写真で腫瘤内に歯が確認された。3歳と10歳時の腹部X線写真は正常であった。経過観察中の画像比較から、奇形腫は増大し、より成熟していたことが示された。本報告は小児期の良性卵巣奇形腫の自然経過を記録し、これらの病変が観察中に増大し、画像上より成熟しうることを示している。
pmid-10415313.summary_en: A 13.5-year-old girl with bilateral benign cystic ovarian teratomas presented with an abdominal mass, and abdominal radiography showed teeth within the mass. Earlier abdominal films at ages 3 and 10 had been normal. Comparison of imaging over follow-up showed that the teratomas had enlarged and matured over time. The report documents the natural history of benign ovarian teratomas in childhood and illustrates that these lesions may grow and become radiologically more mature during observation.

pmid-10418600.summary_ja: 背部痛を主訴とした若い中国人患者3例に、副腎領域の脂肪性病変が偶発的に認められ、副腎摘除術後にいずれも成熟奇形腫と診断された。腫瘍は嚢胞性または充実性で、複数の胚葉由来の組織を含み、未熟成分や悪性所見は認められなかった。追跡期間中に再発した例はなかった。著者らは、副腎領域に生じた奇形腫の初めての報告であるとし、脂肪性副腎病変の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含めること、および切除を推奨している。
pmid-10418600.summary_en: Three young Chinese patients presented with back pain and incidental lipomatous lesions in the adrenal region, and each was diagnosed as a mature teratoma after adrenalectomy. The tumors were cystic or solid, contained tissues from more than one germ layer, and showed no immature elements or malignancy. None recurred during follow-up. The authors report this as the first description of teratoma arising in the adrenal region and recommend including teratoma in the differential diagnosis of lipomatous adrenal lesions, with excision advocated.

pmid-10418712.summary_ja: 1980～1996年に三次施設で治療された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍67例を後方視的に解析した研究です。完全奏効は93%、5年全生存率は89%、無再発生存率は76%でした。進行期が唯一の有意な予後不良因子でした。温存手術と妊孕性温存は実施可能で、化学療法後に出生した児に先天異常はありませんでした。
pmid-10418712.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study reviewed 67 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated between 1980 and 1996, analyzing histology, treatment, and outcomes. Most patients received surgery with or without chemotherapy, and 93% achieved complete response. Five-year overall survival was 89% and relapse-free survival was 76%. Advancing stage was the only significant adverse prognostic factor. Among women who could conceive, 16 pregnancies succeeded, and children exposed to chemotherapy had no congenital abnormalities, supporting conservative surgery and fertility preservation.

pmid-10418719.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の34例で、化学療法中のAFPおよびhCGの半減期を評価した研究です。AFP半減期が7日未満の群は、7日超の群より無イベント生存期間と全生存期間が良好でした。hCG半減期は予後に影響しませんでした。化学療法中のAFP半減期は、基礎的予後因子を補完する動的指標となりうると考えられます。
pmid-10418719.summary_en: This study evaluated serum marker half-life in 34 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell testicular tumors and elevated AFP or hCG who received chemotherapy. Half-lives were calculated from sequential marker concentrations. An AFP half-life under 7 days was associated with significantly better event-free and overall survival than a half-life over 7 days. HCG half-life did not affect survival. The authors suggest that appropriate AFP half-life during chemotherapy may serve as a dynamic prognostic indicator that complements standard baseline prognostic factors.

pmid-10419526.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1を用い、レチノイン酸による分化誘導機構を検討した基礎研究です。レチノイン酸はサイクリンD1のユビキチン化とプロテアソーム分解を促進し、G1期停止を引き起こします。レチノイン酸受容体γを欠く細胞ではこの反応が見られず、受容体の再導入で回復しました。分解されにくい変異サイクリンD1は分化を阻害し、分化と細胞周期を結びつける仕組みが示唆されます。
pmid-10419526.summary_en: This basic research study examines how retinoic acid drives differentiation of human embryonal carcinoma cells, using the NT2/D1 cell line. Retinoic acid reduces cyclin D1 protein through accelerated ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation, which coincides with retinoblastoma protein hypophosphorylation and G1 arrest. Cells lacking retinoic acid receptor gamma fail to show this response, and restoring the receptor rescues it. A cyclin D1 mutant resistant to ubiquitination blocks differentiation, suggesting that cyclin D1 degradation links differentiation to cell cycle control.

pmid-10419751.summary_ja: 閉経後の47歳女性に生じた転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告です。2年間の経過で血清hCGは検出限界付近まで低下しましたが、尿中β-コア断片は高値を維持し残存腫瘍が示唆されました。大量化学療法後に一時上昇し、その後低下しました。血清hCGが検出限界付近のとき、尿中β-コア断片が有用なマーカーとなりうると結論されています。
pmid-10419751.summary_en: This case report describes a 47-year-old postmenopausal woman with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor, followed over two years with urine beta-core fragment measurements alongside serum hCG. Two chemotherapy courses and two debulking operations reduced hCG near the detection limit, yet urine beta-core fragment remained elevated, indicating residual tumor. After high-dose CEM with stem cell harvesting, urine levels rose during therapy and later fell. The authors conclude that urine beta-core fragment may help monitor disease when serum hCG is near or below detection.

pmid-10422438.summary_ja: 中国・四国地方46施設で1984〜1992年に治療された病期I精巣腫瘍348例の調査である。セミノーマが71.6%を占めた。再発は8例（2.3%）で、非セミノーマで再発率が高かった。がん死3例はすべてセミノーマで、術後放射線療法を受けた症例であった。予後は良好と結論づけられている。
pmid-10422438.summary_en: This Japanese multicenter survey analyzed 348 cases of stage I testicular tumor treated at 46 facilities in the Chugoku-Shikoku region from 1984 to 1992. Seminoma accounted for 71.6% and non-seminoma for 28.4%. Recurrence occurred in 8 patients (2.3%), with a higher rate in non-seminoma. All three cancer deaths occurred in seminoma patients who had received postoperative radiotherapy. The authors conclude that prognosis is good, although cancer deaths were limited to seminoma.

pmid-10422441.summary_ja: 31歳男性の後腹膜卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。血清AFP・LDH・hCGは著明に高値であったが、VIP化学療法後に正常化した。その後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行し、腫瘍が取り囲んでいた下大静脈を切除して人工血管で再建した。術後18か月まで人工血管は開存し、再発はない。
pmid-10422441.summary_en: A 31-year-old man had a biopsy-proven retroperitoneal yolk sac tumor with elevated LDH, AFP and hCG, and a 13 cm mass encircling the inferior vena cava. He underwent right orchiectomy and VIP chemotherapy, after which the markers normalized. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was then performed, with resection of the IVC and reconstruction using a 16 cm polytetrafluoroethylene graft. Pathology showed a necrotic tumor with a small mature teratoma component. At 18 months, the graft remained patent with no evidence of recurrence.

pmid-10424741.summary_ja: 白金系導入化学療法後に進行した悪性胚細胞腫瘍164例の予後因子を検討した。多変量解析で、無増悪期間、導入治療への反応、再発時の血清hCG・AFPが独立した予後因子であった。リスク因子が2つ以下の群の5年生存率は47%であり、3つすべてを有する群では3年以上生存例はなかった。
pmid-10424741.summary_en: This study identified prognostic factors for survival in 164 patients with malignant germ cell tumors who progressed after platinum-based induction chemotherapy, most of them testicular (83%). Multivariate analysis identified progression-free interval, response to induction treatment, and serum hCG and AFP at relapse as independent factors. A prognostic model was validated in an independent cohort of 66 patients. Patients with at most two risk factors had a 47% five-year survival, while none of those with all three survived beyond three years.

pmid-10426129.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎と正常胎盤における形質転換増殖因子α（TGF-α）の発現を、免疫組織化学と放射免疫測定法で比較した研究である。胞状奇胎では全妊娠週数で絨毛栄養膜細胞に強い染色が認められ、組織中濃度は正常胎盤より10〜1000倍高かった。TGF-αが栄養膜腫瘍の過増殖を助長する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10426129.summary_en: This study examined transforming growth factor alpha (TGF-alpha) in complete hydatidiform moles compared with normal placentas across gestation. Immunohistochemistry on 149 molar and 96 normal placental samples showed intense TGF-alpha staining in villous trophoblasts of molar placentas at all gestational ages. Radioimmunoassay showed TGF-alpha concentrations 10 to 1000 times higher in molar placentas. The authors suggest TGF-alpha may support the hyperproliferative state of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-10427491.summary_ja: 5〜25年の追跡期間を有する仙尾部奇形腫19例の症例集積である。新生児12例には未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫が含まれ、小児3例は全例が悪性奇形腫であった。新生児・乳児15例は全例生存したが、4例は神経因性膀胱を生じた。手術と併用化学療法の進歩により、悪性例の予後は改善している。
pmid-10427491.summary_en: This series reports 19 sacrococcygeal teratomas with 5 to 25 years of follow-up. Twelve patients were neonates, with immature and mature teratomas, while all three children had malignant teratomas. All neonates and infants survived surgery, but four developed neurogenic bladder requiring catheterization or vesicostomy for 2 to 5 years. Malignant tumors were usually metastatic at diagnosis, but outcomes have improved with surgery and combination chemotherapy.

pmid-10427494.summary_ja: 12年間に単一施設で治療された思春期前小児の精巣奇形腫5例の報告である。平均発症年齢は6.7か月で、右精巣に多く発生した。術前AFP上昇は1例のみで、未熟奇形腫内の胎児肝組織に由来した。全例で精巣摘除術が行われ、平均4.7年の観察で再発はなかった。
pmid-10427494.summary_en: This report analyzes five prepubertal testicular teratomas treated over 12 years at one institution, representing 25% of prepubertal testicular tumors. Mean age at presentation was 6.7 months, and the right testis was most often involved. Only one patient had elevated preoperative AFP, due to fetal liver tissue within an immature teratoma. All patients underwent orchiectomy, and none had residual or recurrent disease at a mean follow-up of 4.7 years. The authors note these tumors differ biologically from adult testicular teratomas.

pmid-10428170.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症、持続性ミュラー管構造、発生異常性性腺の胚細胞腫瘍を有する22歳の46,XY女性の症例報告である。切除された性腺から性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマが見つかった。アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子に「AGGAA」の5塩基欠失によるフレームシフト変異が確認され、迅速な診断に有用とされている。
pmid-10428170.summary_en: This descriptive case study reports a 22-year-old 46,XY woman with complete androgen insensitivity, persistent müllerian structures, and germ cell tumors in dysgenetic gonads. The excised gonads contained a gonadoblastoma and a dysgerminoma, and tumor cells were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase. Genetic analysis found a five-nucleotide AGGAA deletion in the androgen receptor gene, causing a frameshift and an early stop codon. The authors conclude that androgen receptor gene analysis aids rapid diagnosis of complete androgen insensitivity.

pmid-10431529.summary_ja: 妊娠19週の初産婦に発見された仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。出生前超音波検査での評価を検討し、腫瘍の大きさと急速な増大が主要な所見であると述べている。腫瘍に高率に伴う異数性を除外するため、染色体検査の実施を勧めている。仙尾部奇形腫の出生前評価と管理に寄与する報告である。
pmid-10431529.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma detected in a 29-year-old primigravida at 19 weeks of gestation. The authors discuss antenatal ultrasound evaluation, emphasizing tumour size and rapid growth as the main sonographic criteria for these lesions. They recommend karyotyping to exclude aneuploidy, which is frequently associated with the tumour. The report contributes to the prenatal assessment and management of sacrococcygeal teratomas, which are extragonadal germ cell tumours.

pmid-10431849.summary_ja: 2歳男児の左腎ウィルムス腫瘍に対し、腎摘除と術後化学療法・放射線療法を行った症例である。治療後に見つかった後腹膜腫瘤は骨格筋と成熟脂肪組織が主体で、再発か奇形腫かの鑑別が問題となった。エナメル芽細胞様の上皮巣や発育中の歯様構造が認められ、後腹膜奇形腫と診断された。小児における鑑別の難しさを示す症例である。
pmid-10431849.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-year-old boy with a left renal Wilms' tumour treated with nephrectomy and postoperative chemotherapy and radiotherapy. A retroperitoneal mass found after treatment was diagnostically challenging, as it was composed mainly of skeletal muscle and mature adipose tissue. Histology revealed ameloblastic-like epithelial nests and a structure resembling a developing tooth, supporting a retroperitoneal teratoma rather than recurrent Wilms' tumour. The case highlights the diagnostic difficulty of distinguishing these entities in children.

pmid-10433622.summary_ja: 修正TRAP法で精巣良性組織、胚細胞腫瘍、成熟・未熟奇形腫のテロメラーゼ活性とテロメア長を測定した研究である。胚細胞腫瘍では全例で活性が検出された一方、成熟奇形腫では7例すべてで検出されず、有意差があった。悪性転化を伴う未熟奇形腫は高活性を示した。テロメラーゼ活性と分化度は逆相関すると結論している。
pmid-10433622.summary_en: This study measured telomerase activity and telomere length in benign testicular tissue, germ cell cancers, and mature or immature teratomas using a modified TRAP assay. Telomerase was detected in all germ cell cancers and benign testis but in none of seven mature teratomas, a statistically significant difference. Mature teratomas showed very long telomeres, suggesting telomerase repression as a late event in teratoma formation. The single immature teratoma with malignant transformation had high telomerase activity. The authors conclude that telomerase activity inversely correlates with differentiation in clinical germ cell tumors.

pmid-10434554.summary_ja: 右胸痛を訴えた23歳男性で、胸部X線で胸水様の陰影が認められた症例である。CTで前縦隔腫瘍が見つかり、透視下のカテーテル検査で巨大嚢胞と充実性腫瘤の連続が確認された。嚢胞液のSCC抗原、CEA、CA19-9が高値で、縦隔奇形腫が示唆された。完全切除され、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-10434554.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old man with right chest pain whose chest radiograph suggested pleural effusion. CT revealed an anterior mediastinal tumour, and catheter fluoroscopy showed that the opacity was a giant cyst connected to a solid mass. Fluid from the cyst had elevated SCC antigen, CEA and CA 19-9, supporting a mediastinal teratoma. Complete resection was achieved without serious complications; the cyst contained 1,200 ml and occupied half the right thoracic cavity. Pathology confirmed a mature teratoma, a radiologic presentation the authors consider uncommon.

pmid-10435143.summary_ja: 生後10週の女児の中耳・外耳に腫瘤として現れた耳管奇形腫の症例報告である。中耳奇形腫は有毛性先天性ポリープや類皮嚢腫など多様な用語で報告されてきたと整理している。WHOの新しい胚細胞腫瘍分類に基づいて文献をレビューし、大半が耳管から発生または耳管に関与することを示した。希少病変の命名と分類を主題とする論文である。
pmid-10435143.summary_en: This article reports a eustachian tube teratoma presenting as a mass in the middle and external ear of a 10-week-old girl. The authors review the literature on middle ear teratomas, reported under varied terms such as hairy congenital polyp, epidermoid or dermoid cyst, and cutaneous teratoma. They attribute this terminological inconsistency to the difficulty of classifying germ cell tumours and apply the new WHO classification of germ cell tumours. Most middle ear teratomas arise from or involve the eustachian tube. The paper focuses on nomenclature and classification of these rare lesions.

pmid-10435913.summary_ja: ヨルダン大学病院で1984〜1995年に化学療法を受けた妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍90例のうち、85例が寛解を維持した。妊娠を希望した55例中42例（76%）が妊娠し、94名の生児が得られた。先天奇形の増加は認められず、化学療法後の妊孕性は一般集団と遜色なかった。治療効果は高い。
pmid-10435913.summary_en: This report from Jordan University Hospital followed 90 patients with gestational trophoblastic tumors treated with repeated chemotherapy between 1984 and 1995; 85 remained in remission. Of 55 women who wished to conceive, 42 (76%) achieved pregnancy, yielding 94 live births. Fertility compared favorably with the general population, and the authors observed no increase in fetal congenital malformations, suggesting chemotherapy is highly effective and does not impair subsequent reproduction.

pmid-10440749.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍76例を対象に25の遺伝子座でヘテロ接合性の消失（LOH）を解析した。組織型ごとに異なるLOHパターンが認められ、卵黄嚢腫瘍ではD18S543付近の欠失が多かった。混合型20例中11例で同一の欠失が複数成分に認められ、クローン性発生を支持した。
pmid-10440749.summary_en: This study analyzed loss of heterozygosity (LOH) at 25 loci in 76 testicular germ cell tumours and in microdissected mixed tumours. Distinct LOH patterns characterized different histological subtypes, with a region near D18S543 frequently lost in yolk sac tumours. In 11 of 20 mixed tumours, identical allelic losses appeared across different histological components, supporting a clonal origin for many TGCTs. The authors propose two classes of allelic losses: early clonal events and differentiation-related changes.

pmid-10440784.summary_ja: 偶発的に見つかった小型（3cm未満）の非触知性卵巣類皮嚢腫38個を後方視的に検討した。経膣超音波では全例を描出できたが、経腹超音波では22個のみであった。充実性、液体混在性、混合型の3パターンが認められ、いずれも手術で良性と確認された。ドプラ所見は判定に至らなかった。
pmid-10440784.summary_en: Transvaginal sonography was used to describe 38 small (<3 cm), nonpalpable ovarian dermoid cysts found incidentally in 35 women. Transvaginal ultrasound identified all lesions, whereas abdominal ultrasound detected only 22. Three structural patterns (solid hyperechoic, fluid with a wall echogenic focus, and mixed) were seen, with calcification and acoustic shadowing common. Doppler findings were inconclusive, and all lesions were confirmed benign at surgery.

pmid-10442191.summary_ja: 再発・難治性の胚細胞腫瘍65例に、週1回のm-BOP療法を2次治療として実施した。進行例にはシスプラチンとイホスファミドによる3次治療と大量化学療法による地固め療法を行った。追跡期間中央値33か月で、全体の無増悪生存率は60%であった。m-BOPによる交差耐性は認められなかった。
pmid-10442191.summary_en: This report describes salvage therapy for 65 patients with relapsed or refractory germ-cell tumours who received weekly m-BOP (methotrexate, bleomycin, vincristine, cisplatin). Patients who progressed afterwards received cisplatin/ifosfamide-based chemotherapy, with or without high-dose chemotherapy consolidation. At a median follow-up of 33 months, overall progression-free survival reached 60%, and third-line therapy rescued 15% of progressors. The authors suggest no cross-resistance exists between m-BOP and later regimens.

pmid-10442292.summary_ja: 従来のPVB療法に抵抗性の進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の35歳男性に対し、カルボプラチンとエトポシドによる超大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を2段階で実施した。肺転移出現後は増量し、シクロホスファミドを併用した。維持療法なしで再発は認めていない。治療効果が得られた。
pmid-10442292.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumour (stage IIIC, embryonal carcinoma) was refractory to conventional PVB chemotherapy. He received two-step ultra-high-dose chemotherapy with carboplatin and etoposide, each followed by peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. After lung metastasis developed, doses were escalated, with cyclophosphamide added. He has remained recurrence-free without maintenance therapy.

pmid-10442611.summary_ja: 超音波ガイド下の出生前経皮的ドレナージを、嚢胞性仙尾部奇形腫の2症例に実施した。1例は骨盤位で外回転術の後、経膣分娩に至った。もう1例は正期産の陣発直前に行い、合併症なく経膣分娩に成功した。帝王切開の代替となり得ると著者らは提案しており、母児双方のリスク低減が期待される。
pmid-10442611.summary_en: Two cases of cystic sacrococcygeal teratoma were managed with prenatal percutaneous needle drainage under ultrasound guidance. In the first, a large cystic tumour in a breech fetus prevented external version; drainage at 37 weeks allowed successful version and, after repeat drainage before labor, vaginal delivery. In the second, drainage just before induction at term enabled uncomplicated vaginal delivery. The authors propose this as an alternative to cesarean section.

pmid-10442922.summary_ja: 30年間に小児の精巣・精巣傍腫瘍68例を後方視的に検討した研究。精巣では成熟奇形腫(27例)と卵黄嚢腫瘍(17例)が多く、無痛性陰嚢腫瘤が主な症状だった。良性腫瘍では精巣温存手術を行い再発はなかった。手術と化学療法の併用により予後が改善したと結論づけている。
pmid-10442922.summary_en: This 30-year single-institution review of 68 children with testicular or paratesticular tumours found mature teratoma (n=27) and yolk sac tumour (n=17) to be the most common testicular tumours, with paratesticular rhabdomyosarcoma in 13 patients. Most presented as painless scrotal masses. Testis-sparing surgery for benign tumours caused no recurrence. Deaths were limited to rhabdomyosarcoma patients and one patient with mixed germ cell tumour, suggesting that combined surgery and chemotherapy has improved prognosis. Testis-sparing surgery should be considered for benign lesions.

pmid-10443827.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する頸部郭清術の成績を検討した後方視的研究。頸部再発は4例のみで、平均32か月の追跡で無病生存率は72%だった。術前腫瘍マーカーが陰性の病期III症例は予後良好であった。成熟奇形腫の悪性化を防ぐ有用な治療で、合併症も少ないと結論づけている。
pmid-10443827.summary_en: This retrospective review of 45 men with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumour who underwent 51 neck dissections found recurrence in only four dissected necks. Disease-free survival at a mean follow-up of 32 months was 72%. Patients with stage 3 disease and negative preoperative tumour markers had excellent outcomes, while positive markers, germ cell elements in nodes, and late relapse presenting as a neck mass worsened survival. The authors conclude that neck dissection prevents reversion of mature teratoma to malignant germ cell tumour with minimal morbidity.

pmid-10444127.summary_ja: 1977～1996年に診断された非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍517例の病期分布の推移を、5つの病期分類を用いて検討した研究。Royal Marsden分類の病期Iの割合は33%から61%に増加した。転移例では予後良好群の割合が後期に減少していた。低進展の播種例が病期Iに移行したことが要因と考えられ、治療強度の軽減に寄与しうると結論づけている。
pmid-10444127.summary_en: This single-institution study of 517 men with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours diagnosed from 1977 to 1996 compared stage distribution across five-year periods using five staging classifications. The proportion of Royal Marsden stage I disease increased significantly after 1982, from 33% in 1977-81 to 61% in 1992-96. Among patients with disseminated disease, good-prognosis proportions decreased in later periods under the Indiana and EORTC classifications. The authors attribute the shift to more low-extent disseminated disease being classified as stage I, which may help reduce treatment intensity and long-term toxicity.

pmid-10444128.summary_ja: 1992～1997年に11施設から紹介された精巣腫瘍208検体について、紹介元の病理診断と中央病理再検討を比較した研究。腫瘍型の不一致は12例(6%)で、多くはセミノーマから非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍への変更だった。8例では治療方針が変更された。中央病理再検討の意義を支持する結論となっている。
pmid-10444128.summary_en: This study compared referring-hospital histopathology reports with central review for 208 testicular specimens (201 orchidectomies and seven biopsies) from 11 hospitals over 1992-1997. Tumour type discordance occurred in 12 specimens (6%), most often seminoma reclassified as nonseminomatous germ cell tumour, and treatment changed in eight of these patients. Vascular invasion interpretation disagreed in 20% of nonseminomatous tumours, and differences in recognised tumour elements were frequent. The authors conclude that central review is valuable and consistent with specialist cancer service arrangements.

pmid-10444129.summary_ja: 1984～1996年に地域基幹病院で治療された病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍123例の成績。精巣摘除術後に監視療法を行ったセミノーマ60例では30%、奇形腫31例では48%が再発した。再発例はいずれも化学療法や放射線療法で救済された。専門施設以外でも管理は可能だが、再発率が高く、補助療法の対象となる高リスク患者の同定が課題とされている。
pmid-10444129.summary_en: This study from a district general hospital reviewed 123 men treated for stage I germ cell tumours of the testis between 1984 and 1996. Sixty with seminoma and 31 with teratoma were managed with orchidectomy and surveillance, while 32 with seminoma received adjuvant radiotherapy. Relapse occurred in 30% of seminoma patients under surveillance and 48% of teratoma patients, and all relapses responded to salvage treatment. There were no deaths from disease or treatment. The authors conclude that stage I disease can be managed outside specialist centres, but high relapse rates prompt efforts to identify patients for adjuvant therapy.

pmid-10445309.summary_ja: ダウン症候群と両側停留精巣を有する42歳男性の精巣セミノーマ症例。左精巣摘除術を受けたが、重度の知的障害のため補助化学療法や放射線療法は行われず、後腹膜転移を来して2年後に死亡し、剖検が行われた。文献上の36例では17.1%に停留精巣を合併しており、停留精巣、ダウン症候群、胚細胞腫瘍の関係について考察している。
pmid-10445309.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old institutionalised man with Down syndrome and bilateral undescended testes who developed left testicular seminoma with retroperitoneal metastasis. Because of severe intellectual disability, adjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy were not given. He underwent left radical orchiectomy and died of the cancer two years later; autopsy was performed. The authors review 36 reported cases of testicular tumours associated with Down syndrome, of which 17.1% had cryptorchidism, and discuss the relationship between cryptorchidism, Down syndrome, and germ cell tumours.

pmid-10447009.summary_ja: hCGが弱いTSH作動薬として甲状腺機能に影響することを総説しています。妊娠悪阻や、血清hCGが約200IU/mLを超える胞状奇胎・絨毛癌では甲状腺機能亢進症が生じやすいと述べています。奇胎除去や絨毛癌への化学療法で甲状腺機能亢進症が改善すると報告しています。
pmid-10447009.summary_en: This review examines how human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) acts as a weak thyrotropin agonist and influences thyroid function. It covers hyperemesis gravidarum, where hCG-associated thyroid stimulation is common, and trophoblastic tumors, hydatidiform mole, and choriocarcinoma, which can cause hyperthyroidism when serum hCG exceeds roughly 200 IU/mL. The authors note that mole removal or effective chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma resolves the hyperthyroidism, and that hCG variants with increased thyrotropic potency may explain the thyroid effects. The paper links hCG biology with clinical thyroid dysfunction in gestational disease.

pmid-10451222.summary_ja: 絨毛癌患者由来のhCG（切断型・高糖鎖化）に対するモノクローナル抗体2種を作製しています。一方の抗体は由来を問わずhCGnを認識し、もう一方は糖鎖の違いに感受性を示します。これらを用いた二点免疫測定法は、妊娠hCGと絨毛癌hCGを識別する診断ツールとなる可能性があると述べています。
pmid-10451222.summary_en: This study generated two monoclonal antibodies against a fully nicked, hyperglycosylated form of hCG (hCGn) isolated from a choriocarcinoma patient. One antibody (B151) recognised hCGn regardless of its source, while the other (B152) was sensitive to carbohydrate differences. Two-site immunometric assays built with these antibodies can measure hCG isoforms that were previously hard to quantify. The authors suggest the assays could serve as diagnostic tools that distinguish choriocarcinoma-derived hCG from pregnancy hCG.

pmid-10452908.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株Jeg-3をヌードマウスに皮下移植し、異種移植モデルを確立しています。新生血管ではなく、栄養膜細胞に覆われた血液で満たされた大きな腔(ラクナ)が形成され、腫瘍は速く増大しました。胎盤における栄養膜細胞の血管侵入や内皮置換の研究に有用なモデルであると述べています。
pmid-10452908.summary_en: This study established a xenograft model by injecting the human choriocarcinoma cell line Jeg-3 into nude mice. Unlike non-trophoblastic tumours (Hec-1A and HeLa), which became vascularised through neoangiogenesis, the choriocarcinoma xenografts formed large blood-filled lacunae lined by trophoblast cells. These lacunae arose as tumour cells invaded host vessels and eroded their endothelium, allowing faster expansion with fewer necrotic areas. The authors propose the model for studying trophoblast vessel invasion and endothelial replacement, which mirrors haemochorial placentation.

pmid-10453437.summary_ja: MDアンダーソンがんセンターで、精巣がん患者160例と対照136例を比較した症例対照研究です。総脂肪、飽和脂肪、コレステロール摂取量の多さは非セミノーマのリスク上昇と関連し、混合型胚細胞腫瘍とも関連傾向がありました。若年男性では高脂肪食が精巣がんリスクを高める可能性がありますが、症例数が少ないため前向き研究が必要です。
pmid-10453437.summary_en: This hospital-based case-control study at MD Anderson Cancer Center compared 160 testicular cancer cases with 136 matched controls. After adjustment, higher total fat, saturated fat and cholesterol intake were associated with nonseminoma risk (odds ratios up to 6.3), while seminoma risk rose only marginally. High total fat intake was nearly significantly linked to mixed germ cell tumour risk. The authors suggest diet, particularly high fat intake, may increase testicular cancer risk in young men, but note the small sample size and possible bias, so prospective studies are needed.

pmid-10454682.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の卵巣未熟奇形腫を完全切除した44例で、術後化学療法を行わずに経過を観察しました。4年無イベント生存率は純粋な未熟奇形腫で約98%、卵黄嚢腫瘍の微小病巣を伴う例で100%でした。αフェトプロテイン高値例でも外科的切除のみで治癒が得られ、再発例にのみ化学療法を行うことを提案しています。
pmid-10454682.summary_en: This pediatric intergroup study (INT 0106) examined whether postoperative chemotherapy is needed after complete resection of ovarian immature teratoma in children and adolescents. Among 44 patients treated with surgery alone, 4-year event-free survival was about 98% for pure immature teratoma and 100% for teratoma with yolk sac tumour foci. Elevated alpha-fetoprotein was common, yet surgery alone appeared curative. The authors conclude that most patients can avoid the long-term effects of chemotherapy, reserving adjuvant treatment for those who relapse.

pmid-10458260.summary_ja: 本総説は、MEDLINEから抽出した無作為化試験をもとに、シスプラチンとカルボプラチンの薬理学、毒性、臨床活性を比較したものです。卵巣癌や小細胞肺癌では両者が同等の効果を示しました。一方、胚細胞腫瘍ではカルボプラチンは無再発生存率が低く、シスプラチンに劣ると結論づけられています。頭頸部癌ではシスプラチンが奏効率と生存率で優れていました。
pmid-10458260.summary_en: This review compares the pharmacology, toxicity, and clinical activity of cisplatin and carboplatin through MEDLINE-identified randomized trials spanning ovarian, germ cell, lung, and head and neck cancers. Carboplatin matched cisplatin in suboptimally debulked ovarian cancer and extensive-stage small-cell lung cancer. In germ cell tumors, however, carboplatin was inferior owing to lower relapse-free survival. The authors conclude that carboplatin cannot replace cisplatin across all platinum-sensitive tumors, and that it is inferior in germ cell, head and neck, and esophageal cancers.

pmid-10459352.summary_ja: 本研究は、XY純粋性性腺形成不全の3例を検討したもので、2例は性腺芽腫とそれに伴うディスジャーミノーマを発症していました。PCRとシーケンスにより、Y染色体の欠失およびSRY遺伝子の変異を解析しています。腫瘍を有する1例ではSRYを含むY染色体短腕の潜在性欠失が、別の1例ではHMGボックスの塩基置換と欠失が認められました。SRYが特にディスジャーミノーマを含む性腺腫瘍の形成に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-10459352.summary_en: This study examines three patients with XY pure gonadal dysgenesis, two of whom developed gonadoblastoma with associated dysgerminoma. The authors analyzed Y chromosome deletions and SRY sequence alterations by PCR and sequencing. One patient with a tumor carried a cryptic deletion of the short arm of the Y chromosome including SRY, while another had nucleotide substitutions and a deletion in the HMG-box. The patient without tumor had no SRY alteration. The authors conclude that SRY may contribute to gonadal tumor formation, particularly dysgerminoma.

pmid-10459453.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、まれな卵巣の甲状腺腫性カルチノイドについて、臨床所見、病理組織学的所見、免疫組織化学的所見を記載したものです。神経ペプチドの免疫反応から、腫瘍細胞は中腸由来と考えられました。腫瘍細胞は副甲状腺ホルモン関連蛋白（PTHrp）を発現しており、外科的切除後に血清カルシウム値の低下が認められました。単胚葉性奇形腫の一型である卵巣腫瘍の、特異な生化学的所見が示されています。
pmid-10459453.summary_en: This case report describes a rare ovarian strumal carcinoid with clinical, histological, and immunohistochemical findings. Immunoreactions for neuropeptides suggested that the tumor cells originate from the midgut. The carcinoid cells expressed parathyroid hormone-related protein (PTHrp). After surgical resection, serum calcium levels decreased. The paper highlights an unusual biochemical correlate of this ovarian teratoma-derived neoplasm, which is a monodermal teratoma subtype.

pmid-10460663.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた膠芽腫を報告したものです。10歳の女児は、左前頭葉の原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍を治療された後、6年後に近接部位に膠芽腫を発症しました。さらに6年後には、膠芽腫を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が認められました。卵巣奇形腫内の膠芽腫は稀であり、初発時には脳転移として見える可能性があると指摘されています。
pmid-10460663.summary_en: This case study reports glioblastoma multiforme arising within a mature cystic ovarian teratoma. A 10-year-old girl first had a left frontal primitive neuroectodermal tumor, successfully treated. Six years later she developed glioblastoma near the original site, and six years after that she presented with a mature cystic teratoma containing glioblastoma. The authors note that glioblastoma in an ovarian teratoma is exceptional and may initially present as a metastatic brain tumor. They raise the possibility of a genetic predisposition for recurrent glial tumors.

pmid-10461007.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して広範な手術を受けた32歳女性の症例です。フォローアップ中に無症候性の嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかり、経膣超音波と血清FSH測定により過剰卵巣と診断されました。患者が腫瘤の摘出を拒否したため、組織学的確認はできていません。嚢胞性病変の変化は血清FSH値の変動と一致し、卵黄嚢腫瘍の再発や転移は認められませんでした。
pmid-10461007.summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old woman who underwent extensive surgery for ovarian yolk sac tumor and later had an asymptomatic cystic mass found on follow-up. Transvaginal ultrasound and serum FSH measurement helped identify a supernumerary ovary. Histological confirmation was not possible because the patient declined removal of the mass. The cystic changes correlated with serum FSH fluctuations, supporting the diagnosis. There was no evidence of recurrence or metastasis of the yolk sac tumor during follow-up.

pmid-10463590.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常胎盤と3種類の絨毛癌細胞株で糖鎖合成酵素の活性とmRNA発現を比較しています。絨毛癌細胞株ではGnT-IVとGnT-IIIの活性が大幅に上昇し、特にGnT-IVaが高発現していました。著者らは、この異所性発現が絨毛癌患者の尿中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)にみられる異常な二分岐糖鎖の酵素的基盤である可能性を提案しています。
pmid-10463590.summary_en: This study compares glycosyltransferase activities and mRNA levels in normal placentae with three human choriocarcinoma cell lines. GnT-IV and GnT-III activities were markedly elevated in the cancer lines, with GnT-IVa strongly expressed while GnT-IVb remained constant. The authors propose that ectopic GnT-IVa expression accompanies trophoblastic malignancy and underlies the abnormal biantennary sugar chains on hCG in choriocarcinoma patients' urine. The findings suggest a possible enzymatic basis for these aberrant glycoforms.

pmid-10463776.summary_ja: 本研究は、同一起源で放射線感受性が異なるラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株2種の熱感受性と熱耐性を比較しています。放射線感受性株NMT-1は、放射線抵抗性株NMT-1Rより熱に強い傾向が一貫して見られました。両株とも43℃予備加熱後に熱耐性を獲得し、HSP70の蓄積と相関していました。放射線感受性と熱感受性は単純には連動しないことが示唆されます。
pmid-10463776.summary_en: The authors compare two rat yolk sac tumour cell lines of common origin that differ in radiosensitivity, asking whether radiosensitivity predicts heat sensitivity. The radiosensitive NMT-1 line was consistently less heat sensitive than the radioresistant NMT-1R. Thermotolerance developed after 43°C preheating, peaking at 6 h in NMT-1 and 12 h in NMT-1R, and persisted for at least 48 h. HSP70 accumulation correlated with thermotolerance in both lines. The results suggest radiosensitivity and thermal sensitivity are not simply cross-linked.

pmid-10465338.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣がん患者の末梢血中に循環する悪性細胞を、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)遺伝子発現を指標としたネステッドRT-PCRで検出する高感度法を報告しています。末梢血単核球100万個中に1個の腫瘍細胞を検出できたとしています。末梢血幹細胞移植における移植片中の悪性細胞による再発リスクへの応用を念頭に置いています。
pmid-10465338.summary_en: The authors develop a sensitive nested RT-PCR assay measuring alpha-fetoprotein gene expression to detect circulating malignant cells in the peripheral blood of patients with testicular cancer. The method detects a single cancer cell among one million peripheral blood mononuclear cells. The authors frame this as relevant to peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, where malignant cells in grafts pose a risk of recurrence. It is presented as the first attempt to detect circulating testicular cancer cells by nested RT-PCR.

pmid-10467793.summary_ja: 妊娠を継続している症例で、絨毛癌の膣転移による妊娠中の出血を来した患者を報告しています。分娩後に化学療法と手術により良好な治療経過が得られました。まれな病態の非典型的な提示様式を示し、関連文献の概説を加えています。妊娠中の不正出血では絨毛癌の転移も念頭に置くべきことを示す症例です。
pmid-10467793.summary_en: The authors report a patient with antepartum haemorrhage caused by a vaginal metastasis of choriocarcinoma that coexisted with an intact pregnancy. After delivery, she was treated successfully with chemotherapy and surgery. The report highlights this unusual presentation of a rare condition and reviews the relevant literature. The case illustrates how choriocarcinoma may first present with vaginal bleeding during pregnancy.

pmid-10468310.summary_ja: 英国のケースコントロール研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍を組織型別にリスク因子を比較しています。停留精巣はセミノーマで非セミノーマより強い関連を示し、特に32歳以上で差が大きいと報告されています。精巣・鼠径部外傷や性感染症は非セミノーマで高いリスクでした。セミノーマと停留精巣の強い関連は、病因の違いを反映する可能性があると著者は考察しています。
pmid-10468310.summary_en: This UK case-control study compares risk factors for testicular germ cell tumours by histological type, analysing 794 matched case-control pairs, including 400 pure seminomas and 394 other histologies. Undescended testis was more strongly associated with seminoma (odds ratio 5.3 versus 3.0), with the difference greatest in men aged 32 and over. Testicular or groin injury, sexually transmitted disease, and sports participation showed associations differing by histology. The authors suggest the stronger undescended testis link may reflect a genuine aetiological difference.

pmid-10468336.summary_ja: 閉経前女性の卵巣嚢胞手術症例を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。術前経腟超音波検査の所見と病理診断を比較し、子宮内膜腫は約85%、成熟奇形腫は約86%で正確に予測された。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は超音波で中程度の精度で予測可能と結論づけている（漿液性嚢胞腺腫は80%）。
pmid-10468336.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study of 120 premenopausal women who underwent surgery for ovarian cysts assessed how accurately preoperative transvaginal ultrasound predicted histopathology. Endometriomas and mature teratomas were the most common confirmed diagnoses. Ultrasound impressions were accurate in most cases, at about 85% for endometrioma, 86% for mature teratoma and 80% for serous cystadenoma. The authors conclude that endometriomas and mature cystic teratomas can be predicted with moderate accuracy by preoperative ultrasound.

pmid-10469400.summary_ja: 56歳男性の胃卵黄嚢腫瘍（腺癌成分を伴う）の症例報告。両成分の移行領域が認められ、免疫組織化学ではαフェトプロテイン(AFP)やPLAPは卵黄嚢成分に、CEAは腺癌成分に発現した。両者は卵黄嚢と胃粘膜の表現型を併せ持つ多分化能の腫瘍細胞に由来すると考察している。
pmid-10469400.summary_en: A case report of a 56-year-old man with a gastric yolk sac tumor containing an adenocarcinomatous component. Histology showed a transitional zone between the yolk sac and glandular elements. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated AFP, PLAP and cytokeratin expression in the yolk sac tumor, while the adenocarcinoma was CEA positive and AFP negative. The authors propose that both components arose from multipotential neoplastic mucosal epithelial cells with yolk sac and gastric mucosal phenotypes.

pmid-10469692.summary_ja: 良性嚢胞性奇形腫の手術158例（178個）を対象とした後方視的コホート研究。術中漏出は178個中63個（約35%）に生じた。腹腔鏡経験の豊富な術者（年35件超）では漏出率が低く（26.1%対51.2%）、卵巣摘出も漏出を減らした。年齢や腫瘍径は漏出と関連しなかった。
pmid-10469692.summary_en: A retrospective cohort of 158 women undergoing surgery for 178 benign cystic teratomas examined factors associated with intraoperative cyst leakage during laparoscopy and laparotomy. Leakage occurred in 63 of 178 cysts (about 35%). Surgeons with greater laparoscopic experience (more than 35 procedures per year) had fewer leaks than less experienced surgeons (26.1% versus 51.2%), and oophorectomy reduced leakage. Patient age, preoperative size and surgical technique were not associated with leakage.

pmid-10470227.summary_ja: 後腹膜皮様嚢腫（良性奇形腫）を有し、CA 19-9が持続的に高値を示した症例報告。他の腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内だった。I-131標識抗CA 19-9抗体を用いた免疫シンチグラフィとSPECTで、CA 19-9上昇の起源が後腹膜腫瘤と特定された。英語文献で初の報告とされる。
pmid-10470227.summary_en: A case report describing a patient with a large retroperitoneal dermoid (benign teratoma) and persistently elevated serum CA 19-9, ranging from 131 to 329 U/ml, while other tumor markers and laboratory values remained normal. Malignant and other benign disease were excluded, and CT-guided fine needle biopsy showed a benign dermoid. Immunoscintigraphy and SPECT with an I-131-labeled anti-CA 19-9 antibody localized the source of the elevation to the retroperitoneal mass. The authors report this as the first such case in the English literature.

pmid-10472331.summary_ja: 原発不明の転移性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法に不応の21歳男性の症例報告。触診・超音波検査で異常のない精巣に対し、抗αフェトプロテイン(AFP)抗体シンチグラフィーを施行し、原発巣を左精巣と同定した。左精巣摘除術とリンパ節切除を行い、性腺機能低下症を回避して救命できた。
pmid-10472331.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with metastatic germ cell tumor of unknown primary, unresponsive to chemotherapy, was scheduled for blind bilateral orchiectomy despite normal palpation and ultrasonography. Anti-AFP antibody scintigraphy identified the left testis as the primary site. Left orchiectomy and lymph node removal were performed. Histology showed in situ carcinoma in the testis and mixed tumor in the nodes. The approach located the primary and avoided hypogonadism.

pmid-10472566.summary_ja: 1982〜1997年のドイツMAHO共同研究で登録された小児精巣胚細胞腫瘍197例の解析。AFP産生性の病期IA腫瘍では半精巣摘除後の経過観察が安全で、無病生存率は99%であった。化学療法単独で良好な成績が得られ、X線照射や一次リンパ節郭清は省略可能と結論された。
pmid-10472566.summary_en: This German MAHO cooperative study analyzed 197 children with testicular germ cell tumors treated from 1982 to 1997. Most were stage I yolk sac tumors. AFP-producing stage IA tumors were managed with wait-and-see after semicastration, with 99% no evidence of disease. Chemotherapy alone yielded excellent results, so X-ray irradiation and primary lymphadenectomy could be omitted.

pmid-10473019.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療をまとめた総説。全生存率は約90〜95%とされる。臨床病期Iのセミノーマや非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療選択肢を整理し、PEB療法や大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植の位置づけを述べる。長期毒性にも言及。
pmid-10473019.summary_en: This review summarizes diagnosis and treatment of testicular germ cell tumors, which have an overall survival of about 90 to 95%. It covers management options for clinical stage I seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, radiotherapy for stage IIA/B seminoma, and PEB chemotherapy for good-risk metastatic disease. High-dose chemotherapy with stem cell transplantation is discussed for poor-risk or relapsed disease, along with long-term toxicities.

pmid-10475370.summary_ja: 1971年から1991年の間に病期I・IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた88例を後方視的に検討した。最低5年の追跡で6例に後腹膜再発を認めた。全例が左側原発で、腎門部付近または郭清範囲外に再発していた。腎門部のより完全な郭清により局所再発を減らせる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10475370.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 88 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) for stage I or II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 1971 and 1991. Six patients, about 7 percent, developed retroperitoneal recurrence after a minimum follow-up of five years. All recurrences involved left-sided primaries and occurred near the renal hila or outside the surgical boundaries. The authors suggest that more complete bilateral dissection of the renal hila might reduce local failure. Modified RPLND nonetheless remains reliable for removing metastatic tumor.

pmid-10477890.summary_ja: 34歳妊婦の胎児において、超音波で口腔から突出する鼻咽頭奇形腫を出生前に検出した症例報告である。母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値であった。臍帯動脈ドプラ波形に異常を認め、胎児は子宮内で死亡した。剖検で鼻咽頭奇形腫と確定した。母体AFP上昇と胎児超音波所見の組み合わせが性腺外奇形腫の出生前診断に有用であることを示す。
pmid-10477890.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal sonographic detection of a nasopharyngeal teratoma in the fetus of a 34-year-old pregnant woman. Maternal serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated, and ultrasound showed a semisolid mass protruding from the fetal oral cavity that filled the oropharynx and nasopharynx. Abnormal umbilical artery Doppler waveforms were observed, and the fetus died in utero. Postmortem examination confirmed a nasopharyngeal teratoma. The case highlights the value of combining elevated maternal AFP with fetal ultrasound findings for prenatal detection of extragonadal teratoma.

pmid-10478675.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の内部に生じた微小嚢胞性髄膜腫を記述している。精巣腫瘍は主に成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫からなり、セミノーマと胎児性癌の成分を伴っていた。髄膜腫成分は上皮膜抗原に陽性を示し、サイトケラチン、第VIII因子、CD31、αフェトプロテインには陰性であった。著者らは、性腺または性腺外部位の奇形腫に髄膜腫が生じた初の報告と考えている。精巣奇形腫内の非胚細胞腫瘍の認識は予後上重要であると論じている。
pmid-10478675.summary_en: This case report describes a microcystic meningioma arising within a mixed germ cell tumor of the testis. The testicular tumor was predominantly composed of mature and immature teratoma, with components of seminoma and embryonal carcinoma. The meningiomatous component stained positive for epithelial membrane antigen and negative for cytokeratin, factor VIII, CD31, and alpha-fetoprotein. The authors believe this is the first reported meningioma arising in a teratoma at a gonadal or extragonadal site. They argue that recognizing a non-germ cell tumor within a testicular teratoma may be prognostically important.

pmid-10479522.summary_ja: 21トリソミーの13歳女児に発生した骨盤内複雑腫瘤の症例報告である。切除と完全な病期分類により、完全切除された病期IIIC卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を3サイクル施行し、1年後も無病であった。ダウン症候群の女性では胚細胞腫瘍が増加する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-10479522.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with trisomy 21 who presented with a complex pelvic mass. Resection and complete staging revealed a completely resected stage IIIC ovarian dysgerminoma. She received three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy and remained disease-free at one year. The authors present this association as a rare case that may reflect an increased incidence of germ cell neoplasms in females with Down syndrome. They note that seminoma in males with trisomy 21 is well documented, whereas dysgerminoma in females has been reported infrequently.

pmid-10480304.summary_ja: 20歳男性が縦隔未熟奇形腫の破裂により自然血胸を発症し、右胸腔へ自然出血した。生命を脅かす合併症のため緊急手術が必要となった。自然血胸のまれな原因と臨床経過を報告し、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍が致死的な出血を来しうることを示している。手術で止血と腫瘍切除が行われた。
pmid-10480304.summary_en: A 20-year-old man presented with spontaneous hemothorax caused by rupture of an immature teratoma of the mediastinum, which bled spontaneously into the right pleural space. The life-threatening complication required emergency surgery to control the bleeding and remove the tumor. The authors describe this unusual cause of spontaneous hemothorax and its clinical course, highlighting that mediastinal germ cell tumors can present with catastrophic bleeding.

pmid-10480350.summary_ja: ヒトHRAD17とマウスMrad17遺伝子の構造と局在を同定した。精巣で最も高発現し、正常精巣の精細管胚上皮では強い発現を示した一方、セミノーマでは弱くびまん性の発現にとどまった。チェックポイント機能から、HRAD17が精巣腫瘍発生に関与する可能性を提唱している。この発現低下はセミノーマの腫瘍発生との関連を示唆する。
pmid-10480350.summary_en: The authors identified and characterized the human HRAD17 gene and its mouse orthologue Mrad17, including chromosomal localization, exon-intron structure, and pseudogenes. Expression was highest in testis. In situ hybridization showed strong HRAD17 signal in normal seminiferous tubule germinal epithelium but only weak, diffuse signal in seminomas. Given its role in meiotic and mitotic checkpoints, the authors propose that HRAD17 may contribute to testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-10481424.summary_ja: 新生児の咽頭奇形腫（エピグナサス）症例で、気道閉塞に対する麻酔管理を報告した。マスク換気・喉頭鏡が不可能と判断され、表面麻酔下の経鼻ファイバー挿管で気道を確保した。生後5日目に腫瘍を切除し、術後3日目に抜管した。術前の慎重な気道評価が重要と結論している。
pmid-10481424.summary_en: The authors describe anesthetic management of a newborn with epignathus, a rare pharyngeal teratoma that causes high neonatal mortality through airway obstruction. The tumor arose from the palate and filled the oral cavity. Mask ventilation and laryngoscopy were judged impossible, so fiberoptic nasal intubation was performed under topical anesthesia without sedation. The tumor was resected on day five with 103 g of blood loss, and the trachea was extubated on postoperative day three. The authors stress careful preoperative airway assessment.

pmid-10482487.summary_ja: ノルウェーのがん登録データ（1953〜1993年）をフレイルティモデルで解析した。出生時に決まる感受性の高い男性群を仮定し、精巣がんの罹患率の上昇と若年層での発症ピークを説明した。罹患率の急増は胎児期に作用する環境因子の関与を示唆する。モデルは良好に適合した。
pmid-10482487.summary_en: The authors fit a frailty model to Norwegian Cancer Registry incidence data for testicular cancer from 1953 to 1993. The model assumes a susceptible subgroup of men, determined at birth by genetic and environmental factors. It captures the strong rise in incidence over calendar time, suggesting strong environmental effects acting in fetal life, and the peak in younger men followed by decline with age. The model fits the data well, and the authors discuss its interpretation.

pmid-10483591.summary_ja: インディアナ大学での縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の経験を報告した。本腫瘍は肉腫性腫瘍および血液腫瘍の両方と関連することが特徴である。その発生機序、特に血液腫瘍との関連について考察している。抄録のみで定量データは示されていない。縦隔腫瘍の診療における留意点となりうる。
pmid-10483591.summary_en: The authors report their institutional experience with mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, which are unusual because they are associated with both sarcomatous and hematologic neoplasms. The paper discusses possible mechanisms underlying these associations, particularly the link with hematologic malignancies. It is a brief report from Indiana University, and the abstract contains no quantitative data. Clinicians managing mediastinal germ cell tumors may find the association relevant for follow-up and risk awareness.

pmid-10485624.summary_ja: 20年間に治療した非肺性内臓転移性セミノーマ15例を検討した。精巣セミノーマ686例中2.2%であった。進行例の化学療法後の無増悪生存期間中央値は19か月で、40%が生存した。化学療法レジメンの選択で予後の差は明らかでなく、新たな戦略を含む多様式治療の必要性を結論している。
pmid-10485624.summary_en: The authors reviewed 15 patients with nonpulmonary visceral metastatic testicular seminoma treated over 20 years, representing 2.2% of 686 testicular seminoma cases. All had lymph node metastasis, mostly retroperitoneal. Median progression-free survival after chemotherapy for advanced disease was 19 months. Six patients (40%) survived, five relapsed after radiation therapy, and four died of chemorefractory disease. The authors conclude that the choice of chemotherapy regimen did not clearly change outcome, supporting multimodality therapy with new strategies.

pmid-10486475.summary_ja: デンマークの全国コホート研究で、胞状奇胎の女性1520例と男性パートナー1295例のがんリスクを検討した。妊娠性絨毛癌は期待値0.04に対し19例と有意に増加した一方、他のがん種や男性パートナーでは増加は認められなかった。胞状奇胎は妊娠性絨毛癌以外のがんリスク上昇とは関連しないと結論された。
pmid-10486475.summary_en: This nationwide Danish cohort study of 1,520 women with molar pregnancy and their 1,295 male partners assessed cancer risk using national registries. Gestational choriocarcinoma occurred 19 times versus 0.04 expected, a markedly elevated risk, while overall cancer incidence for other types and cancers in male partners were not increased. The authors conclude that molar pregnancy is not associated with increased risk for cancers other than gestational carcinoma.

pmid-10487615.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍41例でγグルタミルトランスペプチダーゼ(GGT)の発現を免疫染色で検討し、白金製剤による治療反応と比較した。GGTはセミノーマとディスジャーミノーマでは陰性、卵黄嚢腫瘍と胎児性癌では陽性であったが、治療反応との相関は認められなかった。GGTはシスプラチンの治療効果に必要ではなく、GGT阻害は抗腫瘍効果を損なわずに腎毒性を抑制しうると示唆された。
pmid-10487615.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry for gamma-glutamyl transpeptidase (GGT) was performed on 41 human germ cell tumours treated with platinum-based chemotherapy. GGT was absent in seminomas and dysgerminomas but present in yolk sac tumours and embryonal carcinomas, yet complete responses to cisplatin-based chemotherapy occurred regardless of GGT status in most patients. GGT expression is therefore not necessary for cisplatin efficacy, suggesting GGT inhibition could reduce nephrotoxicity without compromising antitumour activity.

pmid-10493045.summary_ja: 38歳女性が30日間の間欠的な発熱を呈し、開腹術で巨大な骨盤内腫瘍と、感染を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫が見つかった。病理学的には大腸菌による二次感染を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。摘出と抗菌薬治療により、術後5日目に解熱した。長期間続く発熱では、鑑別診断として卵管卵巣膿瘍も考慮すべきと述べられている。
pmid-10493045.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman had 30 days of intermittent fever without a clear source. Laparotomy revealed a large pelvic tumor and an infected ovarian dermoid cyst, and pathology showed mature teratoma with Escherichia coli superinfection. Fever resolved by postoperative day five after extirpation and antibiotic treatment. The authors note this is a rare presentation and that persistent fever warrants specialist evaluation, including tubo-ovarian abscess in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-10493530.summary_ja: TRA-1-60は胎児性癌細胞および胚細胞腫瘍に発現する細胞表面抗原である。胎児性癌細胞株と臨床検体ではウェスタンブロットで検出され、純粋なセミノーマでは弱い発現が見られた。生化学的解析により、シアル酸修飾を受けたケラタン硫酸プロテオグリカンであることが示され、TRA-1-81・GCTM2・K21と同じ分子のエピトープを共有していた。ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)やαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇しない患者で、補完的な血清マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-10493530.summary_en: TRA-1-60 is a cell-surface antigen expressed by human embryonal carcinoma cells and germ cell tumors. Western blot showed it in all EC cell lines and in clinical GCT specimens, with fainter expression in pure seminoma. Biochemical analyses showed it is a sialylated keratan sulfate proteoglycan that shares epitopes with TRA-1-81, GCTM2 and K21 antigens. The antigen may complement serum hCG and AFP as a marker in patients without elevated conventional markers.

pmid-10494291.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質腫瘍の病理分類について概説した総説。治療と予後は正確な分類に依存するため、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍、性索間質腫瘍、転移性病変を鑑別することが重要である。組織学的所見、血清腫瘍マーカー、免疫組織化学が診断に有用とされる。
pmid-10494291.summary_en: This review addresses the classification and pathology of testicular germ cell tumors and sex cord-stromal tumors. Seminoma must be distinguished from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, as well as from sex cord-stromal tumors and metastatic lesions, because therapy and prognosis depend on accurate classification. The authors emphasize histologic features, serum tumor markers, and immunohistochemistry as diagnostic aids. They also note that urologists can provide clinical information that helps pathologists reach the correct diagnosis.

pmid-10494292.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍における病理学的リスク評価について論じた総説。精巣内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)を生検で同定すると、治療しない限り浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍の高リスク群を特定できる。臨床病期Iの腫瘍では潜在性転移のリスクを層別化し、介入か経過観察かの判断に役立つ。化学療法後病変の正確な分類は、再発リスクの評価に有用である。
pmid-10494292.summary_en: This review examines how pathology defines risk in testicular tumors. Identification of intratubular germ cell neoplasia on biopsy identifies patients at high risk of invasive germ cell tumor unless treated. The method is ineffective in prepubertal patients, except those with intersex syndromes. Pathologic analysis of clinical stage I tumors may stratify patients into high- and low-risk groups for occult metastases, guiding intervention or surveillance. Accurate classification of postchemotherapy lesions helps assess the risk of recurrence and progressive tumor.

pmid-10500969.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分子病期分類に、MAGE1-3およびWT1遺伝子の発現が利用できるかを検討した研究。MAGEはセミノーマの大半と一部の非セミノーマで発現したが病期とは相関しなかった。WT1は高病期の腫瘍で高頻度に発現した。現時点では臨床応用には至らないと結論している。
pmid-10500969.summary_en: This study tests whether MAGE1-3 and WT1 gene expression can serve as molecular markers for staging testicular germ cell tumors. MAGE expression was found in most seminomas and in some nonseminomas, but did not correlate with tumor stage. WT1 was expressed more often in high-stage tumors, and mRNA was not detected in the peripheral blood of high-stage patients. The authors suggest MAGE may be useful for molecular staging of seminoma, and WT1 for high-stage tumors, but neither is yet ready for clinical use.

pmid-10501837.summary_ja: C57BL/6マウスで胎児性癌細胞株F9の腫瘍形成を抑制する単一遺伝子座Gt(B6)の染色体上の位置を決定した研究。F2マウス463匹の解析により、第8染色体の10cM未満の領域に座位することを示した。MHCクラスI欠損の胎児性癌細胞に対する同種移植拒絶の機構の理解に寄与する。
pmid-10501837.summary_en: This study maps the Gt(B6) locus, a single gene conferring resistance to F9 embryonal carcinoma tumor formation in C57BL/6 mice. Of 463 (C57BL/6x129)F2 mice challenged with F9 cells, 78 were tumor-resistant. Candidate regions on chromosome 17 (H2) and chromosome 2 showed no linkage. A genome-wide scan implicated chromosome 8, and Gt(B6) was mapped to a region under 10 cM on its medial portion. The work relates to allograft rejection of MHC class I-deficient embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-10502447.summary_ja: 膣および肺に転移を伴う悪性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の33歳女性の症例報告。流産と誤診され診断が9か月遅れた。子宮全摘術、膣病変切除、EMA/CO化学療法6コースを行い、hCGは正常化し、39か月後も無病生存を維持している。転移性PSTTには減量手術と補助化学療法の併用が推奨されると結論している。
pmid-10502447.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with malignant placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) metastatic to the vagina and lung. Diagnosis was delayed nine months after symptoms were mistaken for spontaneous abortion. Treatment combined hysterectomy with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, repeated vaginal resections, and six cycles of EMA/CO chemotherapy. hCG normalized, and the patient remained disease-free at 39 months. The authors review the literature and recommend cytoreductive surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy for metastatic PSTT.

pmid-10504533.summary_ja: 33歳男性の右精巣に発生した7cmの管状セミノーマの症例報告。腫瘍細胞の多くは充実性または管状に配列し、古典的セミノーマの形態を示した。腫瘍面積の約5%に管内異型胚細胞が認められた。免疫組織化学では胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとビメンチンがびまん性に陽性、サイトケラチンは限局的に陽性であった。まれな変異型であり、鑑別診断を考察している。
pmid-10504533.summary_en: A 33-year-old man presented with a 7 cm right testicular tubular seminoma. Most tumor cells formed solid or tubular patterns and showed classic seminoma morphology, with about 5% intratubular atypical germ cells. Immunohistochemistry was diffusely positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and vimentin, with focal cytokeratin positivity. The authors confirm the diagnosis and discuss the differential diagnosis of this rare seminoma variant.
