For malignant disease, chemotherapy is the treatment of choice: single agents for non-metastatic and low-risk metastatic disease, and combination chemotherapy for high-risk metastatic disease. Judicious use of surgery and radiotherapy may improve survival, with cure rates near 100% in the low-risk group and 80 to 85% in the high-risk group.

pmid-9922205.summary_ja: 多施設後方視的研究で、組織学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫12例のMR画像を検討した。全例で嚢胞成分と充実成分があり、多房性で表面は多葉状、隔壁は肥厚していた。T2強調像では主に高信号、T1強調像の信号は多様であった。粘稠なゼラチン様物質がT1で低信号、T2で無信号〜低信号を示した。
pmid-9922205.summary_en: This multi-institutional retrospective study reviewed MR images of 12 patients with histologically proven struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma composed mainly of thyroid tissue. All lesions had both cystic and solid components, with multilobulated surfaces and thickened septa. T2-weighted images were mostly high signal, and T1 signals varied. Contrast enhancement of solid components was marked or moderate. Viscid gelatinous material produced low T1 and low or void T2 signal. The authors propose that a multicystic tumor with a solid component, multilobulated surface, and these signal features is characteristic of struma ovarii.

pmid-9930258.summary_ja: 南アフリカのRed Cross War Memorial Children's Hospitalで1980～1996年に治療された仙尾部胚細胞腫瘍27例の後方視的検討。新生児期発症が多く、奇形腫は完全切除のみで治癒した。1歳以降の診断例は悪性が多く、再発例も再手術と化学療法で救済された。完全切除の重要性が示された。
pmid-9930258.summary_en: This retrospective review of 27 children treated at the Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital in South Africa from 1980 to 1996 examines sacrococcygeal germ cell tumours. Most patients presented in the neonatal period, and all mature or immature teratomas were cured with complete surgical resection alone. Malignant tumours were more frequent in children diagnosed after age one. Relapses, including yolk sac tumour recurrence after resection of a mature teratoma, were salvaged with repeat surgery and chemotherapy. The authors stress the value of complete resection.

pmid-9932165.summary_ja: 縦隔浸潤を伴うディスジャーミノーマの30歳男性が、治療中に孤立性乳び心膜を発症した症例報告。乳び心膜の病因・診断・新たな治療法を文献的に概観している。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍に伴う稀な合併症として認識すべきことを示している。
pmid-9932165.summary_en: A 30-year-old man with dysgerminoma involving the mediastinum developed an isolated chylopericardium during treatment. The report combines a case presentation with a review of the etiology, diagnosis, and emerging treatment approaches for chylopericardium. Neoplastic causes, such as mediastinal germ cell tumours, should be considered when chylopericardium occurs. The paper is brief and focuses on recognizing this rare complication rather than reporting outcome data. It is relevant to clinicians managing mediastinal germ cell tumours.

pmid-9932638.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の17歳男児で、化学療法後に脾臓の多発結節が転移と疑われたが、切除標本では海綿状血管腫だった。患者は19か月後に胚細胞腫瘍の再発で死亡し、剖検で肺と肝臓にも同様の血管腫が認められた。極めて稀な合併例であり、転移の画像診断で注意すべき点を示している。
pmid-9932638.summary_en: A 17-year-old boy with mediastinal germ cell tumour developed multiple splenic nodules three weeks after chemotherapy, initially suspected to be metastases. Resection showed cavernous hemangiomas instead. He died of germ cell tumour recurrence 19 months after initial treatment, and autopsy revealed similar hemangiomas in the lung and liver. This extremely rare coexistence can complicate imaging interpretation of metastatic disease in germ cell tumour patients.

pmid-9934714.summary_ja: ノルウェーで1967～1995年に出生した約87万人の男性を対象に、精巣がんの出生前・周産期の危険因子を検討した。新生児黄疸は非セミノーマのリスク上昇と関連し、妊娠前の母体疾患は特に5歳未満で関連が強かった。胎盤遺残はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方と関連した。胎児期の免疫反応などの関与が示唆されている。
pmid-9934714.summary_en: This prospective register-based study of 868,068 Norwegian males born 1967 to 1995 examined pre- and perinatal risk factors for testicular cancer. Neonatal jaundice was linked to non-seminoma risk, and maternal disease before pregnancy was associated with testicular cancer, especially in children under 5. Retained placenta was associated with both seminoma and non-seminoma. Lower parity showed an inverse trend. The authors suggest fetal immune reactions and estrogen exposure may contribute to development.

pmid-9934803.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍122例の後方視的検討で、病期Iセミノーマの精巣摘除前β-hCG上昇の予後的意義を評価した。β-hCG陽性は局所進行との有意な関連がなかった。再発は1例のみで、その患者のβ-hCGは正常だった。少数例の検討だが、β-hCG陽性例には横隔膜下放射線療法が有用かもしれないと示唆された。
pmid-9934803.summary_en: This retrospective review of 122 patients with testicular germ cell tumour assessed whether preorchiectomy β-hCG elevation in stage I seminoma affects prognosis. Among 55 stage I seminoma patients, 29 of 54 tested had elevated β-hCG, with no significant association with locally progressive cancer. Treatment was radiotherapy for β-hCG-negative cases and chemotherapy or radiotherapy for positive cases. One recurrence occurred in a patient with normal β-hCG. The authors suggest infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy may suit β-hCG-positive cases, though the series is small.

pmid-9990218.summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫の女児に対する周産期および麻酔管理の症例報告。妊娠34週に尿路閉塞解除のため胎児膀胱穿刺を行ったが、出生後に尿の腹腔内漏出による腹水が生じた。生後2日目の腫瘍摘出は合併症なく完遂された。大量出血、凝固障害、動静脈瘻による高拍出性心不全などの術前リスク評価の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9990218.summary_en: This case report from Japan describes perinatal and anesthetic management of a female neonate with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Fetal bladder puncture was performed at 34 weeks to relieve urinary obstruction, but urine leakage caused postnatal ascites. After cesarean delivery, tumour resection was done on day 2 without complications. The authors emphasize preoperative assessment of risks, including exsanguinating hemorrhage, coagulopathy, and high-output heart failure from arteriovenous fistulae.

pmid-9990229.summary_ja: 化学療法抵抗性の精巣がんで、脳と肺に転移した29歳男性の症例報告。肺転移の楔状切除では胎児性癌が確認された。全脳照射とVIP化学療法で腫瘍は縮小しhCG値も正常化し、脳病変の救済手術では壊死が確認された。治療終了後24か月間再発はなく、難治例に対する救済療法の有効性を示した。
pmid-9990229.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with chemorefractory testicular cancer and a solitary brain metastasis plus lung metastases achieved long-term remission after multimodal therapy. Wedge resection of lung metastases showed embryonal carcinoma. Whole brain irradiation with VIP chemotherapy produced tumour regression and normalized hCG. Salvage surgery of the brain lesion showed necrosis. The patient remained free of recurrence 24 months after completing treatment, illustrating a salvage strategy for advanced refractory disease.

pmid-9990484.summary_ja: 未分化腫瘍の胚細胞起源を判定するため、パラフィン包埋検体で12p増加を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法により検出した予備的研究。既知の精巣GCT 3例と、組織発生不明の7例を解析した。3例で12p増加がみられ、臨床経過とおおむね一致した。12p増加がないことは胚細胞腫瘍を否定しないが、診断への有用性が示された。
pmid-9990484.summary_en: This preliminary study used comparative genomic hybridization on paraffin-embedded samples to detect 12p gain, a marker of testicular germ cell tumour origin. Frozen and paraffin specimens from three known testicular GCTs were compared, and seven undifferentiated tumours of uncertain histogenesis were then analyzed. Three showed 12p gain, suggesting germ cell origin, and their clinical course broadly matched. Absence of 12p gain does not exclude GCT. The approach may aid diagnosis in patients with undifferentiated carcinoma.

pmid-10612460.summary_ja: ヒト多能性奇形癌幹細胞株GCT 27X-1をBMP-2で処理した基礎研究である。BMP-2は増殖を抑制し、CD30やOct-4の発現を低下させた。分化細胞は内胚葉前駆細胞のマーカー発現を示した。腫瘍の臨床知見ではなく、初期ヒト胚発生と細胞分化のモデルとしての報告である。
pmid-10612460.summary_en: The human pluripotent teratocarcinoma stem cell line GCT 27X-1 was treated with bone morphogenetic protein-2 (BMP-2). BMP-2 reduced proliferation, induced morphological changes similar to retinoic acid, and decreased expression of the stem cell markers CD30 and Oct-4. Differentiated cells showed a pattern of endodermal precursor markers. The authors suggest such models may help study early human embryonic development and directed differentiation for transplantation. The study uses the cell line as an in vitro developmental model rather than addressing tumor biology or clinical management.

pmid-17171055.summary_ja: 本論文は、報告されている中で最年少の患者の中耳に生じた先天性類皮嚢腫を報告している。病変は乳突蜂巣に直接及んでいなかった。組織学的には表皮成分と中胚葉成分に加え、内胚葉由来の構造も認められた。中耳粘膜は全体が内胚葉由来であるため、病変を奇形腫と厳密に分類することは不正確であると著者らは考察している。胎生期の発生起源についても議論している。
pmid-17171055.summary_en: The authors report a congenital dermoid cyst in the middle ear of the youngest patient reported to date. The lesion did not directly involve the mastoid. Histology showed epidermal and mesodermal elements as well as structures of endodermal descent. Because the entire middle ear mucosa is endodermal in origin, the authors argue that classifying the lesion specifically as a teratoma would be imprecise. Possible embryologic sites of origin are discussed.

pmid-9457058.summary_ja: β1インテグリン欠損のマウス胚性幹細胞から生じた奇形腫は、正常細胞由来より小さく形成頻度も低いものでした。基底膜は乱れ、ラミニン-1は90%以上、ニドゲンは70%減少していました。これにより基底膜の形成が障害されることが示されました。本研究は奇形腫モデルを用いた基礎研究であり、ヒトの胚細胞腫瘍を直接対象としたものではありません。
pmid-9457058.summary_en: Mouse teratomas formed from beta1 integrin-deficient embryonic stem cells were smaller and less frequent than wild-type teratomas. Immunofluorescence and electron microscopy showed disorganized basement membranes with gaps and multilaminar deposits. Quantitative assays revealed over 90% loss of laminin-1 and 70% loss of nidogen, impairing laminin-nidogen complex formation. The authors conclude beta1 integrins play a distinct role in basement membrane assembly, acting through ligand binding and transcriptional regulation.

pmid-9477112.summary_ja: 1987〜1992年にドイツの病院がん登録から集められた泌尿器腫瘍56,013例の集計です。精巣腫瘍は11.8%で、胚細胞腫瘍6,281例のうちセミノーマが53.6%、非セミノーマが46.6%でした。前立腺がんが最多を占めています。胚細胞腫瘍は泌尿器腫瘍全体の一部として扱われ、論文の中心ではありません。
pmid-9477112.summary_en: This analysis of 56,013 urologic tumor cases from German hospital cancer registries (1987-1992) reports distributions by site, histology, and stage. Testicular tumors made up 11.8% of cases. Among 6,281 germ cell tumors, 53.6% were seminomas and 46.6% nonseminomas, and 66.3% were node-negative. Prostate carcinomas formed the largest share. The authors emphasize how registries can inform diagnosis and therapy. Germ cell tumors form one part of the overall data rather than the paper's central focus.

pmid-9486851.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9の分化におけるプロテインキナーゼCαおよびCβの役割を検討した。PKCαは壁側内胚葉様細胞の維持と分化促進に働き、PKCβは未分化状態の維持に関与することが示された。PKCβの発現により分化細胞が幹細胞様へ戻ることも確認された。胎児性癌細胞株は分化モデルとして用いられており、臨床的な胚細胞腫瘍を扱う論文ではない。
pmid-9486851.summary_en: This study examines the roles of protein kinase C alpha (PKCalpha) and PKCbeta in retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Undifferentiated stem cells express PKCbeta, while parietal endoderm-like cells express PKCalpha. Stable expression of PKCalpha, or inhibition of PKCbeta, enhanced differentiation and accelerated laminin and collagen IV expression. Expressing PKCbeta in parietal endoderm cells reversed their phenotype toward stem cells. The authors conclude that PKCalpha promotes and PKCbeta opposes the parietal endoderm phenotype. The work uses an embryonal carcinoma line as a differentiation model.

pmid-9492541.summary_ja: 正常卵巣および各種卵巣腫瘍におけるapoEの局在を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。正常卵巣では莢膜内層、顆粒層、黄体で陽性となり、腫瘍では顆粒膜細胞腫、奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマで陽性を示した。ステロイド産生との関連が示唆され、診断補助になる可能性が述べられている。
pmid-9492541.summary_en: The authors used immunohistochemistry with a polyclonal anti-apoE antibody to examine apolipoprotein E localization in normal human ovary and various ovarian tumors. In normal ovary, apoE stained the theca interna, granulosa layer and corpus luteum, but not stroma. Among tumors, positive staining was seen in granulosa cell tumor, teratoma and dysgerminoma. The authors suggest a link between apoE and steroid synthesis and propose that apoE immunostaining may aid diagnosis of steroid-producing tumors.

pmid-9496352.summary_ja: ラットモデルにおいて、ヒト類皮嚢腫液とピルフェニドンの腹腔内投与が癒着形成に与える影響を検討した研究。類皮嚢腫液は正常ラットでも癒着を誘発し、子宮角損傷があるとさらに悪化した。ピルフェニドンは癒着を抑制しなかった。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床研究ではなく、癒着に関する実験的研究である。
pmid-9496352.summary_en: In a rat model, human dermoid cyst fluid was injected intraperitoneally, alone or with pirfenidone, to assess adhesion formation. Dermoid fluid caused adhesions even in intact rats and worsened adhesions after uterine horn injury, with higher scores than the saline or pirfenidone groups. Pirfenidone did not reduce adhesion formation. The study concludes that dermoid fluid promotes adhesions and that serosal injury aggravates this effect. It is an experimental fertility-focused study rather than a clinical tumor study.

pmid-9509727.summary_ja: 側頚部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告と文献的考察である。頭頸部の類皮嚢腫の多くは正中部に生じるため、側頚部例は稀である。MRIやCTで脂肪-液体レベルを認めれば頚部類皮嚢腫と診断でき、治療は外科的切除が第一選択とされる。類皮嚢腫は典型的な胚細胞腫瘍ではなく発生異常由来の病変であるため、本サイトの対象との関連性は不確かである。
pmid-9509727.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes a dermoid cyst of the lateral neck, a rare site since most head and neck dermoids occur in the midline. A fat-fluid level on MRI or CT is diagnostic for cervical dermoid cysts. Surgical excision remains the treatment of choice. Dermoid cysts are developmental lesions rather than classic germ cell neoplasms, so their relevance to this site is uncertain.

pmid-9639323.summary_ja: 正常細胞性栄養膜細胞による子宮内膜線維芽細胞のプロMMP-3分泌抑制が、組織特異的かどうかを検討した。腹膜・滑膜線維芽細胞では分泌は増加し、絨毛癌細胞株JArとJEG-3との共培養でも抑制は起こらなかった。絨毛癌は本論文の主題ではなく、比較対象として用いられた細胞株である。腫瘍細胞には正常栄養膜細胞の膜因子が欠けている可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-9639323.summary_en: This study examined whether suppression of endometrial fibroblast proMMP-3 by normal cytotrophoblasts is tissue specific. Peritoneal and synovial fibroblasts did not show suppression. Co-culture with two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JAr and JEG-3, also failed to reduce endometrial proMMP-3 secretion. The authors conclude the downregulation is tissue specific and likely depends on a cytotrophoblast membrane factor absent in tumor cells.

pmid-9639324.summary_ja: BeWo絨毛癌細胞を用いて、β-メルカプトエタノールがhCG-βの産生と細胞内動態に及ぼす影響を検討した。mRNA量は変化せず、タンパク質量が用量依存的に減少し、その作用は可逆的であった。主な作用点は細胞内のhCG-β分子のジスルフィド結合と考えられた。細胞株由来のhCG-βは参照標準品と構造が異なると述べられている。
pmid-9639324.summary_en: This study examined how beta-mercaptoethanol affects human chorionic gonadotropin beta subunit (hCG-beta) in BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. The agent reduced intracellular and medium hCG-beta protein in a dose-dependent manner without changing mRNA levels, and the effects were reversible. Its major target appeared to be intracellular hCG-beta, probably through disulfide bonds. BeWo-derived hCG-beta differed structurally from the reference standard, which may explain differing sensitivity to the agent.

pmid-9654049.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞から単離した核膜を上皮成長因子(EGF)で処理し、タンパク質のリン酸化変化を調べた。EGF受容体阻害剤により受容体活性化が必要であることを示し、44 kDaタンパク質をMAPキナーゼと同定した。絨毛癌細胞は生化学的材料として用いられ、疾患モデルとして扱われてはいない。
pmid-9654049.summary_en: Nuclear membranes isolated from JEG-3 human choriocarcinoma cells were treated with epidermal growth factor (EGF), causing phosphorylation changes in several proteins. Using the EGF receptor kinase inhibitor RG-13022, the authors show that receptor activation is required for these responses. They identify a 44-kDa protein as a MAP kinase and show that EGF increases its phosphorylation and catalytic activity, indicating that nuclear EGF receptors signal through the MAP kinase pathway. The choriocarcinoma line serves as a biochemical source, not as a disease model.

pmid-9655929.summary_ja: マウスMcl1/EATは、Bcl-2ファミリーに属する即時型初期遺伝子として解析された。レチノイン酸処理で胎児性癌細胞株F9、PCC3およびES細胞において発現が著明に増加した。これらは初期胚発生の分化モデルとして用いられている。臨床例の検討はなく、胚細胞腫瘍の診療への関連は間接的である。
pmid-9655929.summary_en: The authors cloned murine Mcl1/EAT, a Bcl-2 family gene, and found it has three Bcl-2 homology domains, two PEST sequences, and immediate response boxes, suggesting it is an immediate-early gene. Its expression rose sharply after retinoic acid exposure in murine embryonal carcinoma cell lines F9 and PCC3 and in embryonic stem cells. These cells serve as models of early embryogenesis and differentiation. The study does not examine tumor patients or clinical outcomes, so its relevance to germ cell tumor management is indirect.

pmid-9664887.summary_ja: 2歳の女児が右側頭部の排膿性瘻孔を呈した。瘻管は前頭骨および蝶形骨の骨内嚢腫に連続し、嚢腫基部は中頭蓋窩の硬膜に付着していた。前頭側頭部の類皮嚢腫は通常、緩徐増大性の腫瘤として現れ、瘻孔形成は稀である。著者らは、このまれな病態では手術前にコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)または磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)を行うことを推奨している。胚細胞腫瘍ではなく先天性の類皮嚢腫を扱った報告である。
pmid-9664887.summary_en: A 2-year-old girl presented with a discharging sinus in the right temporal region. Exploration revealed a sinus tract extending into an intraosseous cyst in the frontal and sphenoid bones, with the cyst base attached to the middle cranial fossa dura. The authors note that frontotemporal dermoids usually present as slow-growing masses, whereas nasal dermoids more often present as sinuses. They recommend CT or MRI before surgery for this rare presentation. The paper addresses a congenital dermoid cyst rather than a germ cell neoplasm.

pmid-9665814.summary_ja: 本研究は、胎児性癌細胞株P19において、BMP4とレチノイン酸が協調してアポトーシスを誘導する機序を検討したものです。受容体選択的なアゴニストとアンタゴニストを用い、RARαまたはRARγの活性化がアポトーシスに十分であることを示しています。臨床の腫瘍研究ではなく、基礎的な細胞生物学の論文です。
pmid-9665814.summary_en: This study examines how bone morphogenetic proteins (BMP2/BMP4) combined with retinoic acid induce apoptosis in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a classic in vitro model of pluripotent cells. Using receptor-selective agonists and antagonists, the authors show that activation of retinoic acid receptor alpha or gamma is sufficient to trigger apoptosis in BMP4-treated cells. The work clarifies which retinoid receptors control this cell death pathway and why BMP-retinoid co-treatment also prevents neuronal differentiation. It is primarily basic cell biology rather than clinical germ cell tumor research.

pmid-9669521.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9およびP19において、転写因子Sox-2がFGF-4遺伝子の発現を制御するかを検討した研究です。Sox-2のDNA結合領域がFGF-4エンハンサーのHMGモチーフに結合し、その結合は熱や酸化の影響を受けないことを示しています。優性阻害型およびアンチセンスのSox-2は、F9細胞でFGF-4のプロモーター活性を低下させました。
pmid-9669521.summary_en: This study examines whether the transcription factor Sox-2 regulates FGF-4 expression in embryonal carcinoma cell lines F9 and P19. The authors show that the Sox-2 DNA-binding domain binds the FGF-4 enhancer HMG motif in a heat- and oxidation-insensitive manner. Dominant-negative and antisense Sox-2 constructs reduce FGF-4 promoter activity in F9 cells, and Sox-2 also affects FGF-4 expression in P19 cells. The work is basic developmental gene-regulation research using cultured cells, not clinical germ cell tumour research.

pmid-9675133.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)遺伝子を組み込んだSindbisウイルスベクターを作製し、LH/CG受容体を持つ細胞への標的導入を検討しました。絨毛癌細胞に効率よく報告遺伝子を導入でき、受容体を欠く細胞への感染は少ないことが示されました。妊娠性絨毛性疾患や胎盤機能不全への遺伝子治療応用が提案されていますが、主題は遺伝子導入ベクターの開発です。
pmid-9675133.summary_en: The authors engineered a Sindbis virus vector whose envelope protein carries alpha- and beta-hCG sequences, aiming to target cells with LH/CG receptors. The chimeric vector showed minimal infection of BHK cells and cancer cells lacking these receptors, but efficiently delivered a reporter gene to choriocarcinoma cells. The approach is proposed as a gene therapy strategy for gestational trophoblastic disease and placental dysfunction. The study is primarily a vector development report using choriocarcinoma cells as the target.

pmid-9720909.summary_ja: レチノイン酸によるヒトH19プロモーターの活性化を、絨毛癌および精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株で検討した研究です。精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞では、活性化に3'下流領域が必要でした。作用機序は間接的で、AP2転写因子ファミリーの関与が考察されています。
pmid-9720909.summary_en: This study examines how retinoic acid activates the human H19 promoter in choriocarcinoma and testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. H19 transcription depends on both its 5' promoter region and a 3' downstream region. In testicular germ cell tumor cells, retinoic acid activation of the promoter requires the 3' downstream region. The authors suggest retinoic acid acts indirectly, possibly through an AP2 transcription factor family member. The tumor-derived cell lines are the experimental system rather than the disease focus.

pmid-9770359.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株P19の終末分化における細胞周期制御因子の変化を調べた基礎研究。レチノイン酸とDMSOによる分化で、pRB・E2F・サイクリン・CKIの発現と活性が系統特異的に変化することを示した。腫瘍そのものではなく分化モデルとしての利用である。
pmid-9770359.summary_en: This study examines how cell cycle regulators change during terminal differentiation of the pluripotent murine embryonal carcinoma line P19. Differentiation was induced with retinoic acid (neuronal lineage) or DMSO (cardiac muscle lineage). The authors measured expression and activity of pRB, E2F, D-type cyclins, cyclin-dependent kinases, and CDK inhibitors. They found lineage-specific changes in several family members, and all E2F family members lost DNA-binding activity as cells terminally differentiated. The work is a developmental cell biology study using the tumor-derived line as a model rather than a study of tumor biology.

pmid-9778120.summary_ja: JAr絨毛癌細胞において、プロテインキナーゼC(PKC)の慢性的な下方制御がEGF受容体の発現とhCG-β分泌を増加させることを示した。PKC阻害剤も基礎およびEGF刺激下のhCG-β産生を高めた。両者の作用は相加的であった。対象は疾患そのものではなく、胎盤のホルモン調節機構である。
pmid-9778120.summary_en: This study shows that chronic phorbol ester (PDB) downregulation of protein kinase C increases EGF receptor expression and hCG-beta secretion in JAr choriocarcinoma cells. Protein kinase C inhibitors also enhanced basal and EGF-stimulated hCG-beta production, and the effects were additive. The authors propose that EGF and PKC pathways regulate hCG in trophoblast-like cells through interactive mechanisms. The work concerns placental hormone regulation rather than choriocarcinoma as a disease.

pmid-9804241.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性腫瘍の患者の血清と嚢胞液中の可溶性接着分子(sICAM-1、sCD44std、sE-カドヘリン)を測定した研究である。類皮嚢腫はその対象の一群として含まれるが、主題は上皮性腫瘍である。血清sICAM-1は全体に上昇していたが、腫瘍の鑑別には有用でなかった。嚢胞液中の3分子は、境界悪性腫瘍と悪性腫瘍で嚢胞腺腫より高値であった。
pmid-9804241.summary_en: This study measured soluble ICAM-1, CD44std, and E-cadherin in serum and cyst fluid from patients with ovarian cystic tumors, including luteal cysts, cystadenomas, dermoid cysts, borderline tumors, and carcinomas. Serum sICAM-1 was elevated across patients but did not discriminate tumor types. Cyst fluid levels of all three molecules were higher in borderline and malignant tumors than in cystadenomas. The authors conclude that cyst fluid adhesion molecules may help distinguish benign from borderline or malignant lesions, while serum levels lack diagnostic value.

pmid-9811012.summary_ja: 正中鼻類皮嚢腫（先天性の類皮嚢腫）の前頭蓋底からの経鼻内視鏡的切除について、術前のCT・MRI評価、皮膚切開の位置、頭蓋内進展の確認法を提示する。類皮嚢腫は通常の胚細胞腫瘍ではなく先天性の外胚葉性嚢腫であり、本論文の主題は手術手技である。大脳鎌に及ぶ病変では頭蓋内外併用アプローチが必要とされている。
pmid-9811012.summary_en: This article offers recommendations for transnasal endoscopic excision of midline nasal dermoid cysts involving the anterior cranial base. The authors advise fine-cut CT with MRI for preoperative evaluation, limited vertical skin incisions favoring the nasal tip, and frozen section of the superior margin to exclude intracranial extension. Endoscopic removal may be attempted even with anterior fossa extension, while falx cerebri involvement requires a combined intra-extracranial approach. These dermoids are congenital inclusion lesions rather than true germ cell neoplasms.

pmid-9826678.summary_ja: 腫瘍形成能を持つ奇形腫由来のPC細胞株では、非腫瘍性細胞に比べPC細胞由来増殖因子(PCDGF)の発現が高いことを示した。PCDGFのアンチセンスcDNAの導入により、同系マウスでの腫瘍形成能が著明に抑制された。奇形腫細胞株を実験系として、増殖因子の腫瘍形成における役割を検討した研究である。
pmid-9826678.summary_en: The authors show that the PC cell line, a tumorigenic teratoma-derived line, expresses high levels of PC cell-derived growth factor (PCDGF) compared with nontumorigenic precursors. Antisense PCDGF transfection markedly suppressed tumorigenicity in syngeneic mice. The study focuses on a growth factor's role in tumor formation, with the teratoma cell line as the experimental system.

pmid-9880647.summary_ja: 新生児女児の胸骨上窩に生じた単房性の正中嚢胞性腫瘤が、先天性の類皮嚢腫と診断された症例報告です。頭頸部の類皮嚢腫は稀ですが、正中部に発生する点が特徴とされます。画像上で脂肪成分が確認されない場合でも、新生児の単房性正中頸部嚢胞では鑑別診断に類皮嚢腫を挙げるべきと述べています。
pmid-9880647.summary_en: This report describes a newborn girl with an unusual unilocular cystic midline mass at the suprasternal notch, ultimately diagnosed as a congenital dermoid cyst. The authors note that dermoid cysts of the head and neck are rare, although a midline location is characteristic. They emphasize that a dermoid cyst should be high on the differential diagnosis for a unilocular midline neck cyst in a neonate, even when imaging shows no fat components.

pmid-9541702.summary_ja: 小児の卵巣腫瘤の評価と治療を概説した総説である。症状が一般的な腹腔内疾患と紛らわしく、組織型も多様であるため診断が難しい。手術技術と化学療法の進歩により、悪性腫瘍をもつ女児の全生存期間（全生存率）は約20%から70%に向上した。要約には腫瘍型の記載がないため、胚細胞腫瘍への言及の有無は不明である。
pmid-9541702.summary_en: This review summarizes the diagnosis and management of ovarian masses in children, which are uncommon but challenging because they can mimic more common intra-abdominal disorders and vary widely in histology. Advances in surgical technique and more effective chemotherapy over the past 25 years have raised overall survival from about 20% to 70% for girls with malignant tumors. The article also reviews pertinent pathology. The abstract does not specify tumor types, so germ cell tumors, which are common among pediatric ovarian malignancies, are not explicitly addressed.

pmid-9728811.summary_ja: マウスおよびウシ胚の生殖隆起や単離原始生殖細胞を、無胸腺マウスの腎被膜下に移植した動物実験です。ウシの生殖隆起からは腫瘍が形成され、DNA解析でウシ由来と確認されました。腫瘍は中胚葉系組織から成り、未分化幹細胞は認められず良性奇形腫と考えられました。奇形腫形成によりウシPGCの多能性を示し、多能性幹細胞の単離への応用可能性を提示しています。
pmid-9728811.summary_en: Intact genital ridges and isolated primordial germ cells from mouse and bovine embryos were transplanted under the kidney capsule of athymic mice to assess in vivo growth and differentiation. Mouse samples and some bovine genital ridges formed tumors, while isolated bovine PGCs did not. The tumors, confirmed bovine by DNA analysis, were composed of mesodermal tissues without undifferentiated stem cells, suggesting benign teratomas. The study demonstrates bovine PGC pluripotency through teratoma induction and suggests the approach could aid isolation of embryo-derived pluripotent stem cells.

pmid-10717208.summary_ja: セミノーマの放射線治療に関する過去20年の進歩をまとめた総説です。治癒率は約97%に達し、照射線量と照射範囲が縮小されました。病期Iでは監視療法が選択肢となり、進行例ではブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法が標準となりました。
pmid-10717208.summary_en: This review traces 20 years of advances in seminoma radiation oncology. Cure rates reached about 97%, with reduced radiation doses and volumes, adoption of serum tumor markers and CT or MRI staging, and surveillance as an option for stage I disease. Chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin became standard for advanced disease, while prophylactic mediastinal irradiation was abandoned. Remaining controversies include stage IIC management and inguinal-scrotal irradiation.

pmid-10740717.summary_ja: 50歳女性にみられた大網の多発性類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。きわめてまれな腹腔内病変で、病因、臨床像、関連文献を簡潔に概説しています。成熟奇形腫の一型として扱われ、胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含まれます。症例報告の形式で、詳細は限られています。
pmid-10740717.summary_en: The authors describe a 50-year-old woman with multiple dermoid cysts of the omentum, an extremely rare extragonadal lesion. They briefly review its aetiopathogenesis, clinical presentation, and relevant literature. Omental dermoid cysts are generally regarded as mature teratomas, so the report falls within extragonadal germ cell tumor scope. The article is a short case report with limited detail.

pmid-10771937.summary_ja: 乳児に発生した稀な未熟性胃奇形腫の症例報告。胃奇形腫は乳児期にみられる極めて稀な腫瘍で、通常は良性とされる。既報66例中、未熟な胚様成分を認めたのは3例のみであり、本症例はその少ない報告に加わる。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の組織学的特徴を検討する上で意義がある。
pmid-10771937.summary_en: This report describes a rare immature gastric teratoma in an infant. Gastric teratoma is an extremely uncommon tumor of infancy that is usually benign. Immature embryonic elements have been reported in only three of 66 previously described cases. The authors present one such immature gastric teratoma, adding to the limited literature on this extragonadal germ cell tumor and its histological features.

pmid-12735812.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の治療から11年後に、高血圧と腎炎性尿沈渣を発症した30歳男性の症例。後腹膜リンパ節郭清の際に左腎静脈が損傷され修復された。左単純腎摘除術後に症状は改善し、遅発性の腎血管合併症と考察されている。
pmid-12735812.summary_en: A 30-year-old man developed hypertension and nephritic urine sediment eleven years after treatment of a left testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. Retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy had required cisplatin-based chemotherapy, followed by surgical resection of a residual mass. During perihilar dissection, the left renal vein was injured and repaired. Hypertension and sediment resolved after left simple nephrectomy. The authors attribute this late complication to renal artery injury.

pmid-12795807.summary_ja: 正常な子宮内妊娠に合併した絨毛癌の2症例を報告し、文献をレビューした論文。起源として既往妊娠の絨毛組織の遺残からの発生と、正常妊娠中の絨毛の悪性転換の2説を検討している。診断・治療は進歩したものの生存率は依然不良と述べられている。
pmid-12795807.summary_en: This article reports two additional cases of choriocarcinoma coexisting with a normal intrauterine pregnancy and reviews the literature. The authors discuss two proposed origins: development from trophoblastic remnants of a prior pregnancy, and malignant transformation of normal trophoblast during an otherwise normal pregnancy. Incidental choriocarcinoma foci in apparently normal placentas support the second hypothesis. Diagnosis, management, and persistently unsatisfactory survival rates are summarized.

pmid-15511950.summary_ja: 妊娠に合併した卵巣腫瘤84例を後方視的に検討した研究。最多は良性の嚢胞性奇形腫であった。無症状例の多くは帝王切開時に偶然発見され、日常的な超音波検査でも見逃されていた。帝王切開時の卵巣検査の励行と、多くの病変に対する保存的治療を提案している。
pmid-15511950.summary_en: A retrospective review of 84 pregnancies complicated by ovarian masses examined presentation, management, pathology, and outcome. Benign cystic teratoma was the most common tumor. Forty-seven cases were asymptomatic, and 29 of these were found incidentally at cesarean section despite routine ultrasound. Aspiration cytology was helpful in only 53%, while histology gave a definitive diagnosis in all. The authors recommend routine ovarian examination at cesarean section and conservative management of most lesions.

pmid-21528347.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍40例を膀胱癌や頭頸部扁平上皮癌と比較し、p53・Bcl-2・HSP70を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。胚細胞腫瘍の89%でp53が陽性だった。セミノーマは非セミノーマより p53 陽性率が高かった。非変異型p53の四倍体近傍での過剰発現が、化学感受性に関与する可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-21528347.summary_en: This immunocytochemical study of 40 germ cell cancers compared p53, Bcl-2 and HSP70 expression with bladder and head and neck cancers. Most germ cell cancers were p53-positive (89%), while Bcl-2 positivity was lower than in the comparison cancers. Seminomas showed higher p53 positivity than non-seminomas. The authors propose that near-tetraploid overexpression of non-mutated p53 contributes to the chemosensitivity of germ cell cancers, and suggest meiotic checkpoints as targets for other cancers.

pmid-21590037.summary_ja: インド・ケララ州の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を対象に、EGFとEGF受容体の発現を免疫組織化学と放射性リガンドアッセイで検討した研究。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌では、EGFとEGFRの双方で非常に強い結合が認められた。持続性栄養膜疾患では変異したEGF受容体が存在する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21590037.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry and radioligand assays were used to evaluate epidermal growth factor (EGF) and EGF receptor (EGFR) expression in gestational trophoblastic disease from Kerala, India. Samples included 50 normal placentas, 122 molar pregnancies, and 52 cases of persistent disease. Invasive moles and choriocarcinomas showed very strong binding of both EGF and EGFR. The authors suggest that persistent trophoblastic disease may harbor mutated EGF receptors, which could be relevant to its behavior. The study is descriptive and quantitative, focusing on expression patterns across the gestational trophoblastic disease spectrum.

pmid-21590177.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性腫瘍における血清マクロファージコロニー刺激因子（M-CSF）の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した研究。M-CSFは上皮・間質性腫瘍と胚細胞腫瘍の双方のマーカーとなり、特異的マーカーのないディスジャーミノーマで有用であった。複数の卵巣腫瘍細胞株でM-CSF産生が確認されたが、オートクラインの機序は確認されなかった。
pmid-21590177.summary_en: The authors evaluated macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) as a serum tumor marker for malignant ovarian tumors and examined its production by tumor cells and whether an autocrine loop operates. Serum M-CSF was useful for malignant ovarian tumors, including epithelial stromal tumors and germ cell tumors. It was notably a marker for dysgerminoma, for which no specific tumor marker is currently available. Combined assays with M-CSF were valuable. M-CSF was produced by several ovarian tumor cell lines, although an autocrine mechanism was not confirmed.

pmid-21590204.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍5例を対象に、末端制限断片（TRF）長を測定したテロメア解析の研究。古典的セミノーマと胎児性癌/セミノーマ混合型は平均約9kbpであった一方、奇形腫/胎児性癌混合型は平均20kbpと長かった。精母細胞性セミノーマは最大100kbpに達した。症例数は少ない。
pmid-21590204.summary_en: Telomere length was measured by terminal restriction fragment analysis in five human testicular germ cell tumours, including classical seminomas, a mixed embryonal carcinoma/atypical seminoma, a mixed teratoma/embryonal carcinoma, and a spermatocytic seminoma. Placental DNA served as the reference. Classical seminomas and the mixed embryonal carcinoma/seminoma showed mean lengths of about 9 kbp, while the teratoma/embryonal carcinoma had longer telomeres (mean 20 kbp). The single spermatocytic seminoma had extremely long telomeres, up to 100 kbp. The study is small, with only five cases, so conclusions are preliminary.

pmid-21590237.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍に結腸卵巣瘻を合併した4例を3年間で経験したという報告。1例目は注腸造影での造影剤漏出とCTでのガス含有病変で診断された。病理は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が2例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍と低悪性度漿液性嚢胞腺腫がそれぞれ1例であった。結腸卵巣瘻の成因と鑑別診断を概説している。
pmid-21590237.summary_en: This report describes four patients with colo-ovarian fistula associated with ovarian tumors, encountered over three years. The first case was demonstrated by barium extravasation on enema and a gas-containing lesion within the tumor on computed tomography. Pathology showed mature cystic teratoma in two patients, while the other two had a mixed germ cell tumor and a serous cystadenoma of low malignant potential. The authors review the etiology and differential diagnosis of colo-ovarian fistula. The fistula is a rare complication of ovarian tumors.

pmid-8976241.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍772例のうち原発性純粋精巣奇形腫44例を後方視的に検討した研究。臨床病期Iでは19.2%、病期IIA/Bでは66%にリンパ節転移を認めた。摘除標本の連続切片では、瘢痕や石灰化を伴う燃え尽き腫瘍が多く、微小病巣の胎児性癌も見られた。後腹膜リンパ節郭清と監視療法の選択に、連続切片の検索が有用と結論付けている。
pmid-8976241.summary_en: This retrospective study of 44 patients with primary pure testicular mature teratoma, identified among 772 testicular germ cell tumor cases, evaluates the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. Lymph node metastases occurred in 19.2% of clinical stage I and 66% of stage IIA/B disease. Serial sectioning revealed burned-out tumors with scarring or calcification in 80% of the 20 patients examined, and microfocal embryonal carcinoma in 20%. No stage I patients relapsed, whereas 33% of stage IIA/B patients did. Overall, 43% presented with metastatic disease. The authors recommend serial sectioning of orchiectomy specimens to guide the choice between lymphadenectomy and surveillance.

pmid-8978593.summary_ja: 婦人科癌細胞株でFas抗原の発現を調べ、卵巣癌株では発現を認めたが絨毛癌株では認めなかった。抗Fas抗体は多くのFas陽性株でアポトーシスを誘導した。卵巣癌株と耐性変異株で化学療法薬との相乗効果が見られ、薬剤耐性克服の可能性が示された。
pmid-8978593.summary_en: The authors examined Fas antigen expression in gynecologic cancer cell lines, finding it in ovarian cancer lines but not choriocarcinoma lines. Anti-Fas antibody induced apoptosis in most Fas-positive lines. A synergistic effect was observed when combined with chemotherapeutic drugs in an ovarian cancer line and its resistant variants, suggesting a strategy to overcome drug resistance.

pmid-8988741.summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍74例に対し、自家造血幹細胞救援を併用した大量化学療法(カルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド)を施行した。5年時点の全生存期間(全生存率)は38%、無増悪生存率は31%であった。従来量のシスプラチン投与中に進行した患者では長期生存者はいなかった。
pmid-8988741.summary_en: This phase I/II trial treated 74 patients with recurrent or refractory germ cell tumors using high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell rescue, combining carboplatin, etoposide, and ifosfamide. Two patients died from treatment toxicity, and 47 relapsed or progressed after a median of 3 months. At five years, overall survival was 38% and failure-free survival 31%. No long-term survivors were seen among patients whose disease progressed during conventional-dose cisplatin. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy can be curative for patients who respond to conventional-dose treatment but do not become disease free.

pmid-8990147.summary_ja: 縦隔の成熟奇形腫内に発生したゴブレット細胞カルチノイドの症例報告です。英語文献では初めての発生部位とされます。腫瘍は均一な腺房状の胞巣を形成し、細胞異型は軽度でした。免疫組織化学では神経内分泌および上皮性の特徴を示し、病変は奇形腫内に完全に限局していました。縦隔奇形腫の悪性転化に関する文献もレビューされています。
pmid-8990147.summary_en: This case report describes a goblet cell carcinoid arising within a mature teratoma of the mediastinum, a location not previously described in the English literature. The tumor showed uniform glandular nests of goblet, endocrine and Paneth cells with minimal atypia and rare mitoses, and immunohistochemistry confirmed neuroendocrine and epithelial features. The carcinoid component was entirely contained within the teratoma. The authors also review published mediastinal teratomas with malignant transformation.

pmid-8995566.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対するエトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD(EMA)療法の有効性と安全性を後方視的研究で検討した報告です。一次治療では7例中5例、単剤抵抗性例の二次治療では22例中21例が寛解に至りました。急性血液毒性は主にグレード1~2でした。二次性腫瘍のリスクから、エトポシドが寛解に必要な症例に限定すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-8995566.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated etoposide, methotrexate and actinomycin D (EMA) for gestational trophoblastic tumor as primary and secondary therapy. Primary EMA induced remission in 5 of 7 patients, and secondary EMA achieved remission in 21 of 22 patients resistant to single-agent regimens. Acute hematologic toxicity was mostly grade 1 or 2, with only 2 of 90 cycles causing grade 4 toxicity. The authors recommend restricting EMA to patients who require etoposide for remission because of secondary malignancy risk.

pmid-8995567.summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍54例に対し、シスプラチン併用化学療法を後方視的研究で検討した報告です。中央値6年の追跡期間で全生存期間(全生存率)は74%でした。術後補助療法群では96%が無病生存しており、最も良好でした。長期毒性は軽度でした。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後改善に有用と結論づけています。
pmid-8995567.summary_en: This retrospective review of 54 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated cisplatin-based chemotherapy given as first-line or salvage therapy at the Institut Gustave Roussy. With a median follow-up of 6 years, overall survival was 74%, and adjuvant-setting patients fared best, with 96% alive without disease. Long-term toxicity was minimal, and many patients who had conservative surgery later resumed menstruation or had children. The authors conclude that cisplatin-based chemotherapy improves prognosis, especially in the adjuvant setting.

pmid-8996148.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術とシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた178例を対象に、治療後の精子形成の回復を解析した。治療前に正常精子数であった患者では、2年で48%、5年で80%に回復した。カルボプラチン併用群は回復確率が高く、4サイクル超では低下した。予後予測モデルで回復確率を3群に層別化できた。
pmid-8996148.summary_en: This study of 178 men treated for testicular germ cell cancer between 1979 and 1991 examined recovery of spermatogenesis after orchidectomy and cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Sperm counts before and after chemotherapy were classified as normospermic, oligospermic, or azoospermic. In men with normal pre-treatment counts, spermatogenesis recovered to 48% at two years and 80% at five years. Carboplatin-based therapy was associated with higher recovery probability, while more than four cycles reduced it. A prognostic model divided patients into three groups with 25%, 45%, and 82% probabilities of recovery by two years.

pmid-8998160.summary_ja: 精巣奇形癌（胎児性癌が主体）の患者で、後腹膜転移に対し化学療法前後にFDG-PETを行った症例報告である。治療前は転移巣のブドウ糖代謝が不均一に亢進していた。化学療法後は腫瘍容積が増大したにもかかわらずFDG集積は正常範囲に低下し、組織学的には純粋な成熟奇形腫であった。ブドウ糖代謝による腫瘍分化の評価には、さらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-8998160.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a primary testicular teratocarcinoma composed predominantly of embryonal carcinoma. FDG-PET was performed before and after chemotherapy for retroperitoneal metastases. Before treatment, the metastases showed heterogeneous, increased glucose metabolism. After chemotherapy, FDG uptake normalized despite increased tumor volume. Histology showed a pure mature teratoma. The authors suggest that measuring glucose metabolism may help assess tumor differentiation in testicular teratocarcinoma metastases, and that further studies are needed to confirm this.

pmid-9000354.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の患者で、腹腔内が皮脂様物質で満たされていた症例を報告している。腹部X線写真で、壁側腹膜と上行結腸外側壁の間に広い脂肪の線状陰影がみられた。著者らはこの所見を、大量の腹腔内脂肪性物質を示す「腹腔内脂肪徴候」と命名した。単一症例の画像所見報告である。
pmid-9000354.summary_en: This short report describes a patient with an ovarian cystic teratoma whose peritoneal cavity was filled with sebaceous material. On an abdominal radiograph, a wide fat stripe was seen between the parietal peritoneum and the lateral wall of the ascending colon. The authors named this finding the intraperitoneal fat sign, which indicates large amounts of intraperitoneal fatty material. The paper is a brief imaging observation from a single case rather than a systematic series.

pmid-9000367.summary_ja: 組織学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫5例のMR画像を後方視的に検討した。全例で多房性嚢胞と充実成分からなる複雑な嚢胞性腫瘤を示し、大小の甲状腺濾胞を反映していた。嚢胞液は多くでT1強調像低信号、T2強調像高信号であったが、出血を伴う1例では逆のパターンであった。多房性嚢胞と充実成分を持つ腫瘤が本疾患の特徴的なMR所見と結論づけられた。
pmid-9000367.summary_en: This retrospective imaging study analyzed unenhanced and gadolinium-enhanced MR images from five histologically proven struma ovarii, a rare benign ovarian neoplasm. All lesions were complex cystic masses with multiple cysts and a solid component, reflecting large and small thyroid follicles. Cyst fluid was usually hypointense on T1-weighted and hyperintense on T2-weighted images, while one hemorrhagic lesion showed the reverse. The authors conclude that a multicystic mass with a solid component is a characteristic MR appearance of struma ovarii.

pmid-9000406.summary_ja: 成人で発見された上咽頭奇形腫の症例報告である。上咽頭の奇形腫は通常新生児に発生するため、成人例は稀である。本症例は初回発生から34年後に再発した。従来のX線写真、CT、MR、組織学的所見を提示し、長期間をおいて再発した稀な節外性奇形腫の画像所見を記録している。
pmid-9000406.summary_en: This case report describes a teratoma of the nasopharynx discovered in an adult, a site where such tumors usually present in neonates. The tumor recurred 34 years after its initial occurrence. The authors present conventional radiographs, CT, MR, and histologic findings. The report documents the imaging appearances of a rare extragonadal teratoma that recurred after a very long interval.

pmid-9010108.summary_ja: 転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対しシスプラチン併用化学療法後に開胸術を受けた215例の残存肺腫瘤を解析した。組織型は壊死54%、成熟奇形腫33%、がん13%であった。開胸前の予測因子、特に後腹膜リンパ節郭清の組織所見を用いたモデルは壊死を高精度に識別し（AUC 0.86）、壊死が疑われる症例では綿密なフォローアップが考慮されると結論づけている。
pmid-9010108.summary_en: This ReHiT Study Group analysis of 215 patients who underwent thoracotomy after cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors examined residual pulmonary masses. Histology was necrosis in 54%, mature teratoma in 33% and cancer in 13%. Logistic models using pre-thoracotomy predictors, especially RPLND histology, discriminated necrosis well (AUC 0.86). The authors suggest close follow-up for patients likely to have necrosis, and recommend RPLND before thoracotomy.

pmid-9010236.summary_ja: 成人精巣の各種腫瘍におけるインプリンティング遺伝子H19の発現を解析した。浸潤性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の多くで両アレルの発現がみられ、これは成人精巣において本腫瘍に特異的な所見であった。発現量は分化系譜と成熟段階に相関し、原始胚細胞起源という考えと整合する。H19は腫瘍抑制遺伝子としては働かないと著者らは結論づけている。
pmid-9010236.summary_en: This study examined imprinted H19 expression in testicular cancers of differing etiology, including spermatocytic seminomas, lymphomas, and Sertoli and Leydig cell tumors, alongside normal and germ cell-free testicular tissue. Most invasive testicular germ cell tumors showed biallelic H19 expression, a pattern specific to these tumors in the adult testis. Expression levels correlated with differentiation lineage and maturation stage, consistent with a primordial germ cell origin. The authors conclude that H19 does not act as a tumor suppressor gene.

pmid-9015705.summary_ja: 32歳の無症状女性に生じた悪性乳頭状卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。著者らは悪性乳頭状卵巣甲状腺腫の診断基準を提案している。完全な病期分類を行えば、腫瘍の経過は通常良性で転移は少ないため、保存的治療が可能であると述べている。希少疾患における診断・治療の混乱を整理する一助となる報告である。
pmid-9015705.summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old asymptomatic woman with malignant papillary struma ovarii, a rare ovarian carcinoma arising from a teratoma. The authors propose diagnostic criteria for malignant papillary struma ovarii. They note that complete staging allows conservative treatment, since this tumor usually has a benign course and a low rate of metastasis. The report helps clarify diagnosis and management of this rare entity.

pmid-9021587.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の乳児症例で、胎児内胎児様の特徴を示した。偽胎児は単心室様の未発達な心臓を有し、宿主児とは異なる拍動数で拍動していた。X線検査で脊柱は認められなかった。胎児内胎児は高度に分化・組織化された奇形腫であり、両者は同一の病態である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9021587.summary_en: This case report describes a sacrococcygeal teratoma in an infant that displayed features of fetus-in-fetu. The pseudo-fetus contained a rudimentary single-cavity heart that beat at a rate different from the host infant's, and radiography showed an absent spinal column. The authors conclude that fetus-in-fetu can represent a remarkably complex, well-differentiated, and highly organized teratoma, suggesting that the two entities may share a single pathological basis.

pmid-9021824.summary_ja: 後腹膜の胎児内胎児を報告した。妊娠後期の超音波検査で、腹腔内嚢胞性病変内に四肢や脊椎を備えた無脳症・無心臓性の塊が確認された。切除標本は四肢、椎体、歯を有する胎児様構造で、宿主と同一の46,XY核型を示し、分子解析でも遺伝学的差異はなかった。十分に発達した四肢と脊椎があれば出生前診断が可能であると強調された。
pmid-9021824.summary_en: The authors report prenatal diagnosis, pathology, karyotyping, and molecular analysis of a retroperitoneal fetus-in-fetu. Third-trimester ultrasound of the host fetus showed an anencephalic, acardiac mass containing identifiable limbs and spine within an intra-abdominal cystic lesion. The resected fetiform mass had four extremities, vertebral bodies, teeth, and an umbilical cord. Both host and mass had a 46,XY karyotype with no genetic difference on molecular analysis. The authors emphasize that such lesions can be diagnosed prenatally when well-developed limbs and spine are present.

pmid-9021828.summary_ja: 胎児仙尾部奇形腫を合併した妊娠10例で、妊娠15週の母体血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を測定した。妊娠後期のCA12-5、TATI、PIIINPも検討した。いずれの値も正常妊娠と同等で、成熟型と未熟型・悪性型の奇形腫の間にも差はなかった。本異常は第2三半期の母体血清トリソミースクリーニングでは検出できないと結論された。
pmid-9021828.summary_en: This study measured maternal serum AFP and total hCG at 15 weeks' gestation in ten pregnancies complicated by fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma, along with late-pregnancy CA 12-5, TATI, and PIIINP. Values were comparable to normal pregnancies and did not differ between histologically mature and immature or malignant teratomas. The authors conclude that this anomaly is not detectable by maternal serum trisomy screening in the second trimester.

pmid-9023554.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍43例を対象に、T細胞、マクロファージ、B細胞、形質細胞を無作為抽出法で定量した。T細胞とマクロファージはセミノーマで非セミノーマ性腫瘍より多かった。胎児性癌は未熟奇形腫よりT細胞が多く、成熟奇形腫はB細胞が多かった。無作為抽出は腫瘍全体の免疫応答をより正確に評価できると結論された。
pmid-9023554.summary_en: This study quantified immunocompetent cells, including T lymphocytes, macrophages, B lymphocytes, and plasma cells, in 43 testicular germ cell tumors using randomized field selection. T lymphocytes and macrophages were more abundant in seminomas than in non-seminomatous tumors, and embryonal carcinomas had more T lymphocytes than immature teratomas. Mature teratomas showed high B lymphocyte counts, while plasma cells were sparse. The authors conclude that randomized sampling yields a more representative immune assessment and allows comparison with other malignancies.

pmid-9032548.summary_ja: 精巣原発の転移性セミノーマが左腎静脈へ直接浸潤し、腫瘍栓が下大静脈まで進展した症例報告である。血栓性の増大により初回化学療法を完遂できず、外科的介入を要した。手術標本に生存腫瘍は認めなかったが、補助化学療法2コース後に腎静脈浸潤部位で再発した。
pmid-9032548.summary_en: This case report describes metastatic seminoma with direct invasion of the left renal vein. A tumor thrombus extended into the renal vein, and the associated vena cava thrombosis proved to be a noncancerous clot that grew as an extension of it. Thrombotic growth prevented completion of primary chemotherapy and required surgery. Surgical specimens showed no viable tumor, and two cycles of adjuvant chemotherapy were given, yet the tumor relapsed at the site of renal vein invasion. The report highlights the diagnostic and management challenges of tumor thrombus extension in testicular cancer.

pmid-9032806.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株(BeWo、JAr)では、良性の栄養膜細胞と比べてEGFRが10倍以上高発現し、TGF-αを自己分泌していた。EGFRやTGF-αを阻害するとJArの増殖が抑制された。EGFR過剰発現と自己分泌ループが絨毛癌の無制御な増殖に関与すると考えられる。
pmid-9032806.summary_en: This study examines epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) expression and the transforming growth factor-alpha (TGF-α) autocrine loop in benign placental cytotrophoblasts and in choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JAr. Choriocarcinoma cells showed EGFR levels at least tenfold higher than benign cytotrophoblasts, did not respond to exogenous TGF-α, and secreted TGF-α in an autocrine fashion. Blocking EGFR or TGF-α inhibited JAr proliferation. The authors propose that EGFR overexpression and the autocrine loop contribute to the uncontrolled growth of choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-9033370.summary_ja: シドニーの単施設で1979〜1993年に治療された精巣セミノーマの成績を後方視的に評価し、文献も踏まえた治療方針を提示した。病期Iおよび病期IIAでは精巣摘除術後の放射線療法で治癒率がほぼ100%に達した。病期IIB(10cm超)では初回化学療法の後に放射線療法を追加する方針が妥当とされた。
pmid-9033370.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluates treatment outcomes for testicular seminoma at a single Sydney institution from 1979 to 1993 and reviews the literature to propose management protocols. Post-orchidectomy radiotherapy for stage I and IIA disease achieved near 100% long-term cure, and routine or surveillance chemotherapy is unlikely to improve outcomes. For stage IIB disease up to 10 cm, radiotherapy with chemotherapy reserved for relapse was considered appropriate. Bulkier stage IIB disease (over 10 cm) warranted initial chemotherapy followed by consolidation radiotherapy.

pmid-9034742.summary_ja: 穿刺吸引細胞診(FNAB)による胚細胞腫瘍の診断可能性を検討した論文である。多くの組織型は細胞診で容易に識別可能とされる。混合型胚細胞腫瘍では一成分が優位な場合に診断が難しく、免疫組織化学が確定診断に有用とされる。
pmid-9034742.summary_en: This paper assesses whether fine-needle aspiration biopsy (FNAB) can reliably diagnose germ cell tumors. The authors state that most subtypes are readily recognized and distinguished from one another on FNAB, and that clinicopathologic correlation helps in difficult cases. Mixed germ cell tumors can be problematic when one component predominates. Immunohistochemistry is noted as an important adjunct for a definitive diagnosis. The report is a brief review of cytologic diagnosis of germ cell tumors.

pmid-9038271.summary_ja: 卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に由来する絨毛癌の脳単独転移の症例報告である。化学療法中に出現し、開頭による切除、放射線療法、追加の化学療法を行った。その後、肺転移は消失し長期生存が得られた。極めてまれな病態である。
pmid-9038271.summary_en: This report describes a pure brain metastasis of choriocarcinoma arising from a mixed germ cell tumor of the ovary in a 19-year-old patient. The metastasis appeared during combination chemotherapy, after pulmonary metastases had proven resistant to treatment. Craniotomy with tumor resection, brain radiation, and further chemotherapy were administered. Afterward, the pulmonary metastasis disappeared and the patient survived long term. The authors emphasize that this isolated brain involvement is extremely rare.

pmid-9038276.summary_ja: 分娩4か月後に不正性器出血で発症した子宮頸部原発絨毛癌の症例である。MRIとカラードプラ超音波検査で、中心壊死を伴う血流豊富な腫瘤を描出した。化学療法2コース後の子宮全摘で残存病変はなく、無病経過を維持している。
pmid-9038276.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman developed primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix four months after a term vaginal delivery, presenting with irregular genital bleeding. MRI and color Doppler ultrasonography revealed a hypervascular 6 cm cervical tumor with central necrosis, and urinary hCG was markedly elevated. After two courses of chemotherapy, total hysterectomy showed no residual choriocarcinoma, and the patient remained disease-free. The authors conclude that MRI and Doppler ultrasound are useful for diagnosis by demonstrating abundant blood flow and central necrosis.

pmid-9041117.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株NT2においてシスプラチンが誘導するアポトーシスとBcl-2・Baxの発現変化を検討した。72時間後には約90%の細胞がアポトーシスを示した。フローサイトメトリーでは、早期アポトーシス細胞の一部でBax発現の上昇が認められ、ウェスタンブロットでは検出されなかった。NT2の化学感受性は低いアポトーシス閾値とBax過剰発現によると考察されている。
pmid-9041117.summary_en: This study examined apoptosis induced by cisplatin in the human testicular germ cell tumor line NT2. Annexin V staining showed apoptosis increasing over 72 hours, reaching about 90% of cells. Bcl-2 and Bax levels were measured by flow cytometry and Western blotting. Western blotting showed no change in Bax, but flow cytometry revealed Bax upregulation in a subpopulation of early apoptotic cells, which was confirmed after sorting. The authors suggest NT2 chemosensitivity reflects a low apoptotic threshold with Bax overexpression, and that flow cytometry better detects heterogeneous Bax expression.

pmid-9041167.summary_ja: 局所浸潤性の原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する成人男性の症例報告である。一方の精巣に浸潤性腫瘍や瘢痕を伴わず、管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)が認められた。臨床的にも剖検でも転移は認められず、患者は診断後まもなく死亡した。著者らは、縦隔腫瘍は精巣の in situ 病変を併存する原発性腫瘍であり、性腺外腫瘍が胚細胞起源であることを支持すると提案している。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生に関する文献レビューも示されている。
pmid-9041167.summary_en: This case report describes an adult male with a locally invasive primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. Examination of the testes revealed intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) in one testis, without invasive tumor or scar. No metastases were found clinically or at autopsy, and the patient died shortly after diagnosis. The authors propose that the mediastinal tumor is a primary neoplasm with a concomitant in situ lesion in the testis, supporting a germ cell origin for extragonadal tumors. A literature review on the histogenesis of extragonadal germ cell tumors is also presented.

pmid-9043039.summary_ja: ノルウェーの前向きコホート研究で、約110万人の20〜56歳女性を追跡し、出産歴と卵巣癌の組織型との関連を検討した。間質性腫瘍41例では明確な関連は認められなかった。一方、胚細胞腫瘍71例は高齢出産および最終出産からの期間の短さと関連していた。生殖因子が胚細胞腫瘍と間質性腫瘍のリスクに異なる影響を与える可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9043039.summary_en: This Norwegian prospective cohort study followed about 1.1 million women aged 20 to 56 years to examine associations between full-term pregnancies and ovarian cancer subtypes. Among 41 stromal tumors, no clear associations were found. Among 71 germ cell tumors, incidence was related to high-age childbirth and short time since last birth. The findings suggest that reproductive factors may differentially influence the risk of germ cell versus stromal ovarian tumors.

pmid-9044831.summary_ja: C57BL/6J×LT/SvのF2マウスを用いた連鎖解析により、自然発生卵巣奇形腫の感受性遺伝子を検討した。LT/Svマウスは単為生殖卵子に由来する卵巣奇形腫の発生率が高い。6番染色体上に、半優性様式で奇形腫頻度を高める主要遺伝子座Ots1が同定された。この特異的表現型の遺伝学的基盤を示す研究である。
pmid-9044831.summary_en: This study used genetic linkage analysis in (C57BL/6J x LT/Sv)F2 mice to investigate susceptibility to spontaneous ovarian teratomas. LT/Sv mice have a high incidence of ovarian teratomas that arise from spontaneously parthenogenetic oocytes, a phenomenon rare in other strains such as C57BL/6J. The authors identified a single major locus on chromosome 6, designated Ots1 (ovarian teratoma susceptibility), which increases teratoma frequency in a semidominant manner. The work provides a genetic basis for this unusual phenotype and a model for ovarian teratoma development.

pmid-9046041.summary_ja: マウスの精巣発生、自然発生精巣奇形腫（STT）およびOTT6050奇形癌におけるk-FGF発現を検討した。発生中の胚細胞ではk-FGFは検出されず、Oct-4はこの細胞でk-FGFを活性化しないと考えられた。実験的なOTT6050では高発現、分化したSTTでは低発現であった。k-FGFの活性化は腫瘍発生に関与し、悪性腫瘍のマーカーとなる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9046041.summary_en: This study examined k-FGF (Fgf4) expression during normal mouse testicular development and in spontaneous testicular teratoma (STT) and the OTT6050 teratocarcinoma. k-FGF was not detectable in developing mouse testicular germ cells, despite Oct-4 expression, indicating Oct-4 does not activate k-FGF in these cells. High k-FGF expression was found in the experimental OTT6050 teratocarcinoma, but only low levels in differentiated STT. The authors suggest k-FGF activation may contribute to tumor genesis and serve as a malignancy marker.

pmid-9048924.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者を対象に、BEP化学療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)の前後で精子の染色体異常を評価した研究である。多色蛍光in situハイブリダイゼーション(FISH)法により16万個以上の精子を解析した。治療後に有意差が認められたのは第1染色体のdisomyの減少のみで、性比や倍数体の頻度に変化はなかった。対照健常者との比較でも差はなく、BEP療法が精子の数的染色体異常を増加させないと結論づけられた。
pmid-9048924.summary_en: This study assessed sperm chromosome abnormalities in men with testicular cancer before and after BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin). Using multicolour FISH on over 160,000 sperm, the authors measured disomy for chromosomes 1, 12, X, Y and XY, along with diploid frequency and sex ratio. Most frequencies did not differ significantly after treatment; only chromosome 1 disomy decreased. Values in patients matched those of 10 healthy control donors. The authors concluded that BEP chemotherapy does not increase numerical chromosomal abnormalities in sperm.

pmid-9050059.summary_ja: 先天性仙尾部奇形腫8例を対象に、ras、fos、junなどのがん遺伝子およびp53、nm23-H-1などの腫瘍抑制遺伝子の発現を検討した研究である。発現の強さは腫瘍径、患者の年齢、生存期間と関連せず、未熟奇形腫と成熟奇形腫の間にも差はなかった。これらの遺伝子はSCTに存在し、発生や発達に関与している可能性が示唆されたが、その正確な役割は未解明である。
pmid-9050059.summary_en: This study examined oncoproteins and tumor suppressor proteins in eight cases of congenital sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT), the most common germ cell tumor of infancy. The authors tested ras family oncogenes, fos and jun early genes, and p53 and nm23-H-I tumor suppressors. Expression did not correlate with tumor size, patient age, or survival. Expression also did not differ between immature and mature teratomas. The findings suggest these genes are present in SCT and may play a role in tumor development, though their exact function remains unclear.

pmid-9052478.summary_ja: 両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者13例を対象に、標準的な両側精巣摘除術の代わりに精巣温存的な腫瘍核出術を評価した。腫瘍は6〜30 mmで、腫瘍床と周辺実質の生検が行われた。上皮内癌を有する患者は精巣照射を受け、一部は補助的局所療法を受けた。観察期間中央値62か月で、1例の局所再発を除き全例が無病であった。ホルモン値は補充なしで正常範囲内に保たれた。著者らは、選択された患者に対して臓器温存手術は有効な選択肢であると結論づけている。
pmid-9052478.summary_en: This study evaluated testis-sparing tumour enucleation in 13 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumours, rather than standard bilateral orchidectomy. Tumours of 6 to 30 mm were enucleated, with biopsies of the tumour bed and surrounding parenchyma. Patients with carcinoma in situ received testicular radiation, and some received adjuvant local therapy. With a median follow-up of 62 months, all were disease-free except one local recurrence, which was treated by orchidectomy. Hormone levels stayed normal without androgen replacement. The authors conclude that organ-sparing surgery is a viable option for selected patients.

pmid-9052479.summary_ja: 本研究は、1984年から1992年の間に治療された臨床病期II非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者55例を対象に、RPLNDの前に行う初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法を評価した。化学療法のみで16例(29%)が持続的完全寛解を得た一方、30例(55%)は残存腫瘍のためRPLNDが必要であった。当初反応を示した6例はその後再発した。全体では95%が33～111か月にわたり無病であった。著者らは、初回のシスプラチン併用化学療法が、病期IIのすべてのサブグループにおいて治癒をもたらしうると結論づけている。
pmid-9052479.summary_en: This study evaluated primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy before retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 55 patients with clinical stage II non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours treated between 1984 and 1992. After chemotherapy, 16 patients (29%) achieved sustained complete remission without surgery, while 30 (55%) required RPLND for residual masses. Six patients who had initially responded later relapsed. Overall, 95% remained disease-free at 33 to 111 months. The authors concluded that primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy can cure stage II disease across all subgroups.

pmid-9052480.summary_ja: 1979〜1995年に化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘍を切除された播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍112例を対象とした。組織学的には生存腫瘍が9%、成熟奇形腫が44%、壊死・線維化が44%であった。合併症は18%に発生し、大半は尿路感染症であった。年齢や残存腫瘍径などは合併症と関連しなかった。残存腫瘤の切除は安全性の高い手技であり、化学療法効果の最終評価には手術による評価が依然として標準であると結論づけられた。
pmid-9052480.summary_en: This study reviewed 112 patients with disseminated non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours who underwent resection of retroperitoneal residual masses after chemotherapy from 1979 to 1995. Viable tumour was found in 9%, mature teratoma in 44%, and necrosis or fibrosis in 44%. Complications occurred in 18% of patients, mostly urinary tract infection. Age, residual tumour size, operative duration, prior laparotomy and pathology were not associated with complications. The authors concluded that residual mass resection is a safe procedure, although surgical evaluation remains the gold standard for assessing treatment response.

pmid-9052754.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍細胞株3株と膀胱癌細胞株3株について、シスプラチン曝露後のDNA白金化とその除去能を比較した研究である。精巣腫瘍細胞株では白金の除去が乏しく、N-rasやCD3δ遺伝子でも修復が認められなかった。この修復能の低下が、精巣腫瘍細胞のDNA障害剤に対する過敏性に関与すると結論づけている。
pmid-9052754.summary_en: This 1997 study compared DNA repair capacity and cisplatin sensitivity in three human testicular tumour cell lines and three bladder cancer cell lines. After a 1-hour exposure to 50 µM cisplatin, testicular lines showed lower DNA platinum levels. Over 72 hours, bladder lines removed platinum from the genome, whereas two testicular lines showed little removal. Quantitative PCR of the N-ras and CD3δ genes confirmed repair deficiency in these testicular lines. The authors suggest reduced repair of cisplatin-damaged DNA underlies the hypersensitivity of testicular tumour cells.

pmid-9053482.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の大規模国際共同解析により、予後不良因子(縦隔原発、AFP・hCG・LDHの高値、非肺内臓転移)を同定した。これらを統合し、予後良好・中間・不良の3群に分類した。5年生存率はそれぞれ91%、79%、48%であり、臨床試験や治療判断に用いる国際的な分類として提案された。
pmid-9053482.summary_en: This 1997 collaborative analysis of 5,202 non-seminomatous and 660 seminoma patients with metastatic germ cell tumours identified independent adverse factors, including mediastinal primary site, elevated AFP, hCG and LDH, and non-pulmonary visceral metastases. Integrating these yielded good, intermediate and poor prognosis groups, with 5-year survival of 91%, 79% and 48%, respectively. The International Germ Cell Consensus Classification provides a simple, clinically applicable framework for risk-based treatment decisions and for designing and reporting clinical trials.

pmid-9053485.summary_ja: 病期Iaの悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍24例を対象に、外科的切除後にサーベイランスを行った研究である。中央追跡6.8年で、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は95%であった。再発や二次原発で化学療法を要した8例の多くは救済された。補助化学療法を省くことの妥当性が示された。
pmid-9053485.summary_en: This study evaluated surveillance rather than adjuvant chemotherapy for 24 women with stage Ia malignant ovarian germ cell tumours treated by surgical resection alone. Histologies included dysgerminoma, pure immature teratoma, and endodermal sinus tumour. With a median follow-up of 6.8 years, 5-year overall survival was 95% and disease-free survival 68%. Eight patients needed chemotherapy for recurrence or second primary tumours, and most were salvaged. The authors conclude that careful clinical, radiologic and serologic surveillance avoids unnecessary adjuvant therapy and its complications.

pmid-9056671.summary_ja: 12p上の増幅遺伝子であるサイクリンD2(CCND2)の発現を、ヒト男性胚細胞腫瘍で解析した。異常な胚細胞を含む上皮内病変では全例で発現し、正常胚細胞では発現がなかった。分化度が低い腫瘍ほど発現が高い傾向が見られ、サイクリンD2の異常発現は胚細胞腫瘍発生の初期事象と考えられた。
pmid-9056671.summary_en: This study examined cyclin D2 (CCND2), a gene on the 12p amplicon, in human male germ cell tumours. CCND2 was expressed in all carcinoma in situ/intratubular germ cell neoplasia lesions studied, but not in normal germ cells. Expression was high in tumours lacking differentiation (seminoma) or with primitive differentiation (embryonal carcinoma), and was lower in more differentiated lines, which showed increased p21. The authors propose that aberrant cyclin D2 expression is an early event in germ cell tumorigenesis.

pmid-9058515.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例で血清CA19-9を測定し、胎児性癌の腫瘍マーカーとしての有用性を検討した。胎児性癌の5例で上昇し、治療反応とともに正常化した。組織免疫染色でも胎児性癌と成熟奇形腫で陽性であり、血清CA19-9は胎児性癌の有用なマーカーになりうると示された。
pmid-9058515.summary_en: This study investigated serum CA19-9 as a marker for embryonal carcinoma in 18 male patients with germ cell tumours. Serum CA19-9 was elevated in five of eight embryonal carcinoma patients and normalized with treatment response, while seminoma patients had normal levels. Immunohistochemistry showed CA19-9 positivity in embryonal carcinomas and mature teratomas, faint positivity in seminomas, and negativity in choriocarcinomas, yolk sac tumours and immature teratomas. The authors suggest serum CA19-9 may be a useful marker for embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-9058522.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍64例に対し、短縮型BEP療法の有効性と入院期間を検討した。化学療法単独で54%が完全奏効し、手術と追加化学療法を加えると計89%が腫瘍消失に至った。1コースあたりの入院は平均約65時間に短縮され、従来法と同等の有効性が示唆された。
pmid-9058522.summary_en: This study assessed a condensed BEP regimen (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for metastatic testicular germ cell tumours in 64 consecutive patients. Cisplatin and bleomycin were given as single daily doses, with etoposide over three consecutive days, and mean hospitalization per course was about 65 hours. Of the patients, 54% achieved complete response with chemotherapy alone, and 35% more became tumour-free after surgery and additional chemotherapy. Creatinine clearance was unchanged. The authors suggest this cost-effective, shorter regimen may match conventional efficacy, pending randomized trials.

pmid-9059751.summary_ja: 35歳と29歳の患者に肺転移を伴う胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の2例を報告。核分裂像は10視野あたり9および13個。免疫染色では1例でhPL陽性細胞が優位、もう1例では逆のパターンを示した。DNA解析では1例に四倍体ピークを伴う異数性を認めた。PSTTの臨床経過は予測困難で、信頼できる予後指標は存在しないと結論づけている。
pmid-9059751.summary_en: This report describes two cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) with pulmonary metastasis in patients aged 35 and 29. Mitotic counts were 9 and 13 per 10 high-power fields. Immunohistochemistry showed hPL-positive cells predominating over hCG-reactive cells in one case and the reverse pattern in the other. DNA analysis of one tumor revealed an aneuploid tetraploid pattern. The authors conclude that PSTT clinical behavior is unpredictable and that no reliable prognostic markers currently exist.

pmid-9060133.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の評価にカラードプラ超音波検査が用いられるが、hCG値が上昇していても約25%の症例では異常血管が描出されない。本報告では、カラードプラが陰性であった3例に子宮鏡下で筋層生検を行い、栄養膜腫瘍を確認した。小さな腫瘍巣はドプラで検出されない可能性があり、遺残性胞状奇胎の管理に影響しうると述べている。
pmid-9060133.summary_en: Color Doppler ultrasonography is widely used to evaluate gestational trophoblastic disease, yet about 25% of patients with suggestive hCG levels show no abnormal uterine vessels. This report describes three such cases in which hysteroscopic myometrial biopsies were obtained and confirmed trophoblastic tumor. The authors suggest Doppler may miss small tumor foci, with possible implications for other tumor types and for the management of persistent molar disease.

pmid-9060597.summary_ja: 精巣の非典型的なトロホブラスト腫瘍2例を報告する。1例は19歳男性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、hCG陽性の「単相性」絨毛癌結節が主成分であった。もう1例は16か月男児の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で、精巣摘除術のみで8年間のフォローアップ中健康であった。鑑別診断としてセミノーマ、卵黄嚢腫瘍、ライディッヒ細胞腫が論じられている。
pmid-9060597.summary_en: The authors describe two unusual testicular trophoblastic tumors. The first was a mixed germ cell tumor in a 19-year-old man, with a predominant component of 'monophasic' choriocarcinoma nodules that were diffusely hCG-positive. The second occurred in a 16-month-old boy and was a pure placental site trophoblastic tumor identical to its uterine counterpart; it was treated with orchiectomy alone, and the patient was well at 8-year follow-up. Differential diagnoses including seminoma, yolk sac tumor, and Leydig cell tumor are discussed.

pmid-9062164.summary_ja: 45XO/46XY核型を有する39歳女性の非妊娠性絨毛癌に対し、大量化学療法と自家幹細胞移植を施行した症例報告。初回のシスプラチンとエトポシドでβ-hCGは正常化したが、肺および縦隔への再発を来した。救済治療後に完全寛解を得て、17か月間無再発で経過した。化学感受性のある非妊娠性絨毛癌では大量化学療法が有効な可能性を示唆している。
pmid-9062164.summary_en: A 39-year-old woman with a 45XO/46XY karyotype and pure gonadal choriocarcinoma with lung metastasis achieved normalized serum beta-hCG after six cycles of cisplatin and etoposide, but later relapsed with lung and mediastinal metastases. After priming chemotherapy, she received high-dose carboplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide with autologous stem cell rescue, plus thoracoscopic resection of residual lung lesions. She achieved complete remission and remained disease-free at 17 months, suggesting that high-dose chemotherapy may help chemosensitive nongestational choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9062167.summary_ja: 甲状腺組織からなる特殊型奇形腫である卵巣甲状腺腫が再発し、悪性転化を来して腹腔内、後腹膜、肝転移を生じた症例を報告。播種性病変の診断と治療経過を記載している。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化は稀で、再発や転移を来すことはさらに稀であるため、臨床的に重要な症例である。
pmid-9062167.summary_en: The authors report a recurrent struma ovarii, a specialized teratoma composed of thyroid tissue, that showed malignant transformation with intraperitoneal, retroperitoneal, and hepatic metastases. The report describes the diagnosis and treatment of this disseminated case. Malignant transformation of struma ovarii is uncommon and rarely recurs or metastasizes, which makes this case clinically important. It adds to the limited literature on management options for disseminated disease.

pmid-9062576.summary_ja: 固形腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的解析にFISHとCGHを応用した方法論的研究。精巣胚細胞腫瘍ではFISHでi(12p)マーカー染色体をさらに特徴づけ、CGHで腫瘍形成や進展に関与しうる染色体領域を同定した。ぶどう膜メラノーマでは、3番染色体のモノソミーが予後不良の指標となることを示した。本手法は従来の核型分析を補完する有用性を示した。
pmid-9062576.summary_en: This methodological study applies fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) and comparative genomic hybridization (CGH) to the cytogenetic analysis of solid tumors. In testicular germ cell tumors, FISH further characterized the i(12p) marker chromosome, and CGH identified chromosomal subregions potentially involved in tumorigenesis or progression. In uveal melanoma, CGH showed monosomy 3 to be a statistically significant marker of poor prognosis.

pmid-9062579.summary_ja: 雄核発生胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、正常胎盤におけるIGF2およびH19の発現とH19のメチル化状態を検討。奇胎では正常胎盤と同程度のH19発現を示した。絨毛癌ではIGF2発現が低くH19発現が高く、遺伝子全体にわたる過メチル化を伴っていた。変異したプロモーターがメチル化による転写抑制を回避している可能性を示唆し、絨毛癌発生の一因として考察している。
pmid-9062579.summary_en: The authors examined IGF2 and H19 expression and H19 methylation in androgenetic moles, choriocarcinomas, and normal placentae. Androgenetic moles resembled normal placentae in H19 expression, whereas choriocarcinomas showed low IGF2 and high H19 expression accompanied by hypermethylation across the H19 gene. The unmethylated active H19 allele in placentae became heavily methylated in tumors, suggesting that a mutated promoter may allow transcription despite methylation, contributing to choriocarcinoma development.

pmid-9066750.summary_ja: 15歳以上の未熟縦隔奇形腫11例(自験2例、文献9例)をレビューした。生存例はいずれも腫瘍を完全切除されていた。AFP高値例には術前化学療法、腫瘍マーカー陰性例には術後化学療法が行われていた。不完全切除または化学療法未実施例は予後不良であった。完全な外科的切除と化学療法の併用が長期生存に不可欠と結論している。
pmid-9066750.summary_en: This report reviews 11 patients over 15 years old with primary immature mediastinal teratoma, including two of the authors' cases and nine from the literature. All survivors had complete tumor resection. Patients with high alpha-fetoprotein received preoperative chemotherapy, while those negative for tumor markers received postoperative chemotherapy and survived long-term. Incomplete resection or omission of chemotherapy was associated with a poor outcome. The authors conclude that complete surgical resection combined with chemotherapy is essential for long-term survival.

pmid-9066751.summary_ja: 小児に発生する悪性胚細胞腫瘍を扱ったレビューである。化学療法の進歩により、治療における外科の役割が明確になった。血清腫瘍マーカーは病勢と治療効果の評価に有用である。精巣腫瘍は外科的管理のみで高い治癒率が得られるが、他部位の腫瘍では生検、化学療法、外科的切除を慎重に計画する必要がある。
pmid-9066751.summary_en: This pediatric surgical oncology review focuses on malignant germ cell tumors, which arise in children at various trunk and cranial sites. Advances in chemotherapy have clarified the surgeon's role in treatment. Serum tumor markers are reliable for monitoring disease progression and treatment success. Surgical management alone yields high cure rates for testicular tumors, whereas tumors at other sites require careful planning of biopsy, chemotherapy, and surgical excision.

pmid-9068117.summary_ja: 25歳男性の原発性後腹膜奇形腫の症例報告である。超音波検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で極めて非典型的な画像形態を示した。腫瘍は外科的切除され、病理組織学的検査で原発性良性後腹膜奇形腫と確定診断された。この稀な疾患に特徴的な画像所見を示した報告である。
pmid-9068117.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with primary retroperitoneal teratoma. Ultrasound and CT showed an unusual imaging morphology. The tumor was resected, and histopathological examination confirmed a diagnosis of primary benign retroperitoneal teratoma. The report highlights a distinctive imaging appearance of this rare entity, which may aid in its recognition before surgery.

pmid-9069232.summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児に発生した悪性胃奇形腫の症例報告である。腹部腫瘤に対し、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と超音波検査で多房性の大きな腫瘍が確認された。腫瘍は完全に切除され、病理学的に悪性胃奇形腫と診断された。12か月のフォローアップでは合併症なく経過した。
pmid-9069232.summary_en: This case report describes a 4-month-old boy with an abdominal mass, in whom CT and ultrasound revealed a large multiloculated tumor. The tumor was completely excised, and pathology confirmed a malignant gastric teratoma. Because gastric teratomas are rare and usually benign, this malignant case is notable. Twelve-month follow-up was uneventful.

pmid-9069238.summary_ja: 新生児の破裂臍帯ヘルニアを呈した症例である。長い管状腸管重複症の末端から発生した胎児様奇形腫が、短い腸管と併存していた。治療方針について考察し、関連文献をレビューしている。腸管重複症が破裂臍帯ヘルニアの原因である可能性が示唆され、稀な病態として臨床的な意義が大きい。
pmid-9069238.summary_en: This report describes a neonate with a ruptured exomphalos caused by a fetiform teratoma arising from the end of a long tubular intestinal duplication with a short gut. The authors discuss management of this rare presentation and review the relevant literature. The case suggests that the intestinal duplication was a probable cause of the ruptured exomphalos.

pmid-9071297.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫2例のMR所見を後方視的に検討し、病理所見と対比した研究である。両腫瘍は多房性嚢胞と充実成分からなる複雑な腫瘤であった。充実成分はガドリニウム投与後に強く造影され、腹水と腹膜肥厚も認めた。T2強調像で高信号の充実成分とT1強調像で高信号の嚢胞を伴う混合性腫瘤が本疾患の特徴とされる。
pmid-9071297.summary_en: This retrospective study describes the MR appearance of struma ovarii in two patients and correlates the findings with pathology. Both tumors were complex masses with multiple cysts and solid components. The solid components showed marked contrast enhancement after gadolinium administration, and ascites and peritoneal thickening were present. The authors conclude that a mixed mass with T2-hyperintense solid components and T1-hyperintense cysts is characteristic of struma ovarii.

pmid-9072011.summary_ja: 正常な胎盤形成、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるトランスグルタミナーゼ(tTG)発現を検討した研究である。tTGの発現は妊娠初期から発生段階に応じて細胞型ごとに変化した。胞状奇胎および絨毛癌では発現が不均一であった。tTGは栄養膜の機能や浸潤の制御に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9072011.summary_en: This study examines tissue transglutaminase (tTG) expression during normal human placentation and in complete hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma. tTG expression is developmentally regulated, appearing in cytotrophoblast before 6-7 weeks and in syncytiotrophoblast thereafter. Expression is heterogeneous in intermediate trophoblast from molar pregnancies and in choriocarcinoma cells. The authors suggest tTG participates in trophoblastic functions and in controlling invasion.

pmid-9072585.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍75例の後方視的解析。BEP 3サイクル・4サイクル、エトポシド・シスプラチン4サイクルで治療し、無病生存率はそれぞれ96%、100%、83%。エトポシド・シスプラチン4サイクル群は病死率が高く、両レジメンの同等性を検討する無作為化試験の必要性が示された。
pmid-9072585.summary_en: Retrospective single-institution review of 75 patients with good-risk metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor treated with 4 cycles of BEP (17), 3 cycles of BEP (23), or 4 cycles of etoposide and cisplatin (35). All achieved response with normalized markers, and the overall no evidence of disease rate was 91% at median 3.5 years. Disease-related death occurred in 11% of the etoposide-cisplatin group versus 3% of the BEP group. The authors conclude that four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin may be inferior and call for a randomized trial.

pmid-9072586.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマ55例で、化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対する外科的切除を検討。3cm以上の腫瘤の30%に生存腫瘍が残存し、3cm未満の腫瘤は壊死組織であった。3cm未満の残存腫瘤では手術の利益はなく、3cm以上では治療効果判定と生存腫瘍の切除のため手術を推奨している。
pmid-9072586.summary_en: Single-center series of 55 patients with advanced seminoma who underwent surgical exploration of a post-chemotherapy mass on CT. Among 27 masses of 3 cm or larger, 30% contained residual tumor, whereas masses smaller than 3 cm were necrotic. Well-defined masses were resected more often than poorly defined ones, and patients with poorly defined masses had poorer outcomes. The authors advise against surgery for residual masses under 3 cm and recommend surgery for masses of 3 cm or larger to define response and resect viable tumor.

pmid-9073306.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマの治療に関する総説。標準治療はエトポシド・シスプラチンで、約90%に持続的奏効が得られる。エトポシド・カルボプラチンは効果が劣るが、新しいカルボプラチン併用療法は同等の可能性がある。化学療法後の3cm未満の残存病変は経過観察が可能で、3cm以上は生存腫瘍を含むことが多く外科的評価が推奨される。
pmid-9073306.summary_en: Narrative update on treatment of advanced seminoma. Etoposide plus cisplatin is considered the standard, with durable response in about 90% of patients. Etoposide plus carboplatin is less effective, although newer carboplatin-based combinations may be comparable. Residual disease under 3 cm can be safely observed after chemotherapy, whereas residuals over 3 cm often contain viable tumor and warrant surgical evaluation.

pmid-9076455.summary_ja: ノルウェー放射線病院で、シスプラチン併用導入化学療法後に生存腫瘍が残存した悪性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍27例を解析。5年生存率は43%。術前に腫瘍マーカーが上昇していた例は11%、正常例は62%で、初期腫瘍量が大きい例の予後は極めて不良だった。新規治療の開発が必要とされた。
pmid-9076455.summary_en: Norwegian Radium Hospital review of 27 patients with viable residual malignant nonseminomatous germ cell tumor found at postchemotherapy surgery after cisplatin-based induction chemotherapy. Sixteen relapsed after surgery, and 5-year survival was 43%. Patients with elevated AFP or hCG before surgery had 11% survival versus 62% with normal markers, and large initial tumor volume predicted 9% versus 84% survival. The authors call for new treatments, including high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support.

pmid-9076475.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の2症例で父親になった例を報告。1例は異時性両側精巣腫瘍、もう1例は片側腫瘍と対側上皮内癌(CIS)であった。単独精巣でも不妊とは限らず、精子形成が保たれ妊孕性を望む場合は、綿密なフォローアップを前提に対側CISの監視療法も選択肢になりうるとしている。
pmid-9076475.summary_en: Report of two men with testicular germ cell tumor who fathered children: one with metachronous bilateral tumors and one with a unilateral tumor and contralateral carcinoma in situ. The authors conclude that patients with bilateral tumors or CIS in a solitary testis are not necessarily infertile. Surveillance may be an option for contralateral CIS when spermatogenesis is active and paternity is desired, provided close follow-up is arranged.

pmid-9086355.summary_ja: 77歳男性が無痛性の右精巣腫大で受診し、高位鼠径精巣摘除術を受けた。組織学的には奇形腫を伴うカルチノイドと診断された。術後4か月のCTで肺と後腹膜リンパ節に多発転移を認めたが、化学療法は奏効しなかった。再発後3か月で肺転移により死亡した。奇形腫成分を伴う原発性精巣カルチノイドの稀な症例とその経過を報告している。
pmid-9086355.summary_en: A 77-year-old man presented with a painless right testicular swelling and underwent high inguinal orchiectomy. Histology revealed a carcinoid tumor with teratoma. Four months later, CT showed multiple lung and retroperitoneal lymph node metastases. Chemotherapy had no effect on these metastases. The patient developed recurrence and died of lung metastasis three months after recurrence. This case report documents an unusual primary testicular carcinoid with teratomatous components and its aggressive clinical course.

pmid-9090481.summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍に関する近年の文献を概説している。治療成績は世界的に改善しつつある。純粋なディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に対しては、手術後の化学療法が放射線療法より妊孕性に影響しにくいとされる。卵巣カルチノイドの臨床病理学的検討や、Y染色体を欠く性腺芽細胞腫の症例報告も取り上げている。
pmid-9090481.summary_en: This review summarizes recent literature on malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. It notes an increasingly successful worldwide trend in treatment outcomes. For pure dysgerminoma, surgery followed by chemotherapy is highlighted as less likely to affect fertility than radiation therapy. A clinicopathological study of ovarian carcinoid tumors is discussed, along with case reports of gonadoblastomas in patients lacking Y-chromosome material.

pmid-9093705.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマに対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた45例の後方視的解析である。治療前の腫瘤径が5cmを超える場合、残存腫瘤が残りやすかった。残存腫瘤を有する33例の大半は、観察のみまたは放射線療法による補助療法を受け、再発はどちらの群でも稀であった。再発は腫瘤径や補助療法の有無とは関連しなかった。
pmid-9093705.summary_en: This retrospective study of 45 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for advanced seminoma examines residual masses after treatment. Residual masses were more likely when the pre-treatment mass exceeded 5 cm. Of 33 patients with residual masses, most were observed or received adjuvant radiotherapy, and recurrence was rare in both groups. Recurrence was not linked to residual mass size or adjuvant therapy. Residual masses persisted in 73% of cases.

pmid-9093706.summary_ja: 2施設で治療された男性胚細胞腫瘍患者530例を後方視的に検討し、シスプラチン併用化学療法後2年以上経過して生じた晩期再発を解析した。5年および10年の累積再発率はそれぞれ1.1%と4.0%であった。補助化学療法を受けた患者に晩期再発はなく、予後良好な非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では再発リスクが低かった。切除可能な局所病変は外科的切除で治癒しうる。生涯にわたる年1回のフォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-9093706.summary_en: This two-institution retrospective review of 530 male germ cell tumor patients examines late relapse, defined as occurring more than two years after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The cumulative late relapse risk was 1.1% at five years and 4.0% at ten years. Patients receiving adjuvant chemotherapy had no late relapses, and risk was lower in good-risk nonseminomatous tumors. Localized resectable disease could be cured surgically. Annual follow-up throughout life is recommended.

pmid-9094031.summary_ja: AFP陽性の小児73例でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の分画解析を行い、卵黄嚢腫瘍、肝芽腫、良性肝疾患を鑑別した。93.2%の検体で型を正しく分類できた。新生児卵巣腫瘍や血清AFPが低い再発卵黄嚢腫瘍の診断に有用であった。小児のAFP陽性疾患、特に胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別診断にも役立つ。
pmid-9094031.summary_en: This study applies AFP subfractionation to 73 AFP-positive infants and children to distinguish yolk sac tumor, hepatoblastoma, and benign hepatic disease. Profiles were correctly classified in 93.2% of samples. The technique helped diagnose neonatal ovarian tumors and recurrent yolk sac tumor with low serum AFP. It also aids differential diagnosis of pediatric liver masses and germ cell tumors. The authors recommend this inexpensive, 48-hour test for pediatric liver disease.

pmid-9094243.summary_ja: 本報告は、腹部腫瘤内に胎児内胎児と2個の奇形腫を伴った新生児女児の症例である。妊娠28週の産科超音波検査で異常が発見され、出生後の超音波検査で脊柱や骨格構造から胎児内胎児が疑われた。術前の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により組織構成と血流分布が評価され、病理学的検査で確定診断された。本稀少疾患の成因と画像診断について文献的考察を行っている。
